Obstructing the officer in the exercise of a power that the warrant confers is an offence punishable on conviction by a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months.
notes: Correct: section 47(2)(a) lets an authorized officer authorized under the warrant call on any person to assist the officer in entering and searching the premises that the officer is empowered to enter and search.
Correct: section 47(2)(c) lets the officer remove by force any person or thing obstructing the officer in the exercise of those powers.

Correct: section 47(2)(d) lets the officer detain any person found on the premises who appears to the officer to be, or to be likely to be, able to give information relevant to the investigation of the suspected offence, until the premises have been searched.
Correct: section 47(3) requires an authorized officer who enters any premises under the section to produce the warrant for inspection, if required.

Correct: section 47(4) makes a person who obstructs an authorized officer exercising a power conferred by a warrant or by section 47(2) liable on conviction to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 裁判官已發出手令，授權獲授權人員進入和搜查懷疑有人於其內犯在沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務的罪行的處所。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 該人員可召請任何人協助該人員進入和搜查其獲手令賦權進入和搜查的處所。
如有任何人或物件妨礙該人員行使根據手令獲賦予的權力，該人員可以武力移去該人或物件。
在處所內發現、該人員覺得有能力或相當可能有能力提供攸關調查資料的人，可被扣留至搜查完畢。
根據該手令進入該處所的獲授權人員，在有人提出要求時，須出示該手令供查閱。
妨礙該人員行使手令所授予權力的人，即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。
notes: 正確：第47(2)(a)條訂明，根據手令獲授權的獲授權人員可召請任何人協助該人員進入和搜查如此獲賦權進入和搜查的處所。
正確：第47(2)(c)條訂明，該人員可以武力移去任何妨礙該人員行使該等權力的人或物件。
正確：第47(2)(d)條訂明，在覺得於該處所內發現的某人有能力（或相當可能有能力）提供攸關涉嫌罪行的調查的資料的情況下，該人員可扣留該人，直至該處所搜查完畢為止。
正確：第47(3)條規定，根據該條進入任何處所的獲授權人員在有人提出要求時，須出示有關手令供查閱。
正確：第47(4)條訂明，任何人妨礙獲授權人員行使手令或第47(2)條授予的權力，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(2)至(7)條

en.q: An authorized officer arrests a person without a warrant, having reasonable grounds to suspect that the person is operating a money service without a licence. Which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: On request, the officer who arrested the person must produce evidence of his or her appointment as an authorized officer.
If the officer considers further enquiries necessary, the person must be taken first to a police station and then to a Customs and Excise office.
The person may be held in detention for up to 72 hours before being charged and brought before a magistrate.
The officer may search the place of arrest and its surrounding areas for anything that may be related to the suspected offence.
If the person forcibly resists the arrest, the officer may use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest.
Any search of the arrested person must be carried out by an authorized officer who is of the same sex as that person.
notes: Correct: section 48(2) requires an authorized officer who arrests or detains a person under the section to produce evidence of his or her appointment as an authorized officer, if requested.

Incorrect: section 48(3) requires the arrested person to be taken immediately to a police station or, if in the officer's opinion further enquiries are necessary, first to an office of the Customs and Excise Department and then to a police station; the order is the other way round.
Incorrect: section 48(4) provides that a person, whether arrested or not, must not be detained for more than 48 hours without being charged and brought before a magistrate.

Correct: section 48(6)(a) lets an officer who has arrested a person search the person, or the place at which the person has been arrested and its surrounding areas, for anything that may be related to the suspected offence.
Correct: section 48(5) lets the authorized officer use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest or detention if a person forcibly resists or attempts to evade it.
Correct: section 48(7) provides that a person may be searched only by an authorized officer of the same sex.

tc.q: 獲授權人員有合理理由懷疑某人正在沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務，無需手令而將該人拘捕。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 應要求時，作出拘捕的人員須出示證據，證明其獲委任為獲授權人員。
如該人員認為有需要作進一步查訊，須先將該人帶往警署，然後帶往香港海關辦事處。
該人可被扣留最多72小時，然後才予落案起訴及帶到裁判法院應訊。
該人員可搜查該人被拘捕的地方及其周邊範圍，以搜尋可能關乎涉嫌罪行的任何物件。
如該人強行反抗拘捕，該人員可使用合理所需的武力，以拘捕該人。
對被拘捕的人進行的任何搜查，均須由與該人同一性別的獲授權人員進行。
notes: 正確：第48(2)條規定，根據該條拘捕或扣留任何人的獲授權人員，在有人提出要求時，須出示其獲委任為獲授權人員的證據。
不正確：第48(3)條規定，獲授權人員須立即將被拘捕的人帶往警署；如該人員認為有需要作進一步的查訊，則須先行將該人帶往香港海關辦事處，然後才帶往警署，次序剛好相反。
不正確：第48(4)條訂明，任何人無論已被拘捕與否，均不得被扣留超過48小時而不予落案起訴及帶到裁判法院應訊。
正確：第48(6)(a)條訂明，已根據該條在某地方拘捕任何人的獲授權人員，可搜查該人或該地方及其周邊範圍，以搜尋可能關乎與涉嫌罪行有關的任何物件。
正確：第48(5)條訂明，如任何人強行反抗或企圖逃避拘捕或扣留，獲授權人員可使用合理所需的武力，以拘捕或扣留該人。
正確：第48(7)條訂明，對任何人進行的搜查，只可由與該人性別相同的獲授權人員進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第26條、第45(3)條及第50、51及58條

en.q: Regarding delegation, regulations, guidelines and the amendment of Schedules under the AMLO's provisions on money service operation and on the Review Tribunal, which of the following are correct?
statements: Subject to some exceptions, the Commissioner of Customs and Excise may in writing delegate functions under the Ordinance to public officers employed in the Customs and Excise Department.
Making regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions regulating the operation of money service is a function the Commissioner of Customs and Excise must not delegate.
By notice published in the Gazette, the Commissioner may amend Schedule 3, the Schedule specifying the fees payable under the provisions regulating money service.
By notice published in the Gazette, the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may amend Schedule 4, which has effect with respect to the Review Tribunal.
The guidelines the Commissioner publishes on how the power to order a licensee to pay a pecuniary penalty will be exercised are not subsidiary legislation.
notes: Correct: section 26(1) lets the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, subject to section 26(2), delegate in writing any of his or her functions under the Ordinance to any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department.

Correct: section 26(2) provides that the Commissioner of Customs and Excise must not delegate any of the functions under section 26 or section 51, and section 51 is the power to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of Part 5.
Correct: section 50 provides that the Commissioner may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Schedule 3, which specifies the fees under sections 28, 30, 31 and 35 to 39.

Correct: section 58(1) gives Schedule 4 effect with respect to the Tribunal, and section 58(2) lets the Secretary, whom section 54 defines as the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, amend Schedule 4 by notice published in the Gazette.

Correct: section 45(3) provides that guidelines published under section 45(1), which indicate how the Commissioner proposes to exercise the power to impose a pecuniary penalty referred to in section 43(2)(c), are not subsidiary legislation.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》中規管經營金錢服務及關於覆核審裁處的條文，關於轉授職能、規例、指引及修訂附表，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 除若干例外外，海關關長可藉書面將其在本條例下的職能轉授予受僱於香港海關的公職人員。
為更佳地施行規管經營金錢服務的條文而訂立規例的職能，海關關長不得轉授。
關長可藉憲報公告，修訂指明規管經營金錢服務的條文下須繳付的費用的附表3。
財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告，修訂就覆核審裁處具有效力的附表4。
關長就如何行使命令持牌人繳付罰款的權力而公布的指引，不是附屬法例。
notes: 正確：第26(1)條訂明，除第26(2)條另有規定外，海關關長可藉書面將其在本條例下的職能，轉授予任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員。
正確：第26(2)條訂明，海關關長不得轉授第26條或第51條所指的職能；第51條是為更佳地施行第5部的條文及達致該部的目的而訂立規例的權力。
正確：第50條訂明，關長可藉憲報公告修訂附表3；附表3指明第28、30、31及35至39條所指的費用。
正確：第58(1)條訂明附表4就審裁處具有效力，第58(2)條則訂明局長（第54條界定為財經事務及庫務局局長）可藉憲報公告修訂附表4。
正確：第45(3)條訂明，根據第45(1)條刊登及公布、示明關長擬如何行使第43(2)(c)條所提述的施加罰款權力的指引，不是附屬法例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52及53條

en.q: Regarding the offence of giving false information in connection with a licence application under the AMLO, and the prosecution of offences under its provisions regulating money service, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person who makes a statement false in a material particular in connection with an application to renew a licence commits an offence if reckless as to whether it is false.
The offence of making a false or misleading statement in connection with a licence application can be committed by any person, not only by the applicant.
The offence of making a false or misleading statement also covers one made in an application for approval of a person proposing to become a licensee's director.
A person convicted of making a false or misleading statement in connection with a licence application is liable to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
Proceedings for an offence under the AMLO's provisions regulating money service, other than an indictable offence, may be instituted within 12 months after the offence is committed.
notes: Correct: section 52(1) makes it an offence for a person, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, to make a statement false or misleading in a material particular, knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, it is false or misleading in a material particular.
Correct: section 52(1) applies to any person who, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, makes such a statement; it is not confined to the applicant.

Incorrect: section 52(1) applies to statements made in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence; an application for approval of a proposed director under section 35 is not such an application.
Correct: section 52(3) makes a person who commits an offence under section 52(1) or (2) liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

Incorrect: section 53 lets proceedings for an offence under Part 5, other than an indictable offence, be instituted within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner, not after it is committed.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》所訂在與牌照申請有關連的情況下提供虛假資料的罪行，以及就該條例中規管經營金錢服務的條文所訂罪行提出檢控，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人罔顧陳述是否虛假，而在與牌照續期申請有關連的情況下作出在要項上屬虛假的陳述，即屬犯罪。
在與牌照申請有關連的情況下作出虛假或具誤導性陳述的罪行，任何人均可干犯，不限於申請人。
作出虛假或具誤導性陳述的罪行，亦涵蓋在要求批准某人成為持牌人董事的申請中所作的陳述。
任何人在與牌照申請有關連的情況下作出虛假或具誤導性陳述，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
就規管經營金錢服務的條文所訂罪行（可公訴罪行除外）提出的法律程序，可於罪行發生後12個月內提出。
notes: 正確：第52(1)條訂明，任何人在與要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請有關連的情況下，作出在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的陳述，並知道或罔顧該陳述是否在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性，即屬犯罪。
正確：第52(1)條適用於在與要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請有關連的情況下作出該等陳述的任何人，並不限於申請人。
不正確：第52(1)條適用於在與要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請有關連的情況下作出的陳述；根據第35條要求批准擬任董事的申請並非該等申請。
正確：第52(3)條訂明，任何人犯第52(1)或(2)條所訂罪行，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
不正確：第53條訂明，就第5部所訂罪行（可公訴罪行除外）而提出的法律程序，可於關長發現或知悉有關罪行後12個月內提出，並非自罪行發生起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第54至56條

en.q: Regarding the tribunal that the AMLO establishes to review specified decisions, which of the following are correct?
statements: In English, the tribunal established to review specified decisions is called the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Appeal Tribunal.
Except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, the tribunal consists of a chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury.
The tribunal's chairperson must be a person eligible for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance.
The tribunal's chairperson must not be a public officer, unless he or she is a public officer only by virtue of chairing a board or tribunal established under an Ordinance.
If the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury considers it appropriate, the Secretary may establish additional tribunals for the purposes of any reviews.
notes: Incorrect: section 55(1) establishes the tribunal as the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal; it is a review tribunal, not an appeal tribunal.

Correct: section 56(1) provides that, except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, the Tribunal consists of a chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary, whom section 54 defines as the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury.
Correct: section 56(2)(a) requires the chairperson to be a person who is eligible for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance (Cap. 4).

Correct: section 56(2)(b) requires the chairperson to be a person who is not a public officer or is a public officer by virtue only of being the chairperson of a board or tribunal established under an Ordinance.
Correct: section 55(3) lets the Secretary, if the Secretary considers it appropriate to do so, establish additional tribunals for the purposes of any reviews.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》為覆核指明決定而設立的審裁處，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 為覆核指明決定而設立的審裁處，其中文名稱為「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集上訴審裁處」。
除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由財經事務及庫務局局長委任的一名主席及2名其他成員組成。
審裁處主席須屬具資格根據《高等法院條例》（第4章）第9條獲委任為法官的人。
審裁處主席須不屬公職人員，或僅因擔任根據條例設立的委員會或審裁處的主席而屬公職人員。
財經事務及庫務局局長如認為適當，可為任何覆核的目的，增設其他審裁處。
notes: 不正確：第55(1)條設立的審裁處，中文名稱為「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處」；是覆核審裁處，並非上訴審裁處。
正確：第56(1)條訂明，除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由局長委任的一名主席及2名其他成員組成；第54條將局長界定為財經事務及庫務局局長。
正確：第56(2)(a)條規定，審裁處主席須具資格根據《高等法院條例》（第4章）第9條獲委任為法官。
正確：第56(2)(b)條規定，審裁處主席須不屬公職人員，或僅憑藉根據任何條例設立的委員會或審裁處的主席的身分而屬公職人員。
正確：第55(3)條訂明，局長如認為適當，可為任何覆核的目的而增設審裁處。

source.en: AMLO s.54 (definition of “specified decision”, paragraph (d)) and s.43(1)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第54條（「指明決定」的定義(d)段）及第43(1)條

en.q: A person aggrieved by a specified decision made in relation to the person may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of it. Which of the following are specified decisions under the AMLO?
statements: The Commissioner's decision, on granting a licence, to impose a condition on the licence
The Commissioner's refusal to approve a person becoming a partner in a partnership that is a licensee
The Commissioner's refusal of a licensee's application to operate a money service at particular premises
A court's order disqualifying a person convicted of operating a money service without a licence from holding one
The Commissioner's decision, on renewing a licence, to amend or remove one of the licence's conditions
The Commissioner's decision to publicly reprimand a licensee that has contravened a condition of its licence
notes: Correct: paragraph (d)(ii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to impose a licence condition under section 30.

Correct: paragraph (d)(x) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to refuse to give approval to a person becoming a partner in a partnership that is a licensee under section 37.

Correct: paragraph (d)(xii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to refuse to grant an application to operate a money service at particular premises under section 39.

Incorrect: the definition of specified decision in section 54 lists decisions of the Monetary Authority, the Securities and Futures Commission, the Insurance Authority, the Commissioner and the Registrar; an order of a court or magistrate disqualifying a person from holding a licence under section 29(3) is not among them.

Incorrect: paragraph (d)(iv) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to amend or impose a licence condition under section 31; a decision to remove a condition is not listed.

Correct: paragraph (d)(xiii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to exercise any of the powers under section 43, which include publicly reprimanding a licensee that contravenes any of the conditions of its licence.

tc.q: 任何人如因就其作出的指明決定感到受屈，可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些屬指明決定？
statements: 關長在批給牌照時，對所批給的牌照施加條件的決定
關長拒絕給予批准讓某人成為屬持牌人的合夥的合夥人的決定
關長拒絕批准持牌人要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請的決定
法庭取消被裁定無牌經營金錢服務的人持有牌照資格的命令
關長在將牌照續期時，修改或免除該牌照的條件的決定
關長公開譴責違反其牌照的任何條件的持牌人的決定
notes: 正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(ii)段涵蓋由關長作出的根據第30條施加牌照條件的決定。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(x)段涵蓋由關長作出的拒絕根據第37條給予批准讓某人成為屬持牌人的合夥的合夥人的決定。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(xii)段涵蓋由關長作出的拒絕根據第39條批准要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請的決定。
不正確：第54條「指明決定」的定義列出的是金融管理專員、證監會、保監局、關長及處長作出的決定；法庭或裁判官根據第29(3)條作出的取消持有牌照資格的命令並不在列。
不正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(iv)段涵蓋由關長作出的根據第31條修改或施加牌照條件的決定；免除條件的決定並不在列。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(xiii)段涵蓋由關長作出的行使第43條所指的任何權力的決定，而該等權力包括公開譴責違反其牌照的任何條件的持牌人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第54條、第59(5)條、第60(1)及(3)條及第61(1)條

en.q: Regarding how the Review Tribunal deals with an application for review of a specified decision under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: As soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for review, the Tribunal must send a copy of it to the specified authority.
The Tribunal may determine a review by sending the matter back to the specified authority, together with any directions it considers appropriate.
Oral evidence, written statements or documents that the Tribunal receives and considers must be material that would be admissible in a court of law.
The Tribunal may order a person not to publish or otherwise disclose any material that the Tribunal receives for the purposes of the review.
The Tribunal may exercise its powers for the purposes of a review on its own initiative, not only on a party's application.
In reviewing a specified decision, the Tribunal must give the parties, namely the specified authority and the applicant, a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
notes: Correct: section 59(5) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for review, to send a copy of the application to the specified authority.
Correct: section 60(1)(b) lets the Tribunal determine a review by remitting the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate.

Incorrect: section 61(1)(a) lets the Tribunal receive and consider any material by way of oral evidence, written statements or documents, whether or not the material would be admissible in a court of law.
Correct: section 61(1)(g) lets the Tribunal, for the purposes of a review, order a person not to publish or otherwise disclose any material the Tribunal receives.
Correct: section 61(1) lets the Tribunal exercise its powers for the purposes of a review on its own initiative or on the application of any party to the review.

Correct: section 60(3) requires the Tribunal, in reviewing a specified decision, to give the parties to the review a reasonable opportunity to be heard, and section 54 defines the parties as the specified authority that made the decision and the person who makes the application for review.

tc.q: 關於覆核審裁處根據《打擊洗錢條例》處理要求覆核指明決定的申請，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處在接獲覆核申請後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快將該申請的複本送交指明當局。
審裁處可藉將有關事宜發還指明當局處理，並附上它認為適當的指示，對覆核作出裁定。
審裁處收取及考慮的口述證供、書面陳述或文件，須屬在法院中可獲接納為證據的材料。
審裁處可命令任何人不得發表或以其他方式披露審裁處為覆核的目的而收取的任何材料。
審裁處為某項覆核的目的，可主動行使其權力，並不限於應覆核任何一方的申請才行使。
審裁處在覆核某指明決定時，須給予覆核的各方，即指明當局及申請人，合理的陳詞機會。
notes: 正確：第59(5)條規定，審裁處在接獲覆核申請後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快將該申請的複本送交指明當局。
正確：第60(1)(b)條訂明，審裁處可將有關事宜連同它認為適當的任何指示發還有關指明當局處理，以對覆核作出裁定。
不正確：第61(1)(a)條訂明，審裁處可收取及考慮以口述證供、書面陳述或文件提供的材料，不論該等材料在法院中是否可獲接納為證據。
正確：第61(1)(g)條訂明，審裁處為某項覆核的目的，可命令任何人不得發表或以其他方式披露審裁處所收取的任何材料。
正確：第61(1)條訂明，審裁處為某項覆核的目的，可主動或應覆核的任何一方的申請行使其權力。
正確：第60(3)條規定，審裁處在覆核某指明決定時，須給予覆核各方合理的陳詞機會；第54條將覆核各方界定為作出有關指明決定的指明當局及提出有關覆核申請的人。

en.q: Regarding offences, contempt and compelled evidence in connection with proceedings before the Review Tribunal under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person who, without reasonable excuse, threatens or insults the chairperson or another member of the Tribunal on account of the performance of their functions commits an offence.
A person convicted summarily of disrupting a sitting of the Tribunal, without reasonable excuse, is liable to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
A person who, without reasonable excuse, breaches the Tribunal's order prohibiting publication of its determination is liable on indictment to a $1,000,000 fine and 2 years' imprisonment.
The Tribunal has the same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, and must adopt the same standard of proof as that Court in exercising them.
Evidence a witness gives by affidavit on the Tribunal's order is, subject to exceptions, not admissible against the witness in criminal proceedings in a court of law.
notes: Correct: section 61(2)(f) makes it an offence, without reasonable excuse, to threaten, insult or cause any loss to the chairperson or any other member of the Tribunal at any time on account of the performance of the chairperson's or member's functions in that capacity.
Incorrect: section 61(3)(b) provides, for an offence under section 61(2), a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction, not a fine at level 5.

Correct: section 66(3) makes it an offence, without reasonable excuse, to fail to comply with an order under section 66(2) prohibiting the publication or disclosure of the Tribunal's determination, and section 66(4)(a) sets a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment.

Correct: section 63(1) gives the Tribunal the same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, and section 63(3) requires it to adopt the same standard of proof as that Court in exercising those powers.

Correct: section 62(1) and (2) make evidence given in accordance with an order of the Tribunal under section 61(1)(f) to provide evidence by affidavit inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings in a court of law, subject to the exceptions in section 62(3) for offences under section 61(2)(a) or Part V of the Crimes Ordinance.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於與覆核審裁處的法律程序有關的罪行、藐視罪及強迫提供的證據，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人無合理辯解而因審裁處主席或成員執行職能，而威脅或侮辱該主席或成員，即屬犯罪。
無合理辯解而干擾審裁處聆訊使其無法進行的人，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
沒有合理辯解而違反審裁處禁止發表其裁定的命令的人，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
審裁處懲罰藐視罪者的權力與原訟法庭相同，而在行使該權力時，其舉證準則亦須與原訟法庭所採用的相同。
證人按審裁處的命令以誓章提供的證據，除例外情況外，不得在法院的刑事法律程序中獲接納為針對該證人的證據。
notes: 正確：第61(2)(f)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而因審裁處主席或任何其他成員以主席或成員身分執行職能，而在任何時間威脅或侮辱主席或該成員，或令其蒙受損失，即屬犯罪。
不正確：第61(3)(b)條訂明，任何人犯第61(2)條所訂罪行，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月，並非第5級罰款。
正確：第66(3)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而沒有遵從審裁處根據第66(2)條作出的禁止發表或披露其裁定的命令，即屬犯罪；第66(4)(a)條訂明，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
正確：第63(1)條訂明，審裁處在懲罰犯藐視罪者方面所具有的權力與原訟法庭相同；第63(3)條規定審裁處行使該等權力時，須採用原訟法庭行使相同權力時採用的舉證準則。
正確：第62(1)及(2)條訂明，任何人按照審裁處根據第61(1)(f)條作出的以誓章提供證據的命令而提供的證據，不得在法院的刑事法律程序中獲接納為針對該人的證據；第62(3)條就第61(2)(a)條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部所訂罪行訂有例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第64條、第65(2)至(3)條、第66(1)條及第68(2)條

en.q: Regarding costs, and the orders and determinations of the Review Tribunal, under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Costs the Tribunal awards to a party to the review must be paid by the other party to the review and are recoverable from it as a civil debt.
Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court applies to the award of costs by the Tribunal and to the taxation of any costs it awards.
The provisions on the Review Tribunal do not require an authorized institution acting as banker to an applicant for review to disclose its other customers' affairs.
After completing a review, the Tribunal must, as soon as reasonably practicable, deliver its determination and the reasons for the determination.
Registration in the Court of First Instance makes an order of the Tribunal one that is regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within its jurisdiction.
notes: Correct: section 65(2)(b) provides that costs awarded to a party to the review under section 65(1)(b) must be paid by, and are recoverable as a civil debt from, the other party to the review.
Correct: section 65(3) applies Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court (Cap. 4 sub. leg. A) to the award of costs, and to the taxation of any costs awarded, by the Tribunal under section 65(1).

Correct: section 64 provides that Part 6 and Schedule 4 do not require an authorized institution, acting as the banker or financial adviser of a person who makes an application for review, to disclose information in relation to the affairs of any of its customers other than that person.
Correct: section 66(1)(a) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after completing a review, to deliver its determination and the reasons for the determination.

Correct: section 68(2) provides that an order registered in the Court of First Instance under section 68(1) is to be regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within the jurisdiction of that Court.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於覆核審裁處判給的訟費，以及審裁處的命令及裁定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處判給覆核某一方的訟費，須由該覆核的另一方支付，並可作為民事債項予以追討。
《高等法院規則》第62號命令適用於審裁處判給訟費，亦適用於所判給訟費的評定。
認可機構如擔任覆核申請人的銀行，有關審裁處的條文並不規定其披露其他客戶事務的資料。
審裁處須在完成覆核後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快宣告其裁定及作出該裁定的理由。
審裁處的命令一經在原訟法庭登記，就所有目的而言，即須視為該法庭在其司法管轄權範圍內作出的命令。
notes: 正確：第65(2)(b)條訂明，如審裁處根據第65(1)(b)條將訟費判給覆核的一方，該訟費須由有關覆核的另一方支付，並可作為民事債項予以追討。
正確：第65(3)條訂明，《高等法院規則》（第4章，附屬法例A）第62號命令適用於審裁處根據第65(1)條判給訟費，亦適用於該等訟費的評定。
正確：第64條訂明，凡某認可機構擔任提出覆核申請的人的銀行或財務顧問，第6部及附表4並不規定該機構披露該人以外的該機構客戶的事務的資料。
正確：第66(1)(a)條規定，審裁處須在完成覆核後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快宣告其裁定及作出該裁定的理由。
正確：第68(2)條訂明，就所有目的而言，根據第68(1)條在原訟法庭登記的命令，須視為原訟法庭在其司法管轄權範圍內作出的命令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第70(1)條、第71(1)至(3)條及第72(2)條

en.q: Regarding an appeal to the Court of Appeal against a determination of the Review Tribunal, and stays of the determination, under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: A party to the review who is dissatisfied with the determination may appeal to the Court of Appeal on a question of fact, but only with that Court's leave.
Leave to appeal to the Court of Appeal against a determination of the Tribunal may be granted by the Tribunal that made the determination.
Leave to appeal may be granted by the Court of Appeal in respect of a particular issue that arises out of the Tribunal's determination.
If the Court of Appeal substitutes another determination, it may be more onerous than the Tribunal's, provided the Tribunal had power to make it.
At any time after the Tribunal has determined a review, a party to the review may apply to the Tribunal for a stay of execution of the determination.
notes: Correct: section 71(1) lets a party to a review who is dissatisfied with the determination appeal to the Court of Appeal on a question of law, a question of fact or a question of mixed law and fact, and section 71(2) bars an appeal unless the Court of Appeal has granted leave.
Incorrect: section 71(2) provides that no appeal may be made unless leave to appeal has been granted by the Court of Appeal; the Tribunal does not grant leave.
Correct: section 71(3)(a) provides that leave to appeal may be granted in respect of a particular issue arising out of the determination.

Correct: section 72(2) allows a determination that the Court of Appeal substitutes to be any determination, whether more or less onerous than the one substituted, that the Tribunal had power to make in respect of the review in question.
Correct: section 70(1) lets a party to a review, at any time after the determination of the review by the Tribunal, apply to the Tribunal for a stay of execution of the determination.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於針對覆核審裁處的裁定向上訴法庭提出上訴，以及暫緩執行該裁定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 覆核的一方如對裁定感到不滿，可就事實問題向上訴法庭提出上訴，但須已獲上訴法庭批予上訴許可。
針對審裁處的裁定向上訴法庭提出上訴的許可，可由作出該裁定的審裁處批予。
上訴法庭可就在審裁處的裁定中出現的某特定爭論點，批予針對該裁定的上訴許可。
上訴法庭以其他裁定取代審裁處的裁定時，取代的裁定可較原裁定嚴苛，只要審裁處本有權作出該裁定。
在審裁處就覆核作出裁定後，覆核的任何一方可隨時向審裁處申請暫緩執行該裁定。
notes: 正確：第71(1)條訂明，覆核的任何一方如對裁定感到不滿，可就法律問題或事實問題或法律兼事實問題向上訴法庭提出上訴；第71(2)條規定須已獲上訴法庭批予上訴許可。
不正確：第71(2)條訂明，除非上訴法庭已批予上訴許可，否則任何人不得提出上訴；批予許可的並非審裁處。
正確：第71(3)(a)條訂明，上訴許可可就在有關裁定中出現的某特定爭論點而批予。
正確：第72(2)條訂明，上訴法庭用以取代的裁定，可以是審裁處本有權就有關覆核作出的任何裁定，不論是否較被取代的裁定嚴苛或寬鬆。
正確：第70(1)條訂明，在審裁處就覆核作出裁定後，該覆核的任何一方可隨時向審裁處提出申請，要求暫緩執行該裁定。

en.q: Regarding the AMLO's preliminary provisions on its short title, its interpretation, its application to the Government and immunity from civil liability, which of the following are correct?
statements: The Ordinance may be cited by its short title, the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance.
The Ordinance applies to the Government except as otherwise expressly provided, and the interpretation provisions in Schedule 1 apply to it in accordance with their terms.
A relevant authority is immune from civil liability for anything it does or omits in performing, or purporting to perform, a function under the Ordinance.
The immunity leaves unaffected any liability of the Government for a thing done or omitted by a public officer in performing, or purporting to perform, the relevant function.
notes: Incorrect: section 1(1), as amended in 2018, provides that the Ordinance may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance; “(Financial Institutions)” is not part of its short title.

Correct: section 3 provides that the Ordinance applies to the Government, except as otherwise expressly provided, and section 2(1) that Schedule 1 contains interpretation provisions that apply to the Ordinance in accordance with their terms.

Incorrect: section 4(1) protects a relevant authority only for anything done or omitted to be done in good faith in the performance or purported performance of such a function; an act not done in good faith is not protected.

Correct: section 4(2) provides that the protection conferred by section 4(1) does not affect any liability of the Government for the thing done or omitted to be done by a public officer in the performance or purported performance of the relevant function.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》導言部分有關其簡稱、釋義、對政府的適用及豁免承擔民事法律責任的條文，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 本條例的簡稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集(金融機構)條例》，本條例可以此引稱。
除另有明文規定外，本條例適用於政府；而附表1所載的釋義條文，按照其內容適用於本條例。
有關當局就其執行或本意是執行本條例所賦予的職能時作出的任何作為或不作為，均獲豁免承擔民事法律責任。
就公職人員在執行或本意是執行有關職能時的作為或不作為，政府所負的任何法律責任，不因有關豁免而受影響。
notes: 不正確：第1(1)條（經2018年修訂）訂明本條例可引稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》；簡稱並無「(金融機構)」字樣。
正確：第3條訂明，除另有明文規定外，本條例適用於政府；第2(1)條訂明，附表1所載釋義條文，按照其內容適用於本條例。
不正確：第4(1)條只就有關當局在執行或本意是執行該等職能時「真誠地」作出的作為或不作為，豁免其民事法律責任；並非真誠作出的作為不受保護。
正確：第4(2)條訂明，如任何公職人員在執行或本意是執行有關職能時作出任何作為或有任何不作為，第4(1)條所賦予的保護，並不影響政府就該作為或不作為而招致的法律責任。

en.q: Regarding Schedule 2 to the AMLO, the guidelines that may be published for its operation, and how the Schedule and those guidelines may be amended, which of the following are correct?
statements: Subject to the limits the Ordinance sets for certain insurance business and stored value facilities, Schedule 2 has effect with respect to financial institutions.
Schedule 2, which sets out the customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements, may be amended by the Commissioner by notice published in the Gazette.
A relevant authority or a regulatory body may publish in the Gazette any guideline it considers appropriate for giving guidance on the operation of any provision of Schedule 2.
A relevant authority may from time to time amend all or part of a guideline it has published, in a manner consistent with its power to publish that guideline.
After an amendment, references to the guideline in any Ordinance, this one included, are to be read as references to the guideline as amended, unless the context otherwise requires.
A guideline published to give guidance on the operation of Schedule 2 is not subsidiary legislation, although it is published in the Gazette by a relevant authority or regulatory body.
notes: Correct: section 5(1) provides that, subject to section 5(2), (3) and (4), which limit its effect for authorized insurers, insurance agents and brokers and certain stored value facilities, Schedule 2 has effect with respect to financial institutions.
Incorrect: section 6 gives the power to amend Schedule 2, by notice published in the Gazette, to the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, not to the Commissioner.

Correct: section 7(1) lets a relevant authority or a regulatory body publish in the Gazette any guideline that it considers appropriate for providing guidance in relation to the operation of any provision of Schedule 2.

Correct: section 7(3) lets a relevant authority or a regulatory body from time to time amend the whole or any part of any guideline published under the section, in a manner consistent with the power to publish the guideline.

Correct: section 7(3)(b) provides that any reference in the Ordinance or any other Ordinance to the guideline, however expressed, is, unless the context otherwise requires, to be construed as a reference to the guideline as amended.
Correct: section 7(1) provides for such guidelines to be published in the Gazette, and section 7(6) provides that a guideline published under the section is not subsidiary legislation.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》附表2、為附表2的施行而可公布的指引，以及附表2及該等指引的修訂，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 除本條例就若干保險業務及儲值支付工具所訂的限制外，附表2就金融機構而具有效力。
載有關於就客戶作盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定的附表2，可由關長藉憲報公告予以修訂。
有關當局或監管機構可在憲報公布它認為對就附表2任何條文的施行提供導引屬適當的指引。
有關當局可不時修訂其所公布的指引的全部或任何部分，修訂方式須與其公布該指引的權力相符。
指引一經修訂，除文意另有所指外，任何條例（包括本條例）凡提述該指引，均須解釋為指經修訂的版本。
有關當局或監管機構為就附表2的施行提供導引而在憲報公布的指引，並不是附屬法例。
notes: 正確：第5(1)條訂明，在第5(2)、(3)及(4)條（就獲授權保險人、保險代理及經紀以及若干儲值支付工具所訂的限制）的規限下，附表2就金融機構而具有效力。
不正確：第6條訂明，可藉憲報公告修訂附表2的是財經事務及庫務局局長，並非關長。
正確：第7(1)條訂明，有關當局或監管機構可在憲報公布它認為對就附表2任何條文的施行而提供導引屬適當的指引。
正確：第7(3)條訂明，有關當局或監管機構可不時修訂根據該條公布的指引的全部或任何部分，修訂方式須與其公布該指引的權力相符。
正確：第7(3)(b)條訂明，本條例或任何其他條例中提述該指引（不論實際如何稱述）之處，除文意另有所指外，須解釋為提述經如此修訂的該指引。
正確：第7(1)條訂明該等指引在憲報公布，而第7(6)條訂明，根據該條公布的指引不是附屬法例。

source.en: AMLO ss.8 (definition of “prescribed requirement”) and 9(1), (12), (13) and (15)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第8條（「訂明規定」的定義）及第9(1)、(12)、(13)及(15)條

en.q: Regarding who may carry out a routine inspection of a licensed money service operator under the AMLO, and what such an inspection covers, which of the following are correct?
statements: Any person, or any person in a class of persons, may be authorized in writing by a relevant authority to act as an authorized person in routine inspections.
Each authorized person must be given, by the relevant authority that authorized him or her, a copy of that authority's authorization.
The inspection powers may be exercised to ascertain whether the operator is likely to be able to comply with a prescribed requirement, not only whether it is complying or has complied.
For the operator, the prescribed requirements include the requirement not to contravene any provision in a guideline published under the Ordinance.
For the purposes of routine inspection, the operator's business premises are any premises that it uses in connection with its business of operating a money service.
Anyone other than the operator whom the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe to possess a specified business record of the operator is an information holder.
notes: Correct: section 9(12) lets a relevant authority authorize in writing any person, or any person belonging to a class of persons, as an authorized person for the purposes of the section.
Correct: section 9(13) requires a relevant authority to provide an authorized person authorized by it with a copy of its authorization.

Correct: under section 9(1) an authorized person has the powers for the purpose of ascertaining whether a prescribed person is complying or has complied with, or is likely to be able to comply with, a prescribed requirement.

Incorrect: for a non-Part 5B prescribed person such as a licensed money service operator, section 8 defines the prescribed requirement as the requirement not to contravene any provision of the Ordinance, any notice or requirement given or imposed under it, any condition of a licence or registration under it, or any other condition imposed under it; a provision in a code or guideline appears only in the definition for a licensed VAS provider and its associated entities.

Incorrect: section 9(15) defines business premises, in relation to a licensed money service operator, as any premises at which it may operate a money service as shown in the register maintained under section 27; premises it merely uses for its business are not enough.

Correct: section 9(15) defines an information holder, for a non-Part 5B inspection subject, as a person other than the inspection subject whom the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe to have information relating to, or to be in possession of, any specified business record in relation to it, whether or not connected with it.

tc.q: 關於根據《打擊洗錢條例》誰可對持牌金錢服務經營者進行例行視察，以及該視察的涵蓋範圍，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人或某類別人士中的任何人，均可由有關當局藉書面授權為獲授權人，以進行例行視察。
授權某人進行例行視察的有關當局，須向該獲授權人提供該當局所發出的授權書的文本。
例行視察可用以確定該經營者是否相當可能有能力遵從訂明規定，而不限於確定其是否正遵從或已遵從該規定。
就該經營者而言，訂明規定包括不得違反根據本條例公布的指引中的任何條文的規定。
就例行視察而言，該經營者的業務處所指其在與經營金錢服務的業務有關連的情況下使用的任何處所。
如獲授權人有合理因由相信某人（並非該經營者）管有該經營者的指明業務紀錄，則該人屬資料持有人。
notes: 正確：第9(12)條訂明，有關當局可為施行該條藉書面授權任何人或某類別人士中的任何人為獲授權人。
正確：第9(13)條規定，有關當局須向它授權的獲授權人提供授權書文本。
正確：第9(1)條訂明，獲授權人具有有關權力，以確定訂明人士是否正遵從、已遵從或相當可能有能力遵從訂明規定。
不正確：就持牌金錢服務經營者等非第5B部訂明人士而言，第8條把訂明規定界定為不得違反本條例任何條文、根據本條例給予或施加的任何通知、規定或要求、本條例所指的任何牌照或註冊的任何條件，或根據本條例施加的任何其他條件的規定；守則或指引中的條文只見於就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者及其有聯繫實體而作的定義。
不正確：第9(15)條把持牌金錢服務經營者的業務處所界定為根據第27條備存的登記冊所顯示的、該經營者可經營金錢服務所在的處所；僅屬該經營者為其業務而使用的處所並不足夠。
正確：第9(15)條把非第5B部視察對象的資料持有人界定為獲授權人有合理因由相信，就該視察對象掌握關於指明業務紀錄或指明交易的資料，或管有指明業務紀錄的人（不屬該視察對象者），不論該人是否與該視察對象有關連。

en.q: Regarding the investigators the Commissioner may direct or appoint under the AMLO, and the reports on their investigations, which of the following are correct?
statements: If the Commissioner has reasonable cause to believe that an offence under the Ordinance may have been committed, that is a ground on which the Commissioner may have the matter investigated.
With the consent of the Financial Secretary, the Commissioner may appoint someone other than a public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department to investigate.
Where the Commissioner, in considering disciplinary action, has reason to inquire whether a licensee has contravened a specified provision, the Commissioner may have the matter investigated.
Within 7 days after an investigator first imposes a requirement on a person, the investigator must let that person inspect a copy of the direction or appointment.
An investigator may report to the Commissioner before the investigation is complete, and must make an interim report as soon as reasonably practicable once the Commissioner requires one.
The Commissioner may, with the consent of the Secretary for Justice, publish a report that an investigator has made to the Commissioner, whether an interim or a final report.
notes: Correct: section 11(1)(a) allows a relevant authority, such as the Commissioner, that has reasonable cause to believe that an offence under the Ordinance may have been committed to direct in writing persons specified in section 11(2) or, with the consent of the Financial Secretary, appoint other persons to investigate the matter.

Correct: section 11(1) lets the relevant authority in writing direct persons specified in section 11(2), which for the Commissioner are public officers employed in the Customs and Excise Department under paragraph (d), or, with the consent of the Financial Secretary, appoint other persons.

Correct: section 11(1)(b) also covers a relevant authority that, in relation to a financial institution and for the purpose of considering whether to exercise any power under section 21 or 43, has reason to inquire whether the institution has contravened a specified provision as defined by section 5(11) or a provision specified in section 43(1).

Incorrect: section 11(5) requires the investigator to produce a copy of the relevant authority's direction or appointment for inspection before first imposing any requirement on the person under section 12(2), (3), (4) or (5), not within 7 days afterwards.

Correct: section 12(8) provides that an investigator may make interim reports on the investigation to the relevant authority, and must make them as soon as reasonably practicable after being required by the relevant authority to do so.

Correct: section 12(10) provides that a relevant authority may, with the consent of the Secretary for Justice, publish a report made under section 12, which covers the interim reports in section 12(8) and the final report in section 12(9).

tc.q: 關於關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》可指示或委任的調查員，以及關於其調查的報告，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長如有合理因由相信有人可能已犯本條例所訂罪行，即屬其可安排調查有關事宜的理由之一。
在財政司司長的同意下，關長可委任受僱任職於香港海關的公職人員以外的人進行調查。
如關長為考慮是否採取紀律行動而有理由查訊持牌人是否已違反指明的條文，亦可安排調查有關事宜。
向某人首次施加要求後7日內，調查員須讓該人查閱有關當局所作出的指示或委任的文本。
調查員可在調查完成前向關長提交中期報告，並須在關長要求提交中期報告後，在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快提交。
關長可在律政司司長的同意下，公布調查員就調查向其提交的報告，不論是中期報告或最後報告。
notes: 正確：第11(1)(a)條訂明，如有關當局（例如關長）有合理因由相信有人可能已犯本條例所訂罪行，可藉書面指示第11(2)條指明的人，或在財政司司長的同意下委任其他人，調查有關事宜。
正確：第11(1)條訂明，有關當局可藉書面指示第11(2)條指明的人（就關長而言，即(d)段所指受僱任職於香港海關的公職人員），或在財政司司長的同意下委任其他人，以調查有關事宜。
正確：第11(1)(b)條亦涵蓋有關當局就某金融機構而言，為考慮是否根據第21或43條行使權力，而有理由查訊該機構是否已違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文或第43(1)條所指明的條文的情況。
不正確：第11(5)條規定，調查員須在根據第12(2)、(3)、(4)或(5)條向任何人首次施加要求「前」，向該人出示有關當局所作出的指示或委任的文本，以供查閱，並非在施加要求後7日內出示。
正確：第12(8)條訂明，調查員可向有關當局提交關於調查的中期報告，並須在有關當局要求後，在合理地切實可行範圍內，盡快提交該報告。
正確：第12(10)條訂明，有關當局可在律政司司長的同意下，公布根據第12條提交的報告，包括第12(8)條所指的中期報告及第12(9)條所指的最後報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(1)至(3)條

en.q: An investigator directed by the Commissioner under the AMLO is investigating a matter in relation to a licensed money service operator. Regarding the requirements the investigator may impose, which of the following are correct?
statements: The investigator may also impose requirements on another person whom the investigator has reasonable cause to believe to possess a record that contains, or is likely to contain, relevant information.
By written requirement, the investigator may summon the operator to meet the investigator at a set time and place and require it to answer questions on any matter under investigation.
The investigator may put written questions to the operator on any matter under investigation and, by a written requirement, oblige the operator to respond to them.
The operator can be required in writing to give the investigator any other assistance with the investigation, so far as the operator is reasonably able to give it.
If the operator produces a record or document as required, the investigator may require it to give an explanation or further particulars in respect of that record or document.
notes: Correct: section 12(1)(b) makes a covered person of a person whom an investigator has reasonable cause to believe to be in possession of any record or document that contains, or is likely to contain, information relevant to the investigation, and section 12(2) lets the investigator impose requirements on a covered person.

Correct: section 12(2)(b) lets the investigator in writing require a covered person to attend before the investigator at the time and place specified in the requirement and answer any question relating to any matter under investigation that may be raised by the investigator.

Correct: section 12(2)(c) lets the investigator in writing require a covered person to respond to any written question relating to any matter under investigation that may be raised by the investigator.

Correct: section 12(2)(d) lets the investigator in writing require a covered person to give the investigator all other assistance in connection with the investigation that the person is reasonably able to give.

Correct: section 12(3) lets the investigator, subject to section 12A, require a covered person who produces a record or document in accordance with a requirement under section 12(2)(a) to give an explanation or further particulars in respect of it.

tc.q: 關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》指示的調查員，正就某持牌金錢服務經營者調查某事宜。關於調查員可施加的要求，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 某人即使並非該經營者，只要調查員有合理因由相信其管有載有或相當可能載有攸關調查的資料的紀錄，亦可向其施加要求。
調查員可藉書面要求，着該經營者在要求所定的時間及地點會晤調查員，並回答其就任何受調查事宜提出的問題。
調查員可就任何受調查事宜向該經營者提出書面問題，並藉書面要求着該經營者作出回應。
除紀錄及回答外，調查員亦可藉書面要求該經營者提供其按理能夠提供、與調查有關連的一切其他協助。
如該經營者按照要求交出紀錄或文件，調查員可要求其就該紀錄或文件給予解釋或進一步詳情。
notes: 正確：第12(1)(b)條訂明，調查員有合理因由相信管有載有或相當可能載有攸關調查的資料的紀錄或文件的人屬受涵蓋人，而第12(2)條容許調查員向受涵蓋人施加要求。
正確：第12(2)(b)條訂明，調查員可藉書面要求受涵蓋人在該要求所指明的時間及地點會晤調查員，並回答調查員提出的關乎受調查的事宜的任何問題。
正確：第12(2)(c)條訂明，調查員可藉書面要求受涵蓋人回應調查員向該人提出的關乎受調查的事宜的任何書面問題。
正確：第12(2)(d)條訂明，調查員可藉書面要求受涵蓋人向調查員提供該人按理能夠提供的與該項調查有關連的一切其他協助。
正確：第12(3)條訂明，如受涵蓋人按照根據第12(2)(a)條施加的要求交出紀錄或文件，調查員可在不抵觸第12A條的情況下，要求該人就該紀錄或文件給予解釋或進一步詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(11)至(12)條及第15條

en.q: Regarding self-incrimination, the use in evidence of answers given to an investigator, and the costs of an investigation under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person whom an investigator requires to answer questions cannot refuse to comply merely because the answers might tend to incriminate him or her.
An investigator who requires a person to answer a question must ensure that the person has first been informed or reminded of the limits on the answer's admissibility in evidence.
The limits on the admissibility of an answer apply where the person who gave the answer claims, after giving it, that it might tend to incriminate him or her.
The limits on an answer's admissibility do not apply where the person who gave it is charged, in respect of the answer, with an offence under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance.
If an investigation's findings lead to a conviction, the court may order the person convicted to pay the relevant authority all or part of the costs and expenses of the investigation.
notes: Correct: section 13(11) provides that a person is not excused from complying with a requirement imposed under section 12 only on the ground that to do so might tend to incriminate the person.

Correct: section 15(1) requires the investigator to ensure that the person has first been informed or reminded of the limitations imposed by section 15(2) on the admissibility in evidence of the requirement, the question and the answer or response.

Incorrect: section 15(2) applies only if the answer might tend to incriminate the person and the person so claims before giving the answer; a claim made after answering does not bring the limits into play.

Correct: section 15(3) provides that section 15(2) does not apply to criminal proceedings in which the person is charged with an offence under section 13(1), (3), (5), (6), (7) or (8), or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 200), in respect of the answer.

Correct: section 13(12) lets the court order a person convicted on a prosecution instituted as a result of the findings of an investigation under section 11 to pay to the relevant authority the whole or a part of the costs and expenses of the investigation, which the authority may recover as a civil debt.

tc.q: 關於根據《打擊洗錢條例》進行的調查中可能導致入罪的回答、該等回答作為證據的使用，以及調查的費用，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 被調查員要求回答問題的人，不能僅以其回答可能會導致其入罪為理由，而拒絕遵從該要求。
調查員要求任何人回答問題時，須確保該人已事先獲告知或提醒有關回答作為證據的可接納性所受的限制。
如任何人在給予回答後，聲稱其回答可能會導致其入罪，則該回答作為證據的可接納性所受的限制即告適用。
如作出回答的人就該回答而被控犯《刑事罪行條例》第V部所訂罪行，則該回答作為證據的可接納性所受的限制並不適用。
如調查所得導致任何人遭檢控並被法院定罪，法院可命令該人向有關當局繳付該項調查的全部或部分費用及開支。
notes: 正確：第13(11)條訂明，任何人不得僅以遵從根據第12條施加於該人的要求可能會導致其入罪為理由，而獲豁免遵從該要求。
正確：第15(1)條規定，調查員須確保該人已事先獲告知或提醒第15(2)條對該要求、有關問題及該項回答或回應作為證據的可接納性施加的限制。
不正確：第15(2)條只在該項回答可能會導致該人入罪，而該人在給予回答「之前」如此聲稱的情況下適用；在回答後才提出聲稱，並不會引致有關限制適用。
正確：第15(3)條訂明，如該人就該項回答而被控犯第13(1)、(3)、(5)、(6)、(7)或(8)條或《刑事罪行條例》(第200章)第V部所訂罪行，則第15(2)條不適用於該等檢控的刑事法律程序。
正確：第13(12)條訂明，如根據第11條進行的調查所得導致任何人遭檢控並被法院定罪，該法院可命令該人向有關當局繳付該項調查的全部或部分費用及開支，而該當局可將其作為民事債項予以追討。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(1)、(2)及(4)條及第16條

en.q: Regarding requirements imposed under the AMLO by an authorized person in a routine inspection or by an investigator, and a failure to comply with them, which of the following are correct?
statements: Either the authorized person or the investigator who imposed the requirement may ask the Court of First Instance, by originating summons, to inquire into a failure to comply with it.
The Court, finding no reasonable excuse for the person's non-compliance, may set a time within which the person must comply with the requirement and order compliance within it.
A person who failed without reasonable excuse may be punished by the Court as if guilty of contempt of court, and so may anyone else knowingly involved in the failure.
A person who failed to comply may be punished by the Court as if for contempt even while criminal proceedings already instituted against that person for the same conduct remain pending.
A person who claims a lien on a record required to be produced must still produce it, no fee being payable for the production, and producing it does not affect the lien.
notes: Correct: section 14(1) lets the authorized person or the investigator apply by originating summons to the Court of First Instance for an inquiry into a failure to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9(3), (5), (9) or (10) or section 12(2), (3), (4) or (5).

Correct: section 14(2)(a) lets the Court of First Instance, on being satisfied that there is no reasonable excuse for the person not to comply with the requirement, order the person to comply with it within the time specified by the Court.

Correct: section 14(2)(b) lets the Court, on being satisfied that the failure was without reasonable excuse, punish the person, and any other person knowingly involved in the failure, in the same manner as if they had been guilty of contempt of court.

Incorrect: section 14(4) provides that no proceedings may be instituted against a person for the purposes of section 14(2)(b) in respect of conduct for which criminal proceedings under section 10 or 13 have previously been instituted against the person and remain pending.

Correct: section 16 provides that a lien claimed on a record or document required to be produced under Part 3 does not affect the requirement to produce it, that no fees are payable for or in respect of the production, and that the production does not affect the lien.

tc.q: 關於獲授權人在例行視察中或調查員根據《打擊洗錢條例》施加的要求，以及沒有遵從該等要求的情況，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 施加要求的獲授權人或調查員，可藉原訴傳票請求原訟法庭就沒有遵從該要求的情況進行查訊。
原訟法庭如信納不遵從並無合理辯解，可定出時限，命令有關的人在該時限內遵從要求。
原訟法庭可按藐視法庭罪的懲罰方式，懲罰無合理辯解而沒有遵從要求的人，以及明知而牽涉入該項不遵從的其他人。
即使就同一行為已對沒有遵從要求的人提起的刑事法律程序仍然待決，原訟法庭仍可懲罰該人，猶如其犯藐視法庭罪。
任何人即使聲稱對須交出的紀錄有留置權，仍須交出該紀錄，且無須因交出而支付任何費用，而交出亦不影響該留置權。
notes: 正確：第14(1)條訂明，如任何人沒有遵從根據第9(3)、(5)、(9)或(10)條或第12(2)、(3)、(4)或(5)條施加的要求，有關獲授權人或調查員可藉原訴傳票向原訟法庭提出申請，要求對該項不遵從進行查訊。
正確：第14(2)(a)條訂明，原訟法庭如信納該人不遵從有關要求是無合理辯解的，可命令該人在原訟法庭指明的時間內遵從該要求。
正確：第14(2)(b)條訂明，原訟法庭如信納該人無合理辯解而沒有遵從要求，可懲罰該人及明知而牽涉入該項不遵從的任何其他人，懲罰方式猶如他們犯藐視法庭罪一樣。
不正確：第14(4)條訂明，如過往已根據第10或13條就同一行為對該人提起刑事法律程序，而該刑事法律程序仍待決，則不得為施行第14(2)(b)條就該行為對該人提起法律程序。
正確：第16條訂明，如任何人聲稱對根據第3部被要求交出的紀錄或文件有留置權，該留置權並不影響交出的要求，無須因該項交出或就該項交出而支付任何費用，而交出亦不影響該留置權。

en.q: Regarding a magistrate's warrant under the AMLO to enter premises and seize records or documents that may be required to be produced in a supervision or investigation, which of the following are correct?
statements: The magistrate may issue the warrant on information on oath laid by an investigator, a person authorized for routine inspections, or an employee or staff member of a relevant authority.
The warrant authorizes entry to the premises, if necessary by force, at any time within the period of 7 days beginning on the date of the warrant.

A record removed under the warrant may be kept for up to 6 months from its removal, or longer as necessary for criminal proceedings or proceedings under the Ordinance for which it is or may be required.
A person authorized by the warrant may prohibit anyone found on the premises from removing a record required to be produced there, or from erasing, adding to or altering anything in it.
Obstructing a person authorized by the warrant in requiring records on the premises to be produced is an offence punishable on indictment by a $1,000,000 fine and 7 years' imprisonment.
Someone who removes a record under the warrant must, as soon as reasonably practicable after removing it, give a receipt for the record.
notes: Correct: section 17(1) lets a magistrate who is satisfied by information on oath laid by an investigator, a person authorized under section 9(12), or an employee or staff member of a relevant authority issue the warrant.
Correct: section 17(1)(a) authorizes the persons specified to enter the premises, if necessary by force, at any time within the period of 7 days beginning on the date of the warrant.

Correct: section 17(4) allows a record or document removed under the warrant to be retained for a period not exceeding 6 months beginning on the day of its removal or, if it is or may be required for any criminal proceedings or any proceedings under the Ordinance, for any longer period necessary for those proceedings.

Correct: section 17(3)(a) lets the authorized person, in relation to any record or document required to be produced under section 17(2), prohibit any person found on the premises from removing it from the premises, from erasing anything from, adding anything to or otherwise altering anything in it, or from otherwise interfering with it.

Incorrect: under section 17(9)(b) and (10)(a) a person who obstructs an authorized person exercising a power conferred by section 17(2) or (3) is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years, not 7 years.
Correct: section 17(5) requires an authorized person who removes any record or document under the section to give a receipt for it as soon as reasonably practicable after the removal.

tc.q: 關於根據《打擊洗錢條例》發出、以進入處所及檢取在監管或調查中可被要求交出的紀錄或文件的裁判官手令，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 裁判官可根據調查員、獲授權進行例行視察的人或有關當局的僱員或員工經宣誓而作的告發，發出該手令。
該手令授權在自手令日期起計的7日的期間內隨時進入有關處所，而如有必要，可強行進入。
根據手令移走的紀錄可保留不超過自移走當日起計的6個月，或在屬或可能屬刑事或本條例下法律程序所需時保留較長期間。
獲手令授權的人可禁止在處所內被發現的人將須交出的紀錄移離處所，或刪除、增添或更改紀錄所載的任何事情。
妨礙獲手令授權的人要求交出處所內的紀錄，即屬犯罪，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
根據手令移走紀錄的人，須在移走該紀錄後，於合理地切實可行範圍內盡快就該紀錄發出收據。
notes: 正確：第17(1)條訂明，裁判官可根據調查員、經第9(12)條獲授權的人或有關當局的僱員或員工經宣誓而作的告發，在信納有關情況後發出手令。
正確：第17(1)(a)條訂明，手令授權有關的人在自該手令日期起計的7日的期間內，隨時進入該處所，而如有必要，可強行進入。
正確：第17(4)條訂明，根據手令移走的紀錄或文件可在不超過自移走當日起計的6個月的期間內予以保留；如屬或可能屬任何刑事法律程序或根據本條例進行的任何法律程序所需要者，則可在為該等程序的目的所需的任何較長期間內予以保留。
正確：第17(3)(a)條訂明，就根據第17(2)條被要求交出的紀錄或文件，獲授權人可禁止在該處所內被發現的人將其移離該處所、刪除、增添或以其他方式更改其所載的任何事情，或以其他方式干擾該紀錄或文件。
不正確：根據第17(9)(b)及(10)(a)條，妨礙獲授權人行使第17(2)或(3)條所授予的權力的人，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年，並非7年。
正確：第17(5)條規定，獲授權人如根據該條移走任何紀錄或文件，須在合理地切實可行範圍內，盡快在其後為此發出收據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第18(2)、19及20條

en.q: Regarding records and documents that a person may be required to produce to an authorized person or an investigator under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where information in a record is held in an information system, a person empowered to require the record may require a reproduction in a form that enables it to be reproduced in a legible form.
An investigator who has taken possession of a record must permit anyone who would otherwise be entitled to inspect it to inspect it and make copies of it at all reasonable times.
An investigator who permits a person to inspect a record in the investigator's possession may impose any condition, as to security or otherwise, that the investigator thinks fit.
Destroying or falsifying a record one is required to produce, or causing or permitting this, is an offence if done with intent to conceal from the investigator facts the record could disclose.
On summary conviction, concealing such a record with intent to conceal from the investigator facts it could disclose is punishable by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
notes: Correct: section 18(2) provides that if information in a record or document is recorded in an information system, a person empowered to require its production is also empowered to require a reproduction of the recording in a form that enables the information to be reproduced in a legible form.

Correct: section 19(1) requires an authorized person or an investigator who has taken possession of a record or document under Part 3 to permit any other person who would have been entitled to inspect it to inspect it and to make copies or otherwise record details of it at all reasonable times.
Incorrect: section 19(2) allows the person giving the permission to impose any reasonable condition as to security or otherwise that the person thinks fit; the condition must be a reasonable one.

Correct: section 20(1) makes it an offence for a person to destroy, falsify, conceal or otherwise dispose of, or cause or permit the destruction, falsification, concealment or disposal of, a record or document the person is required by an authorized person or an investigator to produce under Part 3, with intent to conceal from them facts or matters capable of being disclosed by it.

Incorrect: section 20(2)(b) provides, on summary conviction, for a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months, not a fine at level 5; on conviction on indictment the penalty is a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.

tc.q: 關於任何人根據《打擊洗錢條例》可被要求向獲授權人或調查員交出的紀錄或文件，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如紀錄內的資料記錄於資訊系統內，獲賦權要求交出該紀錄的人，可要求交出一個能令該資料以可閱讀形式重現的版本。
調查員如管有任何紀錄，須准許假使沒有被如此管有本會有權查閱該紀錄的人，在任何合理時間查閱及複製該紀錄。
調查員准許他人查閱其根據本條例管有的紀錄時，可就保安或其他方面施加任何其認為合適的條件。
任何人出於向調查員隱瞞可藉其須交出的紀錄披露的事實的意圖，而銷毀或揑改該紀錄，或致使或准許他人如此行事，即屬犯罪。
出於向調查員隱瞞事實的意圖而隱藏該等紀錄，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
notes: 正確：第18(2)條訂明，如載於紀錄或文件內的資料記錄於資訊系統內，獲賦權要求交出該紀錄或文件的人，亦獲賦權要求交出該資料的版本，而該版本的形式須令該資料能夠以可閱讀形式重現。
正確：第19(1)條規定，如任何獲授權人或調查員根據第3部管有任何紀錄或文件，須准許假使它沒有被如此管有的話本會有權查閱它的任何其他人，在任何合理時間查閱、複製或複印該紀錄或文件，或以其他方式記錄其細節。
不正確：第19(2)條訂明，給予准許的人可就保安或其他方面施加任何該人認為合適的「合理」條件；條件須屬合理。
正確：第20(1)條訂明，凡任何人根據第3部被獲授權人或調查員要求交出任何紀錄或文件，該人如出於向該獲授權人或調查員隱瞞可藉該紀錄或文件披露的事實或事項的意圖，而銷毀、揑改、隱藏或以其他方式處置該紀錄或文件，或致使或准許他人作出該等作為，即屬犯罪。
不正確：第20(2)(b)條訂明，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月，並非第5級罰款；一經循公訴程序定罪，則可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。

en.q: A licensed money service operator has contravened a specified provision of Schedule 2 to the AMLO. Regarding the disciplinary action that the Commissioner, as the relevant authority, may take, which of the following are correct?
statements: Subject to the requirements on procedure and penalty guidelines, the Commissioner may use any one or more of the powers, which include a public reprimand and an order to take remedial action by a set date.
Having exercised such a power, the Commissioner may disclose to the public details of the decision, the reasons for which it was made and any material facts relating to the case.
The Commissioner must inform the operator of the decision by notice in writing, stating the reasons and that the operator may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of the decision.
Where they apply, the terms of any reprimand and the action the operator must take under the decision are also to be stated in the Commissioner's notice of the decision.
notes: Correct: section 21(1) lets the relevant authority, subject to sections 22 and 23, exercise any one or more of the powers in section 21(2), which include publicly reprimanding the financial institution and ordering it to take, by a date specified, action specified to remedy the contravention.

Correct: section 21(8) provides that a relevant authority that has exercised a power under section 21(1) in respect of a financial institution may disclose to the public details of its decision, the reasons for which the decision was made, and any material facts relating to the case.

Correct: section 22(2) requires the relevant authority to inform the financial institution of its decision by notice in writing, and section 22(3)(a) and (e) require the notice to include a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the institution may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of it.

Correct: section 22(3)(b) and (c) require the notice to include, in so far as applicable, the terms in which the financial institution is reprimanded under the decision and the action that it is required to take under the decision.

tc.q: 某持牌金錢服務經營者違反了《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的指明的條文。關於關長作為有關當局可採取的紀律行動，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在符合程序及指引的規定下，關長可行使一項或多於一項權力，包括公開譴責該經營者及命令其在指明日期或之前採取糾正行動。
關長行使該等權力後，可向公眾披露其決定的詳情、作出該決定的理由以及關於該個案的任何重要事實。
關長須藉書面通知將決定告知該經營者，通知須載有作出決定的理由及該經營者可向覆核審裁處申請覆核的提示。
在適用範圍內，關長的決定通知亦須載有根據該決定譴責該經營者的內容，以及根據該決定規定其採取的行動。
notes: 正確：第21(1)條訂明，在符合第22及23條的規定下，有關當局可行使第21(2)條指明的一項或多於一項權力，包括公開譴責有關金融機構，以及命令其在指明的日期或之前採取指明的行動，以糾正有關的違反。
正確：第21(8)條訂明，如有關當局已根據第21(1)條就某金融機構行使權力，該當局可向公眾披露其決定的詳情、作出該決定的理由以及關於該個案的任何重要事實。
正確：第22(2)條規定有關當局須藉書面通知將其決定告知有關金融機構，而第22(3)(a)及(e)條規定該通知須載有作出該決定的理由的說明，以及該機構可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定的提示。
正確：第22(3)(b)及(c)條規定，該通知須（在適用範圍內）載有根據該決定譴責有關金融機構的內容，以及根據該決定規定該機構採取的行動。

source.en: AMLO ss.76A (definition of “specified person”), 76B and 76C(1)(a)–(b) and (f)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76A條（「指明人士」的定義）、第76B條及第76C(1)(a)至(b)及(f)條

en.q: Regarding the duty of confidentiality that the AMLO places on specified persons, such as a relevant authority and its employees, and the disclosures they may make despite that duty, which of the following are correct?
statements: The duty binds a person who was formerly a consultant, agent or adviser of a relevant authority, as well as a person who still holds such a role.
The duty covers a matter that comes to a specified person's knowledge in the course of assisting another person in performing a function under the Ordinance.
Breach of the duty by a specified person is an offence punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.
Despite the duty, a specified person may disclose information in performing a function under the Ordinance, or information already made available to the public.
The duty extends to a record that came into a specified person's possession in performing a function under the Ordinance, provided the record is marked as confidential.
A specified person may disclose information in connection with any judicial or other proceedings to which the person whom the information concerns is a party.
notes: Correct: paragraph (b) of the definition of specified person in section 76A covers a person who is or was a member, an employee, or a consultant, agent or adviser, of a relevant authority, and section 76B applies to every specified person.

Correct: section 76B(1)(a)(iii) applies the duty to a matter that comes to a specified person's knowledge in the course of assisting another person in performing a function under, or carrying into effect, a provision of the Ordinance.

Incorrect: section 76B(3)(a) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, not a fine of $500,000; on summary conviction the penalty is a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months.

Correct: section 76C(1)(a)(i) and (b) let a specified person, despite section 76B, disclose information in performing a function under the Ordinance, and disclose information that has already been made available to the public.

Incorrect: section 76B(1)(b) applies the duty to any record or document that has come into a specified person's possession in any of the circumstances in section 76B(1)(a), and section 76B(2)(b) bars allowing another person to have access to it; nothing limits this to records marked as confidential.

Incorrect: section 76C(1)(f) permits disclosure in connection with any judicial or other proceedings to which the specified person is a party, not proceedings to which the person the information concerns is a party.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》對指明人士（例如有關當局及其僱員）施加的保密責任，以及他們儘管有該責任仍可作出的披露，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 保密責任約束曾屬有關當局顧問或代理人的人，亦約束現屬有關當局顧問或代理人的人。
保密責任涵蓋指明人士在協助另一人根據本條例某條文執行職能的過程中獲悉的事宜。
指明人士違反保密責任即屬犯罪，循公訴程序定罪後的罰則為罰款$500,000及監禁2年。
儘管有保密責任，指明人士可在根據本條例執行職能的過程中披露資料，亦可披露公眾已可得到的資料。
保密責任延及指明人士在根據本條例執行職能的過程中得以管有的紀錄，但以該紀錄註明為機密者為限。
指明人士可在與有關資料所涉及的人作為其中一方的司法或其他法律程序相關的情況下，披露資料。
notes: 正確：第76A條中指明人士的定義(b)段涵蓋屬或曾屬有關當局的成員、僱員、顧問或代理人的人，而第76B條適用於每名指明人士。
正確：第76B(1)(a)(iii)條訂明，該條適用於指明人士在協助另一人根據本條例某條文執行職能或施行本條例某條文的過程中獲悉的事宜。
不正確：第76B(3)(a)條訂明，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年，並非$500,000；一經循簡易程序定罪，則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。
正確：第76C(1)(a)(i)及(b)條訂明，儘管有第76B條的規定，指明人士可在根據本條例執行職能的過程中披露資料，亦可披露公眾已可得到的資料。
不正確：第76B(1)(b)條訂明，該條適用於指明人士在(a)段所述的任何情況下而得以管有的紀錄或文件，而第76B(2)(b)條禁止容許另一人取覽該等紀錄或文件；條文並無只限於註明為機密的紀錄。
不正確：第76C(1)(f)條容許在與「該指明人士」作為其中一方的司法或其他法律程序相關的情況下披露資料，並非與資料所涉及的人作為一方的法律程序。

en.q: Despite the duty of confidentiality, the AMLO permits a relevant authority, such as the Commissioner, to disclose information in certain cases. Regarding those cases, which of the following are correct?
statements: The Review Tribunal, and a liquidator appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance, are among those to whom a relevant authority may disclose information.

A relevant authority may disclose information to The Ombudsman, as a listed recipient, only if satisfied that this is desirable or expedient, having regard to the public interest, the interest of the investing public and the recipient's need.

Information obtained by an authorized person in a routine inspection may be disclosed to the Secretary for Justice, the Commissioner of Police or the Commissioner of the Independent Commission Against Corruption.
Where information obtained from one person relates to a different person, the relevant authority may disclose it with the consent of both the person who gave it and the person it relates to.
When disclosing information in these cases, a relevant authority may impose any condition it considers appropriate, and knowingly contravening such a condition is an offence.
notes: Correct: section 76D(1)(b) and (c) let a relevant authority, despite section 76B, disclose information to a liquidator appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap. 32) and to the Review Tribunal.

Correct: section 76D(1)(g)(xii) names The Ombudsman, and section 76D(2) allows disclosure under paragraph (g) only if the relevant authority is satisfied that it is desirable or expedient, having regard to the public interest and the interest of the investing public and to the recipient's need for the information in performing its functions.

Correct: section 76D(1)(h) lets a relevant authority disclose information obtained by an authorized person under section 9, or by an investigator under section 12, to the Secretary for Justice, the Commissioner of Police, the Commissioner of the Independent Commission Against Corruption or the Review Tribunal.

Correct: section 76D(1)(f) permits disclosure with the consent of the person from whom the information was obtained or received and, if the information relates to a different person, with the consent also of the person to whom it relates.

Correct: section 76D(4) lets a relevant authority, in disclosing information under section 76D(1) or (3), impose any condition that it considers appropriate, and section 76D(7) makes it an offence for a person, knowing of such a condition, to contravene it or to aid, abet, counsel or procure another to do so.

tc.q: 儘管有保密責任，《打擊洗錢條例》容許有關當局（例如關長）在某些情況下披露資料。關於該等情況，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 覆核審裁處及根據《公司(清盤及雜項條文)條例》獲委任為清盤人的人，均屬有關當局可向其披露資料的對象。
有關當局須經顧及公眾利益、投資大眾的利益及接收者的需要而信納披露屬可取或合宜，方可向列明的申訴專員披露資料。
獲授權人在例行視察中取得的資料，有關當局可向律政司司長、警務處處長或廉政專員披露。
如從某人處取得的資料與另一人有關，有關當局可在該人及該另一人均同意的情況下披露該等資料。
有關當局在該等情況下披露資料時，可施加其認為適當的條件，任何人明知有該條件而違反該條件，即屬犯罪。
notes: 正確：第76D(1)(b)及(c)條訂明，儘管有第76B條的規定，有關當局可向根據《公司(清盤及雜項條文)條例》(第32章)獲委任為清盤人的人披露資料，亦可向覆核審裁處披露資料。
正確：第76D(1)(g)(xii)條列出申訴專員，而第76D(2)條訂明，有關當局僅可在經顧及公眾利益及投資大眾的利益，以及有關接收者在執行其職能時有需要取得該等資料，而信納披露資料是可取或合宜的情況下，根據(g)段披露資料。
正確：第76D(1)(h)條訂明，如有關資料是由獲授權人根據第9條或由調查員根據第12條取得，有關當局可向律政司司長、警務處處長、廉政專員或覆核審裁處披露該資料。
正確：第76D(1)(f)條訂明，如有關資料是從某人處取得或接獲，可在該人同意的情況下披露；如該資料與另一人有關，則須在該人及該另一人均同意的情況下披露。
正確：第76D(4)條訂明，有關當局在根據第76D(1)或(3)條披露資料時，可施加其認為適當的條件；第76D(7)條訂明，任何人明知有該條件而違反該條件，或協助、教唆、慫使或促致任何人違反該條件，即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76E(1)至(4)及(6)條、第76F(1)及(8)條及第34(4)條

en.q: Regarding the duty under the AMLO of a licensed money service operator not to disclose information it obtains through a routine inspection, an investigation or a notice of disciplinary action, which of the following are correct?
statements: An operator on which an authorized person has imposed a requirement must not disclose information obtained in the course of it to any other person, unless the relevant authority consents or a specified condition is met.
The operator may disclose such information to seek advice from counsel, a solicitor or another professional adviser acting, or proposing to act, professionally on a matter under the Ordinance.

An operator notified of the Commissioner's decision to take disciplinary action against it must not disclose information obtained from the notice, unless the Commissioner consents or a specified condition is met.
An operator that contravenes the duty not to disclose commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4; the Ordinance provides no term of imprisonment for it.
A solicitor to whom the operator discloses the information to obtain advice must not disclose it to another person, unless the relevant authority consents or another specified condition is met.

The restriction on disclosing information obtained from a notice applies to an operator that the Commissioner notifies of the suspension of its licence, as it applies to a notice of disciplinary action.
notes: Correct: section 76E(2) provides that a person on whom a requirement under section 9 or 12 has been imposed must not disclose any information obtained in the course of the requirement being imposed, or of compliance or purported compliance with it, to any other person unless the relevant authority consents or any of the conditions in section 76E(4) is satisfied.

Correct: section 76E(4)(b) makes it a condition that the disclosure is for the purpose of seeking advice from, or giving advice by, counsel or a solicitor or other professional adviser who is acting or proposing to act in a professional capacity in connection with any matter arising under the Ordinance.

Correct: section 76E(1)(b) and (3) provide that a person given a notice under section 22 or 44, which inform a financial institution or licensee of a disciplinary decision, must not disclose any information obtained from the notice, or from any communication with the relevant authority about its subject matter, unless the relevant authority consents or a condition in section 76E(4) is satisfied.
Correct: section 76E(6) makes a person who contravenes section 76E(2) or (3) liable on conviction to a fine at level 4; no imprisonment is provided.

Correct: section 76F(1) provides that, if information is disclosed under section 76E, each specified recipient, which section 76F(8) defines as the first recipient and anyone obtaining the information directly or indirectly from that recipient, must not disclose it to another person unless the relevant authority consents or another condition in section 76F(1)(b) to (e) applies.
Incorrect: section 76E(1)(b) applies the duty to a person given a notice under section 22, 44, 53ZA or 53ZSU; a decision to suspend a licence is notified under section 34(4), which is not among them.

tc.q: 關於持牌金錢服務經營者根據《打擊洗錢條例》不得披露其透過例行視察、調查或紀律行動通知取得的資料的責任，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 被獲授權人施加要求的經營者，不得向任何其他人披露在該過程中取得的資料，除非有關當局同意或指明的條件獲符合。
該經營者可為向以(或擬以)專業身分行事的大律師、律師或其他專業顧問就根據本條例引起的事宜徵詢意見，而披露該等資料。
經營者獲關長通知對其採取紀律行動的決定後，不得披露自該通知獲得的資料，除非關長同意或指明的條件獲符合。
經營者違反不得披露資料的責任即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第4級罰款；條例並無就該罪行訂明監禁刑罰。
經營者為徵詢意見而向律師披露資料後，該律師亦不得向另一人披露該資料，除非有關當局同意或另一項指明的條件獲符合。
就自通知獲得的資料而設的披露限制，適用於獲關長通知其牌照被暫時吊銷的經營者，一如適用於紀律行動通知。
notes: 正確：第76E(2)條訂明，被根據第9或12條施加要求的人，不得向任何其他人披露在施加該要求或遵從（或看來是遵從）該要求的過程中取得的資料，除非有關當局同意，或第76E(4)條指明的任何條件獲符合。
正確：第76E(4)(b)條指明的條件，是披露的目的為向以(或擬以)專業身分行事的大律師、律師或其他專業顧問在與根據本條例引起的任何事宜相關的情況下徵詢意見，或由其就該事宜給予意見。
正確：第76E(1)(b)及(3)條訂明，獲發第22或44條所指的通知（即告知紀律行動決定的通知）的人，不得披露自該通知或自與有關當局就該通知的標的事宜的通訊獲得的資料，除非有關當局同意，或第76E(4)條指明的任何條件獲符合。
正確：第76E(6)條訂明，任何人違反第76E(2)或(3)條，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第4級罰款，並無監禁刑罰。
正確：第76F(1)條訂明，如根據第76E條披露資料，每名指明收取人（第76F(8)條界定為首述收取人及直接或間接從首述收取人取得資料的人）均不得向另一人披露該資料，除非有關當局同意，或第76F(1)(b)至(e)條的其他條件獲符合。
不正確：第76E(1)(b)條只適用於獲發第22、44、53ZA或53ZSU條所指的通知的人；暫時吊銷牌照的決定是根據第34(4)條以通知告知，並不在其列。

en.q: Regarding the AMLO's miscellaneous provisions on regulations, the standard of proof, prosecutions, the giving of notices and legal professional privilege, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where the Commissioner must be satisfied that a licence condition was contravened, the civil standard of proof is sufficient even for the purposes of a provision relating to an offence.
The Commissioner may prosecute an offence under the Ordinance in the Commissioner's own name, but the offence must then be tried before a magistrate as an offence triable summarily.

In a prosecution a relevant authority brings in its own name, its staff member not qualified as a barrister or solicitor may appear and plead before the magistrate, provided the Secretary for Justice consents.

A notice from the Commissioner to a licensee under the Ordinance is regarded as duly given if left at, or posted to, any of the premises specified in the licence as premises at which the licensee may operate.
The Chief Executive in Council's power to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of the Ordinance does not extend to the Part regulating money services.
The Ordinance leaves claims based on legal professional privilege unaffected, but this does not affect any requirement under it to disclose the name and address of a legal practitioner's client.
notes: Incorrect: section 78 makes the civil standard of proof sufficient only for the purposes of a provision of the Ordinance other than provisions relating to criminal proceedings or to an offence.

Correct: section 79(1) lets a relevant authority prosecute an offence under the Ordinance, or an offence of conspiracy to commit one, in its own name, but if it does so the offence must be tried before a magistrate as an offence that is triable summarily.

Incorrect: section 79(2)(a) lets an employee or staff member of the relevant authority who is not qualified to practise as a barrister or to act as a solicitor appear and plead before a magistrate in any case of which he or she has charge; no consent of the Secretary for Justice is required, and section 79(3) only preserves the Secretary for Justice's own powers of prosecution.

Correct: section 80(1) provides that a notice or other document authorized or required to be given or sent by the Commissioner to a licensee under the Ordinance is to be regarded for all purposes as duly given or sent if it is left at, or sent by post to, the premises or any of the premises specified in the licence as premises at which the licensee may operate a money service.

Correct: section 77(1) lets the Chief Executive in Council make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of the Ordinance except Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C; Part 5 is the Part that regulates the operation of money services.

Correct: section 81(1) provides that, subject to section 81(2), the Ordinance does not affect any claims, rights or entitlements that would arise on the ground of legal professional privilege, and section 81(2) provides that this does not affect any requirement made under the Ordinance to disclose the name and address of a client of a legal practitioner.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》中有關規例、舉證準則、檢控、發出通知及法律專業保密權的雜項條文，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如關長需信納有人違反牌照條件，即使是為關乎罪行的條文的目的，按照民事法律程序適用的舉證準則信納亦屬足夠。
關長可以本身的名義檢控本條例所訂罪行，但如此提出檢控時，該罪行須作為可循簡易程序審訊的罪行而由裁判官審訊。
在有關當局以本身名義提出的檢控中，沒有大律師或律師資格的該當局員工，在律政司司長同意的前提下，可在裁判官席前陳詞。
關長根據本條例向持牌人發出的通知，如留在或郵寄往該持牌人牌照所指明的其可經營金錢服務的任何處所，即須視為已妥為發出。
行政長官會同行政會議為更佳地施行本條例的條文及達致其目的而訂立規例的權力，並不涵蓋規管經營金錢服務的部分。
本條例不影響基於法律專業保密權而產生的聲稱，但此並不影響根據本條例提出的披露法律執業者客戶姓名或名稱及地址的要求。
notes: 不正確：第78條只就本條例中並非關乎刑事法律程序或任何罪行的條文的目的，訂明按照民事法律程序適用的舉證準則證明或信納即屬足夠。
正確：第79(1)條訂明，有關當局可以本身的名義檢控本條例所訂罪行或串謀犯該罪的罪行，但如如此提出檢控，該罪行須作為可循簡易程序審訊的罪行而由裁判官審訊。
不正確：第79(2)(a)條訂明，沒有資格以大律師身分執業或以律師身分行事的有關當局僱員或員工，可就其負責的案件出席審訊，並可在裁判官席前陳詞，無須律政司司長同意；第79(3)條只訂明該條並不減損律政司司長在檢控刑事罪行方面的權力。
正確：第80(1)條訂明，根據本條例關長獲授權或須向持牌人發出或送出的通知或其他文件，如留在或郵寄往該持牌人所持牌照指明的其可經營金錢服務的處所或多於一個處所當中任何處所，就所有目的而言，須視為已妥為發出或送出。
正確：第77(1)條訂明，行政長官會同行政會議可為更佳地施行本條例（第5、5A、5B及5C部除外）的條文及達致其目的而訂立規例；第5部即規管經營金錢服務的部分。
正確：第81(1)條訂明，除第81(2)條另有規定外，本條例不影響可基於法律專業保密權的理由而產生的任何聲稱、權利或享有權；第81(2)條訂明，此並不影響根據本條例提出披露法律執業者的客戶的姓名或名稱及地址的要求。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7(4)條; 《打擊洗錢條例》第7(5)條

en.q: Which statements about the legal effect of guidelines published under the AMLO to guide the operation of Schedule 2 are correct?
statements: Failure to comply with such a guideline does not by itself make a person liable to judicial or other proceedings.
In proceedings under the AMLO before any court, such a guideline is admissible in evidence for the proceedings.
A court must take a guideline provision into account if it appears relevant to a question arising in AMLO proceedings.
When considering a Schedule 2 contravention, the relevant authority must have regard to relevant guideline provisions.
notes: True: AMLO s.7(4) states “A failure by any person to comply with a provision in any guideline published under this section does not by itself render the person liable to any judicial or other proceedings”.
True: AMLO s.7(4) states “in any proceedings under this Ordinance before any court, the guideline is admissible in evidence”.

True: AMLO s.7(4) states “if any provision set out in the guideline appears to the court to be relevant to any question arising in the proceedings, the provision must be taken into account in determining that question”.
True: AMLO s.7(5) states “a relevant authority or a regulatory body must have regard to any provision in the guideline published under this section that is relevant to the requirement”.

tc.q: 以下有關根據《打擊洗錢條例》公布、就附表2的施行提供導引的指引的法律作用，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人沒有遵守有關指引的條文，此事本身不會令致該人可在司法或其他法律程序中被起訴。
在根據《打擊洗錢條例》提起而於任何法院進行的法律程序中，有關指引可獲接納為證據。
如法院覺得有關指引條文攸關根據《打擊洗錢條例》進行的法律程序中的問題，裁斷時須考慮該條文。
有關當局在考慮某人有否違反附表2的條文時，須顧及有關指引內攸關有關規定的任何條文。
notes: 正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第7(4)條列明「如任何人沒有遵守根據本條公布的指引的條文，此事本身不會令致該人可在任何司法或其他法律程序中被起訴」。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第7(4)條列明「但在根據本條例提起而於任何法院進行的法律程序中，該指引可獲接納為證據」。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第7(4)條列明「如該法院覺得該指引內所列條文，攸關該法律程序中產生的任何問題，該法院在裁斷該問題時，須考慮該條文」。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第7(5)條列明「有關當局或監管機構在考慮某人有否違反附表2的條文時，須顧及根據本條公布的指引內攸關有關規定的任何條文」。

source.en: AMLO s.26(2); AMLO s.2(2); AMLO s.79(3); AMLO s.73(2)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第26(2)條; 《打擊洗錢條例》第2(2)條; 《打擊洗錢條例》第79(3)條; 《打擊洗錢條例》第73(2)條

en.q: Which statements about the allocation of powers under the AMLO are correct?
statements: The Commissioner may delegate the power to delegate functions to a public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department.
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may amend the interpretation provisions in Part 2 of Schedule 1 by Gazette notice.
The provision allowing a relevant authority to prosecute in its own name leaves the Secretary for Justice’s criminal prosecution powers intact.
Once an appeal against a Tribunal determination is lodged, the Court of First Instance may, on a review party’s application, stay that determination.
notes: False: AMLO s.26(2) states “The Commissioner of Customs and Excise must not delegate any of the functions under this section or section 51”. The power to delegate under section 26 is itself non-delegable.
True: AMLO s.2(2) states “The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Part 2 of Schedule 1”.
True: AMLO s.79(3) states “This section does not derogate from the powers of the Secretary for Justice in respect of the prosecution of criminal offences”.

False: AMLO s.73(2) states “If an appeal is lodged under section 71, the Court of Appeal may, on an application made to it by any party to the review, order a stay of execution of the determination of the Tribunal appealed against”. The specified court is the Court of Appeal, not the Court of First Instance.

tc.q: 以下有關《打擊洗錢條例》下各機關的權限分工，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 海關關長可將轉授職能的權力本身，轉授予受僱於香港海關的公職人員行使。
財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告，修訂附表1第2部所載的釋義條文。
容許有關當局以其本身名義提出檢控的條文，並不減損律政司司長檢控刑事罪行的權力。
針對審裁處裁定提出上訴後，原訟法庭可應覆核一方的申請，命令暫緩執行有關裁定。
notes: 不正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第26(2)條列明「海關關長不得轉授本條或第51條所指的職能」。第26條的轉授職能本身不得轉授。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第2(2)條列明「財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告修訂附表1第2部」。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第79(3)條列明「本條並不減損律政司司長在檢控刑事罪行方面的權力」。
不正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第73(2)條列明「如有上訴根據第71條針對某裁定提出，上訴法庭可應有關覆核的任何一方向它提出的申請，命令暫緩執行該裁定」。有關權力屬上訴法庭，並非原訟法庭。

source.en: FAQ Licensing A2; FAQ Licensing A4; AMLO s.12(1)(b); AMLO s.12(1)(c); AMLO s.5(7)
source.tc: 《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》發牌常見問題答2; 《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》發牌常見問題答4; 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(1)(b)條; 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(1)(c)條; 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(7)條

en.q: Which statements about persons subject to the AMLO and the bodies responsible for them are correct?
statements: The Postmaster General is among those subject to the statutory duties under the AMLO, alongside MSOs and other specified financial institutions.
The relevant authority responsible for the Postmaster General under the AMLO is the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury.
A person reasonably believed by the investigator to possess relevant information in another way is covered, even without being the subject of the investigation.
A person employed to work for an MSO commits an offence if the person knowingly causes or permits the MSO to contravene a specified provision of Schedule 2.
