notes: True: FAQ Licensing A2 states “Money Service Operators (“MSOs”) and the Postmaster General as well as other specified financial institutions”.
False: FAQ Licensing A4 states “The Commissioner of Customs & Excise (“CCE”) is the relevant authority under the “AMLO””. The CCE is the relevant authority for both MSOs and the Postmaster General.
True: AMLO s.12(1)(c) states “a person whom an investigator has reasonable cause to believe to be otherwise in possession of information relevant to an investigation under section 11”.

True: AMLO s.5(7) states “If a person who is an employee of a financial institution or is employed to work for a financial institution or is concerned in the management of a financial institution knowingly causes or knowingly permits the financial institution to contravene a specified provision, the person commits an offence”.

tc.q: 以下有關《打擊洗錢條例》涵蓋的人士及其主管機關，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 郵政署署長與金錢服務經營者及其他指定金融機構一樣，屬須受《打擊洗錢條例》法定責任約束的對象。
在《打擊洗錢條例》下，負責監管郵政署署長的有關當局，是財經事務及庫務局局長。
調查員有合理因由相信某人以其他方式管有相關調查資料，即使該人並非調查對象，亦屬受涵蓋人。
受僱為金錢服務經營者工作的人，如明知而致使或准許經營者違反附表2的指明的條文，該人即屬犯罪。
notes: 正確：《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》發牌常見問題答2列明「金錢服務經營者及郵政署署長，以及其他指定的金融機構需受「打擊洗錢條例」的法律約束」。
不正確：《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》發牌常見問題答4列明「海關關長(「關長」)是「打擊洗錢條例」下的有關當局」。金錢服務經營者及郵政署署長的有關當局均為海關關長。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第12(1)(c)條列明「調查員有合理因由相信，該人以其他方式管有攸關根據第11條進行的調查的資料」。
正確：《打擊洗錢條例》第5(7)條列明「任何屬金融機構的僱員、或受僱為金融機構工作、或關涉金融機構的管理的人，如明知而致使或明知而准許該機構違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第25(d)、(e)、(g)及(h)條

en.q: For which of these institutions and money services does Part 5 of the AMLO, regulating money service operations, not apply?
statements: A licensed insurance broker company operating a money service that is ancillary to the company’s own principal business as an insurance broker.
A licensed individual insurance agent whose money service is ancillary to the insurer’s principal business, but not to the agent’s principal business.
A licensed insurance agency operating a money service that is ancillary to its own principal business, rather than a principal money service business.
A designated retail payment system’s settlement institution whose money service is ancillary to its retail business, unrelated to its settlement business.
A stablecoin licensee operating a money service that is a business activity of the licensee under its stablecoin licence, as specified in the AMLO.
notes: Correct: s.25(d) excludes a licensed insurance broker company where the money service is “ancillary to the company’s principal business”.
False: s.25(e) requires the money service to be ancillary to the agent’s or agency’s own principal business, not merely to the insurer’s business.
Correct: s.25(e) also names licensed insurance agencies, subject to the same requirement that the service be ancillary to their principal business.
False: s.25(g) requires the service to be ancillary to the institution’s business “as a system operator or settlement institution”, not an unrelated retail business.
Correct: s.25(h) uses the business-activity-under-the-stablecoin-licence condition. Merely holding a stablecoin licence does not satisfy it for unrelated money services.

tc.q: 就以下機構及其經營的金錢服務，哪些不適用《打擊洗錢條例》第5部規管金錢服務營運的條文？
statements: 持牌保險經紀公司經營一項金錢服務，而該服務附屬於該公司本身作為保險經紀的主要業務。
持牌個人保險代理經營金錢服務，而該服務附屬於保險人的主要業務，並非附屬於該代理本身的主要業務。
持牌保險代理機構經營金錢服務，而該服務附屬於該機構本身的主要業務，並非以金錢服務為主要業務。
指定零售支付系統的交收機構經營金錢服務，而該服務附屬於其零售業務，與其作為交收機構的業務無關。
穩定幣持牌人經營金錢服務，而該服務是《打擊洗錢條例》所指的該持牌人在其穩定幣牌照下的業務活動。
notes: 正確：第25(d)條規定，持牌保險經紀公司經營的金錢服務須附屬於該公司本身的主要業務，方不適用第5部。
錯誤：第25(e)條的附屬業務條件針對該代理或代理機構本身的主要業務，不能以附屬於保險人的主要業務代替。
正確：第25(e)條亦列明持牌保險代理機構，而金錢服務須附屬於該機構的主要業務。
錯誤：第25(g)條要求金錢服務附屬於其「作為系統營運者或交收機構的業務」，與此無關的零售業務並不符合。
正確：第25(h)條的條件是金錢服務屬於持牌人在其穩定幣牌照下的業務活動；單憑持有穩定幣牌照，不能把無關的金錢服務納入豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(2)(a)至(b)條

en.q: A person omits a material particular from a statement connected with a licence grant or renewal application. Which statements about the omission offence are correct?
statements: An omission that leaves the statement neither false nor misleading still satisfies the result element, if the person knows that the material particular was omitted.
An omission making the statement misleading can constitute the offence where the person is reckless as to whether the material particular is omitted from it.
Proof that the omission makes the statement false establishes the offence even if the person neither knows of the omission nor is reckless as to whether it occurred.
Where a known omission makes the statement false or misleading, the mental element concerns knowledge of the omission, not separate knowledge that the result is misleading.
notes: False: s.52(2)(a) requires the omission to render the statement false or misleading; knowledge of the omission cannot replace that result.
Correct: s.52(2)(b) permits recklessness as to omission as an alternative to knowledge, while s.52(2)(a) still requires the false or misleading result.
False: s.52(2)(b) also requires knowledge of, or recklessness as to, the omission. The false result alone does not establish both elements.
Correct: s.52(2)(b) says the person knows that “the material particular is omitted”; the resulting false or misleading statement is the separate requirement in s.52(2)(a).

tc.q: 某人在與批給牌照或續牌申請有關連的陳述中遺漏要項。以下有關遺漏要項罪行的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 即使遺漏要項並沒有使陳述成為虛假或具誤導性，只要該人知道要項已被遺漏，便已符合罪行所要求的結果要件。
遺漏要項導致陳述具誤導性，而該人罔顧陳述是否遺漏該要項，便可構成罪行；無須證明該人實際知道有關遺漏。
只要證明遺漏要項使陳述成為虛假，即可成立罪行，即使該人既不知道有關遺漏，也沒有罔顧要項是否被遺漏。
如明知要項被遺漏，而遺漏使陳述成為虛假或具誤導性，主觀要件針對知道遺漏，並非另須知道所造成的結果具誤導性。
notes: 錯誤：第52(2)(a)條要求遺漏要項「以致」陳述成為虛假或具誤導性；知道要項被遺漏，不能取代這個結果要件。
正確：第52(2)(b)條把罔顧是否遺漏要項列為知道遺漏以外的另一種主觀狀態；同時仍須符合(a)的虛假或具誤導性結果。
錯誤：第52(2)(b)條亦要求知道要項被遺漏，或罔顧是否遺漏；單憑陳述成為虛假的結果，並未符合全部要件。
正確：第52(2)(b)條所指的是「知道該項陳述遺漏該要項」；陳述因遺漏而成為虛假或具誤導性，是(a)另列的結果要件。

en.q: Which statements about leave to appeal and a stay of the Review Tribunal's determination under the AMLO are correct?
statements: Once an appeal against the Tribunal's determination is lodged under the AMLO, lodging it itself stays execution of that determination until the appeal is decided.
The Court of Appeal may grant leave subject to conditions it considers necessary to secure the just, expeditious and economical disposal of the appeal.
Leave may be granted only if the Court of Appeal is satisfied that the appeal has a reasonable prospect of success or another interests-of-justice reason warrants hearing it.
When ordering a stay after an appeal is lodged, the Court of Appeal may impose appropriate conditions, including costs and payment of money into the Tribunal.
notes: False: s.73(1) says lodging the appeal does not by itself operate as a stay; a stay is a separate procedural matter.
Correct: s.71(3)(b) permits conditions that the Court of Appeal considers necessary to secure the just, expeditious and economical disposal of the appeal.
Correct: s.71(4) requires a reasonable prospect of success or some other reason in the interests of justice why the appeal should be heard; these are alternatives.
Correct: s.73(3) permits any conditions the Court of Appeal considers appropriate, expressly including costs and payment into the Tribunal.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》下的上訴許可及暫緩執行覆核審裁處裁定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 一旦根據《打擊洗錢條例》針對審裁處的裁定提出上訴，提出上訴本身便會暫緩執行該裁定，直至上訴獲裁決。
上訴法庭可在其認為為確使上訴得到公正、迅速及合乎經濟原則的處置而需要的條件規限下，批予上訴許可。
上訴法庭須信納上訴有合理機會得直，或有其他有利於秉行公正的理由因而應予審理，方可批予上訴許可。
在上訴提出後命令暫緩執行時，上訴法庭可施加它認為適當的條件，包括關於訟費及繳存款項於審裁處的條件。
notes: 錯誤：第73(1)條訂明，提出上訴本身並不具有暫緩執行裁定的效力；暫緩執行是另一程序。
正確：第71(3)(b)條容許在上訴法庭認為為確使上訴得到公正、迅速及合乎經濟原則的處置而需要的條件規限下批予許可。
正確：第71(4)條所列的合理機會得直，與其他有利於秉行公正的理由，以「或」相連，屬兩種替代準則。
正確：第73(3)條容許上訴法庭施加其認為適當的任何條件，明文包括訟費及繳存款項於審裁處的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9A(1)至(2)及12A(1)至(2)條

en.q: Which statements about another regulatory authority seeking an MSO's customer information under the AMLO are correct?
statements: The special restrictions apply where the authority authorising the inspecting person, or appointing or directing the investigator, is not the relevant authority for the MSO concerned.

For routine inspection, the other authority's oral assurance that customer information is necessary for the inspection satisfies the required certification, without a written certificate of that opinion.

For investigation, the investigator must have reasonable cause to believe that the customer may be able to give relevant information; the other authority's necessity certificate alone is insufficient.
For investigation, the other authority must also consider the customer-information disclosure or production necessary for that investigation and certify in writing that it holds that opinion.
notes: Correct: s.9A(1)(c) and s.12A(1)(c) define the other regulatory authority by its not being the relevant authority for the prescribed subject person.
False: s.9A(2) requires the other authority to certify its necessity opinion in writing; an oral assurance does not satisfy that requirement.
Correct: s.12A(2)(a) adds the investigator's reasonable-cause belief about the customer's ability to provide relevant information; it is cumulative with the written certification in (b).
Correct: s.12A(2)(b) requires both the opinion of necessity for the investigation and written certification of that opinion.

tc.q: 關於其他監管當局根據《打擊洗錢條例》索取金錢服務經營者的客戶資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如授權進行檢查的人，或委任或指示調查員的當局，並不是就有關金錢服務經營者的有關當局，便適用這些特別限制。
在例行檢查中，其他監管當局口頭保證客戶資料對檢查屬必要，便符合所需的證明規定，無須藉書面證明它持有該意見。
在調查中，調查員須有合理因由相信客戶可能有能力提供與調查相關的資料；單憑其他監管當局的必要性證明並不足夠。
在調查中，其他監管當局亦須認為披露或交出有關客戶事務的資料或紀錄對調查屬必要，並藉書面證明它持有該意見。
notes: 正確：第9A(1)(c)及12A(1)(c)條所指的其他監管當局，並不是就屬訂明人士的標的人士的有關當局。
錯誤：第9A(2)條要求其他監管當局藉書面證明它認為披露或交出客戶資料對施行檢查條文屬必要，口頭保證並不符合。
正確：第12A(2)(a)條另要求調查員有合理因由相信客戶可能有能力提供相關資料，並須同時符合(b)的書面證明條件。
正確：第12A(2)(b)條既要求其他監管當局認為披露或交出客戶資料對調查屬必要，亦要求藉書面證明它持有該意見。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(5)至(10)條

en.q: Regarding the offences under the AMLO for contravening a specified provision of Schedule 2, which of the following are correct?
statements: A financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
A financial institution that, with intent to defraud any relevant authority, contravenes a specified provision is liable on summary conviction to a $500,000 fine and 6 months' imprisonment.
A person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution, causes it to contravene a specified provision commits an offence.
An employee charged with causing the institution, with intent to defraud, to contravene a specified provision has a defence if he or she proves following its compliance policies and procedures.
A fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence of contravening a specified provision is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.
An MSO that contravenes a specified provision with intent to defraud the Commissioner is liable on conviction on indictment to a $1,000,000 fine and seven years' imprisonment.
notes: Correct: section 5(5)(a) makes a financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
Incorrect: section 5(6)(b) provides for a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on summary conviction, not 6 months.

Correct: section 5(8) covers a person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution or any relevant authority, causes or permits it to contravene a specified provision.

Incorrect: section 5(9) gives this defence only in proceedings for an offence under section 5(7), knowingly causing or permitting a contravention; it does not extend to the offence of doing so with intent to defraud under section 5(8).
Correct: section 5(10) provides that a fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence under the section is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.

Correct: s.5(6)(a) gives a $1,000,000 fine and seven years' imprisonment on indictment for a financial institution's contravention with intent to defraud a relevant authority; the Commissioner is the MSO's relevant authority.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》所訂違反附表2指明的條文的罪行，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
金融機構出於詐騙任何有關當局的意圖而違反指明的條文，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁6個月。
關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該機構的意圖而致使該機構違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪。
僱員被控出於詐騙意圖而致使金融機構違反指明的條文，如證明其作為是按照該機構為確保遵從而設立的政策及程序，即可作免責辯護。
如合夥因被裁定干犯違反指明的條文的罪行而遭判處罰款，該項罰款須以該合夥的資金支付。
金錢服務經營者出於詐騙關長的意圖而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
notes: 正確：第5(5)(a)條訂明，金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
不正確：第5(6)(b)條訂明，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁1年，並非6個月。
正確：第5(8)條涵蓋關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該金融機構或任何有關當局的意圖，而致使或准許該機構違反指明的條文。
不正確：第5(9)條所訂的免責辯護只適用於就第5(7)條（明知而致使或准許違反）所訂罪行提起的法律程序，並不適用於第5(8)條出於詐騙意圖的罪行。
正確：第5(10)條訂明，如合夥因被裁定干犯該條所訂罪行而遭判處罰款，該項罰款須以該合夥的資金支付。
正確：第5(6)(a)條就金融機構出於詐騙有關當局的意圖而違反指明的條文，訂明公訴定罪可處$1,000,000及監禁7年；關長是金錢服務經營者的有關當局。

en.q: Regarding offences for non-compliance with requirements imposed by an authorized person in a routine inspection or by an investigator, which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on summary conviction, by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
Failing to comply with the requirement with intent to defraud is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years.
Knowingly giving an answer false in a material particular, in purported compliance, is punishable on conviction on indictment by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.
Recklessly giving a materially false response in purported compliance with an investigator's requirement is punishable on summary conviction by a level 6 fine and imprisonment for 6 months.
notes: Correct: section 10(1) and (2)(a) make a person who, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9(3), (5), (9) or (10) liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $200,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year. Section 13(1) and (2)(a) impose the same penalty for the corresponding investigation requirements under section 12(2), (3), (4) or (5).

Correct: section 10(2)(b) provides, for that offence, a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction. Section 13(1) and (2)(b) apply the same summary penalty to the corresponding investigation offence.

Correct: section 10(5) and (9)(a) make a person who, with intent to defraud, fails to comply with the requirement liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 7 years. Section 13(5) and (9)(a) impose the same indictment penalty for fraudulent non-compliance with the corresponding investigation requirements.

Correct: section 10(3) and (4)(a) cover a person who knowingly or recklessly gives an answer false or misleading in a material particular in purported compliance, and set a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on indictment. Section 13(3) and (4)(a) impose the same indictment penalty for a knowingly or recklessly false or misleading answer given in purported compliance with an investigation requirement.
Correct: s.13(3)(b) includes recklessness as to material falsity, and s.13(4)(b) gives a level 6 fine and six months on summary conviction.

tc.q: 關於不遵從獲授權人在例行視察中或調查員在調查中施加的要求的罪行，根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。
無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
出於詐騙意圖而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
明知而以在要項上屬虛假的回答充作遵從，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
罔顧回應是否在要項上屬虛假，仍以之充作遵從調查要求，循簡易程序定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。
notes: 正確：第10(1)及(2)(a)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而沒有遵從根據第9(3)、(5)、(9)或(10)條施加的要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。第13(1)及(2)(a)條就不遵從第12(2)、(3)、(4)或(5)條下相應調查要求訂立相同刑罰。
正確：第10(2)(b)條訂明，就該罪行一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。第13(1)及(2)(b)條對相應調查罪行訂立相同的簡易程序刑罰。
正確：第10(5)及(9)(a)條訂明，任何人出於詐騙意圖而沒有遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。第13(5)及(9)(a)條就出於詐騙意圖不遵從相應調查要求訂立相同公訴刑罰。
正確：第10(3)及(4)(a)條涵蓋任何人明知或罔顧而給予在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的回答，充作遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。第13(3)及(4)(a)條就明知或罔顧而以在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的回答充作遵從調查要求，訂立相同公訴刑罰。
正確：第13(3)(b)條涵蓋罔顧是否在要項上屬虛假；第13(4)(b)條訂明簡易定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

en.q: Regarding fraudulent non-compliance with requirements imposed by an authorized person in a routine inspection or by an investigator, and related proceedings, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An employee of the person on whom the requirement is imposed commits an offence if, with intent to defraud, the employee causes or allows that person to fail to comply.
With intent to defraud, giving a materially false answer in purported compliance with an investigation requirement carries a level 6 fine and six months' imprisonment on summary conviction.

A related person who, with intent to defraud, allows the obligated person to give a materially misleading answer in purported compliance with an investigation requirement commits an offence only if financially benefited.

While proceedings to punish a person as if for contempt for the same conduct remain pending, criminal proceedings for non-compliance with an investigation requirement cannot be instituted against that person.
notes: Correct: section 10(7) makes it an offence for a related person, defined in section 10(11) to include an employee, to cause or allow the obligated person, with intent to defraud, to fail to comply with the requirement. Section 13(7) applies the same rule to investigation requirements, and section 13(14) expressly adopts section 10(11)'s definition of related person, including the obligated person's employee.
Correct: s.13(6) covers materially false or misleading answers with intent to defraud; s.13(9)(b) provides a level 6 fine and six months on summary conviction.
False: s.13(8) requires the related-person relationship, intent to defraud and causing or allowing the materially misleading response; obtaining a financial benefit is not an additional element.
Correct: s.13(10)(a)–(b) bars the specified criminal proceedings when proceedings for s.14(2)(b) concerning the same conduct have previously been instituted and remain pending.

tc.q: 關於出於詐騙意圖不遵從獲授權人的例行視察要求或調查員的調查要求，以及相關法律程序，根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 被施加該要求的人的僱員，如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許該人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。
出於詐騙意圖，以在要項上虛假的回答充作遵從調查要求，循簡易程序定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。
相關人士出於詐騙意圖容許義務人以要項上具誤導性的回答充作遵從調查要求，須另獲財務利益才屬犯罪。
就同一行為已提起的猶如藐視法庭罪般懲罰程序仍待決時，不得就不遵從調查要求另提刑事程序。
notes: 正確：第10(7)條訂明，義務人的相關人士（第10(11)條界定為包括其僱員）如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許義務人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。第13(7)條對調查要求訂有相同規則；第13(14)條明文採用第10(11)條的相關人士定義，包括義務人的僱員。
正確：第13(6)條涵蓋出於詐騙意圖給予在要項上虛假或具誤導性的回答；第13(9)(b)條訂明簡易定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。
錯誤：第13(8)條要求相關人士關係、詐騙意圖，以及致使或容許在要項上具誤導性的回應；並無另加獲取財務利益的要件。
正確：第13(10)(a)至(b)條禁止在過往已為施行第14(2)(b)條就同一行為提起的法律程序仍待決時，提起指明的刑事程序。

en.q: Regarding notices refusing a money service licence or changing its conditions, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A refusal to grant a money service licence must be communicated to the applicant by a notice in writing.
A refusal to renew a money service licence must be communicated to the licensee by a notice in writing.
A notice refusing a grant must state both the reasons and the applicant’s right to apply for Tribunal review.
A notice changing licence conditions need state reasons only when the licensee asks the Commissioner for them.
notes: Correct: ss.30(8)–(9), 31(8)–(9) and 32(2)–(3) — Section 30(8) requires notice in writing to the applicant.
Correct: ss.30(8)–(9), 31(8)–(9) and 32(2)–(3) — Section 31(8) requires written notice to the licensee.
Correct: ss.30(8)–(9), 31(8)–(9) and 32(2)–(3) — Section 30(9) requires both reasons and notice of the right to seek review.
False: ss.30(8)–(9), 31(8)–(9) and 32(2)–(3) — Section 32(3) requires reasons in the notice, without a request condition.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於拒絕批給金錢服務牌照或更改牌照條件的通知，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長拒絕批給金錢服務牌照時，須以書面通知將決定告知有關申請人。
關長拒絕將金錢服務牌照續期時，須以書面通知將決定告知有關持牌人。
拒絕批給牌照的通知，須載有決定理由，以及申請人可向覆核審裁處申請的提示。
更改牌照條件的通知，只須在持牌人向關長要求提供理由時，才載列有關理由。
notes: 正確：第30(8)至(9)、31(8)至(9)及32(2)至(3)條——第30(8)條規定須藉書面通知告知申請人。
正確：第30(8)至(9)、31(8)至(9)及32(2)至(3)條——第31(8)條規定須藉書面通知告知持牌人。
正確：第30(8)至(9)、31(8)至(9)及32(2)至(3)條——第30(9)條要求理由的說明及可申請覆核的提示。
錯誤：第30(8)至(9)、31(8)至(9)及32(2)至(3)條——第32(3)條規定通知須載有理由，並無須先提出要求的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第33條

en.q: Regarding the particulars and conditions appearing on a money service licence, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A licence for operation at specified premises must name the address of every premises where the licensee may operate.
A licence for operation without particular premises must specify the residential address of each of its directors.
The licence must be endorsed with conditions imposed or amended on grant, renewal or a later change of conditions.
The licence must use a form specified by the Commissioner and state the period for which the licence remains valid.
notes: Correct: s.33 — Section 33(a)(i) requires every permitted premises address.
False: s.33 — Section 33(a)(ii) specifies the licensee’s correspondence address.
Correct: s.33 — Section 33(b) expressly covers conditions under sections 30, 31 and 32.
Correct: s.33 — Section 33 requires the specified form and, in paragraph (c), the validity period.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於金錢服務牌照載列的資料和條件，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 准予在指明處所經營的牌照，須指明持牌人可經營金錢服務的每一個處所的地址。
准予不在特定處所經營的牌照，須指明持牌人每一名董事現時居住的住宅地址。
牌照須批註根據批給、續期或其後修改牌照條件的條文而施加或修改的條件。
牌照須採用關長指明的格式，並且必須在牌照上指明牌照的有效期間。
notes: 正確：第33條——第33(a)(i)條要求指明每一個准予經營處所的地址。
錯誤：第33條——第33(a)(ii)條指明的是持牌人的通訊地址。
正確：第33條——第33(b)條包括根據第30、31或32條施加或修改的條件。
正確：第33條——第33條要求指明格式，而(c)段要求指明有效期。

en.q: Regarding refusing approval of a proposed director, ultimate owner or partner of a licensee, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: When approval of a proposed director is refused, the written refusal notice must be given to the licensee.
When approval of a proposed ultimate owner is refused, the notice must explain the reasons for that decision.
When approval of a proposed partner is refused, the notice must state that the licensee may seek Tribunal review.
When approval of a proposed director is refused, the notice must state that the proposed director may seek review.
notes: Correct: ss.35(5)–(6), 36(5)–(6) and 37(5)–(6) — Section 35(5) names the licensee as recipient.
Correct: ss.35(5)–(6), 36(5)–(6) and 37(5)–(6) — Section 36(6)(a) requires a statement of reasons.
Correct: ss.35(5)–(6), 36(5)–(6) and 37(5)–(6) — Section 37(6)(b) requires notice of the licensee’s review right.
False: ss.35(5)–(6), 36(5)–(6) and 37(5)–(6) — Section 35(6)(b) names the licensee, not the proposed director.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於拒絕批准持牌人的擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長拒絕批准擬任董事的申請時，必須以書面通知將決定告知有關持牌人。
關長拒絕批准擬任最終擁有人的申請時，通知必須載有作出該決定的理由。
關長拒絕批准擬任合夥人的申請時，通知須提示持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核。
關長拒絕批准擬任董事的申請時，通知須提示擬任董事可向覆核審裁處申請覆核。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第44(2)至(3)條

en.q: Regarding what a disciplinary decision notice must tell a licensee, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The Commissioner must give the licensee a written notice informing it of the disciplinary decision that was made.
Where a reprimand is imposed, the notice must include the terms in which the licensee is reprimanded in the decision.
Where remedial action is ordered, the notice must include the action the licensee is required to take under the decision.
Where a longer payment period is allowed, the notice may omit the deadline so long as it specifies the penalty amount.
notes: Correct: s.44(2)–(3) — Section 44(2) requires notice in writing.
Correct: s.44(2)–(3) — Section 44(3)(b) requires the terms of the reprimand insofar as applicable.
Correct: s.44(2)–(3) — Section 44(3)(c) requires the action ordered to be specified.
False: s.44(2)–(3) — Section 44(3)(d) also requires the alternative payment time.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於紀律處分決定通知須告知持牌人的事項，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長作出紀律處分決定後，必須藉書面通知將有關決定告知有關持牌人。
如決定包括譴責，通知必須在適用範圍內，載有根據決定對持牌人的譴責內容。
如決定命令採取糾正行動，通知必須在適用範圍內，載列持牌人須採取的行動。
如准許較長繳款期，只要通知已列明罰款金額，便可不列明繳付罰款的時限。
notes: 正確：第44(2)至(3)條——第44(2)條要求書面通知。
正確：第44(2)至(3)條——第44(3)(b)條要求在適用範圍內載列譴責內容。
正確：第44(2)至(3)條——第44(3)(c)條要求載列須採取的行動。
錯誤：第44(2)至(3)條——第44(3)(d)條也要求載列不同於通常期限的繳款時限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(5)至(7)條

en.q: Regarding enforcing and publishing money service disciplinary penalties, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: On the Commissioner’s application, the Court of First Instance may register an order to pay a daily pecuniary penalty.
To seek registration, the Commissioner must give the High Court Registrar a written request and the original and a copy.
On registration, the penalty order is treated as a money-payment order made within the court’s criminal jurisdiction.
After taking disciplinary action, the Commissioner may publicly disclose the decision, reasons and material case facts.
notes: Correct: s.43(5)–(7) — Section 43(5) includes orders under subsection (4), the daily penalty power.
Correct: s.43(5)–(7) — Section 43(6) requires the notice, original and copy.
False: s.43(5)–(7) — Section 43(5) says civil jurisdiction, not criminal jurisdiction.
Correct: s.43(5)–(7) — Section 43(7) permits disclosure of these three categories.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於執行及公布金錢服務紀律罰款，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 原訟法庭可應關長的申請，登記就持續沒有採取糾正行動而作出的按日罰款命令。
關長要求登記命令時，須向高等法院司法常務官送交書面要求、命令正本及一份複本。
罰款命令一經登記，即視為原訟法庭在其刑事司法管轄權範圍內作出的繳付款項命令。
關長採取紀律行動後，可向公眾披露決定的細節、決定理由及個案的任何重要事實。
notes: 正確：第43(5)至(7)條——第43(5)條包括第(4)款的按日罰款命令。
正確：第43(5)至(7)條——第43(6)條要求書面通知、正本和一份複本。
錯誤：第43(5)至(7)條——第43(5)條指民事司法管轄權，而非刑事司法管轄權。
正確：第43(5)至(7)條——第43(7)條准許披露這三類資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(3)及69(2)至(4)條

en.q: Regarding an application to extend the time for seeking a review, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Before granting an extension, the Tribunal must give both the applicant and the specified authority a chance to be heard.
To grant an extension, the Tribunal must be satisfied there is good cause for extending the time for the review application.
A person seeking an extension must await its determination before applying for a stay of the underlying specified decision.
In granting a stay, the Tribunal may attach conditions concerning costs or the payment of money into the Tribunal.
notes: Correct: ss.59(3) and 69(2)–(4) — Section 59(3)(a) requires a reasonable opportunity for both parties.
Correct: ss.59(3) and 69(2)–(4) — Section 59(3)(b) requires good cause.
False: ss.59(3) and 69(2)–(4) — Section 69(2) allows a stay application before the extension application is determined.
Correct: ss.59(3) and 69(2)–(4) — Section 69(4) permits conditions on costs and payment into the Tribunal.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於申請延長提出覆核的期限，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處批准延長期限前，必須給予申請人及有關指明當局雙方合理的陳詞機會。
審裁處批准延長提出覆核的期限前，必須信納有良好因由批准延長有關期限。
申請延長期限的人，必須等候延長期限申請獲裁定後，才可申請暫緩執行指明決定。
審裁處批准暫緩執行時，可在訟費或繳存款項於審裁處方面，定出適當的條件。
notes: 正確：第59(3)及69(2)至(4)條——第59(3)(a)條要求給予雙方合理的陳詞機會。
正確：第59(3)及69(2)至(4)條——第59(3)(b)條要求信納有良好因由。
錯誤：第59(3)及69(2)至(4)條——第69(2)條容許在延長期限申請裁定前申請暫緩執行。
正確：第59(3)及69(2)至(4)條——第69(4)條准許就訟費及繳存款項定條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第67條

en.q: Regarding the form and proof of Review Tribunal orders, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An order made by the Tribunal must be recorded in writing and signed by the chairperson of the Tribunal.
A document appearing to be a Tribunal order signed by its chairperson is presumed valid even if contrary evidence exists.
Absent contrary evidence, such a signed document benefits from the presumption without separate proof of its making.
Even absent contrary evidence, the presumption needs separate proof that the signer actually held the chairperson’s office.
notes: Correct: s.67 — Section 67(1) requires writing and the chairperson’s signature.
False: s.67 — Section 67(2) makes the presumption subject to absence of evidence to the contrary.
Correct: s.67 — Section 67(2) expressly dispenses with proof of making.
False: s.67 — Section 67(2) dispenses also with proof of the signer’s office.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於覆核審裁處命令的格式及證明，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處在覆核中作出的命令必須以書面形式記錄，並且由覆核審裁處主席簽署。
文件看來是由主席簽署的審裁處命令，即使有相反證據，也須推定為妥為作出及簽署。
在沒有相反證據時，該類看來由主席簽署的文件，無需另行提出作出命令的證明。
即使沒有相反證據，該項推定仍須另外證明簽署命令的人確實是覆核審裁處主席。
notes: 正確：第67條——第67(1)條要求書面記錄及主席簽署。
錯誤：第67條——第67(2)條以沒有相反證據為推定的條件。
正確：第67條——第67(2)條明言無需提出作出命令的證明。
錯誤：第67條——第67(2)條也免除證明簽署人確是主席的需要。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(c)至(f)、(i)至(j)條

en.q: Regarding the Review Tribunal’s control over evidence and procedure, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The Tribunal can require attendance and production of relevant documents by written notice signed by the chairperson.
The Tribunal may examine a person attending before it, but questions can be required only if that person is under oath.
The Tribunal may order a witness to provide evidence for the purposes of the review by means of an affidavit.
The Tribunal may stay proceedings on grounds and terms it considers appropriate, having regard to the interests of justice.
notes: Correct: s.61(1)(c)–(f), (i)–(j) — Section 61(1)(c) provides for a written notice signed by the chairperson.
False: s.61(1)(c)–(f), (i)–(j) — Section 61(1)(e) says on oath or otherwise.
Correct: s.61(1)(c)–(f), (i)–(j) — Section 61(1)(f) allows the Tribunal to order evidence by affidavit.
Correct: s.61(1)(c)–(f), (i)–(j) — Section 61(1)(i) allows a stay having regard to the interests of justice.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於覆核審裁處對證據及程序的控制，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處可藉主席簽署的書面通知，要求某人出席聆訊及交出攸關覆核的文件。
審裁處可訊問到席的人，但只有在該人經宣誓的情況下，才可規定該人回答問題。
審裁處可為進行有關覆核的目的，命令證人以誓章的方式提供所需的證據。
審裁處可在顧及公正原則下，按其認為適當的理由及條款擱置覆核程序。
notes: 正確：第61(1)(c)至(f)、(i)至(j)條——第61(1)(c)條規定藉主席簽署的書面通知提出要求。
錯誤：第61(1)(c)至(f)、(i)至(j)條——第61(1)(e)條明言不論該人是否經宣誓。
正確：第61(1)(c)至(f)、(i)至(j)條——第61(1)(f)條准許命令證人以誓章提供證據。
正確：第61(1)(c)至(f)、(i)至(j)條——第61(1)(i)條准許在顧及公正原則下暫停程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(2)(c)至(e)及(4)條

en.q: Regarding conduct by witnesses and others during a Tribunal review, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A person required to attend may leave without permission once the person’s own evidence has been given.
Without reasonable excuse, deterring someone from producing documents for a review constitutes an offence.
Insulting a witness because of attending is an offence only if financial loss is also caused to the witness.
A person may refuse compliance solely because following the Tribunal’s requirement could incriminate that person.
notes: False: s.61(2)(c)–(e) and (4) — Leaving without permission is covered by section 61(2)(c), subject to reasonable excuse.
Correct: s.61(2)(c)–(e) and (4) — Section 61(2)(d) includes deterring production of documents.
False: s.61(2)(c)–(e) and (4) — Section 61(2)(e) separately lists threats, insults or causing loss, subject to reasonable excuse.
False: s.61(2)(c)–(e) and (4) — Section 61(4) excludes self-incrimination alone as an excuse for non-compliance.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於證人及其他人在審裁處覆核中的行為，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 被要求出席聆訊的人，在完成自己的證供後，即可不經審裁處准許而離開。
無合理辯解而阻嚇他人為覆核目的交出文件，屬於條例所訂的一項罪行。
因證人出席聆訊而侮辱證人，只有在同時令證人蒙受金錢損失時才屬犯罪。
任何人可僅因遵從審裁處的要求可能導致自己入罪，而拒絕遵從該項要求。
notes: 錯誤：第61(2)(c)至(e)及(4)條——第61(2)(c)條涵蓋未經准許而離開，除非有合理辯解。
正確：第61(2)(c)至(e)及(4)條——第61(2)(d)條涵蓋阻嚇他人交出文件。
錯誤：第61(2)(c)至(e)及(4)條——第61(2)(e)條以「或」連接威脅、侮辱及造成損失，並受合理辯解限制。
錯誤：第61(2)(c)至(e)及(4)條——第61(4)條不准僅以可能導致入罪為理由獲豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(1)至(2)條

en.q: Regarding costs awarded to someone attending a Tribunal review, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Someone whose attendance was necessary for the review may receive costs even without attending as a witness.
The Tribunal may award an appropriate sum for costs reasonably incurred in the review and its application.
Costs awarded to a necessary attendee must always be paid by the applicant who initiated the review.
Costs awarded to a necessary attendee are recoverable from the designated party as a criminal fine.
notes: Correct: s.65(1)–(2) — Section 65(1)(a) expressly says whether or not as a witness.
Correct: s.65(1)–(2) — Section 65(1) covers the review and application and requires reasonably incurred costs.
False: s.65(1)–(2) — Section 65(2)(a) allows any party the Tribunal considers appropriate.
False: s.65(1)–(2) — Section 65(2) makes the award recoverable as a civil debt.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於判給出席審裁處覆核的人的訟費，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 為覆核而需要出席的人，即使並非以證人身分出席，也可獲審裁處判給訟費。
審裁處可就覆核及覆核申請而合理招致的訟費，判給其認為數額適當的款項。
判給有需要出席的人的訟費，必須一律由最初提出覆核申請的申請人支付。
判給有需要出席的人的訟費，可向被指定支付的覆核一方作為刑事罰款追討。
notes: 正確：第65(1)至(2)條——第65(1)(a)條明言無論是否以證人身分。
正確：第65(1)至(2)條——第65(1)條涵蓋覆核及申請，並限定為合理招致的訟費。
錯誤：第65(1)至(2)條——第65(2)(a)條由審裁處決定適當的覆核一方支付。
錯誤：第65(1)至(2)條——第65(2)條列明可作為民事債項追討。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第66(1)(b)及(2)條

en.q: Regarding restrictions on publishing the outcome of a private Tribunal hearing, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If any part of a review hearing was private, the Tribunal may prohibit publication of part of its determination.
The power to restrict publication also covers reasons for the determination, including only part of those reasons.
The Tribunal may also prohibit publication of a costs order or any part of the reasons for making that order.
After completing the review, the Tribunal must deliver any costs order and explain the reasons for that order.
notes: Correct: s.66(1)(b), (2) — Section 66(2) applies where a sitting or any part was private.
Correct: s.66(1)(b), (2) — Section 66(2)(a) expressly includes all or part of the reasons.
Correct: s.66(1)(b), (2) — Section 66(2)(b) covers the order under section 65 and its reasons.
Correct: s.66(1)(b), (2) — Section 66(1)(b) requires delivery of costs orders and reasons as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於公布審裁處閉門聆訊結果的限制，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 只要覆核聆訊的任何部分閉門進行，審裁處便可禁止發表其裁定的任何部分。
限制發表的權力也涵蓋作出裁定的理由，包括只限制發表該等理由的某一部分。
審裁處也可禁止發表有關訟費命令，或禁止發表作出該訟費命令的部分理由。
完成覆核後，審裁處須盡快宣告就覆核作出的任何訟費命令，以及作出命令的理由。
notes: 正確：第66(1)(b)及(2)條——第66(2)條適用於聆訊或任何部分閉門進行的情況。
正確：第66(1)(b)及(2)條——第66(2)(a)條包括理由的全部或任何部分。
正確：第66(1)(b)及(2)條——第66(2)(b)條涵蓋第65條命令及其理由。
正確：第66(1)(b)及(2)條——第66(1)(b)條要求在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快宣告命令及理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第63(4)條

en.q: Regarding parallel contempt and criminal proceedings for the same Tribunal misconduct, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: While an earlier prosecution for the same conduct under the Tribunal offence provision is pending, contempt action is barred.
A prior prosecution can bar contempt action even after it ends, if that prosecution prevents lawful prosecution again for that conduct.
Once contempt proceedings have begun, a prosecution for the same conduct may proceed alongside them until contempt is finally determined.
The prohibition on taking both routes also prevents prosecution for a completely different act of misconduct during the review.
notes: Correct: s.63(4) — Section 63(4)(a) bars the contempt route while the earlier section 61(2) prosecution remains pending.
Correct: s.63(4) — Section 63(4)(a)(ii) also covers the bar to instituting proceedings again.
False: s.63(4) — Section 63(4)(b) bars a section 61(2) prosecution while the earlier contempt proceedings remain pending.
False: s.63(4) — Section 63(4) ties the restriction to the same conduct.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於就同一審裁處不當行為並行進行藐視及刑事程序，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就同一行為按審裁處罪行條文提出的較早刑事程序仍待決時，不得行使藐視懲罰權力。
較早刑事程序結束後，如因此不得就同一行為再次合法檢控，仍不得行使藐視懲罰權力。
按藐視法庭罪追究的程序待決時，可同時就同一行為檢控，直至該程序獲最終裁定。
不得並用兩種程序的規定，也禁止就覆核過程中另一項完全不同的不當行為提出刑事檢控。
notes: 正確：第63(4)條——第63(4)(a)條禁止在較早第61(2)條刑事程序待決時行使藐視懲罰權。
正確：第63(4)條——第63(4)(a)(ii)條也涵蓋因較早程序而不得再次合法檢控的情況。
錯誤：第63(4)條——第63(4)(b)條禁止在較早按藐視法庭罪追究的程序待決時就同一行為根據第61(2)條檢控。
錯誤：第63(4)條——第63(4)條將限制繫於同一行為，不是所有不同事件。

en.q: Regarding changes in particulars, licence display and closure, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The duty to report changed particulars also covers particulars already supplied through an earlier change notification.
After receiving a change notification, the Commissioner must update relevant register particulars where this is necessary.
A licensee returning its licence for cancellation after closure is entitled to a refund of the unused licence period.
Failing without reasonable excuse to display the original licence is punishable on conviction by a level 5 fine.
notes: Correct: ss.39A(2), 40(2)–(3) and 41(3) — Section 40(2) includes particulars notified under subsection (1).
Correct: ss.39A(2), 40(2)–(3) and 41(3) — Section 40(3) says if necessary and as soon as reasonably practicable.
False: ss.39A(2), 40(2)–(3) and 41(3) — Section 41(3) provides no refund of grant or renewal fees on cancellation.
Correct: ss.39A(2), 40(2)–(3) and 41(3) — Section 39A(2) specifies a level 5 fine.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於詳情改變、展示牌照及停業，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 具報詳情改變的責任，也涵蓋持牌人先前在具報改變時已經提供予關長的詳情。
關長接獲具報改變後，須在有需要時，盡快修改登記冊內有關的詳情。
持牌人停業後將牌照交回以作取消，有權獲退還牌照尚未使用期間的牌照費。
無合理辯解而沒有展示牌照正本的持牌人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款。
notes: 正確：第39A(2)、40(2)至(3)及41(3)條——第40(3)條要求在有需要時，在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快修改。
錯誤：第39A(2)、40(2)至(3)及41(3)條——第41(3)條規定已付批給或續期牌照費不予退回。

en.q: Regarding the mandatory preparation for exercising pecuniary penalty powers, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Before first using the money service penalty power, the Commissioner must publish guidelines on how it will be used.
Those money service guidelines must be published in the Gazette as well as any other manner considered appropriate.
The Commissioner must have regard to the published guidelines when using the money service pecuniary penalty power.
For the separate financial-institution penalty power, the relevant authority likewise must publish guidelines before first use.
notes: Correct: ss.23(1)–(2) and 45(1)–(2) — Section 45(1) requires publication before the first use.
Correct: ss.23(1)–(2) and 45(1)–(2) — Section 45(1) requires Gazette publication and any other appropriate manner.
Correct: ss.23(1)–(2) and 45(1)–(2) — Section 45(2) requires regard to the published guidelines.
Correct: ss.23(1)–(2) and 45(1)–(2) — Section 23(1) imposes the analogous publication requirement for section 21(2)(c).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於行使施加罰款權力前的法定準備，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長首次使用金錢服務罰款權力前，必須公布指引，示明擬採用何種方式行使該權力。
上述金錢服務罰款指引必須在憲報刊登，並以關長認為適當的其他方式公布。
關長使用金錢服務罰款權力時，必須顧及按法定要求刊登及公布的罰款指引。
就另一項金融機構罰款權力而言，有關當局也必須在首次行使該權力前公布指引。
notes: 正確：第23(1)至(2)及45(1)至(2)條——第45(1)條要求首次行使權力前公布指引。
正確：第23(1)至(2)及45(1)至(2)條——第45(1)條同時要求憲報刊登及其他認為適當的公布方式。
正確：第23(1)至(2)及45(1)至(2)條——第45(2)條要求顧及已公布指引。
正確：第23(1)至(2)及45(1)至(2)條——第23(1)條就第21(2)(c)條權力施加相同的預先公布要求。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(10)至(11)條

en.q: Regarding a licence that expires while a valid renewal application awaits decision, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If the application is still pending and the licence has not been revoked or suspended, the licence can continue beyond its old expiry date.
If the licensee withdraws the renewal application after the old expiry date, the pending-renewal protection continues until a refusal is issued.
If the licence is suspended while the renewal application remains pending, the application itself does not preserve the right to keep operating.
If renewal is granted after the old expiry date, its effective date is the day after the licence would otherwise have expired.
notes: Correct: s.31(10)–(11) — Section 31(10) keeps the licence in force pending determination, subject to its exceptions.
False: s.31(10)–(11) — Withdrawal is an express exception to continued validity.
Correct: s.31(10)–(11) — Suspension under section 34 is an express exception.
Correct: s.31(10)–(11) — Section 31(11)(b) prevents a gap in the renewal period.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於有效續期申請待決期間到期的牌照，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如申請仍待決，而且牌照未被撤銷或暫時吊銷，牌照可在原本屆滿日期之後繼續有效。
如持牌人在原屆滿日後撤回續期申請，待決續期的保障仍持續，直至關長發出拒絕決定。
如牌照在續期申請待決時被暫時吊銷，申請本身不能保留持牌人繼續經營的權利。
如原屆滿日之後才批給續期，續期生效日為沒有待決延續規定時牌照本應屆滿之日的翌日。
notes: 正確：第31(10)至(11)條——第31(10)條在例外限制下維持牌照效力。
錯誤：第31(10)至(11)條——撤回申請是持續有效的明文例外。
正確：第31(10)至(11)條——第34條的暫時吊銷是明文例外。
正確：第31(10)至(11)條——第31(11)(b)條把續期起點定為本應屆滿之日的翌日。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(7)條

en.q: Regarding the start date of a condition imposed when a licence is granted, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A grant-condition notice received on 4 June and specifying 8 June takes effect on 8 June rather than immediately on receipt.
A grant-condition notice received on 10 June but specifying 8 June makes the condition effective retrospectively from 8 June.
A grant-condition notice received and specifying effect on the same day starts on that day, without an added 21-day waiting period.
Posting a grant-condition notice on 1 June makes the condition effective that day even if receipt and the specified time are later.
notes: Correct: s.30(7) — The later of receipt and specified time controls.
False: s.30(7) — Receipt on 10 June is later, so the condition starts then.
Correct: s.30(7) — Section 30(7) supplies a specific commencement rule.
False: s.30(7) — Dispatch is not the trigger in section 30(7).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於批給牌照時施加條件的生效日期，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 批給牌照的條件通知在6月4日收到、指明6月8日生效，條件在6月8日才生效。
批給牌照的條件通知在6月10日收到、指明6月8日生效，條件會追溯至6月8日生效。
批給牌照的條件通知在收到當天指明生效，條件當天生效，無須另等21日。
批給牌照的條件通知在6月1日寄出，即使接獲及指明時間較後，也在寄出當日生效。
notes: 正確：第30(7)條——接獲時間與指明時間以較遲者為準。
錯誤：第30(7)條——6月10日收到通知較遲，應在該日生效。
正確：第30(7)條——第30(7)條另有明確的生效規則。
錯誤：第30(7)條——第30(7)條不是以寄出日期觸發生效。

en.q: Regarding new and existing occupants of domestic MSO premises, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If a new occupant refuses written entry consent, the Commissioner may exercise the statutory revocation or suspension powers.
Consent from every original occupant protects the licence even if a newly arrived occupant refuses to give written consent.
One existing occupant withdrawing consent can trigger the power even if every other occupant maintains written consent.
A new occupant’s refusal automatically cancels the licence without a decision or an opportunity for the licensee to be heard.
notes: Correct: s.34(1)(b), (2)–(3) — Section 34(1)(b)(ii) expressly addresses new occupants.
False: s.34(1)(b), (2)–(3) — New occupants’ refusal is independently specified.
Correct: s.34(1)(b), (2)–(3) — Section 34(1)(b)(i) says any occupant.
False: s.34(1)(b), (2)–(3) — Section 34 gives discretionary powers exercisable after a reasonable opportunity to be heard.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於金錢服務住宅處所的新舊佔用人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如住宅處所的新佔用人拒絕書面進入同意，關長可行使法定撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照權力。
只要原有佔用人全部曾經同意，即使新入住佔用人拒絕書面同意，牌照也不受該理由影響。
即使其他佔用人全都保留書面同意，一名原有佔用人撤回同意也足以觸發有關權力。
新佔用人拒絕同意便會自動取消牌照，無須關長決定，也無須給持牌人陳詞機會。
notes: 正確：第34(1)(b)、(2)至(3)條——第34(1)(b)(ii)條明確處理新佔用人。
錯誤：第34(1)(b)、(2)至(3)條——新佔用人拒絕同意是獨立列出的理由。
錯誤：第34(1)(b)、(2)至(3)條——第34條給予酌情權，並要求先給予合理陳詞機會。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條最終擁有人定義(c)段

en.q: Regarding whether an individual is an ultimate owner of a corporate licensee, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An individual with exactly 25% of issued capital, no voting control and no ultimate management control fails the share-capital limb.
An individual controlling 30% of issued capital indirectly through a trust can qualify without holding those shares personally.
An individual controlling 30% of general-meeting voting rights can qualify despite holding no issued shares in the corporation.
An individual with ultimate management control can qualify even with no shares and no more than 25% of voting rights.
notes: Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c) — The share-capital test is more than 25%, not 25% or more.
Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c) — Indirect ownership or control through a trust is expressly included.
Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c) — Voting control is an alternative limb rather than an additional shareholding condition.
Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c) — Ultimate management control is a separate alternative limb.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於個人是否屬法團的持牌人的最終擁有人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 個人恰好持有25%已發行股本，沒有投票控制或最終管理控制，不符合股本比例的條件。
個人透過信託間接控制30%已發行股本，即使沒有以個人名義持股，也可符合定義。
個人控制成員大會30%投票權，即使沒有持有法團的已發行股份，也可符合定義。
個人具有最終管理控制，即使沒有股份且投票權不超過25%，也可符合最終擁有人定義。
notes: 正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)段——股本條件是25%以上，而非等於或超過25%。
正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)段——定義明確包括透過信託的間接擁有或控制。
正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)段——投票控制屬另一獨立條件，並非附加持股要求。
正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)段——最終管理控制是另一獨立條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)至(3)條

en.q: Regarding closing one of several licensed premises, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Closing only one licensed branch still requires the licensee to notify the Commissioner of the intention before its closure date.
Keeping the other licensed branch open allows the licensee to retain the unchanged licence instead of returning it for amendment.
The closure notice must state the intended closure date as well as the intention to stop operating at that particular premises.
After receiving the returned licence, the Commissioner removes relevant register particulars as soon as reasonably practicable.
notes: Correct: s.41(1)–(3) — Section 41(1) includes ceasing at any specified premises.
False: s.41(1)–(3) — The partial-closure case is still subject to section 41(1)(b).
Correct: s.41(1)–(3) — Section 41(1)(a) requires both intention and date.
Correct: s.41(1)–(3) — Section 41(2)(b) requires removal of relevant particulars.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於停止在多個持牌處所中的一個處所營業，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 只關閉其中一個持牌分店，仍須在停業日期前向關長具報停止在該處所營業的意向。
只要另一持牌分店仍繼續營業，持牌人便可保留未經修訂的牌照，無須交回作修訂。
停業通知除了表明停止在該特定處所經營的意向，也必須載明擬定的停業日期。
關長收到交回的牌照後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快刪除登記冊的有關詳情。
notes: 正確：第41(1)至(3)條——第41(1)條包括停止在任何指明處所經營。
錯誤：第41(1)至(3)條——部分處所停業仍須遵從第41(1)(b)條。
正確：第41(1)至(3)條——第41(1)(a)條同時要求意向及日期。
正確：第41(1)至(3)條——第41(2)(b)條要求刪除有關詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(b)至(e)條

en.q: Regarding facts relevant to fitness and propriety of an MSO applicant, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A foreign conviction requiring a finding of dishonesty is a listed consideration even if it is not itself a money-laundering offence.
An individual subject to current bankruptcy proceedings is a listed consideration even before adjudication as an undischarged bankrupt.
A corporate applicant with an appointed receiver is a listed consideration only if the corporation has also entered liquidation.
The listed considerations prevent the Commissioner taking another relevant matter into account when judging fitness and propriety.
notes: Correct: s.30(4)(b)–(e) — Section 30(4)(b)(iii) separately includes fraud, corruption or dishonesty.
Correct: s.30(4)(b)–(e) — Section 30(4)(d) includes being the subject of bankruptcy proceedings.
False: s.30(4)(b)–(e) — Section 30(4)(e) uses or, not a combined requirement.
False: s.30(4)(b)–(e) — Section 30(4) expressly adds any other matter considered relevant.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於判斷金錢服務申請人適當人選資格的事實，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 外地定罪必須涉及不誠實裁斷時，即使不是洗錢罪，也屬明列須顧及的事宜。
個人現為破產程序的標的，即使尚未被判為未獲解除破產的破產人，也屬明列考慮事宜。
法團申請人有接管人獲委任，只有在法團同時已進入清盤時，才屬明列的考慮事宜。
列明的考慮事宜，會阻止關長在判斷適當人選資格時，考慮其他有關的事項。
notes: 正確：第30(4)(b)至(e)條——第30(4)(b)(iii)條獨立涵蓋欺詐、舞弊或不誠實。
正確：第30(4)(b)至(e)條——第30(4)(d)條包括作為破產程序的標的。
錯誤：第30(4)(b)至(e)條——第30(4)(e)條以「或」連接，並非須同時符合。
錯誤：第30(4)(b)至(e)條——第30(4)條明確要求也考慮其他認為有關的事宜。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(1)至(4)條

en.q: Regarding a disciplinary fine and a further daily penalty, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If a remedial order gives a deadline, the further daily penalty can cover continuing failure after that deadline has passed.
A licensee given extra time to pay its monetary penalty may use that payment extension to postpone the separate remedial deadline.
An order imposing a monetary penalty can be accompanied by a public reprimand because the Commissioner may use more than one power.
The ordinary thirty-day payment period begins when the penalty order takes effect as a specified decision, not when an inspection starts.
notes: Correct: s.43(1)–(4) — Section 43(4) counts failure continuing after the specified remedial deadline.
False: s.43(1)–(4) — Section 43(3) concerns payment, while section 43(4) uses the date fixed for remedial action.
Correct: s.43(1)–(4) — Section 43(1) permits any one or more powers.
Correct: s.43(1)–(4) — Section 43(3) expressly starts time after the order takes effect under section 75.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於紀律罰款及進一步按日罰款，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 命令採取糾正行動如指明期限，進一步按日罰款可涵蓋在該期限之後持續沒有遵從命令的情況。
持牌人獲延長繳付罰款期限後，可用該繳款延期，順延另一項糾正行動的期限。
施加罰款的命令可同時附有公開譴責，因為關長可行使多於一項的紀律處分權力。
通常三十日繳款期由罰款命令作為指明決定生效時起計，而不是由視察開始時起計。
notes: 正確：第43(1)至(4)條——第43(4)條針對採取糾正行動期限後持續沒有遵從的情況。
錯誤：第43(1)至(4)條——第43(3)條處理繳款期限，第43(4)條則按糾正行動的指定期限。
正確：第43(1)至(4)條——第43(1)條准許行使一項或多於一項權力。
正確：第43(1)至(4)條——第43(3)條明確從命令根據第75條生效後起計。

en.q: Regarding sharing confidential inspection information for professional advice, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An MSO subject to an inspection requirement may disclose relevant information to a solicitor acting professionally to advise on the AMLO matter.
That professional-advice exception also permits posting the inspection information publicly to obtain informal advice from anyone online.
When the authority consents to a disclosure, it may impose appropriate conditions instead of granting unrestricted permission.
A recipient given the information under the advice exception is automatically free to pass it on because the first disclosure was lawful.
notes: Correct: s.76E(2), (4)(b), (5) and s.76F(1) — Section 76E(4)(b) expressly permits seeking professional advice.
False: s.76E(2), (4)(b), (5) and s.76F(1) — The exception requires a professional adviser acting or proposing to act professionally on the AMLO matter.
Correct: s.76E(2), (4)(b), (5) and s.76F(1) — Section 76E(5) permits conditions on consent.
False: s.76E(2), (4)(b), (5) and s.76F(1) — Section 76F(1) imposes a separate onward-disclosure restriction, subject to its own exceptions.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於為專業意見而披露保密視察資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 受視察要求規限的經營者，可向以專業身分就條例事宜提供意見的律師披露有關資料。
專業意見例外也准許在網上公開張貼視察資料，以向任何網民徵求非正式意見。
有關當局同意披露資料時，可施加其認為適當的條件，並非必須給予不受限制的准許。
資料收取人根據徵詢意見例外獲得資料後，只因首次披露合法，便自動可再向任何人披露。
notes: 正確：第76E(2)、(4)(b)、(5)及76F(1)條——第76E(4)(b)條明確准許徵詢專業意見。
錯誤：第76E(2)、(4)(b)、(5)及76F(1)條——例外要求專業顧問以或擬以專業身分就條例事宜行事。
正確：第76E(2)、(4)(b)、(5)及76F(1)條——第76E(5)條准許就同意施加條件。
錯誤：第76E(2)、(4)(b)、(5)及76F(1)條——第76F(1)條另行限制轉披露，須符合該條本身的例外。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 ss.2(1)(a), 5(1)(b), 13(2) and 16; Sample Questions MSSB/CA_01/2021, Example (3)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)、5(1)(b)、13(2)及16條；參考試題 MSSB/CA_01/2021 例子(3)

en.q: Regarding the statutory Customer Due Diligence (CDD) requirements of an MSO licensee, which of the following measures are correct?
statements: Identifying the customer and verifying the customer’s identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a governmental body
MSO must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account

MSO must continuously monitor the business relationship with a customer by conducting appropriate scrutiny of transactions carried out for the customer to ensure that they are consistent with its knowledge of the customer and the customer’s business and risk profile
Before carrying out a remittance transaction involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, MSO must verify the identity of the originator by reference to the originator’s identification document
notes: Correct: section 2(1)(a) of Schedule 2 has a financial institution identify the customer and verify its identity on documents, data or information from listed sources, the first of which is a governmental body.
Correct: section 16 of Schedule 2 forbids opening or maintaining any anonymous account, or an account in a fictitious name, for any customer.

Correct: under section 5(1)(b) of Schedule 2, continuous monitoring includes scrutinising transactions to ensure they are consistent with the knowledge of the customer and the customer's business and risk profile.
Correct: section 13(2) of Schedule 2 requires this before a remittance of $8,000 or more that is not a wire transfer; a wire transfer of that size is an occasional transaction that calls for CDD.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者持牌人的法定客戶盡職審查規定，下列哪項正確？
statements: 識別客户的身分，及根據政府機構所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實該客户的身分。
金錢服務經營者不得開立或維持匿名戶口。
金錢服務經營者須藉對為客戶執行的交易進行適當的審查，以確保它們符合其對客戶、客戶的業務及風險狀況的認知，以持續監察與客戶的業務關係。
金錢服務經營者在進行涉及相等於$8,000或以上的款額的匯款交易前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分。
notes: 正確：附表2第2(1)(a)條規定金融機構須識別客戶的身分，並根據所列來源提供的文件、數據或資料核實其身分，首項來源即為政府機構。
正確：附表2第16條規定不得為任何客戶開立或維持匿名戶口，亦不得以虛構的姓名或名稱開立或維持戶口。
正確：附表2第5(1)(b)條規定須對為客戶執行的交易進行適當的審查，以確保它們符合對客戶、客戶的業務及風險狀況的認知。
正確：附表2第13(2)條規定，在進行涉及相等於$8,000或以上、並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易之前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件核實其身分；同等款額的電傳轉賬屬須執行客戶盡職審查的非經常交易。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 ss.1(1) and 3(1), (1A); AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.2.1 and footnote 15
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)、3(1)及(1A)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.1段及註腳15

en.q: Regarding when an MSO must carry out customer due diligence measures in relation to a customer, which of the following are correct?
statements: CDD measures are required before a transaction of $120,000 or more for a customer who has no business relationship with the MSO.
CDD measures are required before an occasional transaction that is a wire transfer of $8,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency.
CDD measures are required before an occasional currency exchange of $8,000 or more, or an equivalent amount in another currency.
CDD measures are required when the MSO suspects the customer or its account of money laundering or terrorist financing, whatever the amount involved.
CDD measures are required when the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of information previously obtained to identify or verify the customer.
notes: Correct: section 3(1)(b) of Schedule 2 requires CDD measures before an occasional transaction of $120,000 or more, and section 1(1) defines an occasional transaction as one with a customer who does not have a business relationship with the MSO.
Correct: section 3(1A)(a) of Schedule 2 requires CDD measures before an occasional transaction that is a wire transfer involving $8,000 or more, or an equivalent amount in any other currency.
Incorrect: a currency exchange is not a wire transfer, so the threshold is the $120,000 in section 3(1)(b) of Schedule 2; the $8,000 threshold in section 3(1A)(a) is for wire transfers.

Correct: section 3(1)(d) of Schedule 2 requires CDD measures when the MSO suspects that the customer or the customer's account is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing, and footnote 15 to ¶4.2.1 of the Guideline says this criterion applies irrespective of the $120,000 or $8,000 threshold.

Correct: section 3(1)(e) of Schedule 2 requires CDD measures when the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of any information previously obtained for identifying the customer or for verifying the customer's identity.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者須在何時就客戶執行客戶盡職審查措施，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 為與金錢服務經營者沒有業務關係的客戶執行涉及$120,000或以上款額的交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。
為客戶執行屬電傳轉賬、涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。
為客戶執行涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）、屬貨幣兌換的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。
當金錢服務經營者懷疑客戶或客戶的戶口涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時，不論所涉款額多少，均須執行客戶盡職審查措施。
當金錢服務經營者懷疑過往為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的資料是否真實或充分時，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。
notes: 正確：附表2第3(1)(b)條規定，在執行涉及相等於$120,000或以上款額的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施；第1(1)條把非經常交易界定為與沒有業務關係的客戶之間的交易。
正確：附表2第3(1A)(a)條規定，在為客戶執行屬電傳轉賬並涉及相等於$8,000或以上款額（或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額）的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。
不正確：貨幣兌換並非電傳轉賬，適用的門檻是附表2第3(1)(b)條的$120,000；第3(1A)(a)條的$8,000門檻是為電傳轉賬而設。
正確：附表2第3(1)(d)條規定，當懷疑客戶或客戶的戶口涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時，須執行客戶盡職審查措施；指引第4.2.1段的註腳15指出，即使低於適用於非經常交易的120,000元或8,000元門檻，此準則仍然適用。
正確：附表2第3(1)(e)條規定，當懷疑過往為識別客戶的身分或核實客戶的身分而取得的資料是否真實或充分時，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)及(2)至(4)條

en.q: Regarding verifying identity after a business relationship is established, and an MSO that cannot complete customer due diligence, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO that verifies identity after establishing a business relationship must complete the verification as soon as reasonably practicable afterwards.

An MSO may verify identity after an occasional transaction of $120,000 or more if needed to avoid interrupting normal business and any money laundering or terrorist financing risk is effectively managed.
An MSO that cannot carry out the required CDD measures for a customer must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with that customer.
An MSO with an existing business relationship that is unable to complete deferred verification must consider restricting or terminating that relationship.

Verification may be put off until after a business relationship is established only if needed to avoid interrupting normal business and any money laundering or terrorist financing risk is effectively managed.
notes: Correct: section 3(3) of Schedule 2 requires an MSO that verifies after establishing a business relationship to complete the verification as soon as reasonably practicable after establishing the relationship.

Incorrect: section 3(2) of Schedule 2 allows verification after establishing a business relationship, and only then; for an occasional transaction of $120,000 or more, section 3(1)(b) requires the CDD measures before it is carried out.
Correct: section 3(4)(a) of Schedule 2 says an MSO unable to comply must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with that customer.
Incorrect: section 3(4)(b) of Schedule 2 says the MSO must terminate the business relationship as soon as reasonably practicable; considering a restriction instead is not what it requires.

Correct: section 3(2) of Schedule 2 allows later verification if this is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business with the customer and any risk of money laundering or terrorist financing it may cause is effectively managed.

tc.q: 關於在建立業務關係之後才核實身分，以及金錢服務經營者未能完成客戶盡職審查的情況，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在建立業務關係之後才核實身分的金錢服務經營者，須在該關係建立之後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快完成核實。
如為免干擾正常業務而必需，且洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理，便可在$120,000或以上的非經常交易之後才核實客戶身分。
金錢服務經營者如不能夠就某客戶執行所需的客戶盡職審查措施，不可與該客戶建立業務關係，亦不可與該客戶執行任何非經常交易。
已與客戶建立業務關係的金錢服務經營者，如未能完成延後進行的身分核實，須考慮限制或結束與該客戶的業務關係。
只有在為免干擾正常業務而必需，且洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理時，才可延至建立業務關係之後核實身分。
notes: 正確：附表2第3(3)條規定，在建立業務關係之後才進行核實的金錢服務經營者，須在該關係建立之後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快完成有關核實。
不正確：附表2第3(2)條只容許在建立業務關係之後才核實身分；就涉及$120,000或以上的非經常交易而言，第3(1)(b)條規定須在執行該交易之前執行客戶盡職審查措施。
正確：附表2第3(4)(a)條規定，不能夠遵守有關規定的金錢服務經營者，不可與該客戶建立業務關係，亦不可與該客戶執行任何非經常交易。
不正確：附表2第3(4)(b)條規定，如已與該客戶建立業務關係，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快結束該關係；並非只須考慮限制該關係。
正確：附表2第3(2)條規定，須為就客戶的業務正常運作不造成干擾而必需，且在業務關係建立之後才進行核實而可能引致的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理，才可在建立業務關係之後核實身分。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 s.4(3) and (5); Sch. 1 Pt. 2 s.1 (definition of “financial institution”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)及(5)條；附表1第2部第1條（「金融機構」的定義）

en.q: Under the AMLO, when about to establish a business relationship, or to carry out an occasional transaction that calls for customer due diligence, in which of the following cases may an MSO carry out simplified customer due diligence?
statements: The customer is a corporation listed on any stock exchange, whether the exchange is in Hong Kong or elsewhere.
The customer is another licensed money service operator, which the AMLO counts as a financial institution.
The customer is the government of any jurisdiction outside Hong Kong, whether an equivalent jurisdiction or otherwise.
The product is a pension scheme insurance policy that contains no surrender clause and cannot be used as collateral.
The product is a life insurance policy for which an annual premium of up to $20,000 is payable.
The customer is a body in an equivalent jurisdiction that performs functions similar to those of a public body.
notes: Correct: section 4(3)(c) of Schedule 2 lists a corporation listed on any stock exchange.
Correct: section 4(3)(a) of Schedule 2 lists a financial institution, and Part 2 of Schedule 1 includes a licensed money service operator in the definition of financial institution.
Incorrect: section 4(3)(f) of Schedule 2 lists the government of an equivalent jurisdiction, not the government of any jurisdiction outside Hong Kong.

Correct: section 4(5)(b) of Schedule 2 lists an insurance policy for the purposes of a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme that does not contain a surrender clause and cannot be used as a collateral.
Incorrect: section 4(5)(c) of Schedule 2 lists a life insurance policy with an annual premium of no more than $8,000; $20,000 is the limit for a single premium.
Correct: section 4(3)(f) of Schedule 2 lists a body in an equivalent jurisdiction that performs functions similar to those of a public body.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，在將要建立業務關係，或將要執行須進行客戶盡職審查的非經常交易時，金錢服務經營者在下列哪些情況下可執行簡化客戶盡職審查？
statements: 客戶是在任何證券市場上市的法團，不論該證券市場位於香港或其他地方。
客戶是另一持牌金錢服務經營者，即《打擊洗錢條例》所指的金融機構。
客戶是香港以外任何司法管轄區的政府，包括對等司法管轄區以外的司法管轄區。
產品是為退休金計劃的目的而購買、不載有退回條款及不可用作抵押品的保險單。
產品是須繳付的每年保費在$20,000或以下的人壽保險單。
客戶是在對等司法管轄區執行與公共機構的職能相類似的職能的機構。
notes: 正確：附表2第4(3)(c)條列出在任何證券市場上市的法團。
正確：附表2第4(3)(a)條列出金融機構，而附表1第2部的金融機構定義包括持牌金錢服務經營者。
不正確：附表2第4(3)(f)條列出的是對等司法管轄區的政府，並非香港以外任何司法管轄區的政府。
正確：附表2第4(5)(b)條列出為公積金計劃、退休金計劃、退休計劃或離職金計劃的目的而購買、不載有退回條款及不可用作抵押品的保險單。
不正確：附表2第4(5)(c)條列出的是須繳付的每年保費不多於$8,000的人壽保險單；$20,000是一筆整付保費的上限。
正確：附表2第4(3)(f)條列出在對等司法管轄區執行與公共機構的職能相類似的職能的機構。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 ss.3(1), (1A) and 4(1), (2); AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.8.3(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)、(1A)及4(1)、(2)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.3(b)段

en.q: Regarding simplified customer due diligence under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Before establishing a business relationship, an MSO may carry out simplified CDD if it has reasonable grounds to believe that the customer is of a listed kind.
An MSO may carry out simplified CDD for a listed customer even when it suspects the customer of involvement in money laundering or terrorist financing.
Under simplified CDD, the MSO may omit verifying the customer's identity, but must still identify and verify the identity of the customer's beneficial owner.
When establishing a business relationship with a customer outside the listed kinds, the MSO need not identify the beneficial owners of an entity of a listed kind in its ownership chain.
Before an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or more, an MSO may carry out simplified CDD if it has reasonable grounds to believe that the customer is of a listed kind.
notes: Correct: section 4(1) of Schedule 2 allows simplified CDD in the circumstance in section 3(1)(a), before establishing a business relationship, if the MSO has reasonable grounds to believe that the customer falls within section 4(3).

Incorrect: section 4(1) of Schedule 2 allows simplified CDD only in the circumstances in section 3(1)(a) and (b), (1A) and (1B); a suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing is the separate circumstance in section 3(1)(d). The AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.8.3(b) also says SDD measures should not be applied where the MSO suspects ML or TF.

Incorrect: section 4(1) of Schedule 2 lets the MSO carry out only the measures in section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d), so it still identifies and verifies the customer; it is the beneficial owner measure in section 2(1)(b) that is left out.

Correct: section 4(2) of Schedule 2 says that, in the circumstances it names, including establishing a business relationship, the MSO is not required to identify, or verify the identities of, the beneficial owners of that entity or of any person in that chain beyond that entity.
Correct: the circumstances in section 4(1) of Schedule 2 include section 3(1A), the occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or more, so simplified CDD is available there on the same reasonable grounds.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》下的簡化客戶盡職審查，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在與客戶建立業務關係之前，如金錢服務經營者有合理理由相信客戶屬所列的類別，便可執行簡化客戶盡職審查。
即使金錢服務經營者懷疑某名所列客戶涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集，仍可就該客戶執行簡化客戶盡職審查。
在簡化客戶盡職審查下，金錢服務經營者可略去核實客戶的身分，但仍須識別及核實客戶的實益擁有人的身分。
與不屬所列類別的客戶建立業務關係時，如其實益擁有權鏈狀架構中有屬所列類別的實體，金錢服務經營者無需識別該實體的實益擁有人。
在執行涉及$8,000或以上款額的非經常電傳轉賬之前，如金錢服務經營者有合理理由相信客戶屬所列的類別，便可執行簡化客戶盡職審查。
notes: 正確：附表2第4(1)條容許在第3(1)(a)條所列的情況中，即在建立業務關係之前，如有合理理由相信客戶屬第4(3)條所指的客戶，執行簡化客戶盡職審查。
不正確：附表2第4(1)條只容許在第3(1)(a)及(b)、(1A)及(1B)條所列的情況中執行簡化客戶盡職審查；懷疑涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集屬第3(1)(d)條所列的另一情況。《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.8.3(b)段亦訂明，金錢服務經營者懷疑有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集活動時，便不應執行簡化盡職審查措施。
不正確：附表2第4(1)條容許只執行第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c)及(d)條所列的措施，因此仍須識別及核實客戶的身分；略去的是第2(1)(b)條關於實益擁有人的措施。
正確：附表2第4(2)條規定，在其所列的情況中（包括建立業務關係），無需識別或核實該實體的實益擁有人，或在該架構中位於該實體以上的任何人的實益擁有人的身分。
正確：附表2第4(1)條所列的情況包括第3(1A)條，即屬電傳轉賬並涉及$8,000或以上款額的非經常交易，因此亦可基於同樣的合理理由執行簡化客戶盡職審查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10條

en.q: Regarding the special requirements of the AMLO that apply when a customer of an MSO is a politically exposed person, which of the following are correct?
statements: Before establishing a business relationship with the customer, the MSO must obtain approval from its money laundering reporting officer.
Before establishing a business relationship, the MSO must take reasonable measures to establish the customer's source of wealth and of the funds involved.
Where an existing customer has become a politically exposed person, the MSO must terminate its business relationship with that customer.
The same requirements apply where it is a beneficial owner of the customer, and not the customer itself, who is the politically exposed person.
The requirements cease to apply as soon as the person's prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong comes to an end.
notes: Incorrect: section 10(1)(a) of Schedule 2 requires approval from the senior management, not from the MLRO.

Correct: section 10(1)(b) of Schedule 2 requires reasonable measures to establish the customer's or beneficial owner's source of wealth and the source of the funds that will be involved in the proposed business relationship.

Incorrect: section 10(2) of Schedule 2 says the MSO must not continue the relationship unless it has obtained senior management approval and taken reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and of the funds; with both done, it need not terminate it.
Correct: section 10(1) and (2) of Schedule 2 apply where a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer is a politically exposed person.

Incorrect: section 10(3) of Schedule 2 disapplies the requirements only if the MSO is satisfied that the person is a former politically exposed person who, based on an appropriate risk assessment, does not present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者的客戶屬政治人物時《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的特別規定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者在與該客戶建立業務關係之前，須取得其洗錢報告主任的批准。
建立業務關係前，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施確立該客戶的財富及所涉資金的來源。
如現有客戶已成為政治人物，金錢服務經營者須結束與該客戶的業務關係。
如屬政治人物的並非客戶本身，而是客戶的實益擁有人，同樣的規定亦適用。
一旦有關人士在香港以外地方擔任的重要公職結束，有關規定即告停止適用。
notes: 不正確：附表2第10(1)(a)條規定須取得有關高級管理層的批准，並非洗錢報告主任的批准。
正確：附表2第10(1)(b)條規定須採取合理措施，確立該客戶或該實益擁有人的財富來源，及將會牽涉於擬建立的業務關係中的資金來源。
不正確：附表2第10(2)條規定，除非已取得有關高級管理層的批准，並已採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源，否則不可維持與該客戶的業務關係；兩者均已完成，便無需結束該關係。
正確：附表2第10(1)及(2)條適用於客戶或客戶的實益擁有人屬政治人物的情況。
不正確：附表2第10(3)條規定，須信納該人屬前政治人物，並基於適當風險評估，該前政治人物不會造成洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集方面的高度風險，有關規定才不適用。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following are politically exposed persons as the AMLO defines the term?
statements: An individual entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong as a senior executive of a state-owned corporation
An individual entrusted with a prominent public function in Hong Kong as a senior government or judicial official
The spouse of a child of an individual entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
A brother or sister of an individual entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
An individual who has been, but is no longer, entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
An individual entrusted with a public function outside Hong Kong as a middle-ranking official of a government department
notes: Correct: paragraph (a)(i) of the definition in section 1(1) of Schedule 2 includes a senior executive of a state-owned corporation among individuals entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong.
Incorrect: paragraph (a) of the definition covers a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong; an official entrusted with one in Hong Kong is not within the AMLO's definition.
Correct: paragraph (b) of the definition includes a spouse or a partner of a child of an individual falling within paragraph (a).
Incorrect: paragraph (b) of the definition lists a spouse, a partner, a child or a parent, and a spouse or partner of a child; a brother or sister is not among them.
Correct: paragraph (a) of the definition covers an individual who is or has been entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong.
Incorrect: paragraph (a)(ii) of the definition does not include a middle-ranking or more junior official of any of the categories mentioned in paragraph (a)(i).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》的定義，下列哪些人士屬政治人物？
statements: 在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的國有企業高級行政人員
在香港擔任重要公職的高級政府或司法官員
在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人的子女的配偶
在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人的兄弟姊妹
曾在香港以外地方擔任重要公職、但目前已沒有擔任的個人
在香港以外地方擔任政府部門中級官員的個人
notes: 正確：附表2第1(1)條中政治人物定義的(a)(i)段，把國有企業高級行政人員列為在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人。
不正確：定義的(a)段所指的是在香港以外地方擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人；在香港擔任重要公職的官員不屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的政治人物。
正確：定義的(b)段包括(a)段所指的個人的子女的配偶或伴侶。
不正確：定義的(b)段列出的是配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，以及子女的配偶或伴侶；兄弟姊妹並不在其中。
正確：定義的(a)段涵蓋在香港以外地方擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人。
不正確：定義的(a)(ii)段訂明，政治人物不包括(a)(i)段所述的任何類別的中級或更低級官員。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 s.15; Sch. 1 Pt. 2 s.1 (definition of “relevant authority”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15條；附表1第2部第1條（「有關當局」的定義）

en.q: Regarding the special requirements of the AMLO for high-risk situations, which of the following are correct?
statements: The requirements apply in a situation the Commissioner specifies in a written notice to the MSO, and in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
Where a business relationship is to be established with the customer concerned, the MSO must obtain approval from its senior management to establish it.
Where a business relationship is to be established, the MSO must either take reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and funds, or take additional measures to mitigate the risk.
Where a business relationship has been established and there is a beneficial owner, the MSO must take reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity.
Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the MSO must take additional measures to mitigate the risk; senior management approval is not required.
notes: Correct: section 15 of Schedule 2 applies in a situation specified by the relevant authority, which for an MSO is the Commissioner under Part 2 of Schedule 1, in a notice in writing, and in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
Correct: section 15(a)(i) of Schedule 2 requires approval from the senior management to establish the business relationship.

Correct: section 15(a)(ii) of Schedule 2 gives a choice: reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and the source of the funds, or additional measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
Correct: section 15(b)(ii) of Schedule 2 requires, if there is a beneficial owner in relation to the relevant customer, reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity.

Correct: section 15(c) of Schedule 2 requires additional measures to mitigate the risk for an occasional transaction; the senior management approval in section 15(a) and (b) is required for establishing or continuing a business relationship.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》就高度風險情況所訂的特別規定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 有關規定適用於關長藉給予金錢服務經營者的書面通知所指明的情況，及任何其他以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況。
如將要與有關客戶建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須取得其高級管理層的批准，以建立該業務關係。
如將要建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源，或採取額外措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
如已建立業務關係，而就有關客戶而言有某實益擁有人，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施，以核實該實益擁有人的身分。
如將執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者須採取額外措施以減低所涉風險，而無須取得高級管理層的批准。
notes: 正確：附表2第15條適用於有關當局（就金錢服務經營者而言，根據附表1第2部即為關長）藉書面通知指明的情況，及任何其他以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況。
正確：附表2第15(a)(i)條規定須取得有關高級管理層的批准，以建立該業務關係。
正確：附表2第15(a)(ii)條容許二擇其一：採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源，或採取額外措施以減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。
正確：附表2第15(b)(ii)條規定，如就有關客戶而言有某實益擁有人，須採取合理措施，以核實該實益擁有人的身分。
正確：附表2第15(c)條規定，如將執行非經常交易，須採取額外措施以減低所涉風險；第15(a)及(b)條所指的高級管理層批准，是為建立或繼續業務關係而設。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3)(c)及13條

en.q: Regarding the special requirements for a remittance transaction of $8,000 or more that a licensed MSO carries out, other than a wire transfer, which of the following are correct?
statements: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's name and address, and the currency and amount involved.
Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's identification document number and, for a travel document, its place of issue.
Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the recipient's name and address, the method of delivery, and the date and time it received the instructions.
Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's date and place of birth, where the originator is an individual.
For these requirements, a transaction is a remittance transaction if it is for sending money, or arranging for money to be sent, to a place outside Hong Kong.
notes: Correct: section 13(2)(c)(i), (iii) and (iv) of Schedule 2 require the originator's name, the originator's address, and the currency and amount involved to be recorded.
Correct: section 13(2)(c)(ii) of Schedule 2 requires the originator's identification document number and, if that document is a travel document, the place of issue of the travel document.
Correct: section 13(2)(c)(v) of Schedule 2 requires the date and time of receipt of the instructions, the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery.

Incorrect: section 13(2)(c) of Schedule 2 does not list the originator's date and place of birth; that detail is one of the options in section 12(3)(c) for the originator information recorded before a wire transfer.
Correct: section 13(3) of Schedule 2 defines a remittance transaction as a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong.

tc.q: 關於持牌金錢服務經營者進行涉及$8,000或以上款額、並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易的特別規定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的姓名及地址，以及所涉的貨幣及款額。
進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的識別文件的號碼，以及（如屬旅行證件）發出旅行證件的地方。
進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄收款人的姓名及地址、送遞的方式，以及接獲指示的日期及時間。
進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的出生日期及地方（如匯款人屬一名個人）。
就有關規定而言，凡為將金錢送往香港以外地方或安排如此送交而進行的交易，即屬匯款交易。
notes: 正確：附表2第13(2)(c)(i)、(iii)及(iv)條規定須記錄匯款人的姓名、匯款人的地址，以及所涉的貨幣及款額。
正確：附表2第13(2)(c)(ii)條規定須記錄匯款人的識別文件的號碼，以及（如匯款人的識別文件是旅行證件）發出旅行證件的地方。
正確：附表2第13(2)(c)(v)條規定須記錄接獲指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及送遞的方式。
不正確：附表2第13(2)(c)條並無列出匯款人的出生日期及地方；這是第12(3)(c)條就進行電傳轉賬前須記錄的匯款人資料所列的選項之一。
正確：附表2第13(3)條把匯款交易界定為為將金錢或安排將金錢送往香港以外地方而進行的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(1)、(2)及(4)條

en.q: An MSO carries out customer due diligence measures by means of an intermediary. Which of the following are correct?
statements: The MSO may carry out a measure by means of the intermediary only if the intermediary consents in writing to be the MSO's intermediary.
The MSO must be satisfied that, when asked, the intermediary will hand over without delay a copy or record of what it obtained in carrying out the measure.
Using an intermediary does not relieve the MSO of liability under the AMLO for a failure to carry out the customer due diligence measure.
Immediately after the intermediary carries out a measure, the MSO must obtain the data or information obtained, but need not get copies of documents at the same time.
The MSO must ensure that the intermediary will, if asked within the record-keeping period, provide copies or records of what it obtained as soon as reasonably practicable.
notes: Correct: section 18(1)(a) of Schedule 2 makes it a condition that the intermediary consents in writing to be the MSO's intermediary.
Correct: section 18(1)(b) of Schedule 2 requires the MSO to be satisfied that the intermediary will on request provide such a copy or record without delay.
Correct: section 18(2) of Schedule 2 says an MSO that carries out a CDD measure by means of an intermediary remains liable under the Ordinance for a failure to carry out that measure.
Correct: section 18(4)(a) of Schedule 2 requires the data or information immediately after the measure, and says nothing in it requires the MSO to obtain at the same time a copy of any document.

Correct: section 18(4)(b) of Schedule 2 requires the MSO to ensure that, if it asks within the period in section 20(2) or (3), the intermediary provides the copy or record as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the request.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 只有在中介人藉書面同意擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人的情況下，金錢服務經營者才可藉著該中介人執行措施。
金錢服務經營者須信納，中介人在接到要求時，會毫不延誤地交出其在執行措施時取得的文件複本或數據資料紀錄。
藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施，並不免除金錢服務經營者根據《打擊洗錢條例》就未有執行措施所負的法律責任。
在中介人執行措施之後，金錢服務經營者須立刻取得中介人取得的數據或資料，但無需同時取得任何文件的複本。
金錢服務經營者須確保，如在備存紀錄期間內提出要求，中介人會在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快提供其取得的文件複本或紀錄。
notes: 正確：附表2第18(1)(a)條訂明的條件之一，是中介人藉書面同意擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人。
正確：附表2第18(1)(b)條規定金錢服務經營者須信納，中介人可應其要求，沒有延誤地提供在執行客戶盡職審查措施時取得的文件複本，或取得的數據或資料的紀錄。
正確：附表2第18(2)條規定，藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施的金錢服務經營者，仍然根據本條例就未有執行客戶盡職審查措施負有法律責任。
正確：附表2第18(4)(a)條規定須在中介人執行措施之後立刻取得數據或資料，但並不規定同時取得任何文件的複本。
正確：附表2第18(4)(b)條規定須確保中介人在金錢服務經營者於第20(2)或(3)條提述的期間作出要求時，會在接獲要求後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快提供有關文件的複本或紀錄。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 s.18(3)(b); Sch. 1 Pt. 2 s.1 (definition of “financial institution”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(b)條；附表1第2部第1條（「金融機構」的定義）

en.q: Under the AMLO, which of the following may an MSO use as an intermediary to carry out customer due diligence measures?
statements: A financial institution that is an authorized institution
A financial institution that is a licensed money service operator
A financial institution that is a licensed corporation
A financial institution that is an SVF licensee
A financial institution that is a licensed insurance broker company
notes: Correct: section 18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 lists a financial institution that is an authorized institution.

Incorrect: section 18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 lists an authorized institution, a licensed corporation, an authorized insurer, a licensed individual insurance agent, a licensed insurance agency and a licensed insurance broker company; a licensed money service operator is not among them.
Correct: section 18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 lists a financial institution that is a licensed corporation.
Incorrect: an SVF licensee is a financial institution under Part 2 of Schedule 1, but section 18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 does not list it among the financial institutions that may act as intermediaries.
Correct: section 18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 lists a financial institution that is a licensed insurance broker company.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，金錢服務經營者可藉著下列哪些機構作為中介人，執行客戶盡職審查措施？
statements: 屬認可機構的金融機構
屬持牌金錢服務經營者的金融機構
屬持牌法團的金融機構
屬工具持牌人的金融機構
屬持牌保險經紀公司的金融機構
notes: 正確：附表2第18(3)(b)條列出屬認可機構的金融機構。
不正確：附表2第18(3)(b)條列出的是屬認可機構、持牌法團、獲授權保險人、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構或持牌保險經紀公司的金融機構；持牌金錢服務經營者並不在其中。
正確：附表2第18(3)(b)條列出屬持牌法團的金融機構。
不正確：工具持牌人雖屬附表1第2部所界定的金融機構，但附表2第18(3)(b)條並無把它列為可作為中介人的金融機構。
正確：附表2第18(3)(b)條列出屬持牌保險經紀公司的金融機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(1)及21條

en.q: Regarding the records an MSO must keep under the AMLO and the form in which they are kept, which of the following are correct?
statements: For each transaction, the MSO must keep the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained for it under the CDD requirements.
For each customer, the MSO must keep the original or a copy of its business correspondence with the customer and with any beneficial owner of the customer.
Where a record consists of a document, any copy of it that the MSO keeps must be kept on paper, on microfilm or in the database of a computer.
Any data or information the MSO is required to keep must be recorded either on microfilm or in the database of a computer.
For a record in the form of a document, retaining the original document meets the AMLO's rule on the manner in which records are kept.
notes: Correct: section 20(1)(a) of Schedule 2 requires, for each transaction, the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained in connection with the transaction in accordance with Part 2.

Correct: section 20(1)(b)(ii) of Schedule 2 requires, for each customer, the original or a copy of the files relating to the customer's account and business correspondence with the customer and any beneficial owner of the customer.
Incorrect: section 21(a)(ii) of Schedule 2 allows a copy of a document to be kept either on microfilm or in the database of a computer; paper is not one of the forms it permits.
