正確：附表4第8(1)條訂明，如覆核各方要求並同意作出該命令，並同意命令的所有條款，審裁處或主席可作出其有權作出的命令，不論任何其他適用於作出該命令的規定是否已獲符合。
正確：附表4第8(2)條訂明，該命令就所有目的而言，須視為根據本條例有關條文作出的命令，並視為符合在其他方面適用於該命令的作出的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9條

en.q: Regarding the chairperson of the Review Tribunal determining matters as its sole member, which of the following are correct?
statements: Before any sitting is held to determine a review, the parties may inform the Tribunal by notice in writing that they agree to the chairperson deciding it alone, and the chairperson may then do so.
An application to extend the time for applying for a review, or for a stay of execution of a specified decision, may be determined by the chairperson sitting alone.
A Tribunal made up of the chairperson as its sole member is regarded for all purposes as a Tribunal constituted also by 2 ordinary members.
Once the chairperson has alone decided an application for a stay of execution, he or she must report that determination, and the reasons for it, to the Tribunal.
If illness prevents the chairperson acting on an application for a stay of execution, a judge or deputy judge of the Court of First Instance appointed by the Chief Executive decides it.
notes: Correct: section 9(1) of Schedule 4 lets the chairperson determine the review as the sole member if, after the application for review is made but before any sitting of the Tribunal is held to determine it, the parties by notice in writing inform the Tribunal that they have so agreed.

Correct: section 9(2) of Schedule 4 lets the chairperson determine as the sole member an application under section 59(2) for an extension of the time for applying for a review, or under section 69(2) for a stay of execution of a specified decision.
Correct: section 9(3) of Schedule 4 regards the Tribunal constituted by the chairperson as the sole member, for all purposes, as the Tribunal constituted also by 2 ordinary members.

Correct: section 9(4) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson, after determining a stay application as the sole member, to report to the Tribunal the making of the determination and the reasons for it, and any other matters relating to it that the chairperson considers appropriate.

Incorrect: under section 9(5) of Schedule 4 the judge or deputy judge of the Court of First Instance who determines the application is appointed for the purpose by the Chief Justice, not by the Chief Executive.

tc.q: 關於覆核審裁處主席作為審裁處唯一成員裁定事宜，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在審裁處舉行聆訊以裁定覆核前，如各方藉書面通知告知審裁處同意由主席單獨裁定，主席即可單獨裁定該項覆核。
要求延展提出覆核申請限期的申請，或要求暫緩執行某指明決定的申請，可由主席作為審裁處唯一成員裁定。
由主席作為唯一成員構成的審裁處，就所有目的而言，須視為連同2名普通成員構成的審裁處。
主席單獨裁定要求暫緩執行指明決定的申請後，須向審裁處報告其所作的裁定及作出該裁定的理由。
如主席因傷病而不能就暫緩執行的申請執行其職能，該申請由獲行政長官委任的原訟法庭法官或暫委法官裁定。
notes: 正確：附表4第9(1)條訂明，在覆核申請提出後但在審裁處舉行聆訊以裁定該項覆核前的任何時間，如各方藉書面通知告知審裁處同意由主席單獨裁定，主席可作為唯一成員裁定該項覆核。
正確：附表4第9(2)條訂明，主席可作為唯一成員，裁定根據第59(2)條要求延展提出覆核申請限期的申請，或根據第69(2)條要求暫緩執行某指明決定的申請。
正確：附表4第9(3)條訂明，由主席作為唯一成員構成的審裁處，就所有目的而言，須視為連同2名普通成員構成的審裁處。
正確：附表4第9(4)條規定，主席在作為唯一成員裁定暫緩執行的申請後，須向審裁處報告作出該裁定及其理由，以及主席認為適當的關乎該裁定的其他事宜。
不正確：根據附表4第9(5)條，裁定該申請的原訟法庭法官或暫委法官，是由終審法院首席法官為此目的委任，並非由行政長官委任。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2 s.1(1), definition of beneficial owner (a)(ii), (b)(i)(B), (b)(ii) and (d)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(a)(ii)、(b)(i)(B)、(b)(ii)及(d)段

en.q: Under the AMLO, which statements about a customer’s beneficial owners, including persons for whom the customer acts, are correct?
statements: An individual entitled to control, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the voting rights in a partnership customer is its beneficial owner.
If a corporate customer acts on behalf of another corporation, that other corporation falls within the customer’s beneficial owner definition.
When a partnership customer acts for another person, this representative relationship makes its managing partner the beneficial owner instead of that other person.
For a customer that is neither a corporation, a partnership nor a trust, the ultimate-ownership limb identifies a corporation that ultimately owns or controls it.
If a customer outside the corporation, partnership and trust categories acts for another person, that other person is included as its beneficial owner.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (b)(i)(B) states “is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 25% of the voting rights in the partnership”.

Correct: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (a)(ii) states “if the corporation is acting on behalf of another person, means the other person”. “The other person” is not confined to an individual; this follows the statutory definition.

False: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (b)(ii) states “if the partnership is acting on behalf of another person, means the other person”. This branch identifies the person for whom the partnership acts, not the managing partner by reason of the representative relationship.
False: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (d)(i) states “means an individual who ultimately owns or controls the person”. The ultimate-ownership or control limb names an individual, not a corporation.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (d)(ii) states “if the person is acting on behalf of another person, means the other person”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，以下有關客戶的實益擁有人（包括由客戶代表行事的人）的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 個人直接或間接地有權支配合夥客戶25%以上投票權的行使，便可憑該項投票控制權成為客戶的實益擁有人。
法團客戶如代表另一法團行事，該另一法團亦符合該客戶的實益擁有人定義，並不因屬法團而被排除。
合夥客戶如代表另一人行事，該項代表關係使合夥的管理合夥人成為實益擁有人，而非由合夥代表的另一人。
就既非法團、合夥亦非信託的客戶而言，最終擁有權這一定義分支所識別的，是最終擁有或控制該客戶的法團。
不屬法團、合夥或信託類別的客戶如代表另一人行事，該另一人亦包括在該客戶的實益擁有人定義之內。
notes: 正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(b)(i)(B)段訂明「直接或間接地有權行使在該合夥的投票權的25% 以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使」。
正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(a)(ii)段訂明「( 如該法團是代表另一人行事) 指該另一人」。「該另一人」並不限於個人；須依照法定定義處理。
不正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(b)(ii)段訂明「( 如該合夥是代表另一人行事) 指該另一人」。此分支識別的是由合夥代表的另一人，並非因該代表關係而識別管理合夥人。
不正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(d)(i)段訂明「最終擁有或控制該人的任何個人」。最終擁有或控制的分支所指的是個人，並非法團。
正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(d)(ii)段訂明「( 如該人是代表另一人行事) 該另一人」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3)、(3A)及(5)至(7)條

en.q: Regarding the information an MSO acting as the ordering institution records and passes on for a wire transfer, which of the following are correct?
statements: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the originator's address before carrying it out.
For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the recipient's name before carrying it out.
For a wire transfer of $8,000 or more, the message or payment form accompanying it must include the originator's address.
For a wire transfer below $8,000, the message or payment form accompanying it need include only the originator's details.
notes: Correct: section 12(3A) disapplies the requirement of section 12(3)(c), which covers the originator's address, for a wire transfer below $8,000.
Incorrect: the recipient's name, under section 12(3)(d), must be recorded before any wire transfer; only the requirement of section 12(3)(c) is disapplied below $8,000.

Incorrect: section 12(3)(c) permits the originator's address OR its customer identification or identification document number OR, for an individual, date and place of birth. The accompanying-information rule in section 12(5) is also subject to the domestic and batch-transfer provisions in subsections (6) and (7); the address is not invariably required.
Incorrect: section 12(5)(b) requires the information under section 12(3)(a), (b), (d) and (e), which takes in the recipient's name and account number, to accompany a wire transfer below $8,000.

tc.q: 就屬匯款機構的金錢服務經營者為電傳轉賬記錄及傳遞的資料而言，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄匯款人的地址。
就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱。
就涉及$8,000或以上款額的電傳轉賬而言，附隨該項轉賬的信息或付款表格須包括匯款人的地址。
就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，附隨該項轉賬的信息或付款表格只須包括匯款人的資料。
notes: 正確：附表2第12(3A)條訂明，第12(3)(c)條（涵蓋匯款人的地址）不適用於涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉帳。
不正確：第12(3)(d)條規定，進行任何電傳轉賬前均須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱；$8,000以下的轉帳只豁免第12(3)(c)條的規定。
不正確：附表2第12(3)(c)條容許匯款人的地址、客戶識別號碼或識別文件號碼，或個人匯款人的出生日期及地方作為替代資料。第12(5)條的附隨資料規定亦受第(6)及(7)款的本地及群組轉賬條文限制，並非一律須有地址。
不正確：第12(5)(b)條規定，涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉帳，須包括根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(d)及(e)條記錄的資料，當中包括收款人的姓名或名稱及戶口號碼。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第4至5項

en.q: Regarding the fees the AMLO specifies for applications by money service operators and for copies of entries in the register of licensees, which of the following are correct?
statements: An application for the grant of a licence carries a fee of $3,810, with $2,440 added for each additional business premises.
A renewal application carries the same basic fee as a grant application, $3,810, plus $410 for each additional business premises.
An application for the grant of a licence also carries $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test.
Renewal also costs $945 for each person subject to the fit and proper person test, even if the fee was paid at the original grant.
notes: Correct: item 4 of Schedule 3 sets the fee for an application for the grant of a licence at $3,810, plus $2,440 for each additional business premises.

Incorrect: item 5 of Schedule 3 sets the basic fee for an application for the renewal of a licence at $910, not the $3,810 that item 4 sets for a grant; $410 is then added for each additional business premises.
Correct: item 4 of Schedule 3 adds, to the fee for an application for the grant of a licence, $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test.
Correct: Schedule 3 item 5 adds $945 for each person tested at renewal; item 4's grant charge is not a once-for-all payment.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》就金錢服務經營者提出的申請及持牌人登記冊內記項的複本所指明的費用，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 申請批給牌照的費用為$3,810，並須就每多一個營業處所另加$2,440。
申請牌照續期的基本費用與批給牌照相同，為$3,810，每多一個營業處所另加$410。
申請批給牌照時，亦須就每一個須判定是否適當人選的人另加$945。
續牌亦須就每名須判定是否適當人選的人另加$945，即使發牌時已繳過有關費用。
notes: 正確：附表3第4項訂明申請批給牌照的費用為$3,810，並就每多一個營業處所另加$2,440。
不正確：附表3第5項訂明申請牌照續期的基本費用為$910，並非第4項就申請批給牌照訂明的$3,810；每多一個營業處所另加$410。
正確：附表3第4項訂明，申請批給牌照時，須就每一個須判定是否適當人選的人另加$945。
正確：附表3第5項就續期另加每名須判定是否適當人選的人的$945費用，第4項的發牌收費並非一經繳付便永久豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第1至2、6至8及10項；第39(1)至(3)條

en.q: Regarding the fees the AMLO specifies for applications by money service operators and for copies of entries in the register of licensees, which of the following are correct?
statements: An application for approval to become a licensee's director carries a fee of $945 for each application that is made.
For each person in relation to whom approval to become a licensee's ultimate owner or partner is sought, the fee is $945.
An uncertified copy of an entry in the register of licensees costs $160 per copy, the same as a certified copy.
An MSO moving from no particular premises to particular premises pays $2,440 per business premises covered by its application.
notes: Incorrect: item 6 of Schedule 3 charges $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made, not $945 for each application.
Correct: items 7 and 8 of Schedule 3 charge $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made, for approval to become a licensee's ultimate owner and to become a licensee's partner.

Incorrect: item 2 of Schedule 3 charges $1.5 per page or portion of a page for an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register; $160 per copy is the fee in item 1 for certifying a copy.
Correct: s.39 covers moving from operation without particular premises to particular premises; Schedule 3 item 10 charges $2,440 for each business premises, not only additional premises.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》就金錢服務經營者提出的申請及持牌人登記冊內記項的複本所指明的費用，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 申請要求批准擔任持牌人董事的費用，為每宗提出的申請$945。
就申請批准擔任持牌人最終擁有人或合夥人而言，申請所關乎的每一人須繳費$945。
提供登記冊內記項的未經核證複本，費用為每份$160，與核證複本相同。
持牌人由無特定處所改為在特定處所經營金錢服務，其申請按每一營業處所收費$2,440。
notes: 不正確：附表3第6項訂明的費用，是就提出申請所關乎的每一人收取$945，並非每宗申請收取$945。
正確：附表3第7及8項訂明，申請要求批准擔任持牌人最終擁有人或持牌人合夥人，均須就提出申請所關乎的每一人繳付$945。
不正確：附表3第2項訂明，提供登記冊內記項或其摘錄的未經核證複本，按每頁或每頁的部分收費$1.5；每份$160是第1項就核證複本訂明的費用。
正確：第39條處理原本不在特定處所經營而申請在特定處所經營；附表3第10項按每一營業處所收取$2,440，並非只就額外處所收費。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(3)(b)及(5)條

en.q: Regarding former politically exposed persons and ongoing monitoring, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An MSO may cease the special PEP monitoring measures once it assesses a former PEP as not presenting a high ML/TF risk.
A customer’s retirement from public office alone permits the MSO to end the special PEP monitoring without a risk assessment.
The monitoring exception can apply where a corporate customer’s beneficial owner, rather than the customer, is the former PEP.
A current PEP assessed as low risk qualifies for the former-PEP monitoring exception without first leaving public office.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.5(3)(b), (5) — The section 5(5) exception requires former status and an appropriate risk assessment.
False: Sch. 2 s.5(3)(b), (5) — Retirement alone does not satisfy the risk-assessment limb of section 5(5).
Correct: Sch. 2 s.5(3)(b), (5) — Section 5(5) expressly covers a customer or its beneficial owner.
False: Sch. 2 s.5(3)(b), (5) — Section 5(5)(a) requires the person to be a former PEP.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於前政治人物及持續監察，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經適當評估信納前政治人物不造成高度洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險後，可停止政治人物特別監察。
客戶單憑已從重要公職退休，便可讓經營者在沒有風險評估下停止政治人物的特別監察措施。
監察例外也可用於法團客戶的實益擁有人屬前政治人物的情況，而不只限於客戶本人。
仍在任的重要公職人員只要獲評估為低風險，無須離任也符合前政治人物的監察例外。
notes: 正確：附表2第5(3)(b)及(5)條——第5(5)條例外要求前政治人物身分及適當的風險評估。
錯誤：附表2第5(3)(b)及(5)條——退休本身不足以符合第5(5)條的風險評估條件。
正確：附表2第5(3)(b)及(5)條——第5(5)條明確涵蓋客戶或其實益擁有人。
錯誤：附表2第5(3)(b)及(5)條——第5(5)(a)條要求屬前政治人物。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)至(3A)條

en.q: Regarding which event starts the five-year record-retention period, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: For a completed occasional exchange requiring CDD, the customer-identification record clock starts when that exchange is completed.
For a completed occasional wire transfer requiring CDD, the customer record clock waits until the customer returns for another transfer.
If a transaction completes one year before the relationship ends, its transaction records still run from that transaction’s completion.
Customer-identification files in a continuing relationship may be discarded five years after the last transaction, despite the relationship continuing.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.20(2)–(3A) — Section 20(3A) covers customer records for qualifying occasional transactions.
False: Sch. 2 s.20(2)–(3A) — Section 20(3A) starts the period on completion of the occasional transaction.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.20(2)–(3A) — Section 20(2) ties transaction records to completion irrespective of subsequent closure.
False: Sch. 2 s.20(2)–(3A) — Section 20(3) requires retention throughout the relationship as well as five years afterwards.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於五年紀錄保存期由甚麼事件起計，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 須作盡職審查的非經常兌換交易完成後，客戶身分紀錄的保存期從該項交易完成當日起計。
須作盡職審查的非經常電傳轉賬完成後，客戶紀錄的保存期須等客戶再次匯款才開始起計。
如交易在業務關係終止前一年完成，交易紀錄的保存期仍從該項交易完成之日開始起計。
持續業務關係中的客戶身分檔案，可在最後交易完成五年後刪除，即使業務關係仍在繼續。
notes: 正確：附表2第20(2)至(3A)條——第20(3A)條涵蓋合資格非經常交易的客戶紀錄。
錯誤：附表2第20(2)至(3A)條——第20(3A)條從非經常交易完成之日起計。
正確：附表2第20(2)至(3A)條——第20(2)條按交易完成起計，不因其後結束關係而改變。
錯誤：附表2第20(2)至(3A)條——第20(3)條要求在關係繼續期間及終止後至少五年備存。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(1)、(2)及(6)條

en.q: Regarding using an agent or an intermediary to perform CDD, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An MSO may appoint an agent to perform a CDD measure, but remains liable under the AMLO if that measure is not carried out.
Calling the service provider an agent instead of an intermediary transfers the statutory liability for failed CDD away from the MSO.
A specified intermediary’s verbal consent is enough if the MSO is satisfied that documents will be available promptly when requested.
A written intermediary appointment removes the MSO’s statutory liability if the intermediary later fails to perform the agreed CDD measure.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(1), (2), (6) — Section 18(6) preserves the agent route and the MSO’s liability.
False: Sch. 2 s.18(1), (2), (6) — The express retention of liability in section 18(6) defeats this change of label.
False: Sch. 2 s.18(1), (2), (6) — Section 18(1)(a) independently requires consent in writing.
False: Sch. 2 s.18(1), (2), (6) — Section 18(2) retains the MSO’s liability even when it relies on an intermediary.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於藉代理人或中介人執行客戶盡職審查，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者可藉代理人執行盡職審查措施，但沒有執行該措施時，仍須根據條例負有法律責任。
把服務提供者稱為代理人而非中介人，可把盡職審查失責的法定責任從經營者轉移出去。
如經營者信納文件可在要求時迅速提供，即使指明中介人只是口頭同意，也足以符合要求。
中介人書面接受委任後，如其未有執行約定的盡職審查措施，經營者便不再負法定責任。
notes: 正確：附表2第18(1)、(2)及(6)條——第18(6)條保留使用代理人的安排及經營者的法律責任。
錯誤：附表2第18(1)、(2)及(6)條——第18(6)條明文保留責任，稱謂改變並不能轉移責任。
錯誤：附表2第18(1)、(2)及(6)條——第18(1)(a)條另行要求書面同意。
錯誤：附表2第18(1)、(2)及(6)條——第18(2)條即使在使用中介人時，也保留經營者的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)至(2)條

en.q: Regarding an overseas branch blocked by local law from applying AML procedures, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A Hong Kong-incorporated MSO must add effective risk-mitigation measures when local law blocks required procedures at an overseas branch.
Informing the relevant authority of the legal obstacle alone discharges the duty even if no additional risk mitigation is put in place.
The same additional-mitigation duty can apply to a covered overseas subsidiary undertaking, rather than only to an overseas branch.
The MSO must ensure comparable procedures to the extent local law permits, rather than treating one legal obstacle as a complete exemption.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.22(1)–(2) — Section 22(2)(b) requires additional mitigation of the resulting risk.
False: Sch. 2 s.22(1)–(2) — Section 22(2) joins notification and additional mitigation with and.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.22(1)–(2) — Section 22(2)(b) expressly covers branches and subsidiary undertakings.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.22(1)–(2) — Section 22(1) applies to the extent permitted by the law of that place.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於海外分行因當地法律而不能實行打擊洗錢程序，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 香港成立的經營者遇到海外法律阻止分行實行所需程序時，必須採取增補措施有效減低風險。
只要已把法律障礙通知有關當局，即使沒有增補風險減低措施，也已完全履行有關責任。
同一增補風險減低責任，也可適用於受規定涵蓋的海外附屬企業，並非只限於海外分行。
經營者須確保在當地法律准許的範圍內有相類程序，不可把一項法律障礙當作全面豁免。
notes: 正確：附表2第22(1)至(2)條——第22(2)(b)條要求增補措施減低因此產生的風險。
錯誤：附表2第22(1)至(2)條——第22(2)條以「及」連接通知與增補措施，兩者均須履行。
正確：附表2第22(1)至(2)條——第22(2)(b)條明確涵蓋分行及附屬企業。
正確：附表2第22(1)至(2)條——第22(1)條規定在當地法律准許的範圍內確保遵守。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(c)段

en.q: Regarding identifying beneficial owners of a trust with vested future interests, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A beneficiary entitled to a vested remainder interest may count even though the beneficiary does not presently possess the trust property.
A class of beneficiaries entitled to vested interests may count even though the definition refers to a class rather than a single beneficiary.
A beneficiary’s vested interest is excluded from the definition if the terms of the trust make that vested interest defeasible.
A vested reversion interest falls within the definition, so current possession is not the only form of interest that the MSO must consider.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (c) — The definition expressly includes vested interests in remainder.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (c) — The definition expressly includes a class of beneficiaries.
False: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (c) — The definition says whether it is defeasible or not.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (c) — The definition expressly includes reversion as well as possession and remainder.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於識別具有既得未來權益的信託實益擁有人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 有權享有既得剩餘權益的受益人，即使現時未管有信託財產，也可屬實益擁有人。
有權享有既得權益的某類別受益人，即使是一個類別而非單一人士，也可屬實益擁有人。
受益人的既得權益，如按信託條款屬可予廢除的權益，便被排除於實益擁有人定義之外。
既得復歸權益也屬定義範圍，因此經營者不能只考慮目前具有管有權的信託權益。
notes: 正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(c)段——定義明確包括剩餘權的既得權益。
正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(c)段——定義明確包括某類別受益人。
錯誤：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(c)段——定義明言不論該權益是否可予廢除。
正確：附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(c)段——定義明確包括復歸權、管有權及剩餘權。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(c)條

en.q: Regarding the card-transaction exclusion from special wire-transfer requirements, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A card-funded transfer to another individual fails the card exclusion where the card is used as a person-to-person payment system.
An ATM withdrawal using a debit card is one of the examples of card transactions identified for the exclusion.
A card purchase automatically qualifies for the exclusion even where the card number or equivalent identifier is absent from its message.
A cash advance on a credit card is outside the examples, because the exclusion lists purchases of goods and services only.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(2)(c) — The person-to-person condition is separate from the use of a card.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(2)(c) — Section 12(2)(c)(i)(A) expressly lists this example.
False: Sch. 2 s.12(2)(c) — Section 12(2)(c)(iii) still requires the card number or equivalent identifier.
False: Sch. 2 s.12(2)(c) — Section 12(2)(c)(i)(B) expressly includes obtaining a cash advance.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於卡交易不適用電傳轉賬特別規定的界線，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如以卡作個人與個人之間的支付系統，向另一人轉款便不符合卡交易不適用規定的條件。
使用扣帳卡透過自動櫃員機從銀行戶口提款，是不適用規定列出的其中一項卡交易例子。
購物使用信用卡後，即使附隨信息沒有卡號或等同獨特識別編碼，也自動符合不適用規定。
信用卡現金貸款不在例子之列，因為不適用規定只列出購買貨物及服務的卡交易。
notes: 正確：附表2第12(2)(c)條——個人與個人之間支付的限制，是使用卡以外的獨立條件。
正確：附表2第12(2)(c)條——第12(2)(c)(i)(A)條明確列出這項例子。
錯誤：附表2第12(2)(c)條——第12(2)(c)(iii)條仍要求卡號或等同獨特識別編碼。
錯誤：附表2第12(2)(c)條——第12(2)(c)(i)(B)條明確包括取得現金貸款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6(1)至(2)條

en.q: Regarding CDD triggered by changes to a pre-existing customer’s account, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A material change in account operation triggers CDD even without an unusual transaction occurring at that same time.
A material change in account operation triggers CDD only after the MSO has also formed a money-laundering suspicion.
The special rules for pre-existing customers replace the separate CDD trigger for doubts about identification information.
If CDD triggered by the material change cannot be completed, keeping the relationship until the next annual review is allowed.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.6(1)–(2) — Section 6(1)(b) is an alternative trigger to the transactions in paragraph (a).
False: Sch. 2 s.6(1)–(2) — The material-change limb contains no additional suspicion requirement.
False: Sch. 2 s.6(1)–(2) — Section 6(1) applies in addition to section 3(1)(d) and (e).
False: Sch. 2 s.6(1)–(2) — Section 6(2) requires termination as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於先前客戶戶口轉變所觸發的盡職審查，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 戶口操作方式有重大轉變，即使當時沒有異乎尋常交易發生，也會觸發盡職審查。
戶口操作方式有重大轉變，只有在經營者也已形成洗錢懷疑後，才會觸發盡職審查。
先前客戶的特別規定，取代了對身分識別資料有疑問時另須執行盡職審查的責任。
如未能完成重大轉變所觸發的盡職審查，經營者可保留業務關係直至下次年度覆核。
notes: 正確：附表2第6(1)至(2)條——第6(1)(b)條是(a)段交易以外的獨立觸發情況。
錯誤：附表2第6(1)至(2)條——重大轉變的條件並沒有另加洗錢懷疑的要求。
錯誤：附表2第6(1)至(2)條——第6(1)條在第3(1)(d)及(e)條情況以外增加責任。
錯誤：附表2第6(1)至(2)條——第6(2)條要求在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快終止。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(a)至(c)條

en.q: Regarding different high-risk situations faced by an MSO, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: For a high-risk occasional transaction, the special rule requires additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved.
For a new high-risk relationship, extra mitigation can replace source-of-wealth and source-of-funds measures, but not senior approval.
For an existing high-risk relationship with a beneficial owner, identity verification of that owner may be replaced by additional mitigation.
For an existing high-risk relationship, mitigation measures remove the need for senior approval to continue the relationship.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.15(a)–(c) — Section 15(c) expressly addresses occasional transactions.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.15(a)–(c) — Section 15(a) requires approval and then gives two alternative measures.
False: Sch. 2 s.15(a)–(c) — Section 15(b)(ii) is a separate requirement, outside the alternatives in paragraph (iii).
False: Sch. 2 s.15(a)–(c) — Section 15(b)(i) separately requires senior-management approval.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於經營者面對的不同高風險情況，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 對高風險非經常交易，特別規定要求採取額外措施，減低所涉洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
對新高風險業務關係，額外措施可替代確立財富及資金來源的措施，但不能替代高級管理層批准。
對有實益擁有人的現有高風險業務關係，核實該擁有人身分的責任可由額外減低風險措施取代。
對現有高風險業務關係，只要採取減低風險措施，便無須高級管理層批准而可繼續該關係。
notes: 正確：附表2第15(a)至(c)條——第15(c)條明確處理非經常交易。
正確：附表2第15(a)至(c)條——第15(a)條要求批准，再於兩類措施中擇一。
錯誤：附表2第15(a)至(c)條——第15(b)(ii)條是獨立要求，不屬(iii)段的二擇一措施。
錯誤：附表2第15(a)至(c)條——第15(b)(i)條獨立要求高級管理層批准。

en.q: Regarding classifying a wire transfer whose route includes an overseas intermediary, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A transfer between two Hong Kong institutions routed through an overseas intermediary fails the definition of a domestic wire transfer.
Such a transfer qualifies for the domestic reduced-message rule merely because its ordering and beneficiary institutions are both local.
If it receives this transfer as beneficiary without required information, an MSO must seek the missing information from the instructing institution.
An MSO acting as an intermediary on this non-domestic route must also address missing required information, rather than merely pass it on.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(6), (10)–(11) — All intermediary institutions must also be financial institutions located in Hong Kong.
False: Sch. 2 s.12(6), (10)–(11) — Section 12(6) is restricted to domestic wire transfers; the overseas routing defeats that status.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(6), (10)–(11) — Section 12(10)(a)(i) applies to a non-domestic beneficiary institution.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(6), (10)–(11) — Section 12(10) covers beneficiary and intermediary institutions.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於將涉及海外中介機構的電傳轉賬分類，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 兩間香港機構之間的轉賬，如經海外中介機構處理，便不符合本地電傳轉賬的定義。
這類轉賬只因匯款及收款機構同在本地，便可使用本地轉賬的簡化附隨信息規則。
經營者以收款機構身分接收這類轉賬而欠缺所需資料時，須向發出指示的機構取得遺漏資料。
經營者在這類非本地路徑以中介機構身分行事，也須處理遺漏資料，不可只把轉賬傳遞下去。
notes: 正確：附表2第12(6)、(10)至(11)條——所有中介機構也必須是位於香港的金融機構。
錯誤：附表2第12(6)、(10)至(11)條——第12(6)條限本地轉賬；海外中介機構令其不符合定義。
正確：附表2第12(6)、(10)至(11)條——第12(10)(a)(i)條適用於非本地轉賬的收款機構。
正確：附表2第12(6)、(10)至(11)條——第12(10)條涵蓋收款及中介機構。

en.q: Regarding the limits of using recognized digital identification for an absent customer, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Using recognized digital identification to identify and verify an absent customer can disapply the special absence-related identification measures.
That digital identification can also remove the extra monitoring obligation arising solely from the customer’s absence for identification.
If the digitally verified customer is a current PEP, the MSO can also omit senior approval because digital verification replaces PEP measures.
Digital identification removes monitoring measures caused by a separate high-risk situation as well as measures caused by physical absence.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 ss.5(3)–(4), 9(2) and 10(1) — Section 9(2) disapplies subsection (1) where the stipulated digital identification measure was carried out.
Correct: Sch. 2 ss.5(3)–(4), 9(2) and 10(1) — Section 5(4) disapplies the absence limb of section 5(3)(a).
False: Sch. 2 ss.5(3)–(4), 9(2) and 10(1) — Section 10(1)(a) separately requires senior-management approval before establishing a relationship with a PEP.
False: Sch. 2 ss.5(3)–(4), 9(2) and 10(1) — Section 5(4) disapplies paragraph (3)(a), not the separate high-risk limb (3)(c).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於對沒有現身客戶使用認可數碼識別的限制，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 用認可數碼識別系統識別及核實沒有現身的客戶，可令沒有現身所需的特別識別措施不適用。
該數碼識別也可令純粹因客戶沒有為識別而現身所產生的額外監察責任不適用。
如經數碼核實的客戶是在任政治人物，數碼核實也可取代政治人物措施，令高級管理層批准不必進行。
數碼識別既可取消因客戶沒有現身引起的監察措施，也可取消另一高風險情況所引起的監察措施。
notes: 正確：附表2第5(3)至(4)、9(2)及10(1)條——第9(2)條在已執行指定數碼識別措施時令第(1)款不適用。
正確：附表2第5(3)至(4)、9(2)及10(1)條——第5(4)條令第5(3)(a)條沒有現身的條件不適用。
錯誤：附表2第5(3)至(4)、9(2)及10(1)條——第10(1)(a)條另要求在與政治人物建立關係前取得高級管理層批准。
錯誤：附表2第5(3)至(4)、9(2)及10(1)條——第5(4)條只令第(3)(a)款不適用，並無取消第(3)(c)款的高風險責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)及(1A)條

en.q: Regarding occasional transactions by ordinary individual customers, with no simplified CDD available, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An occasional cash exchange of exactly $120,000 meets the general transaction-value threshold for CDD before it is carried out.
An occasional wire transfer of exactly $8,000 meets the wire-transfer CDD threshold even though it is below $120,000.
Three cash-exchange operations of $40,000 appearing linked may be treated separately so that no operation meets the CDD threshold.
Two apparently linked wire-transfer operations of $4,000 each can meet the occasional wire-transfer threshold when taken together.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(b), (1A) — The general threshold is equal to or above $120,000.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(b), (1A) — Section 3(1A) overrides the general threshold for an occasional wire transfer.
False: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(b), (1A) — Section 3(1)(b) aggregates apparently linked operations.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(b), (1A) — Section 3(1A) also includes operations appearing linked.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於普通個人客戶的非經常交易，並無簡化盡職審查可用，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 恰好120,000元的非經常現金兌換，符合一般交易金額門檻，須在進行前作盡職審查。
恰好8,000元的非經常電傳轉賬，即使少於120,000元，仍符合電傳轉賬盡職審查門檻。
三次看似有關連的40,000元現金兌換，可分開處理，令每次操作都不達盡職審查門檻。
兩次看似有關連的4,000元電傳轉賬操作，合併計算時可符合非經常電傳轉賬門檻。
notes: 正確：附表2第3(1)(b)及(1A)條——一般門檻是相等於120,000元或以上。
正確：附表2第3(1)(b)及(1A)條——第3(1A)條就非經常電傳轉賬另定較低門檻。
錯誤：附表2第3(1)(b)及(1A)條——第3(1)(b)條涵蓋看似有關連的若干次操作。
正確：附表2第3(1)(b)及(1A)條——第3(1A)條也涵蓋看似有關連的若干次操作。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(d)至(e)條

en.q: Regarding small transactions accompanied by suspicion or identity doubts, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A suspected laundering transaction of $1,000 can trigger CDD despite being below both the general and wire-transfer monetary thresholds.
If identification data previously obtained appears inadequate, CDD can be triggered even without evidence that the data is deliberately false.
Suspicion concerning the customer’s account can trigger CDD even where the MSO has not formed a separate suspicion about the customer personally.
Previously verified identity data that now appears untrue can trigger fresh CDD even though the MSO completed verification when the account opened.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(d)–(e) — Suspicion is an independent trigger without an amount threshold.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(d)–(e) — Doubts about adequacy are sufficient; falsity is not the only ground.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(d)–(e) — The source says the customer or the customer’s account.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(1)(d)–(e) — The trigger expressly concerns information previously obtained.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於附有懷疑或身分疑問的小額交易，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 涉及洗錢懷疑的1,000元交易，即使低於一般及電傳轉賬金額門檻，也可觸發盡職審查。
過往取得的身分資料看似不充分時，即使沒有故意虛假資料的證據，也可觸發盡職審查。
對客戶戶口的懷疑，即使經營者沒有另行懷疑客戶本人，也可觸發盡職審查責任。
先前已核實的身分資料現時看似不真實，即使開戶時曾完成核實，也可再次觸發盡職審查。
notes: 正確：附表2第3(1)(d)至(e)條——懷疑是沒有金額門檻的獨立觸發情況。
正確：附表2第3(1)(d)至(e)條——對充分性的疑問已足夠，並非只有虛假才觸發。
正確：附表2第3(1)(d)至(e)條——原文列明客戶或客戶的戶口。
正確：附表2第3(1)(d)至(e)條——觸發條件明確針對過往取得的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(2)至(3)條

en.q: Regarding a proposal to verify identity after opening a business relationship, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Preventing interruption of normal business is insufficient by itself if the risk created by delayed verification is not effectively managed.
An MSO may delay verification merely for customer convenience even if delaying it is not necessary to avoid interrupting normal business.
Effective risk management alone allows delayed verification even when there is no need to avoid interrupting the customer’s normal business.
Once delayed verification is permitted, the MSO may leave it unfinished until the next periodic review even if earlier completion is practicable.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(2)–(3) — Section 3(2) requires both necessity and effective management of the resulting risk.
False: Sch. 2 s.3(2)–(3) — The necessity condition remains required.
False: Sch. 2 s.3(2)–(3) — Effective risk management is cumulative with, not an alternative to, necessity.
False: Sch. 2 s.3(2)–(3) — Section 3(3) requires completion as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於在建立業務關係後才核實身分的建議，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如延遲核實引起的風險未獲有效管理，單憑避免干擾正常業務的需要，並不足以延遲核實。
即使延遲核實並非為避免干擾正常業務所必需，經營者也可只為方便客戶而延遲核實。
即使無須避免干擾客戶的正常業務，只要風險獲有效管理，也一律准許延遲核實身分。
獲准延遲核實後，即使可更早完成，經營者也可留待下次定期覆核時才完成身分核實。
notes: 正確：附表2第3(2)至(3)條——第3(2)條同時要求必需性及風險有效管理。
錯誤：附表2第3(2)至(3)條——仍須符合避免干擾正常業務的必需條件。
錯誤：附表2第3(2)至(3)條——風險管理和必需性須同時符合，並非二選一。
錯誤：附表2第3(2)至(3)條——第3(3)條要求在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快完成。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(4)條

en.q: Regarding decisions when mandatory CDD cannot be completed, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If required CDD cannot be completed before a new relationship, the MSO must decline to establish that relationship.
If required CDD for an occasional transfer fails, the MSO may execute the transfer first and restrict later transactions instead.
If permitted delayed verification cannot be completed, the MSO must end the existing relationship as soon as reasonably practicable.
If required CDD fails after a relationship already exists, closing the relationship is optional whenever the next transaction is small.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(4) — Section 3(4)(a) prohibits establishing the relationship.
False: Sch. 2 s.3(4) — Section 3(4)(a) prohibits carrying out the occasional transaction.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.3(4) — Section 3(4)(b) applies where a relationship has already been established.
False: Sch. 2 s.3(4) — Section 3(4)(b) requires termination without a small-transaction exception.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於未能完成強制盡職審查時的決定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如未能在新業務關係建立前完成所需盡職審查，經營者不得建立該業務關係。
如非經常轉賬所需盡職審查失敗，經營者可先執行該轉賬，改為限制其後交易。
如獲准延遲的核實無法完成，經營者須在合理地切實可行範圍內，盡快結束現有關係。
如已建立關係後所需盡職審查失敗，只要下次交易金額細小，結束關係便屬自願選擇。
notes: 正確：附表2第3(4)條——第3(4)(a)條禁止建立關係。
錯誤：附表2第3(4)條——第3(4)(a)條禁止執行非經常交易。
正確：附表2第3(4)條——第3(4)(b)條適用於已建立的關係。
錯誤：附表2第3(4)條——第3(4)(b)條要求結束關係，沒有小額交易例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(1)、(3)(c)及2(1)(d)條

en.q: Regarding an MSO starting an ordinary relationship with a qualifying listed company, with no suspicion or identity doubt, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Reasonable grounds for believing that the company is listed can permit the MSO to use the statutory simplified CDD route.
Choosing simplified CDD permits the MSO to omit identification and verification of the listed corporate customer itself.
If a representative acts for the company, simplified CDD permits the MSO to accept that representative without checking authority.
The statutory listed-company category requires a Hong Kong listing, so listing solely on a foreign stock exchange cannot qualify.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.4(1), (3)(c) and s.2(1)(d) — Section 4(1) permits simplified measures on reasonable grounds, and section 4(3)(c) lists this customer.
False: Sch. 2 s.4(1), (3)(c) and s.2(1)(d) — Section 4(1) retains section 2(1)(a), the customer identity measure.
False: Sch. 2 s.4(1), (3)(c) and s.2(1)(d) — Section 4(1) retains section 2(1)(d), including verification of authority.
False: Sch. 2 s.4(1), (3)(c) and s.2(1)(d) — Section 4(3)(c) says any stock exchange.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於經營者與合資格上市公司建立普通關係，沒有懷疑或身分疑問，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如有合理理由相信該公司已上市，經營者可採用法定簡化客戶盡職審查安排。
選用簡化盡職審查後，經營者可省略上市法團客戶本身的身分識別及核實。
如有人代表公司行事，簡化盡職審查准許經營者接受該代表，無須核實其授權。
法定上市公司類別要求在香港上市，因此只在外地證券市場上市並不足以符合資格。
notes: 正確：附表2第4(1)、(3)(c)及2(1)(d)條——第4(1)條容許有合理理由時簡化，第4(3)(c)條列出上市法團。
錯誤：附表2第4(1)、(3)(c)及2(1)(d)條——第4(1)條保留第2(1)(a)條客戶身分措施。
錯誤：附表2第4(1)、(3)(c)及2(1)(d)條——第4(1)條保留第2(1)(d)條，包括核實授權。
錯誤：附表2第4(1)、(3)(c)及2(1)(d)條——第4(3)(c)條列明任何證券市場。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(2)至(3)(c)條

en.q: Regarding an unlisted customer whose ownership chain includes a qualifying listed entity, without suspicion or identity doubts, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The MSO may stop identifying or verifying beneficial owners of the qualifying listed entity and of persons further up that ownership chain.
The presence of the listed entity exempts every individual beneficial owner in the chain, including those below the listed entity.
The unlisted customer itself must become listed before the ownership-chain exception can apply to the qualifying listed entity above it.
A foreign-listed qualifying entity can provide the same stopping point because the listed-entity category is not confined to Hong Kong exchanges.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.4(2)–(3)(c) — Section 4(2) defines the permitted stopping point.
False: Sch. 2 s.4(2)–(3)(c) — The exemption concerns the qualifying entity and persons beyond it, not below it.
False: Sch. 2 s.4(2)–(3)(c) — Section 4(2) expressly covers a customer not falling within subsection (3).
Correct: Sch. 2 s.4(2)–(3)(c) — Section 4(3)(c) extends to any stock exchange.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於非上市客戶的擁有權鏈含合資格上市實體，並無懷疑或身分疑問，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者可不再識別或核實合資格上市實體及其上層人士的實益擁有人身分。
只要鏈中有上市實體，所有個人實益擁有人都獲豁免，包括位於上市實體以下的人士。
非上市客戶本身必須先行上市，才可對其上層的合資格上市實體使用擁有權鏈例外。
外地上市的合資格實體也可作為相同的停止追查層次，因上市類別不限於香港市場。
notes: 正確：附表2第4(2)至(3)(c)條——第4(2)條界定可停止追查的層次。
錯誤：附表2第4(2)至(3)(c)條——豁免針對該實體及以上人士，並非以下層次。
錯誤：附表2第4(2)至(3)(c)條——第4(2)條明確適用於客戶本身不屬第(3)款類別的情況。
正確：附表2第4(2)至(3)(c)條——第4(3)(c)條涵蓋任何證券市場。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(b)至(d)條

en.q: Regarding a representative opening an MSO relationship for a company with an obvious commercial purpose, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: When both purpose and intended nature are obvious, the specific duty to obtain information about them is subject to an exception.
The obvious-purpose exception also permits the MSO to dispense with checking the representative’s authority to act for the company.
A genuine identity document for the representative does not itself establish that the representative is authorized to act for the company.
Where the company has a beneficial owner, a clear business purpose does not remove the requirement to understand ownership and control.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.2(1)(b)–(d) — Section 2(1)(c) expressly qualifies this information requirement.
False: Sch. 2 s.2(1)(b)–(d) — Section 2(1)(d)(ii) is a separate obligation; the purpose exception does not remove it.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.2(1)(b)–(d) — Section 2(1)(d) separately requires identity measures and verification of authority.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.2(1)(b)–(d) — Section 2(1)(b) independently requires measures to understand legal-person ownership and control.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於代表公司建立具有明顯商業目的的金錢服務業務關係，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 當目的及擬具有的性質均屬顯而易見時，取得有關目的及性質資料的特定責任設有例外。
目的顯而易見的例外，也准許經營者省略核實代表該公司行事的人的授權。
代表的身分證明文件即使真實，也不等於已核實該人獲授權代表公司行事。
公司有實益擁有人時，即使業務目的清楚，也不會取消了解公司擁有權及控制權結構的責任。
notes: 正確：附表2第2(1)(b)至(d)條——第2(1)(c)條明確限定這項資料要求。
錯誤：附表2第2(1)(b)至(d)條——第2(1)(d)(ii)條是獨立責任，不受目的例外取消。
正確：附表2第2(1)(b)至(d)條——第2(1)(d)條分別要求身分措施及核實授權。
正確：附表2第2(1)(b)至(d)條——第2(1)(b)條另要求了解法人的擁有權及控制權結構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3)(b)、(e)及(11)條

en.q: Regarding identifying the originator where someone else gives a wire-transfer instruction, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If money is paid from a company’s account with the ordering MSO, its employee giving the instruction does not replace the company as originator.
If there is no such account, the person instructing the ordering institution to make the transfer is the originator under the definition.
If the originator has no account, the ordering MSO records a unique reference number that the beneficiary institution assigned to the transfer.
If the recipient lacks an account, the recipient-side replacement reference is assigned by the beneficiary institution, not the ordering MSO.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(3)(b), (e), (11) — The account-holder limb applies where the money comes from such an account.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(3)(b), (e), (11) — The second limb applies in the absence of the account.
False: Sch. 2 s.12(3)(b), (e), (11) — Section 12(3)(b) uses a number assigned by the ordering financial institution itself.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(3)(b), (e), (11) — Section 12(3)(e) specifically names the beneficiary institution.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於由他人發出電傳轉賬指示時識別匯款人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如款項從公司在匯款經營者的戶口支付，發指示的僱員不會因此取代公司成為匯款人。
如沒有上述付款戶口，指示匯款機構進行該項轉賬的人便是定義所指的匯款人。
如匯款人沒有戶口，匯款經營者須記錄由收款機構為該轉賬編配的獨特參考編號。
如收款人沒有戶口，收款人一方的替代參考編號由收款機構編配，而非由匯款經營者編配。
notes: 正確：附表2第12(3)(b)、(e)及(11)條——款項從該戶口支付時，適用戶口持有人的條件。
正確：附表2第12(3)(b)、(e)及(11)條——第二個條件適用於沒有上述戶口的情況。
錯誤：附表2第12(3)(b)、(e)及(11)條——第12(3)(b)條使用由匯款金融機構本身編配的編號。
正確：附表2第12(3)(b)、(e)及(11)條——第12(3)(e)條明確指收款機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(1)至(2)條

en.q: Regarding an outward non-wire remittance of $8,000 whose originator presents a travel document, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The originator’s identity must be verified by reference to the identification document before the MSO carries out the remittance.
The MSO must record both the travel document number and the place of issue, rather than recording the number alone.
The record must include when the instructions were received, including the date and time, rather than only when the money is delivered.
The MSO must also record the recipient’s name and address and the delivery method, although the transaction is not a wire transfer.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.13(1)–(2) — Section 13(2)(b) requires verification before carrying out the transaction.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.13(1)–(2) — Section 13(2)(c)(ii) adds place of issue where the identification document is a travel document.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.13(1)–(2) — Section 13(2)(c)(v) specifies receipt of instructions.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.13(1)–(2) — These details are listed specifically for qualifying non-wire remittances.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於匯款人出示旅行證件的8,000元非電傳香港以外匯款，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者進行這項匯款之前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分。
經營者須同時記錄旅行證件的號碼及發出地方，不能只記錄旅行證件號碼。
紀錄須載有接獲指示的日期及時間，而不只是金錢送遞時的日期及時間。
經營者也須記錄收款人的姓名及地址和送遞方式，即使這並不是電傳轉賬。
notes: 正確：附表2第13(1)至(2)條——第13(2)(b)條要求在進行交易前核實。
正確：附表2第13(1)至(2)條——第13(2)(c)(ii)條在旅行證件情況增加發出地方。
正確：附表2第13(1)至(2)條——第13(2)(c)(v)條指明接獲指示的時間。
正確：附表2第13(1)至(2)條——這些資料專為合資格非電傳匯款列明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3)、(3A)及(5)(b)條

en.q: Regarding an MSO ordering an individual non-domestic wire transfer below $8,000, not bundled in a batch file, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A $7,500 transfer does not require the extra originator address-or-alternative detail merely because its destination is outside Hong Kong.
The reduced information requirement removes the need to record the recipient’s name when the transfer is only $7,500.
The message for a $7,500 non-domestic transfer still carries the names and account or reference details of both sides.
Increasing that transfer to exactly $8,000 still leaves the extra originator detail optional because the exemption includes the threshold amount.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(3), (3A), (5)(b) — Section 12(3A) exempts the paragraph (3)(c) detail below $8,000.
False: Sch. 2 s.12(3), (3A), (5)(b) — The exemption covers paragraph (c), not the recipient-name requirement in paragraph (d).
Correct: Sch. 2 s.12(3), (3A), (5)(b) — Section 12(5)(b) keeps paragraphs (3)(a), (b), (d) and (e).
False: Sch. 2 s.12(3), (3A), (5)(b) — The exemption is for less than $8,000, not $8,000 or less.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於經營者發出少於8,000元、並非集合在群組檔案內的單項非本地電傳轉賬，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 7,500元轉賬不會只因目的地在香港以外，而必須記錄匯款人的額外地址或替代資料。
轉賬只有7,500元時，簡減資料要求也令經營者無須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱。
7,500元非本地轉賬的信息，仍須附有雙方的姓名或名稱及戶口或參考編號資料。
把該轉賬增加至恰好8,000元後，額外匯款人資料仍屬可選，因為豁免包括門檻金額本身。
notes: 正確：附表2第12(3)、(3A)及(5)(b)條——第12(3A)條對少於8,000元免除第(3)(c)款資料。
錯誤：附表2第12(3)、(3A)及(5)(b)條——豁免只涵蓋(c)段，並非(d)段的收款人姓名。
錯誤：附表2第12(3)、(3A)及(5)(b)條——豁免是8,000元以下，不包括恰好8,000元。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(a)至(b)條

en.q: Regarding choosing a local intermediary for an MSO’s CDD, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A second licensed MSO does not qualify under the listed local financial-institution intermediary category merely by holding its MSO licence.
An accounting professional can qualify under the professional route only if it satisfies the MSO that adequate AML/CFT procedures are in place.
A local estate agent is excluded from the professional intermediary route even where adequate AML/CFT procedures satisfy the MSO.
A licensed insurance broker company can be a listed financial-institution intermediary even though it is not an authorized bank.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(a)–(b) — Section 18(3)(b) lists six financial-institution categories and excludes the MSO category.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(a)–(b) — Section 18(3)(a) makes adequate procedures a condition for the listed professionals.
False: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(a)–(b) — An estate agent is expressly listed in section 18(3)(a)(ii).
Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(a)–(b) — Section 18(3)(b) expressly includes licensed insurance broker companies.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於為金錢服務經營者選擇本地盡職審查中介人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 另一持牌金錢服務經營者，不能單憑金錢服務牌照便符合明列的本地金融機構中介人類別。
會計專業人士必須令經營者信納已有充分防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集程序，才可走專業人士途徑。
即使其充分打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集程序令經營者信納，本地地產代理仍不能走專業中介人途徑。
持牌保險經紀公司即使不屬銀行業的認可機構，也可符合明列的金融機構中介人類別。
notes: 正確：附表2第18(3)(a)至(b)條——第18(3)(b)條列出六類金融機構，沒有金錢服務經營者類別。
正確：附表2第18(3)(a)至(b)條——第18(3)(a)條把充分程序列為明列專業人士的條件。
錯誤：附表2第18(3)(a)至(b)條——第18(3)(a)(ii)條明確列出地產代理。
正確：附表2第18(3)(a)至(b)條——第18(3)(b)條明確包括持牌保險經紀公司。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(d)(ii)、(3A)及(7)條

en.q: Regarding related foreign intermediaries used by a non-Hong Kong-incorporated MSO that has not re-domiciled, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Its head office abroad can meet the relationship limb if it carries on business similar to a listed intermediary financial institution’s business.
A branch of its foreign head office can also meet the relationship limb if the required business condition is met.
The group policy relied on must apply to both the MSO and the relevant related foreign financial institution.
A qualifying relationship with the head office removes the need to satisfy the separate group-policy and group-supervision conditions.
notes: Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(d)(ii), (3A), (7) — The foreign-incorporated, non-re-domiciled case expressly includes its head office.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(d)(ii), (3A), (7) — Section 18(7) also names a branch of the head office.
Correct: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(d)(ii), (3A), (7) — The group-policy definition requires application to both institutions.
False: Sch. 2 s.18(3)(d)(ii), (3A), (7) — Section 18(3)(d) requires both related status and the conditions in subsection (3A).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於沒有遷冊至香港的外地成立經營者使用相關外地中介人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 香港以外總行如經營與明列中介人金融機構相類業務，可符合相關外地機構定義的關係條件。
其香港以外總行的分行如符合所需業務條件，也可符合相關外地機構定義的關係條件。
所依賴的集團政策必須同時適用於經營者及有關的相關外地金融機構。
與總行有合資格關係，便可免除另須符合的集團政策及集團層面監管條件。
notes: 正確：附表2第18(3)(d)(ii)、(3A)及(7)條——外地成立且未遷冊的情況明確包括總行。
正確：附表2第18(3)(d)(ii)、(3A)及(7)條——第18(7)條也列明總行的分行。
正確：附表2第18(3)(d)(ii)、(3A)及(7)條——集團政策定義要求適用於兩個機構。
錯誤：附表2第18(3)(d)(ii)、(3A)及(7)條——第18(3)(d)條同時要求相關身分及第(3A)款條件。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶4.7; Sample Questions MSSB/CA_01/2021, Example (4)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.7段；參考試題 MSSB/CA_01/2021 例子(4)

en.q: Regarding the requirements of local management office (LMO) of an MSO Licensee, which of the following statements are correct?
statements: The licensees operating with or without particular premises must maintain a LMO
LMO must be staffed by the compliance officer, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee
LMO can be reached in person and through telephone by the C&ED officers
If an MSO licensee fails to maintain the LMO, it may result in the suspension and revocation of the MSO licence.
notes: Incorrect: ¶4.7 requires a local management office of an applicant who chooses to operate a money service without particular premises, not of every licensee.
Correct: ¶4.7 says personnel in the LMO must be the sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or compliance officer of the licensee.
Correct: ¶4.7 describes the LMO as a physical office which can be reached in person and through telephone by C&ED officers.
Correct: ¶4.7 says a failure to maintain the LMO will result in the suspension and/or revocation of the licence.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者持牌人的本地管理辦事處的規定，下列哪項正確？
statements: 無論持牌人會或不會在特定處所經營金錢服務，都須維持本地管理辦事處。
本地管理辦事處須駐有持牌人的合規主任、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人。
本地管理辦事處可讓海關人員親身前往及以電話聯絡。
如金錢服務經營者持牌人未能維持本地管理辦事處，將可能會導致暫時吊銷及撤銷金錢服務經營者牌照。
notes: 不正確：第4.7段規定，選擇不會在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人，才須在香港維持實體辦事地點作為本地管理辦事處，並非所有持牌人均須維持。
正確：第4.7段規定實體辦事處內的人員必須是持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任。
正確：第4.7段指本地管理辦事處是實體辦事處，可讓海關人員親身前往及以電話聯絡。
正確：第4.7段指如持牌人未能維持本地管理辦事處，或會導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following particular premises are considered NOT suitable to be registered for the operation of a money service?
statements: Particular premises that are situated in a building that is wholly residential
Premises declared by another applicant for the grant or renewal of an MSO licence
Premises that cannot be entered without the permission of another business sharing them
Premises whose signboard name differs from the name on the Business Registration Certificate
Premises in a mixed commercial and residential building, with every occupant's written consent
notes: Correct: ¶4.6 lists particular premises situated in a wholly residential building as not suitable.
Correct: ¶4.6 lists premises being used by another MSO, or declared by another applicant for the grant or renewal of a licence, as not suitable.
Correct: ¶4.6 lists premises that are not accessible without the permission or assistance of another business sharing them as not suitable.
Correct: ¶4.6 lists premises whose signboard name differs from the name on the Business Registration Certificate submitted as not suitable.
Incorrect: ¶4.6 lists premises in a mixed commercial and residential building, whose every occupant has given written consent to entry by C&ED, as suitable.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，以下哪些特定處所被視為不適合登記用以經營金錢服務？
statements: 位於純住宅樓宇內、用以經營金錢服務的特定處所
另一名申請人已填報用以申請批給牌照或將牌照續期的特定處所
如未獲共用處所的其他業務准許便不能進入的特定處所
招牌所展示的業務名稱與商業登記證上的名稱並不相同的特定處所
位於混合式商住樓宇內並已取得每名佔用人書面同意的特定處所
notes: 正確：第4.6段把位於純住宅樓宇內的特定處所列為不適合登記。
正確：第4.6段把現由另一名金錢服務經營者使用，或另一名申請人已填報用以申請批給牌照或將牌照續期的特定處所列為不適合登記。
正確：第4.6段把如未獲共用處所的其他業務的佔用人或擁有人准許或協助便不能進入的特定處所列為不適合登記。
正確：第4.6段把招牌所展示的業務名稱與所遞交的商業登記證上的業務名稱並不相同的特定處所列為不適合登記。
不正確：第4.6段把位於混合式商住樓宇內、申請人已取得每名佔用人書面同意讓海關人員進入的特定處所列為適合登記。

en.q: Regarding the renewal of an MSO licence as the Licensing Guide describes it, which of the following are correct?
statements: C&ED sends each licensee a reminder 90 days before expiry, but it is the licensee's legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before expiry.
For a renewal at particular premises, at least four 4R-size photographs of the premises should be attached to the application form.
Once all the requisite documents for a renewal are found to be in order, the CCE issues the licensee with a notice for an interview.
A renewal application is deemed invalid if, after C&ED's reminder for outstanding documents, the licensee fails to produce them all within the specified period.
Where an invalid renewal application cannot be processed, the licence lapses automatically when its validity period expires and the licensee must cease operating.
notes: Correct: ¶6.2 says the department sends a reminder to each licensee 90 days before the expiry of the licence, but it is the licensee's legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before expiry.
Incorrect: ¶6.3 asks for at least two photographs of 4R size, one showing the inner part of the premises, such as the counter or office, and the other the outer part, such as the signboard.
Correct: ¶6.3 says that when all the requisite documents are found to be in order, the CCE will issue a notice for an interview to the licensee.
Correct: ¶6.4(b) deems the application invalid where a reminder for outstanding documents has been issued and the licensee fails to produce all the supporting documents within the specified period.

Correct: ¶6.4 says that if a licensee submits an invalid renewal application which cannot be processed, the existing licence will lapse automatically upon the expiry of the validity period and the licensee must cease money service operation.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於金錢服務經營者牌照的續期，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 海關會在牌照屆滿前90日向持牌人發出提示通知，但持牌人有法定責任在屆滿前45日申請續期。
如屬在特定處所經營金錢服務的續牌申請，申請書應夾附最少四張4R尺寸的處所照片。
持牌人遞交的續牌所需文件全部確認符合要求後，關長會向持牌人發出會面通知。
如海關已發信催交尚欠文件，但持牌人未能在指明期限內遞交所有證明文件，續牌申請將被視作無效。
續牌申請如屬無效而未能處理，現有牌照會於有效期屆滿後自動失效，持牌人亦必須停止經營金錢服務。
notes: 正確：第6.2段訂明海關會在牌照有效期屆滿前90日向每名持牌人發出提示通知，但持牌人有法定責任在牌照有效期屆滿前45日申請續期。
不正確：第6.3段規定申請書應夾附最少兩張4R尺寸的照片，一張顯示特定處所的內部，例如櫃枱或辦事處，另一張顯示外部，例如招牌。
正確：第6.3段訂明，如全部所需文件確認符合要求，關長會向持牌人發出會面通知。
正確：第6.4(b)段訂明，海關已向持牌人發信催交尚欠文件，但持牌人未能在指明期限內遞交所有證明文件，有關申請將被視作無效申請。
正確：第6.4段訂明，如持牌人遞交無效的續牌申請以致海關未能處理，現有牌照將於有效期屆滿後自動失效，持牌人必須停止經營金錢服務。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.1, ¶5.3 and ¶12.1–12.4

en.q: Regarding the format and pass rule of the Competence Assessment and the notification of its results, which of the following are correct?
statements: The Assessment has 35 multiple-choice questions in Chinese or English, each with only one correct answer, and candidates must complete it in 1 hour and 15 minutes.
A candidate who attains a total score of 25 or above for the entire Assessment paper obtains a pass in the Assessment.
Candidates will be notified of their results, which are PASS or FAIL only, by e-mail only and within 14 days after the Assessment.
A candidate dissatisfied with the result may ask in writing for a re-check within 14 days after the date of issuance of the result notification.
A re-check looks at the answer sheet for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies, and its result is final.
Once a re-check is completed, C&ED will disclose to the candidate, on request, the exact score that the candidate obtained.
notes: Correct: ¶5.1 says the Assessment comprises 35 multiple-choice questions in Chinese or English, with only one correct answer for each, to be completed in 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Incorrect: ¶5.3 also requires the candidate to make not more than two mistakes in each module; a total score of 25 or above is not enough on its own.
Correct: ¶12.1 says candidates will only be notified of the results, i.e. PASS or FAIL, by e-mail only within 14 days after the Assessment.
Incorrect: ¶12.2 allows a request for re-checking within seven days after the date of issuance of the result notification, and late submission will not be considered.
Correct: ¶12.3 says the answer sheet is re-checked for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies, and ¶12.4 says the result of the re-checking is final.
Incorrect: ¶12.4 says C&ED will not disclose the exact scores, the Assessment questions or the corresponding correct answers in any case.

tc.q: 關於能力評核的形式、合格要求及成績通知，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 能力評核備有中文或英文版本，共35條選擇題，每題只有一個正確答案，須於1小時15分鐘內完成。
應考者整份試卷取得的總分達25分或以上，即可在能力評核取得合格成績。
能力評核結果只分合格或不合格，並會在考試結束後14日內僅以電郵通知應考者。
應考者如對其能力評核成績不滿，可在發出成績通知當日起計14日內以書面要求覆檢。
覆檢答題紙時會留意輸入分數出錯及數據前後不一等技術錯誤，而覆檢結果將視作最終成績。
完成覆檢後，海關會應要求向應考者披露其在能力評核取得的實際分數。
notes: 正確：第5.1段訂明能力評核的試卷備有中文或英文版本，共有35條選擇題，每題只有一個正確答案，應考者須於1小時15分鐘內完成。
不正確：第5.3段同時規定應考者在每個單元不可答錯超過兩題；總分達25分或以上並不足夠。
正確：第12.1段訂明能力評核結果會在考試結束後14日內僅以電郵方式通知應考者，成績分為合格或不合格。
不正確：第12.2段訂明應考者須在發出成績通知當日起計7日內要求覆檢，逾期提出的要求將不獲受理。
正確：第12.3段訂明覆檢答題紙時會留意輸入分數出錯及數據前後不一等技術錯誤，第12.4段訂明覆檢結果將視作最終成績。
不正確：第12.4段訂明海關在任何情況下均不會披露實際分數、能力評核的試題及相關正確答案。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.1–4.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.1至4.3段

en.q: Regarding the eligible persons an MSO nominates to sit the Competence Assessment, which of the following are correct?
statements: An eligible person must be senior management overseeing the money service business and directly involved in decisions on company policy and governance.
Where the applicant or licensee is a partnership, not more than three of its partners can be nominated to participate in the Assessment.
Where the applicant or licensee is a corporation, the directors it may nominate include a director that is itself a corporation.
Candidates of the same company under one application or licence must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances.
notes: Correct: ¶4.1(i)–(ii) say an eligible person must be the senior management of the applicant or licensee in overseeing the operation of the money service business, and has a direct involvement in making decisions on company policy and governance arrangements.
Correct: ¶4.2(i)(b) says not more than three partners can be nominated to participate in the Assessment.
Incorrect: ¶4.2(ii)(b) refers to the individual directors of a corporation, who must be natural persons, so a director that is itself a corporation cannot be nominated.
Correct: ¶4.3 says that, as the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, candidates of the same company under an application or licence must attend the same session in all circumstances.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者提名應考能力評核的合資格人士，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 合資格人士必須是監督金錢服務業務運作的高級管理層，並直接參與公司政策及管治安排的決策。
如牌照申請人或持牌人屬合夥，可獲提名應考能力評核的合夥人不得超過三名。
如牌照申請人或持牌人屬法團，可獲提名應考能力評核的董事包括本身屬法團的董事。
就同一申請或牌照而言，同屬一所公司的應考者在任何情況下均必須應考同一時段的能力評核。
notes: 正確：第4.1段訂明合資格人士必須是牌照申請人／持牌人的高級管理層，負責監督金錢服務業務的運作，並要直接參與有關公司政策及管治安排的決策。
正確：第4.2段訂明，就合夥的合夥人而言，不得提名超過三名合夥人應考能力評核。
不正確：第4.2段所指的是法團內必須屬自然人的個別董事，本身屬法團的董事不能獲提名。
正確：第4.3段訂明，鑑於能力評核以公司為單位進行，同屬一所公司／法團的應考者在任何情況下均必須應考同一時段的能力評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.4–4.6; Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶6.2

en.q: Regarding when eligible persons are nominated for the Competence Assessment and when they sit or re-take it, which of the following are correct?
statements: A licensee nominates eligible persons for the Assessment when it notifies the deletion of its only eligible person who has passed the Assessment.
For the grant of a licence, the eligible persons must sit the Assessment within 30 days upon attending the interview with C&ED officers.
A licensee that has to nominate for its renewal must do so within 30 days upon receipt of the invitation letter for the Assessment.
If its eligible persons fail at renewal, a licensee may arrange a re-take at any time after 30 days upon the notification of result.
If all its eligible persons still fail before the licence expires, the renewal could be refused where the CCE considers the licensee no longer fit and proper.
notes: Correct: the Guidance Notes ¶4.4(iii) list, among the circumstances for nomination, notification by a licensee of the deletion of the only eligible person who has passed the Assessment.
Correct: the Guidance Notes ¶4.5 say that, for granting a licence, the eligible persons shall attend the Assessment within 30 days upon attending the interview with C&ED officers.
Incorrect: the Licensing Guide ¶6.2 requires the licensee to nominate the eligible persons within seven days upon receipt of the invitation letter, not 30 days.
Incorrect: the Guidance Notes ¶4.6 allow the re-take after 30 days upon the notification of result and before the expiry of the licence, not at any time.

Correct: the Guidance Notes ¶4.6 say that if all the eligible persons still fail before the expiry of the licence, the renewal application could be refused where the CCE considers the licensee no longer fit and proper.

tc.q: 關於提名合資格人士應考能力評核，以及他們應考或再次應考的時間，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 持牌人具報唯一取得合格成績的合資格人士已卸任時，會提名合資格人士應考。
就批給牌照而言，合資格人士必須在與海關人員會面當日起計30日內應考能力評核。
續牌時須提名的持牌人，必須在接獲邀請信當日起計30日內提名合資格人士應考。
續牌時合資格人士如應考失敗，持牌人可在成績通知發出當日起計30日後任何時間安排再次應考。
如所有合資格人士在牌照屆滿前仍未取得合格成績，關長若認為持牌人不再屬適當人選，可拒絕續牌申請。
notes: 正確：《能力評核須知》第4.4段把持牌人已具報唯一在能力評核取得合格成績的合資格人士已卸任，列為提名合資格人士應考的情況之一。
正確：《能力評核須知》第4.5段訂明，就批給牌照而言，合資格人士必須在與海關人員會面當日起計30日內應考能力評核。
不正確：《牌照指引》第6.2段規定持牌人須在接獲邀請信當日起計7日內提名合資格人士應考能力評核，並非30日。
不正確：《能力評核須知》第4.6段訂明再次應考須在成績通知發出當日起計30日後並在牌照有效期屆滿前進行，並非任何時間均可。
正確：《能力評核須知》第4.6段訂明，如持牌人的所有合資格人士在牌照有效期屆滿前仍未能取得合格成績，在關長認為持牌人不再屬適當人選的情況下，續牌申請可能被拒絕。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.1–8.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.1至8.3段

en.q: Regarding the validity of a pass in the Competence Assessment, which of the following are correct?
statements: The CCE treats a pass as a company-based qualification, which is also one of the fit and proper statuses to be associated with the business.
The qualification becomes void automatically when the licensee no longer has at least one member of its senior management who passed.
Once void, a partnership or corporation, but not a sole proprietorship, may have an eligible person sit within 30 days of notifying C&ED of the change.
Where a licensee whose qualification is void is due for renewal within 180 days, the Assessment follows the arrangement for renewing a licence.
On the merits of each case, the CCE may allow a licensee with no eligible person who has passed to continue its business, imposing licensing conditions.
notes: Correct: ¶8.1 says a pass in the Assessment is considered by the CCE to be a company-based qualification which is also one of the fit and proper person statuses to be associated with the business of operating a money service.

Correct: ¶8.2 says the qualification will be void automatically when the licensee no longer has at least one member of the senior management, i.e. the sole proprietor, a partner or a director, who passed the Assessment.

Correct: ¶8.2 gives a partnership or corporation an opportunity to arrange an eligible person to take the Assessment within 30 days upon notification to C&ED of the change in partnership or directorship, except for a licensee that is a sole proprietorship.
Correct: ¶8.2 says that for licensees due for renewal within 180 days, the Assessment arrangement follows ¶4.6, which relates to the renewal of licence.

Correct: ¶8.3 says the CCE may, having considered the merits of each case, exercise discretion to allow the licensee to continue when none of its eligible persons passed, and will impose the licensing conditions it deems appropriate and necessary.

tc.q: 關於在能力評核取得合格成績的有效期，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長將在能力評核取得合格成績視作以公司為單位取得的資格，這亦關乎是否屬與業務有聯繫的適當人選。
如持牌人的高級管理層中不再有最少一名成員在能力評核取得合格成績，此項資格將自動失效。
資格失效後，合夥及法團可安排合資格人士於具報合夥或董事人選改變後30日內應考，但獨資經營的持牌人除外。
如資格已失效的持牌人須於180日內將牌照續期，其能力評核須按關於續牌的安排處理。
關長經考慮個案情況後，即使持牌人已沒有合資格人士取得合格成績，仍可容許其繼續經營，並會施加發牌條件。
notes: 正確：第8.1段訂明關長將「在能力評核取得合格成績」視作一項以公司為單位取得的資格，這亦關乎是否屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。
正確：第8.2段訂明，如持牌人的高級管理層（即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）中不再有最少一名成員在能力評核取得合格成績，此項以公司為單位取得的資格將自動失效。
正確：第8.2段訂明合夥及法團可獲給予一次機會，於向海關具報合夥或董事人選有改變當日起計30日內安排合資格人士應考，但獨資經營的持牌人除外。
正確：第8.2段訂明，如持牌人須於180日內將牌照續期，則按第4.6段所載關於續牌的能力評核安排。
正確：第8.3段訂明關長經考慮每宗個案的情況後，即使持牌人已沒有任何合資格人士取得合格成績，仍可運用酌情權容許其繼續經營，並會施加其認為適當及必要的相關發牌條件。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶9.1, ¶9.3 and ¶10.2

en.q: Regarding what candidates present and observe when attending the Competence Assessment, which of the following are correct?
statements: Candidates should present a Hong Kong Identity Card or another identification document with a photo, such as a valid travel document.
Of the documents to be presented, the authorization letter applies only to candidates of a partnership company or a corporation.
A candidate who presents an identification document that is damaged or defaced will be refused entry to the Assessment.
Requests to change the date, time or centre of the Assessment will not be considered, and latecomers will not be let in once it has started.
notes: Correct: ¶9.1(1) lists a Hong Kong Identity Card or an alternative identification document with photo, e.g. valid travel documents, among the documents candidates should present.
Correct: ¶9.1(2) lists the authorization letter as a document only for the partnership company and corporation.
Incorrect: ¶9.3 says a candidate whose identification document is damaged or defaced may not be allowed to attend; refusal is a possibility, not a certainty.
Correct: ¶10.2 says requests for change of Assessment date, time or centre will not be considered, and that once the Assessment has started candidates will not be allowed to enter.

tc.q: 關於應考者應考能力評核時須出示的文件及須遵守的事項，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 應考者須出示香港身份證或其他附有相片的身份證明文件，例如有效的旅遊證件。
應考時須出示的文件中，授權書僅適用於合夥公司及法團的應考者。
如應考者出示的身份證明文件受損或曾遭塗改，將被拒絕應考能力評核。
更改應考日期、時間或試場的要求將不被接納，而開考後應試者不會獲准進入試場。
notes: 正確：第9.1(1)段列出應考者須出示香港身份證或其他附有相片的身份證明文件，例如有效的旅遊證件。
正確：第9.1(2)段訂明授權書僅適用於合夥公司及法團。
不正確：第9.3段訂明身份證明文件受損或曾遭塗改的應考者「可能」不獲准應考，並非必定被拒絕應考。
正確：第10.2段訂明任何更改能力評核日期／時間／試場的要求將不被接納，而能力評核開考後，應試者將不會獲准進入試場。

en.q: Regarding changes in a licensee's particulars and in its business after it is licensed, which of the following are correct?
statements: A change in the bank account used for operating the money service business must be notified to the CCE on the Notification of Change in Particulars (Form 6).
A licensee that changes its legal entity may carry on under its existing licence by notifying the change to the CCE on Form 6.
A licensee changing from money changing to remittance service must file a written submission with the CCE, including an updated Business Plan and AML Policy.
The offence of failing to notify a change in particulars carries, on conviction, a fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months.
Some changes in particulars, such as a change in the fit and proper status of a director, may result in a review of the validity of the licence.
notes: Correct: ¶9.1(k) lists a change in bank account used for operating money service business among the changes notified on the Notification of Change in Particulars (Form 6).

Incorrect: ¶9.4 says that, as far as the change of the legal entity is concerned, the licensee needs to submit a fresh licence application for the CCE to consider the fit and proper status of the legal entity concerned.

Correct: ¶9.4 requires a licensee wishing to change the nature of its money service business, e.g. from money changing to remittance, to file a written submission including the updated Business Plan and AML Policy.
Incorrect: ¶9.3 says a licensee who, without reasonable excuse, contravenes section 40(1) is liable on conviction to a fine of HK$50,000; no term of imprisonment is provided.
Correct: ¶9.1 warns that some changes in particulars may result in a review of the validity of an MSO licence, for example changes in the fit and proper status of a director.

tc.q: 關於持牌人獲批牌照後其詳情及業務的改變，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 用以經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶有改變，須填寫表格6（具報詳情改變）向關長具報。
持牌人如改變法律實體，可以表格6向關長具報有關改變，並繼續沿用現有牌照。
持牌人由貨幣兌換改為匯款服務，須向關長遞交書面陳詞，包括經修訂的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。
違反具報詳情改變規定的罪行，一經定罪，可被判港幣5萬元罰款及監禁6個月。
若干詳情的改變，例如董事的適當人選身分有改變，或會引致牌照被檢視是否仍有效。
notes: 正確：第9.1(k)段把用以經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶的改變，列為須填寫表格6（具報詳情改變）向關長具報的改變。
不正確：第9.4段訂明，就改變法律實體而言，持牌人須遞交新的牌照申請，讓關長考慮相關法律實體的適當人選資格是否符合批給牌照的資格準則。
正確：第9.4段規定持牌人如有意改變金錢服務業務性質，例如從貨幣兌換服務轉為匯款服務，須向關長遞交書面陳詞，包括經修訂的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。
不正確：第9.3段訂明任何人無合理辯解而違反第40(1)條，一經定罪，可被判港幣5萬元罰款，並無監禁的罰則。
正確：第9.1段提醒持牌人，若干詳情的改變或會引致牌照被檢視是否仍有效，例如董事適當人選身分的改變。

en.q: Regarding a licensee that ceases to operate a money service, wholly or at any of its specified premises, which of the following are correct?
statements: A licensee wishing to switch from particular premises to operating without them must notify the CCE of the cessation of its business and apply for a new licence.
Where its business ends with the expiry of its licence, a licensee must still notify the CCE on Form 7 before the date of expiry.
A licensee that stops operating at one of its specified premises must apply in Form 5 to have those premises removed from its licence.
A licensee that cancels its licence within its validity period is refunded the part of the fees that covers the unexpired period.
Contravening the duty to notify the CCE of a cessation, without reasonable excuse, is an offence and will adversely affect the fitness and propriety of the person concerned.
notes: Correct: ¶10.1 says such a licensee needs to notify the CCE of the cessation of its existing business and submit a new application for a licence to operate without particular premises.
Correct: ¶10.2 says the licensee must notify the CCE before the date of cessation, including expiry of licence, by completing the Notification of Cessation of Business (Form 7).

Incorrect: ¶10.1–10.2 treat ceasing to operate at a specified premises as a cessation, notified to the CCE on the Notification of Cessation of Business (Form 7); Form 5 is the application to add premises (¶8.4).
Incorrect: ¶10.3 answers no: a licensee that cancels its licence within its validity period gets no refund of the whole or any part of the fees paid.

Correct: ¶10.4 says a licensee who, without reasonable excuse, contravenes section 41(1) commits an offence, and that such contravention will adversely affect the fitness and propriety of the person concerned.

tc.q: 關於持牌人停止經營金錢服務或停止在牌照指明的任何處所經營金錢服務，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 持牌人如由在特定處所經營改為在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，須具報停業並提出新的牌照申請。
如業務隨牌照有效期屆滿而終止，持牌人仍須在屆滿日期前填寫表格7向關長具報。
持牌人如停止在其中一個指明處所經營，須填寫表格5申請將該處所從牌照上刪除。
持牌人如在牌照生效期間取消牌照，可獲退還已繳費用中涵蓋餘下有效期的部分。
無合理辯解而違反具報停業的規定即屬犯罪，而此等違例行為會對有關個人是否屬適當人選造成負面影響。
notes: 正確：第10.1段訂明該持牌人需要向關長具報停止現有業務，並提出新的牌照申請，以在沒有特定處所的情況下經營金錢服務。
正確：第10.2段訂明持牌人必須在停業日期（包括牌照的有效期屆滿日期）前填寫具報停業表格（表格7），向關長具報停業意向及停業日期。
不正確：第10.1及10.2段把停止在指明處所經營金錢服務視作停業，須填寫具報停業表格（表格7）向關長具報；表格5是申請加入處所的表格（第8.4段）。
不正確：第10.3段的答案是「不會」：持牌人在牌照生效期間取消牌照，不會獲退還全部或部分已繳交的費用。
正確：第10.4段訂明任何持牌人如無合理辯解而違反第41(1)條，即屬犯罪，而此等違例行為會對有關個人是否屬適當人選造成負面影響。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶8.3, ¶8.4 and Section XIV (fee schedule)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.3、8.4段及第XIV條（收費表）

en.q: Regarding the applications a licensee makes to the CCE for changes after it is licensed, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where a person proposes to become a partner, the licensee must apply in Form 4 and that person must submit a fit and proper person declaration form.
To begin operating at particular premises, a licensee that has none must apply in Form 5 and must also submit a Business Plan and updated AML Policy.
An application to add new business premises carries a fee of HK$945 for each new business premises to be added to the licence.
To add premises at which to operate a money service, a licensee must notify the CCE of the change in business premises information on Form 6.
notes: Correct: ¶8.3 says a licensee needs to make an application in Form 4 and the proposing partner needs to submit the fit and proper person declaration form.
Correct: ¶8.4 says such a licensee, apart from submitting an application in Form 5, needs to submit a Business Plan and updated AML Policy to notify the CCE of the change in operation mode.
Incorrect: the fee schedule in Section XIV sets the fee for an application to add new business premises at HK$2,440 for each new business premises.

Incorrect: ¶8.4 says a licensee that wishes to add premises to operate a money service needs to make an application in Form 5; adding premises needs the CCE's prior approval, not a notification of change.

tc.q: 關於持牌人獲批牌照後就改變事項向關長提出的申請，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如有人擬成為合夥人，持牌人須填寫表格4提出申請，而擬成為合夥人的人則須遞交適當人選聲明表格。
持牌人如由在沒有特定處所的情況下經營改為在特定處所經營，須遞交表格5、業務計劃及經修訂的打擊洗錢政策。
申請要求加入新的業務處所時，須就每一新的業務處所繳付港幣945元的費用。
持牌人如要加入新處所經營金錢服務，須以表格6向關長具報業務處所資料有改變。
notes: 正確：第8.3段訂明持牌人需要填寫表格4以提出申請，而擬成為合夥人的人則須遞交適當人選聲明表格。
正確：第8.4段訂明該持牌人除了需要向海關遞交表格5以作申請，還需要遞交業務計劃及經修訂的打擊洗錢政策，向關長具報經營模式有改變。
不正確：第XIV條收費表訂明，申請要求加入新的業務處所的費用為每一新的業務處所港幣2,440元。
不正確：第8.4段訂明持牌人如有意加入處所經營金錢服務，需要填寫表格5以提出申請；加入處所須事先取得關長批准，並非以具報詳情改變的方式處理。

en.q: Regarding the ultimate owners of an applicant for a licence or a licensee, which of the following are correct according to the Licensing Guide?
statements: For an individual applicant or licensee, a second individual who ultimately owns or controls its money service business is an ultimate owner.
If an individual applicant or licensee is acting on behalf of someone else, the ultimate owner is that someone else.
In a partnership, an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the partnership is an ultimate owner.
Each director of a corporate applicant or licensee is one of its ultimate owners by virtue of holding that office.
Like the licensee's partners and directors, an ultimate owner in relation to a licensee must remain fit and proper at all times.
notes: Correct: ¶4.2.1(a) says that, for an applicant or licensee that is an individual, the ultimate owner means another individual who ultimately owns or controls the money service business of the first-mentioned individual.
Correct: ¶4.2.1(b) says that, if the first-mentioned individual is acting on behalf of another person, the ultimate owner means the other person.
Correct: ¶4.2.2(c) includes an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the partnership.

Incorrect: ¶4.2.3 identifies the ultimate owner of a corporation by its issued share capital, its voting rights at general meetings or ultimate control over its management; holding the office of director is not one of them.
Correct: ¶11.1(c) says the individual, any partner, any director and ultimate owner in relation to a licensee must remain fit and proper at all times.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於牌照申請人或持牌人的最終擁有人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如申請人或持牌人是個人，另一名最終擁有或控制其金錢服務業務的個人屬最終擁有人。
如屬個人的申請人或持牌人是代表另一人行事，該另一人即屬最終擁有人。
就屬合夥的申請人或持牌人而言，行使對該合夥的管理最終的控制權的個人屬最終擁有人。
屬法團的申請人或持牌人的每名董事，均因擔任董事職位而屬其最終擁有人。
與持牌人的合夥人及董事一樣，與持牌人有關的最終擁有人在任何時間均必須是適當人選。
notes: 正確：第4.2.1(a)段訂明，就屬個人的牌照申請人或持牌人而言，最終擁有人指最終擁有或控制該名個人的金錢服務業務的另一名個人。
正確：第4.2.1(b)段訂明，如首述個人是代表另一人行事，最終擁有人指該另一人。
正確：第4.2.2(c)段把行使對該合夥的管理最終的控制權的個人列為最終擁有人。
不正確：第4.2.3段以已發行股本、成員大會上的投票權或對法團的管理最終的控制權界定法團的最終擁有人；擔任董事職位並不在其中。
正確：第11.1(c)段訂明與持牌人有關的該名個人、任何合夥人、任何董事及最終擁有人在任何時間均必須是適當人選。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶11.2; Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2025 (30 May 2025) ¶3, ¶5 and ¶6
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第11.2段；香港海關通函MSSB/MIS_02/2025（2025年5月30日）第3、5及6段

en.q: Regarding the periodic return a licensee lodges with the CCE, which of the following are correct?
statements: A licensee must lodge its periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year, unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing.
Returns are lodged twice a year, not quarterly, and the first return of each year covers the transactions from 1 January to 30 June.
New periodic returns must be submitted through the MSOS, and C&ED no longer accepts periodic returns submitted in paper form.
Licensees must give further information in the new return, including the jurisdictions involved in, and the delivery channels used for, remittances.
Licensees were required to lodge their first new return, covering transactions from 1 January to 30 June 2025, beginning from 1 July 2025.
notes: Correct: the Licensing Guide ¶11.2 says a licensee shall lodge a periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year unless specified by the CCE by notice in writing.
Correct: the circular replaces quarterly lodgement with a half-yearly arrangement, 2 submissions per year, the first covering 1 January to 30 June and the second 1 July to 31 December.
Correct: the circular requires new returns to be submitted via the electronic service of the MSOS and says C&ED will no longer accept submission in paper form.

Correct: the circular lists the jurisdictions involved in remittance transactions and the delivery channels used in remittance transactions among the additional information, together with the foreign currencies involved in money changing.
Correct: the circular requires all licensees to lodge their first new return, covering the transactions from 1 January 2025 to 30 June 2025, beginning from 1 July 2025.

tc.q: 關於持牌人向關長遞交的定期申報表，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 持牌人須在每半年開始後的兩星期內遞交定期申報表，除非關長透過通知書另作指定。
定期申報表每年遞交兩次而非每季遞交，每年第一次涵蓋1月1日至6月30日的交易資料。
新定期申報表須經牌照系統遞交，海關亦不再接受以紙本形式遞交的定期申報表。
持牌人須在新定期申報表提供額外資料，包括匯款交易所涉司法管轄區及匯款交易使用的交付渠道。
第一份新定期申報表涵蓋2025年1月1日至6月30日的交易，須在2025年7月1日起遞交。
notes: 正確：《牌照指引》第11.2段訂明，除關長透過通知書另作指定外，持牌人必須在每半年開始後的兩星期內，向關長遞交定期申報表。
正確：通函把每季遞交改為每半年遞交一次，即每年兩次，第一次涵蓋1月1日至6月30日，第二次涵蓋7月1日至12月31日。
正確：通函規定持牌人須經牌照系統電子服務遞交新定期申報表，海關將不再接受紙本定期申報表。
正確：通函把匯款交易所涉司法管轄區及匯款交易使用的交付渠道，連同貨幣兌換交易所涉外幣，列為須提供的額外資料。
正確：通函訂明所有持牌人須在2025年7月1日起遞交第一份新定期申報表，涵蓋2025年1月1日至6月30日的交易。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction and items 2, 7 and 9
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言及第2、7及9項

en.q: According to the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan, which of the following should an applicant include in its business plan?
statements: The source of the applicant's capital, and whether the applicant is associated with or controlled by any entities or group company
The measures taken to protect customer funds against loss if another agent or MSO, in or outside Hong Kong, fails to fulfil its part
The expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital
The risk assessment methodology it uses for AML/CFT purposes, including its procedures for assessing the risk of customers
A written confirmation that it is well aware of, and will comply with, the duty to notify a change in particulars within one month
notes: Correct: item 2 (company history) asks for information on the applicant's history, the source of capital and whether the applicant is associated with or controlled by any entities or group company.

Correct: item 7 asks the applicant to elaborate the measures taken to protect customer funds against risk of loss in the event of nonfulfillment of other agent or MSO both inside and outside Hong Kong.
Correct: item 9 asks for the expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years and the running capital for the daily operation of the business.
Incorrect: the 17 items the guideline lists, from the company name to other supervision, do not include the applicant's risk assessment methodology for AML/CFT purposes.
Correct: the introduction requires the applicant to confirm in writing in the business plan that it is well aware of and will comply with the duty to notify a change in particulars within one month.

tc.q: 根據《遞交業務計劃的指引》，申請人應在業務計劃內包括下列哪些資料？
statements: 申請人的資金來源，以及申請人是否與任何實體或集團公司有聯繫或受其控制
如其他在香港及香港以外的代理人或金錢服務經營者未能履行承諾，保障客戶資金免受損失的措施
未來兩年每類產品及服務的預計利潤幅度和營業額，以及業務日常運作的營運資本
申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而進行風險評估的方法，包括評估客戶風險的程序
書面確認全然知悉並會遵從須在詳情改變後一個月內藉書面向關長具報的法定規定
notes: 正確：第2項（公司歷史）要求就申請人的歷史、資金來源及申請人是否與任何實體或集團公司有聯繫或受其控制提供資料。
正確：第7項要求闡述如其他在香港及香港以外的代理人或金錢服務經營者未能履行承諾，有何措施保障客戶的資金，以免承受損失的風險。
正確：第9項要求就未來兩年每類產品及服務的預計利潤幅度和營業額及業務日常運作的營運資本提供資料。
不正確：指引所列的17個項目，由公司名稱至另受監管，並不包括申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而進行風險評估的方法。
正確：指引的引言規定申請人須於業務計劃內藉書面確認全然知悉並會遵從在詳情改變發生之日起計的一個月內藉書面向關長具報的法定規定。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), introduction and items 3, 5 and 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）引言及第3、5及16項

en.q: According to the Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy, which of the following are correct about an applicant's AML/CFT policy?
statements: On distribution channels, the policy should state the percentage of the applicant's transactions that are face-to-face and non-face-to-face.
On record keeping, the policy should state whether the system can retrieve the records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day.
The MSO will monitor, and keep records of, which staff have been trained, when they received the training and what type of training it was.
The guidelines' example of a situation assessed as high risk is a walk-in customer remitting HK$120,000 in cash to the Mainland.
The items tabulated are by no means exhaustive, and the applicant must consider other important issues peculiar to its business model.
notes: Correct: item 5 asks the applicant to elaborate its distribution channels, including the percentage of face-to-face and non-face-to-face transactions.
Correct: item 3, on record keeping, asks whether the system can retrieve those records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day.
Correct: item 16 says the MSO will monitor and maintain records of who have been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of training provided.
Incorrect: item 3 gives as its example of a situation assessed to be high risk a walk-in customer remitting HK$200,000 in cash to the Mainland.
Correct: the introduction says the items tabulated are by no means exhaustive and the applicant must consider any other important issues peculiar to its business model.

tc.q: 根據《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》，關於申請人的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就分銷渠道而言，政策應闡述申請人面對面及非面對面交易各佔的百分率。
就備存紀錄而言，政策應闡述有關系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日內）提取有關紀錄。
金錢服務經營者將就職員接受培訓的情況，包括誰人、何時及培訓類別，進行監察並備存紀錄。
指引所舉評定為高風險情況的例子，是有街客要求將港幣120,000元現金匯往內地。
所列項目並非詳盡無遺，申請人必須顧及本身業務模式獨有的其他重要事項。
notes: 正確：第5項要求闡述分銷渠道，包括面對面及非面對面交易所佔百分率。
正確：第3項就備存紀錄要求闡述有關系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日內）提取有關紀錄。
正確：第16項訂明金錢服務經營者將監察誰人已接受培訓、職員何時接受培訓，以及所提供培訓的類別，並備存紀錄。
不正確：第3項舉出的經評定為高風險情況的例子，是有街客要求將港幣200,000元現金匯往內地。
正確：指引的引言訂明所列項目並非詳盡無遺，申請人必須顧及本身業務模式獨有的其他重要事項。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(a)、(d)、(f)、(m)、(p)及(q)段

en.q: Which of the following does the Supplementary Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety give as matters the CCE considers relevant in deciding whether a person is fit and proper?
statements: Whether the person is the subject of unresolved criminal charges in Hong Kong or anywhere else
