Whether the person has been disqualified by a court of competent jurisdiction from being a director
Whether the licensee has been the subject of any complaint relating to its conduct of carrying on the business
Whether the person has genuine intention and readiness to carry on the money service business proposed in its application
Whether the person's money service business has made a profit in each year since the grant of the licence
Whether the person has failed to comply with any conditions imposed by the CCE on the licence
notes: Correct: ¶6(m) lists whether the person is the subject of unresolved criminal charges in Hong Kong or elsewhere.
Correct: ¶6(p) lists whether the person has been disqualified by a court of competent jurisdiction from being a director.
Incorrect: ¶6(d) gives as its example a complaint made reasonably and in good faith relating to the licensee's conduct of carrying on the business, not any complaint.

Correct: ¶6(f) lists whether the person has genuine intention and readiness to carry on the money service business proposed in the licence application, giving nil money service for a prolonged period after the grant as an example.
Incorrect: ¶6(q) asks whether the person has adequate financial resources for the nature and scale of its operations; none of the matters listed is whether the business makes a profit.
Correct: ¶6(a) lists whether the person has failed to comply with any conditions imposed by the CCE on the licence.

tc.q: 根據《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》，關長在斷定某人是否適當人選時，下列哪些屬其認為有關的事宜？
statements: 該人是否在香港或其他地方於尚未結案的刑事檢控中屬於被告
該人是否曾被具司法管轄權的法院取消擔任董事的資格
持牌人經營業務的行為是否曾遭任何人提出任何投訴
該人是否具備真正意向並已準備就緒經營申請牌照時擬議的業務
該人的金錢服務業務自獲批給牌照後是否每年均有盈利
該人是否曾不遵從關長在其牌照上施加的任何條件
notes: 正確：第6(m)段列出「該人是否在香港或其他地方於尚未結案的刑事檢控中屬於被告」。
正確：第6(p)段列出「該人是否曾被具司法管轄權的法院取消擔任董事的資格」。
不正確：第6(d)段所舉的例子是持牌人經營業務的行為遭投訴，「而投訴屬合理及真誠地提出」，並非任何投訴。
正確：第6(f)段列出「該人是否具備真正意向並已準備就緒經營申請牌照時擬議的業務」，例如持牌人獲批給牌照後長時間沒有提供金錢服務。
不正確：第6(q)段關注的是該人是否具備充分財政資源支持其運作的性質及規模；所列事宜並不包括業務是否有盈利。
正確：第6(a)段列出「該人是否曾不遵從關長在牌照上施加的任何條件」。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶4, ¶6, ¶7 and ¶9; Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018) ¶3, ¶5, ¶7 and ¶9
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第4、6、7及9段；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第3、5、7及9段

en.q: Under the CCE's guidelines on pecuniary penalties, which of the following are correct about how the CCE decides whether to impose a penalty on an MSO and its amount?
statements: As a matter of policy, the CCE will usually make public all of its decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO.
The CCE takes the MSO's size and financial resources into account, as a penalty should not be likely to put the MSO in financial jeopardy.
A contravention caused merely by negligence, or conduct resulting only in a technical breach, is generally regarded as less serious.
A number of smaller issues, which individually may not justify a penalty but do so when taken collectively, are a factor considered.
The CCE generally takes no disciplinary action for conduct that was in line with the guidance current at the time of the conduct.
The CCE's aim in imposing a pecuniary penalty is to deter the MSO concerned and, as a general deterrent, other MSOs too.
notes: Correct: the Disciplinary Action Guideline ¶4 and the Disciplinary Fining Guideline ¶3 both say that, as a matter of policy, the CCE will usually publicise all his decisions to impose pecuniary penalty.

Correct: ¶7 of each guideline says a pecuniary penalty should not have the likely effect of putting the MSO concerned in financial jeopardy, and the CCE will take into account its size and financial resources.
Correct: ¶9(a)(i) of each guideline says a contravention resulting from negligence, or conduct which only results in a technical breach, is generally regarded as less serious.
Correct: ¶9(a)(viii) of each guideline lists whether there are a number of smaller issues which individually may not justify a pecuniary penalty but which do so when taken collectively.
Correct: ¶9(d)(i) of each guideline says the CCE generally will not take disciplinary action for conduct that is in line with guidance which was current at the time of the conduct in question.

Correct: the Disciplinary Action Guideline ¶6 and the Disciplinary Fining Guideline ¶5 both say a pecuniary penalty is to act as a deterrent to the MSO concerned and as a general deterrent to other MSOs.

tc.q: 根據關長就施加罰款發出的指引，關於關長如何決定是否向金錢服務經營者施加罰款及罰款金額，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 按照目前的政策，關長通常會公布所有向金錢服務經營者施加罰款的決定。
關長會顧及金錢服務經營者的規模及財政資源，因罰款不應令其陷入財政困難。
純粹因疏忽所造成的違規行為，或只屬技術性違規的行為，一般會視作嚴重性較低。
若干較輕微的違規事項個別未必足以施加罰款，但合起來則可施加罰款，這屬考慮因素之一。
如有關行為符合當時適用的導引，關長一般不會就該行為採取紀律行動。
關長施加罰款，旨在阻嚇有關金錢服務經營者，同時對其他金錢服務經營者起一般的阻嚇作用。
notes: 正確：《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第4段及《紀律處分罰款指引》第3段均訂明，按照目前的政策，關長通常會公布所有施加罰款的決定。
正確：兩份指引的第7段均訂明罰款不應導致有關持牌人或金錢服務經營者陷入財政困難，關長將顧及其規模及財政資源。
正確：兩份指引的第9(a)(i)段均訂明，純粹因疏忽造成的違規行為或只屬技術性違規的行為，一般會視作嚴重性較低的行為。
正確：兩份指引的第9(a)(viii)段均把干犯一些較輕微的違規事項，個別未必足以施加罰款，但合起來則可施加罰款，列為考慮因素。
正確：兩份指引的第9(d)(i)段均訂明，如有關行為符合當時適用的導引，關長一般不會採取紀律行動。
正確：《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第6段及《紀律處分罰款指引》第5段均訂明，罰款的作用是阻嚇有關持牌人或金錢服務經營者，並對其他持牌人或金錢服務經營者發揮一般阻嚇作用。

en.q: Regarding the Licensing Guide's explanation of who must apply for an MSO licence, who need not, and how the application is made, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person who wishes to operate a money service is required to apply for a licence, and must apply to the CCE before operating the service.
The CCE will not accept an application for the grant or renewal of a licence from an applicant that has been exempted from the licensing requirements.
Each additional premises is included in the application for the grant of a licence, with a fee paid for each, and needs no separate application.
If the CCE later refuses to grant the licence, the application fee that was collected for processing the application is refunded to the applicant.
An SVF licensee, as the exemption uses the term, is a person granted a licence under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance.
notes: Correct: ¶2.1 requires a person who operates or wishes to operate a money service to apply for a licence, and ¶2.7 says a person must apply for a licence from the CCE before he or she operates a money service.
Correct: ¶3.1 says the CCE will not accept any application for grant or renewal of licence if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements.

Correct: ¶2.6 says a separate application is not required: the applicant must include each additional premises in which money service is operated in an application for licence and pay a fee for each additional business premises to be registered.
Incorrect: ¶2.8 says no refund will be made for the application fee collected, irrespective of whether the application is subsequently approved or refused.
Correct: ¶3.7 says an SVF licensee means a person who is granted a licence under section 8F of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance, Chapter 584.

tc.q: 關於《牌照指引》就誰人須申請金錢服務經營者牌照、誰人不需要申請及如何申請所作的解釋，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 擬經營金錢服務的人須申請牌照，並必須在經營金錢服務前向關長提出申請。
如申請人本身獲豁免於發牌規定，關長將不會接納其提出的批給牌照或牌照續期申請。
申請批給牌照時，額外處所須列入同一申請書並就每一處所繳費，無須另行申請。
如關長其後拒絕批給牌照，就處理該申請而收取的牌照申請費用會發還申請人。
豁免條文所指的工具持牌人，是根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》獲批給牌照的人。
notes: 正確：第2.1段訂明任何經營或擬經營金錢服務的人士必須申請牌照，第2.7段訂明任何人在經營金錢服務前必須向關長申請牌照。
正確：第3.1段訂明，如申請人本身獲豁免於金錢服務經營者的發牌規定，關長將不會接納任何由其提出要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請。
正確：第2.6段訂明不需要另行提出申請；申請人必須將每一個用作經營金錢服務的額外處所列入牌照申請書內，並須就需要加以登記的每一個額外業務處所繳交費用。
不正確：第2.8段訂明不論牌照其後是獲批准抑或遭拒絕，已收取的牌照申請費用概不發還。
正確：第3.7段訂明工具持牌人指根據第584章《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》第8F條獲批給牌照的人。

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following are correct about the premises at which a money service is operated?
statements: The particular premises that need to be registered are those in which the licensee operates a money changing service and/or a remittance service.
Premises where the licensee is only a visitor or a customer, such as a dining establishment or a bank, are not treated as its particular premises.
Going to a customer's office to meet the customer there is not considered to be operating a money service at particular premises.
Where another business is run on the same premises, the MSO's money service business must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from it.
An MSO may share its premises with another MSO to operate money service business, provided that the two businesses are clearly partitioned.
notes: Correct: ¶4.4 says the particular premises that need to be registered are those in which you operate a money changing service and/or a remittance service.
Correct: ¶4.4 says premises are not treated as particular premises for operating a money service if you are only a visitor or a customer at premises such as dining establishments or banks.
Correct: ¶4.5(b) gives meeting customers at a customer office as an example of what is not considered operating a money service at particular premises.

Correct: ¶4.8 says that where other business is being run on the same premises of an applicant, the money service business of the MSO must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from the other business.
Incorrect: the partition rule in ¶4.8 is for other business run on the same premises; sharing the premises with other MSO to operate money service business will not be accepted by the CCE.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於經營金錢服務的處所，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 需要登記的特定處所，是持牌人用以經營貨幣兌換服務及／或匯款服務的處所。
如持牌人只是食肆或銀行等處所的訪客或顧客，有關處所不被視為其特定處所。
持牌人前往顧客的辦事處與顧客會面，不被視為在特定處所經營金錢服務。
如有其他業務在同一處所內經營，金錢服務業務必須設有明顯分隔，與其他業務清楚區分。
如業務設有明顯分隔，金錢服務經營者可與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所經營業務。
notes: 正確：第4.4段訂明需要作出登記的特定處所指你用以經營貨幣兌換服務及／或匯款服務的處所。
正確：第4.4段訂明，如你只是食肆或銀行等處所的訪客或顧客，有關處所不被視為特定處所。
正確：第4.5(b)段把在顧客的辦事處會見顧客列為不被視為在特定處所經營金錢服務的例子。
正確：第4.8段訂明，如有其他業務與申請人在同一處所內經營，金錢服務業務必須設有明顯分隔，與其他業務清楚區分。
不正確：第4.8段的分隔規定適用於在同一處所經營的其他業務；關長不會接納與其他金錢服務經營者共用處所經營金錢服務業務。

en.q: Regarding the other requirements that the Licensing Guide sets for an applicant for, or a holder of, an MSO licence, which of the following are correct?
statements: An applicant must appoint a competent CO as the focal point for overseeing its AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, and an MLRO as the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions.
Where persons other than the sole proprietor, a partner, a director or an ultimate owner act as CO and MLRO, they must be the applicant's employees under the Employees' Compensation Ordinance.
The sole proprietor, or any one of the partners and directors, of an applicant or licensee must pass the Competence Assessment conducted by C&ED; the Guidance Notes on it give further details.

Any person carrying on business in Hong Kong must register it, and an applicant must hold a valid Business Registration Certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies before C&ED processes its application.
Applicants and licensees alike must have a valid Business Registration Certificate, and a licensee that does not have one is liable to have its licence suspended or revoked by the CCE.
notes: Correct: ¶4.15(a) requires an applicant to appoint a competent CO and an MLRO to act respectively as the focal point for the oversight of its AML/CFT systems and compliance measures and the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions.

Incorrect: ¶4.15(a) requires the CO and MLRO, except where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO and MLRO, to be the applicant's employee under the definition of the Employment Ordinance, Cap. 57.

Correct: ¶4.15(b) says the sole proprietor, any one of the partners and directors of an applicant or a licensee must pass a Competence Assessment conducted by C&ED, and refers applicants and licensees to the Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment for further details.

Incorrect: ¶4.15(c) requires business registration under the Business Registration Ordinance and a valid Business Registration Certificate issued by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue, otherwise the application for a licence will not be processed by C&ED.

Correct: ¶4.15(c) says an applicant or a licensee must have a valid Business Registration Certificate, otherwise, if a licence has been granted, the licence will be subject to suspension and/or revocation by the CCE.

tc.q: 關於《牌照指引》對金錢服務經營者牌照的申請人或持有人訂明的其他規定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 申請人須委任一名合資格的合規主任，作為監督其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度及合規措施的中心點，以及洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。
如由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人以外的人擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，他們必須為根據《僱員補償條例》所界定受聘於申請人的僱員。
申請人或持牌人的獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在由海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，詳情可參閱《金錢服務經營者適用的能力評核須知》。
任何在香港經營業務的人須登記其業務，而申請人必須持有由公司註冊處處長發出的有效商業登記證，海關才會處理其牌照申請。
申請人及持牌人均須持有有效商業登記證；如已批給牌照的持牌人沒有有效商業登記證，關長仍可暫時吊銷及／或撤銷其牌照。
notes: 正確：第4.15(a)段規定申請人須委任一名合資格的合規主任及洗錢報告主任，分別作為監督申請人的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度及合規措施的中心點，以及報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。
不正確：第4.15(a)段規定，除非申請人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，否則合規主任及洗錢報告主任必須為根據第57章《僱傭條例》所界定受聘於申請人的僱員。
正確：第4.15(b)段訂明申請人或持牌人的獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在由海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，並請申請人及持牌人參閱《金錢服務經營者適用的能力評核須知》了解詳情。
不正確：第4.15(c)段規定業務須根據《商業登記條例》登記，申請人必須持有由稅務局局長發出的有效商業登記證，否則海關將不會處理有關牌照申請。
正確：第4.15(c)段訂明申請人或持牌人必須持有有效商業登記證，否則即使已批給牌照，關長仍可暫時吊銷及／或撤銷有關牌照。

en.q: Regarding how an applicant applies for a licence to operate a money service, as the Licensing Guide describes it, which of the following are correct?
statements: Besides completing Form 1, the supplementary information sheet and the relevant annex, the applicant submits a Business Plan and its AML Policy.
The form, the supplementary information sheet and the annex may be completed in either English or Chinese, or in both if the case requires.
Together with the completed form, supplementary information sheet and annex, the applicant must submit to C&ED the originals of the requisite documents.
The completed application, with photocopies of the requisite documents, must be lodged by the applicant in person at the Money Service Supervision Bureau of C&ED.
The application form and the submission guidelines for the Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau or C&ED's website.
notes: Correct: ¶5.1 says an applicant needs to complete an application form (Form 1), supplementary information sheet and the relevant annex and submit a Business Plan and AML/CFT policies (the AML Policy).
Correct: ¶5.1 says the applicant may complete the form, supplementary information sheet and annex in either English or Chinese, or both if the case requires.

Incorrect: ¶5.1 requires the completed form, supplementary information sheet and annex to be submitted together with the photocopies of the requisite documents; the original documents are brought to the interview (¶5.4).
Incorrect: ¶5.1 allows the completed documents to be submitted by post or via C&ED's website or in person to the Money Service Supervision Bureau; lodging them in person is one of three ways.

Correct: ¶5.1 says the application form, annex, supplementary information sheet and guidelines for submission of Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Bureau's address or downloaded from C&ED's website.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於申請人如何申請經營金錢服務的牌照，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 申請人除填寫申請書（表格1）、補充資料表格及相關附件外，亦須遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。
申請人可用英文或中文填寫申請書、補充資料表格及附件，或在有需要時中英並用填寫。
填妥的申請書、補充資料表格及附件，必須連同所需文件的正本，一併遞交至香港海關辦理。
填妥的申請文件連同所需文件的複本，必須由申請人親自遞交至香港海關金錢服務監理科。
申請表格及有關遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策的指引，可在金錢服務監理科索取，或從海關網站下載。
notes: 正確：第5.1段訂明申請人須填寫申請書（表格1）、補充資料表格及相關附件，並遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策。
正確：第5.1段訂明申請人可用英文或中文或在有需要時中英並用填寫申請書、補充資料表格及附件。
不正確：第5.1段規定填妥的申請書、補充資料表格及附件須連同所需文件的複本遞交；文件的正本是在會面時帶同（第5.4段）。
不正確：第5.1段訂明申請可郵寄、經海關網站或親自遞交至金錢服務監理科；親自遞交只是三種方式之一。
正確：第5.1段訂明申請表格、附件、補充資料表格及有關遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策的指引可在上址索取或從海關的網址下載。

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following are correct about the Business Plan and the AML Policy that an applicant submits?
statements: The Business Plan should be a comprehensive overview of the business, with components including its detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customers, staffing and finance.
An applicant that intends to operate a money service without using a bank account is required to provide details of how its money service business is operated in that circumstance.
The AML Policy should set out the applicant's own policies, procedures and controls in its relevant operational areas with a view to eliminating the ML/TF risks it is exposed to.
For example, the AML Policy must elaborate the company's payment or settlement system for remittance transactions and its mechanism for sanction screening and screening of high-risk customers.
At the interview, the applicant is required to clarify and elaborate any information in the documents it submitted, such as its Business Plan and AML Policy.
notes: Correct: ¶5.2 says the Business Plan should be a comprehensive overview of the business, which includes but is not limited to detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customer, staffing and finance of the company.

Correct: ¶5.2 gives the example that, if an applicant intends to operate a money service without using bank account, the applicant is required to provide relevant details as to how its money service business is operated in this circumstance.

Incorrect: ¶5.2 says the AML Policy sets out the applicant's own policies, procedures and controls with a view to mitigating the ML/TF risks to which it is exposed and fulfilling the relevant statutory and regulatory requirements, not eliminating those risks.

Correct: ¶5.2 gives, as an example for the AML Policy, that an applicant is required to elaborate the company's payment/settlement system for remittance transactions, and the company's mechanism for sanction screening and screening of high-risk customers.

Correct: ¶5.4 says that at the interview the applicant will be required to clarify and elaborate any information of the submitted documents in relation to the licence application, e.g. its Business Plan and AML Policy provided for the application.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於申請人遞交的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 業務計劃應綜合概述業務，內容項目包括但不限於公司的詳細運作模式、組織架構、支付系統、客戶對象、職員編制及財政。
如申請人擬不使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務，便須就如何在此情況下經營金錢服務業務提供相關細節。
打擊洗錢政策應載列申請人就本身相關經營領域而制訂的政策、程序及管控措施，以消除申請人面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
舉例來說，申請人須在打擊洗錢政策闡述公司執行匯款交易時使用的支付／結算系統，以及公司篩查制裁名單及篩查高風險客戶的機制。
會面時，申請人須就所遞交文件的資料作出澄清及闡述，例如為申請而提交的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。
notes: 正確：第5.2段訂明業務計劃應綜合概述業務，內容項目包括但不限於有關公司的詳細運作模式、組織架構、支付系統、客戶對象、職員編制及財政。
正確：第5.2段舉例指出，如申請人擬不使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務，申請人便須就如何在此情況下經營金錢服務業務提供相關細節。
不正確：第5.2段訂明打擊洗錢政策所載的政策、程序及管控措施，是要減低申請人面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並符合相關法定及監管規定，並非消除風險。
正確：第5.2段就打擊洗錢政策舉例指出，申請人須闡述公司執行匯款交易時使用的支付／結算系統，以及公司篩查制裁名單及篩查高風險客戶的機制。
正確：第5.4段訂明申請人須在會面時就牌照申請所遞交文件的資料作出澄清及闡述，例如為申請而提交的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。

en.q: Regarding how C&ED processes an application for the grant of a licence, including the interview, which of the following are correct according to the Licensing Guide?
statements: On receipt of a licence application, the applicant is given an acknowledgment receipt, and a reminder for any outstanding documents is issued where necessary.
Together with the notice for an interview, the applicant receives an invitation letter for nominating its sole proprietor, partners or directors to attend the Assessment.
At the interview the original documents are verified, and the applicant is required to sign the application for an MSO licence in the presence of a Justice of the Peace.
The applicant is briefed on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements applicable to MSOs, so that it can fully understand and fulfil a licensee's obligations.
Where the applicant is a partnership, a staff member of the applicant may attend the interview if any one of the partners has authorized the staff member in writing.
The processing time may vary with factors including on-site inspection at the business premises and obtaining records from other authorities for the fit and proper person test.
notes: Correct: ¶5.4 says that on receipt of a licence application by C&ED, an applicant will have an acknowledgment receipt, and a reminder for provision of any outstanding documents will be issued where necessary.

Correct: ¶5.4 says that when all the requisite documents are submitted, the applicant will receive a notice for an interview together with, among other things, an invitation letter for nominating the eligible persons, i.e. the sole proprietor, partners or directors, to attend the Assessment.

Incorrect: ¶5.4 says that during the interview the original documents and the payment record will be verified, and the applicant will be required to sign on the application for an MSO licence in the presence of the C&ED officers.

Correct: ¶5.4 says that, with a view to ensuring that the applicant can fully understand and fulfil the obligations of an MSO licensee, the applicant will be briefed on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements applicable to MSOs.
Incorrect: ¶5.5(b) requires a staff member attending for a partnership to be authorized in writing by every partner, not by any one of them.

Correct: ¶5.6 says the processing time may vary and depend on various factors including on-site inspection at the business premises and the time required in obtaining records from other authorities to perform a fit and proper person test.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於海關如何處理批給牌照的申請（包括會面），下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 海關收到牌照申請書後，會向申請人發出確認收到申請書通知，並在有需要時發信催交尚欠文件。
申請人收到會面通知時，亦會收到信件邀請提名其獨資經營者、合夥人或董事應考能力評核。
在會面時，海關人員會查驗文件的正本，而申請人須於太平紳士面前在金錢服務經營者牌照申請書上簽署。
人員會向申請人簡介金錢服務經營者適用的法定發牌及合規規定，確保其全面了解及符合持牌人的規定。
如申請人屬合夥業務，申請人的員工如已獲任何一名合夥人以書面授權，即可代表申請人出席會面。
處理時間的長短，視乎在業務處所進行實地視察、為判定適當人選向其他機構索取紀錄所需的時間等因素。
notes: 正確：第5.4段訂明海關收到牌照申請書後，會向申請人發出確認收到申請書通知，並在有需要時向申請人發信催交尚欠文件。
正確：第5.4段訂明申請人遞交全部所需文件後，便會收到會面通知，並會收到信件邀請提名合資格人士（即申請人的獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）應考能力評核。
不正確：第5.4段訂明本署人員會在會面時查驗文件的正本及繳費紀錄，而申請人須在海關人員面前於金錢服務經營者牌照申請書上簽署。
正確：第5.4段訂明，為確保申請人全面了解及符合金錢服務經營者持牌人的規定，人員會向申請人簡介適用於金錢服務經營者的法定發牌及合規規定。
不正確：第5.5(b)段規定，如申請人屬合夥業務，出席會面的員工須獲每一名合夥人以書面授權，並非任何一名合夥人。
正確：第5.6段訂明處理時間會因各種因素而有所差異，包括在業務處所進行實地視察，以及為判定適當人選向其他機構索取紀錄所需的時間。

en.q: Regarding the application for the fit and proper person test and how it is processed, which of the following are correct according to the Licensing Guide?
statements: Where the applicant is a corporation, each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation is required to apply for the fit and proper person test.
An individual completes Form 3A with Appendices I and II and a corporation completes Form 3B, and the form is submitted to C&ED with supporting documents.
Appendix I to Form 3A must be signed before a witness who is an authorized officer of C&ED, a practising professional, a notary public or a Justice of the Peace.
The witness must check the particulars stated in Appendix I against the original, or a certified copy, of the declarant's identity documents.
The CCE's checks on a declaration form include vetting the details against information held by C&ED and by other government and law enforcement agencies.
The fee paid for the fit and proper person test is non-refundable, so it is not returned to the applicant even if the CCE later refuses the licence.
notes: Correct: ¶5.7 requires, where the applicant is a corporation, each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation to be associated with the business of operating a money service to apply for the fit and proper person test.

Correct: ¶5.8 says the applicant needs to complete a Fit and Proper Person Declaration Form, Form 3A with Appendices I and II for an individual and Form 3B for a corporation, and submit it together with supporting documents to C&ED.

Correct: ¶5.8 says the declarant has to sign Appendix I in the presence of a witness who is an authorized officer of the C&ED, a practising professional (e.g. solicitor, accountant, auditor), a notary public or a Justice of the Peace.
Incorrect: ¶5.8 says the witness shall check the personal particulars stated in Appendix I against the original identity documents of the declarant; a copy, certified or not, is not mentioned.

Correct: ¶5.9 says the CCE will undertake a number of checks to confirm the accuracy of the information provided, including vetting details against information held by this department, other government and law enforcement agencies.
Correct: ¶4.14 says the fee paid for the fit and proper person test is non-refundable.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於申請進行適當人選判定及有關申請的處理，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如申請人屬法團，則法團的每名董事以及每名最終擁有人，均須申請進行適當人選判定。
個人須填寫表格3A連同附錄I及II，法團則須填寫表格3B，並須將表格連同證明文件呈交海關。
表格3A的附錄I須在見證人在場下簽署，見證人包括海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士、公證人或太平紳士。
見證人須將附錄I內載列的個人資料，與聲明人的身份證明文件的正本或核證副本互相核對。
關長就適當人選聲明表格進行的查驗，包括將資料與海關、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對。
為判定適當人選而繳交的費用屬不可退還，即使關長其後拒絕批給牌照，費用亦不會退回。
notes: 正確：第5.7段訂明，如申請人屬法團，法團的每名董事，以及與經營金錢服務業務有關連的法團的每名最終擁有人，均須申請進行適當人選判定。
正確：第5.8段訂明申請人需要填寫適當人選聲明表格（適用於個人的表格3A連同附錄I及II，及適用於法團的表格3B），並須將表格連同證明文件呈交海關。
正確：第5.8段訂明聲明人須在見證人在場情況下簽署附錄I，見證人包括海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士（例如事務律師、會計師、核數師）、公證人或太平紳士。
不正確：第5.8段訂明見證人須將附錄I內載列的個人資料與聲明人的身份證明文件的正本互相核對；並無提及副本。
正確：第5.9段訂明關長會進行多次查驗，以證實所獲提供的資料的準確程度，查驗包括將資料與本署、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對。
正確：第4.14段訂明為判定適當人選而繳交的費用不會退回。

en.q: Which of the following does the Licensing Guide give as examples of situations in which the CCE may refuse to grant a licence to an applicant?
statements: The applicant fails to provide a Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the relevant guidelines promulgated by C&ED
The applicant appoints one person to act both as its Compliance Officer and as its Money Laundering Reporting Officer
The applicant fails to appoint a competent Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer
The applicant's Business Plan projects that its money service business will make a loss in its first year
The application for the grant of a licence that the applicant submits to C&ED is incomplete or invalid
Any one member of the applicant's senior management fails the Competence Assessment designated by C&ED
notes: Correct: ¶5.10(f) lists an applicant failing to provide Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the relevant guidelines promulgated by C&ED.

Incorrect: none of the examples in ¶5.10 is one person holding both posts; what ¶5.10(g) gives is a failure to appoint a competent CO or MLRO, and ¶4.15(a) itself provides for a sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner who is also the CO and MLRO.
Correct: ¶5.10(g) lists an applicant failing to appoint a competent CO or MLRO.

Incorrect: the examples in ¶5.10, from (a) to (k), do not include a Business Plan that projects a loss; what (f) gives is a failure to provide the Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the guidelines.
Correct: ¶5.10(h) lists an applicant submitting an incomplete or invalid application.

Incorrect: ¶5.10(j) gives the situation where none of the senior management of an applicant, i.e. the sole proprietor, partner or director, passes the Assessment designated by C&ED; one member failing while another passes is not that situation.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》舉出下列哪些情況，作為關長可能拒絕向申請人批給牌照的例子？
statements: 申請人未能根據海關頒布的相關指引提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策
申請人委任同一人同時擔任其合規主任及其洗錢報告主任
申請人未能為其業務委任合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任
申請人的業務計劃預計其金錢服務業務在首年會出現虧損
申請人就批給牌照向海關遞交的申請並不完整或屬無效
申請人的高級管理層中任何一名成員在海關指定的能力評核中失敗
notes: 正確：第5.10(f)段列出申請人未能根據海關頒布的相關指引提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。
不正確：第5.10段所舉例子並不包括由同一人兼任兩職；第5.10(g)段所指的是未能委任合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任，而第4.15(a)段本身亦訂明獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人可同時擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任的情況。
正確：第5.10(g)段列出申請人未能委任合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任。
不正確：第5.10(a)至(k)段所舉例子並不包括業務計劃預計虧損；(f)段所指的是未能根據相關指引提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。
正確：第5.10(h)段列出申請人遞交的申請不完整或無效。
不正確：第5.10(j)段所指的是申請人的高級管理層（即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）中沒有成員於海關指定的能力評核取得合格成績；一名成員失敗而另有成員合格，並不屬此情況。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1段

en.q: Regarding the revocation and suspension of an MSO licence, as the Licensing Guide describes them, which of the following are correct?
statements: The circumstances the Guide lists in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence are examples only, and the list is not exhaustive.
The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence whose holding fails to fulfil its purpose of providing a money service, for example where the licensee has never provided one.
The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee's LPS falls foul of the requirements set out in the Licensing Guide.
A licensee's failure to appoint, or to maintain, a competent Compliance Officer or MLRO is one of the examples given for revocation or suspension.
The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee fails to comply with any requirement under the AMLO, including those in Part 5.
A licensee's failure to submit a periodic return on time is another of the examples in which the CCE may revoke or suspend its licence.
notes: Correct: ¶7.1 introduces its circumstances as a non-exhaustive list of examples in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence.

Correct: ¶7.1(g) lists a licensee's holding of the licence failing to fulfil the purpose (i.e. provision of money service) for which it was issued, an example being that a money service has never been provided by the licensee.
Correct: ¶7.1(d) lists the licensee failing to maintain an LPS or the LPS falling foul of the requirements set out in the licensing guide.
Correct: ¶7.1(i) lists a licensee failing to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO.
Correct: ¶7.1(h) lists a licensee failing to comply with any requirements provided under the AMLO, including requirements stipulated in Part 5 of the AMLO.
Correct: ¶7.1(f) lists, among the examples in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence, where a licensee fails to submit a periodic return on time.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，關於撤銷及暫時吊銷金錢服務經營者牌照，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 《牌照指引》所列關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的情況只屬例子，並非詳盡無遺。
如持牌人持有牌照而未能符合提供金錢服務的發牌目的，例如從未提供金錢服務，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。
如持牌人的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點未能符合《牌照指引》所載的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。
持牌人未能委任或維持具備合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任，是可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的例子之一。
如持牌人未能遵從條例所訂的任何規定，包括條例第5部訂明的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。
持牌人未能按時遞交定期申報表，亦屬關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照的例子之一。
notes: 正確：第7.1段指出所列的是關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的例子，並非詳盡無遺。
正確：第7.1(g)段列出持牌人持有牌照而未能符合發牌目的（即提供金錢服務），例如持牌人從未提供金錢服務。
正確：第7.1(d)段列出持牌人未能維持本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，或本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點未能符合本牌照指引所載的規定。
正確：第7.1(i)段列出持牌人未能委任或維持具備合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任。
正確：第7.1(h)段列出持牌人未能遵從條例所訂的任何規定，包括條例第5部訂明的規定。
正確：第7.1(f)段把持牌人未能按時遞交定期申報表，列為關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的例子之一。

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following are among the obligations of an MSO licensee?
statements: A licensee must comply with all the applicable provisions of the AMLO and the guidelines issued by the CCE, and must report on suspicious transactions.
A licensee must develop an AML Policy that is effective in mitigating ML/TF risks, and must also maintain that policy.
A licensee operating without particular premises must ensure that its local management office can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.
A licensee must submit its periodic return to the CCE in a timely manner, and must use the form that the CCE specifies for it.
A licensee must give notice of its appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as the AML Guideline requires, by way of supplementary information forms.
notes: Correct: ¶11.1 says a licensee is obliged to comply with all the applicable provisions of the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE, and its item (a) is that a licensee must report on suspicious transactions.
Correct: ¶11.1(b) says a licensee must develop and maintain an effective AML Policy to mitigate ML/TF risks.

Correct: ¶11.1(g) says that where a licensee operates a money service without particular premises, it must maintain an LMO and ensure the LMO can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.
Correct: ¶11.1(i) says a licensee must submit periodic return to the CCE in the form specified by the CCE in a timely manner.
Correct: ¶11.3 explains the supplementary information forms: a licensee is required to notify the C&ED of the appointment of a CO and an MLRO as required by the AML Guideline.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪些屬金錢服務經營者持牌人的責任？
statements: 持牌人務必遵從條例的所有適用條文及關長發出的指引，並必須報告可疑交易。
持牌人必須制訂有效的打擊洗錢政策以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並維持該政策。
如持牌人在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，必須確保本地管理辦事處可作為與海關溝通的聯絡點。
持牌人必須按時向關長遞交定期申報表，而申報表須採用關長指明的格式。
持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定遞交補充資料表格，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事作出具報。
notes: 正確：第11.1段訂明持牌人務必遵從條例的所有適用條文及關長發出的指引，其(a)項亦訂明持牌人必須報告可疑交易。
正確：第11.1(b)段訂明持牌人必須制訂並維持有效的打擊洗錢政策，以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
正確：第11.1(g)段訂明，如持牌人在沒有特定處所的情況下經營金錢服務，持牌人必須維持本地管理辦事處，並確保本地管理辦事處可以作為與海關溝通的聯絡點。
正確：第11.1(i)段訂明持牌人必須按時以關長指明的格式向關長遞交定期申報表。
正確：第11.3段解釋補充資料表格的用途：持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事向關長具報。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶16.1–16.3 (checklist of supporting documents, item 2)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第16.1至16.3段（證明文件核對清單第2項）

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide's checklist of supporting documents, which of the following are correct about the documents an applicant submits for its premises?
statements: For each premises used for operating a money service, a copy of the stamped tenancy agreement or record of ownership and a floor plan are required.
Copies of consent letters from every occupant of the premises are required for each of the premises that the applicant uses for operating a money service.
The documents for a local management office include a copy of a valid Business Registration Certificate, which the LPS documents do not include.
For premises used for operating a money service, a copy of the landlord's letter permitting the premises to be used for money service business is required.
The supporting documents are stamped with the applicant's company chop and submitted with the completed Form 1 or 2, annex and supplementary information sheet.
The list is not exhaustive, and C&ED may require other supporting documents to determine the applicant's fitness and propriety and the suitability of the premises.
notes: Correct: item 2 of the checklist in ¶16.3 lists, for premises used for the operation of a money service, a copy of stamped tenancy agreement or record of ownership of the premises and a floor plan of the premises.
Incorrect: the checklist asks for copies of consent letters from every occupant of the premises for mixed commercial and residential premises only.

Correct: the checklist lists a copy of valid Business Registration Certificate among the documents for the local management office; the documents listed for the local place for storage of books and records do not include it.

Correct: the checklist lists, for premises used for the operation of a money service, a copy of letter issued by the landlord to the applicant permitting the premises to be used for money service business.

Correct: ¶16.1 requires the applicant to submit the documents, stamped with the applicant's company chop, together with the completed application form, i.e. Form 1 or 2, annex and supplementary information sheet.

Correct: ¶16.2 says the list is not exhaustive and, with a view to determining the fitness and propriety of the applicant and the suitability of the premises, C&ED may require the applicant to produce other supporting documents.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》的證明文件核對清單，關於申請人須就其處所遞交的文件，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 每一個用作經營金錢服務的處所，均須遞交該處所的已加蓋釐印租約或業權紀錄的複本及平面圖。
每一個用作經營金錢服務的處所，均須遞交由處所內每一名佔用人發出的同意書的複本。
本地管理辦事處須遞交的文件包括有效商業登記證的複本，本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點的文件則不包括這一項。
用作經營金錢服務的處所，須遞交由業主發出容許將該處所用作經營金錢服務的同意書複本。
證明文件須蓋上申請人的公司印章，並連同已填妥的表格1或2、附件及補充資料表格一併遞交。
所列文件並非詳盡無遺，海關可要求申請人出示其他證明文件，以斷定申請人是否屬適當人選及處所是否適合。
notes: 正確：第16.3段核對清單第2項就用作經營金錢服務的處所列出該處所的已加蓋釐印租約或業權紀錄的複本及該處所的平面圖。
不正確：核對清單只要求混合商業及住宅處所遞交處所內每一名佔用人的同意書的複本。
正確：核對清單把有效商業登記證的複本列為本地管理辦事處須遞交的文件之一；本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點所列的文件並不包括此項。
正確：核對清單就用作經營金錢服務的處所列出由業主發出容許將該處所用作經營金錢服務的同意書複本。
正確：第16.1段規定申請人須連同已填妥的申請表格（即表格1或2）、附件及補充資料表格遞交有關文件，文件須蓋上申請人的公司印章。
正確：第16.2段訂明所列並非詳盡無遺，當海關斷定申請人是否屬適當人選及處所是否適合時，可要求申請人出示其他證明文件。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶16.3 (checklist of supporting documents, items 1, 3, 5 and 6)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第16.3段（證明文件核對清單第1、3、5及6項）

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide's checklist of supporting documents, which of the following must an applicant submit?
statements: For each individual director who is not a Hong Kong resident, a completed Form 3A with Appendices I and II and a copy of the bio-data page of the travel document
For the CO and the MLRO, a copy of residential address proof, such as a utility bill or a bank statement, issued within the last six months from the application date
A copy of the agreement or contract with each local and/or foreign third party that is involved in the process of the money service
For a local company applicant, a copy of every annual return it has filed with the Companies Registry since incorporation
An acknowledgement from the bank that the bank account held by the applicant is used for operating the money service business
A copy of the authorization letter signed by all partners where the applicant is a partnership, or by the board of directors where it is a corporation
notes: Correct: item 3 of the checklist lists, for each individual partner, director or ultimate owner who is a non-Hong Kong resident, a completed Form 3A together with Appendices I and II and a copy of the bio-data page of the travel document.
Incorrect: item 6 of the checklist asks for residential address proof of the CO and MLRO, e.g. utility bills or a bank statement, issued within the last three months from the application date.
Correct: item 6 of the checklist lists a copy of agreement or contract with each local and/or foreign third party involved in the process of money service.

Incorrect: item 1 of the checklist asks a local company for a copy of the latest Annual Return (Form NAR1) and all documents filed with the Companies Registry after filing of the latest Annual Return, not every annual return since incorporation.
Correct: item 6 of the checklist lists an acknowledgement from bank that the bank account held by the applicant is used for operating money service business.

Correct: item 5 of the checklist lists, for a partner, a copy of the authorization letter signed by all partners and, for a corporation, a copy of the authorization letter signed by the Board of Directors.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》的證明文件核對清單，申請人須遞交下列哪些文件？
statements: 每名非香港居民個人董事已填妥的表格3A（連同附錄I及II）及其旅遊證件的個人資料頁的複本
合規主任及洗錢報告主任在申請日期前六個月內發出的住址證明（例如銀行結單）的複本
與參與經營金錢服務的本地及／或外地第三方簽訂的協議／合約複本
如申請人屬本地公司，其自成立以來向公司註冊處存檔的每一份周年申報表的複本
確認由申請人持有的銀行帳戶是用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行確認書
如申請人屬合夥，經所有合夥人簽署的授權書複本；如屬法團，則為經董事局簽署的授權書複本
notes: 正確：核對清單第3項就每一名屬非香港居民的（個人）合夥人、董事或最終擁有人列出已填妥的適當人選聲明表格3A連同附錄I及II，以及旅遊證件的個人資料頁的複本。
不正確：核對清單第6項要求合規主任及洗錢報告主任的住址證明複本，例如在申請日期前三個月內發出的水、電、煤氣費用帳單或銀行結單。
正確：核對清單第6項列出與參與經營金錢服務的本地及／或外地第三方簽訂的協議／合約複本。
不正確：核對清單第1項要求本地公司遞交最近的周年申報表（表格NAR1）及在遞交最近的周年申報表後存檔於公司註冊處的所有文件的複本，並非自成立以來的每一份周年申報表。
正確：核對清單第6項列出確認由申請人持有的銀行帳戶是用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行確認書。
正確：核對清單第5項就合夥人列出經所有合夥人簽署的授權書複本，就法團則列出經董事局簽署的授權書複本。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶1.1, ¶1.2, ¶3.1, ¶12.5 and ¶14.1

en.q: Regarding the purpose of the Competence Assessment and of its Guidance Notes, and what an Assessment result means for a licence, which of the following are correct?
statements: The Assessment aims at ensuring that the compliance officer of a licensed MSO has a fundamental knowledge and clear understanding of AML/CFT to duly oversee its AML/CFT systems.
According to the Guidance Notes, the Assessment helps to raise compliance standards across the MSO sector and to safeguard the integrity of the AML/CFT regime the AMLO establishes.
In the evaluation of overall fit and proper status, the Assessment result carries a substantial weighting, and it is one of the factors the CCE has regard to in considering a grant or renewal.
An invitation to the Assessment does not imply that the candidate has fully met the licensing requirements, as the vetting process is still in progress.
A pass in the Assessment does not necessarily make an applicant eligible for a licence; for the grant, the licensing requirements in the AMLO and the Licensing Guide must also be met.
The Guidance Notes aim to give candidates more information on the Assessment, especially on its examination format and its criteria, so that they can better prepare for it.
notes: Incorrect: ¶1.1 says the Assessment aims at ensuring that the senior management of a licensed MSO has that fundamental knowledge and clear understanding; it does not name the compliance officer.
Correct: ¶1.1 says the Assessment is conducive to uplifting the compliance level of the MSO sector and safeguarding the integrity of the AML/CFT regime under the AMLO.

Correct: ¶3.1 says the result of the Assessment will constitute a substantial weighting in the evaluation of the overall F&P person status and thus be one of the factors that the CCE will have regard to in considering the grant or renewal of an MSO licence.
Correct: ¶14.1 says the invitation to the Assessment does not imply that a candidate has fully met the licensing requirements as the vetting process is still in progress.

Correct: ¶12.5 says a pass in the Assessment does not necessarily mean that you are eligible for a licence, and that for granting a licence applicants are also required to meet the licensing requirements stipulated in the AMLO and the licensing guide promulgated by the C&ED.

Correct: ¶1.2 says the purpose of the Guidance Notes is to provide candidates with more information with respect to the Assessment, especially on the examination format as well as the Assessment criteria, so that candidates can better prepare for the Assessment.

tc.q: 根據《能力評核須知》，關於能力評核及《須知》的目的，以及能力評核成績對牌照的意義，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 能力評核旨在確保持牌金錢服務經營者的合規主任對打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集具備基本知識並清楚了解，以便妥為監督有關制度。
《須知》指能力評核有助提升金錢服務業整體的合規水平，亦可捍衛按《打擊洗錢條例》建立的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
在評定整體的適當人選資格時，能力評核的成績會佔相當比重，屬關長考慮批給牌照或將牌照續期時會顧及的因素之一。
鑑於牌照的審批程序仍在進行中，即使應考者已獲邀應考能力評核，亦不代表其已完全符合各項發牌規定。
即使在能力評核取得合格成績，亦不代表合資格取得牌照；申請人要獲批給牌照，必須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及《牌照指引》訂明的規定。
《須知》旨在向應考者提供更多有關能力評核的資料，尤其是考試形式及能力評核準則方面，讓應考者為考試作好準備。
notes: 不正確：第1.1段訂明能力評核的目的是要確保持牌金錢服務經營者的高級管理層具備這方面的基本知識並清楚了解，並非合規主任。
正確：第1.1段訂明能力評核有助提高金錢服務業的合規水平，並可捍衛根據《打擊洗錢條例》建立的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
正確：第3.1段訂明在評定整體的適當人選資格時，能力評核的成績會佔相當比重，因而屬於關長考慮是否批給金錢服務經營者牌照或將牌照續期時會顧及的因素之一。
正確：第14.1段訂明，鑑於審批程序仍在進行中，即使應考者獲邀應考能力評核，亦不代表其已完全符合發牌規定。
正確：第12.5段訂明即使在能力評核取得合格成績，亦不代表合資格取得牌照；申請人要獲批給牌照，必須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及海關頒布的《牌照指引》訂明的規定。
正確：第1.2段訂明本《須知》旨在向應考者提供更多有關能力評核的資料，尤其是有關考試形式及能力評核準則方面，讓應考者為考試作好準備。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.2 and ¶6.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.2及6.1段

en.q: Regarding the modules of the Competence Assessment and the materials on which its questions are mainly set, which of the following are correct according to the Guidance Notes?
statements: One of the seven modules of the Assessment covers general knowledge on AML/CFT and on counter proliferation financing.
Parts 1 to 7 of the AMLO are covered by one module of the Assessment, and the Schedules to the AMLO by a separate module.
In the Assessment, the module on MSO's systems and controls (iii) covers the institutional governance and strategy of an MSO.
The Licensing Guide and the guidelines and circulars that the C&ED issues to MSOs are among the materials on which the questions are mainly set.
Each of the seven modules, including the one on guidelines promulgated by the C&ED, consists of five multiple-choice questions.
notes: Correct: ¶5.2 lists general knowledge on AML/CFT and Counter Proliferation Financing as the first of the seven modules.
Correct: ¶5.2 lists Part 1-7 of the AMLO and the Schedules to the AMLO as two of the seven modules, the second and the third.
Incorrect: in ¶5.2, MSO's systems and controls (iii) is demonstrating and monitoring compliance; institutional governance and strategy is MSO's systems and controls (i).

Correct: ¶6.1 lists the Licensing Guide issued by C&ED to MSOs, guidelines issued by C&ED to MSOs and circulars issued by C&ED to MSOs among the publicly available materials on which all the multiple-choice questions are set mainly based, with the AMLO and the AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs.
Correct: ¶5.2 says the Assessment is composed of seven modules and each module consists of five multiple-choice questions; guidelines promulgated by the C&ED make up the fourth module.

tc.q: 根據《能力評核須知》，關於能力評核的單元及其選擇題大致取材的資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在能力評核的七個單元中，其中一個單元涵蓋有關打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集與打擊擴散資金籌集的常識。
在能力評核中，《打擊洗錢條例》第1至7部屬一個單元，而《打擊洗錢條例》的附表則另屬一個單元。
在能力評核中，金錢服務經營者的系統及管控措施(iii)單元涵蓋機構層面的管治及策略。
海關向金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》、各類指引及通函，均屬選擇題大致取材的公開資料。
能力評核的7個單元中，包括海關頒布的指引在內，每一個單元各由5條選擇題組成。
notes: 正確：第5.2段把有關打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集與打擊擴散資金籌集的常識列為七個單元的第一個。
正確：第5.2段把《打擊洗錢條例》第1至7部及《打擊洗錢條例》的附表列為七個單元中的兩個，即第二及第三個單元。
不正確：根據第5.2段，金錢服務經營者的系統及管控措施(iii)是證明符合規定及監察合規水平；機構層面的管治及策略屬系統及管控措施(i)。
正確：第6.1段把海關向金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》、各類指引及通函，連同《打擊洗錢條例》及海關頒布的《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引(金錢服務經營者適用)》，列為能力評核選擇題大致取材的公開資料。
正確：第5.2段訂明能力評核分為7個單元，每個單元有5條選擇題；海關頒布的指引屬第四個單元。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.1, ¶10.4–10.7 and ¶10.9

en.q: Regarding the rules that candidates must follow at the Competence Assessment centre, which of the following are correct according to the Guidance Notes?
statements: A candidate who violates the rules or acts dishonestly during the Assessment is liable to be disqualified, and may also be asked to leave the centre immediately.
Where the invigilator has any doubt on a candidate's identity, the invigilator may copy the identification document at the centre for further verification when required.
A candidate may take an unused question book or answer sheet away from the Assessment centre, but must leave behind any that has been used.
Mobile phones, other electronic devices or articles that can emit sound must be switched off throughout the examination.
Candidates must bring with them to the Assessment centre the stationery they will need for marking the multiple-choice answer sheet.
Answers not written on the multiple-choice answer sheet will not be marked, and nothing may be copied from the question book onto the invitation letter.
notes: Correct: ¶10.1 says anyone who violates the rules or acts dishonestly in any way during the Assessment is liable to be disqualified, and may also be requested to leave the Assessment centre immediately.
Correct: ¶10.4 says that in case of any doubt on your identity, the invigilator may make copies of your identification document at the Assessment centre for further verification as and when required.
Incorrect: ¶10.6 says candidates are strictly forbidden to take away any question book or answer sheet, whether used or unused, out of the Assessment centre.
Correct: ¶10.7 says mobile phones, other electronic devices or articles that can emit sound must be switched off throughout the examination.
Incorrect: ¶10.5 says stationery will be provided at the Assessment centre.

Correct: ¶10.9 says answers not written on the multiple-choice answer sheet will not be marked, and that you must not copy anything from the question book onto the invitation letter, your personal belongings or parts of your body.

tc.q: 根據《能力評核須知》，關於應考者在能力評核試場須遵守的規則，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 應試者如違反規定或以不誠實的行為應考，可被取消考試資格，亦可能被要求立即離開能力評核試場。
如監考員對應試者的身份有懷疑，可於試場複印其身份證明文件，以便在有需要時作進一步核實。
應考者可把未曾使用的問卷或答題紙攜離試場，但已使用的問卷或答題紙則須留在試場。
在整個考試過程中，考生必須關掉手提電話、其他電子裝置或任何備有發聲功能的物品。
應考者須自行準備並攜帶在選擇題答題紙上作答所需的文具，前往能力評核試場應考。
寫在選擇題答題紙以外位置的答案將不獲評分，而應考者亦不可將問卷的任何內容抄寫在邀請信上。
notes: 正確：第10.1段訂明如應試者違反規定，或以不誠實的行為應考，可被取消考試資格，並可能被要求立即離開能力評核試場。
正確：第10.4段訂明如監考員對應試者的身份有懷疑，可於試場複印身份證明文件，以便在有需要時作進一步核實。
不正確：第10.6段訂明任何問卷或答題紙，不論是否曾經使用，均嚴禁攜離試場。
正確：第10.7段訂明在整個考試過程中，考生必須關掉手提電話、其他電子裝置或任何備有發聲功能的物品。
不正確：第10.5段訂明試場備有文具供應。
正確：第10.9段訂明寫在選擇題答題紙以外位置的答案將不獲評分，而應考者不可將問卷的任何內容抄寫在邀請信及／或個人物品或身上。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶13.1 and ¶14.2–14.5

en.q: Regarding the severe weather arrangements for the Competence Assessment and the other matters the Guidance Notes set out, which of the following are correct?
statements: As a general rule, the Assessment is held as scheduled when typhoon signal No. 3 or lower, or the Amber or Red rainstorm signal, is issued by the Hong Kong Observatory.
If typhoon signal No. 8 or above, or the Black rainstorm warning, is still hoisted at or after 7:00 a.m. on the scheduled date, the Assessment will be suspended.
Alternative arrangements, if any, will be published on the website of the MSO Licensing System on the first working day that follows.
Where the C&ED requires changes to the Assessment arrangements, candidates will be informed by email before the Assessment as soon as practicable.
The C&ED may require candidates, as appropriate, to produce medical proof confirming their disabilities in order to make suitable arrangements for them.
Candidates should not, without permission, enter any area of the centre not open to them, and in any dispute the decision of the C&ED is final and conclusive.
notes: Correct: ¶13.1 says that, as a general rule, the Assessment will be held as scheduled when typhoon signal No. 3 or lower, and/or rainstorm signal Amber or Red, is issued by the Hong Kong Observatory.

Incorrect: ¶13.1 sets the time at 8:00 a.m.: the Assessment will be suspended if typhoon signal No. 8 or above, and/or rainstorm warning Black, is still hoisted at or after 8:00 a.m. on the scheduled date.
Correct: ¶13.1 says alternative arrangements, if any, will be published on the website of Money Service Operators Licensing System on the first working day that follows.
Correct: ¶14.2 says that where changes to the Assessment arrangements are required by C&ED, candidates will be informed by email before the Assessment as soon as practicable.

Correct: ¶14.3 says that, as regards the facilitating arrangements for persons with disabilities, the C&ED may require, as appropriate, the candidates to produce medical proof to confirm their disabilities in order to make suitable arrangements.

Correct: ¶14.4 says you should not, without permission, enter the offices, classrooms or any area in the Assessment centre not open to candidates, and ¶14.5 says that in case of any dispute the decision made by the C&ED shall be final and conclusive.

tc.q: 關於能力評核在惡劣天氣下的安排及《能力評核須知》所載的其他事項，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 一般而言，如天文台發出三號或以下的熱帶氣旋信號，或「黃色」或「紅色」暴雨警告信號，考試會如期舉行。
如八號或以上的熱帶氣旋信號或「黑色」暴雨警告信號於考試當日上午7時或之後仍然生效，能力評核會改期。
如因惡劣天氣而需另作安排，金錢服務經營者牌照系統網頁將於隨後首個工作日公布有關安排。
如海關須更改能力評核的安排，海關將於能力評核舉行前盡快以電郵通知應考者有關更改。
海關或會在有需要時要求應考者出示醫學證明，以便在確定其殘疾情況後作出適當的應考安排。
未經准許，應考者不應進入試場內沒有向應考者開放的範圍；如有任何爭議，一概以海關的最終決定為準。
notes: 正確：第13.1段訂明一般而言，如香港天文台發出三號或以下的熱帶氣旋、「黃色」或「紅色」暴雨警告信號時，考試會如期舉行。
不正確：第13.1段訂明的時間是上午8時：如八號或以上的熱帶氣旋及／或「黑色」暴雨警告信號於預約考試日期當日上午8時或之後仍然生效，能力評核才會改期。
正確：第13.1段訂明如需另作安排，金錢服務經營者牌照系統網頁將於隨後首個工作日公布有關安排。
正確：第14.2段訂明如海關須更改能力評核的安排，將於能力評核舉行前盡快以電郵通知應考者。
正確：第14.3段訂明，有關便利殘疾人士應考能力評核的安排，海關或會在有需要時要求應考者出示醫學證明，以便在確定殘疾情況後作出適當安排。
正確：第14.4段訂明除非獲得准許，否則應考者不應進入辦事處、課室或試場內沒有向應考者開放的任何範圍；第14.5段訂明如有任何爭議，一概以海關的最終決定為準。

source.en: F&P Guideline (Apr 2018) ¶4, ¶5(e), ¶7 and ¶8; Supplementary F&P Guideline (Jan 2020) opening paragraphs, ¶7, ¶8 and ¶9
source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第4、5(e)、7及8段；《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）開首段落及第7、8及9段

en.q: Regarding the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (the F&P Guideline, April 2018) and the Supplementary F&P Guideline (January 2020), which of the following are correct?
statements: The F&P Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence, and is applicable both to the applicant for a licence and to the person who will hold the licence.
One of the F&P Guideline's factors is whether a person has been convicted of a criminal offence other than those listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO.
The Supplementary F&P Guideline must be read in conjunction with the F&P Guideline for determining whether an applicant or a licensee is fit and proper.
Under the Supplementary F&P Guideline, the CCE may still be satisfied that a person who fails to comply with one of its individual elements is fit and proper.
Each of the two guidelines describes itself as binding on applicants for a licence and on licensees, rather than as advisory.
Each of the two guidelines will be kept under review and may be revised or updated from time to time as considered appropriate.
notes: Correct: ¶4 of the F&P Guideline says it applies to every applicant for a licence under section 30 of the AMLO and is applicable to both the applicant for a licence as well as to the person who will hold the licence.
Incorrect: ¶5(e) of the F&P Guideline covers such a conviction only where the offence has a significant and negative bearing on the person's honesty, integrity and reliability.

Correct: the opening paragraphs of the Supplementary Guideline say it must be read in conjunction with the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety for determining whether an applicant for a licence or a licensee is a fit and proper person.
Correct: ¶7 of the Supplementary Guideline says failure to comply with individual elements may not result in the CCE not being satisfied that a person is fit and proper.

Incorrect: for the avoidance of doubt, ¶7 of the F&P Guideline and ¶8 of the Supplementary Guideline each say the guideline is advisory, and that an applicant or a licensee should seek legal advice where necessary.

Correct: ¶8 of the F&P Guideline says it will be kept under review and may be revised from time to time as considered appropriate, and ¶9 of the Supplementary Guideline says it will be kept under review and may be updated from time to time.

tc.q: 關於《有關適當人選準則的指引》（《適當人選指引》，2018年4月）及《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（《適當人選補充指引》，2020年1月），下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 《適當人選指引》適用於每名牌照申請人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將會持有牌照的人士。
《適當人選指引》的因素包括某人是否曾被裁定犯了第30(4)(a)及(b)條所列以外的刑事罪行。
《適當人選補充指引》須與《適當人選指引》一併閱讀，以決定申請人或持牌人是否適當人選。
根據《適當人選補充指引》，某人即使未有符合其中個別項目，關長仍可能信納其屬適當人選。
兩份指引均各自表明，其本身是一份對金錢服務經營者牌照申請人及持牌人具約束力的文件。
當局會持續檢討《適當人選指引》及《適當人選補充指引》的內容，並按情況不時作出修訂或更新。
notes: 正確：《適當人選指引》第4段訂明本指引適用於根據打擊洗錢條例第30條申請牌照的每名申請人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將會持有牌照的人士。
不正確：《適當人選指引》第5(e)段只涵蓋對該人的誠實、誠信及可靠性有重大而負面影響的該等罪行。
正確：《適當人選補充指引》開首段落訂明本補充指引須與《有關適當人選準則的指引》一併閱讀，該指引用作決定金錢服務經營者牌照申請人或持牌人是否適當人選。
正確：《適當人選補充指引》第7段訂明任何人即使不能符合個別項目，亦未必會導致關長不信納該人屬適當人選。
不正確：為免生疑問，《適當人選指引》第7段及《適當人選補充指引》第8段均訂明有關指引屬指引性文件，申請人或持牌人有需要時應尋求法律意見。
正確：《適當人選指引》第8段及《適當人選補充指引》第9段分別訂明當局會持續檢討指引的內容，按情況不時作出修訂或更新。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(b)、(c)、(e)、(i)及(o)段

en.q: In the Supplementary F&P Guideline, which of the following are among the examples of any other matter that the CCE considers relevant in determining whether a person is fit and proper?
statements: Whether the person has any record of non-compliance with the AMLO or relevant regulation that resulted in administrative action, prosecution, a written warning or discipline by the CCE
Whether the person is in compliance with guidelines promulgated for money service operators in the regulatory regime, such as the Licensing Guide and the AML/CFT Guideline

Whether the person has been the subject of any criminal or disciplinary proceedings, or notified of any potential proceedings or any investigation which might lead to those proceedings, under any law in any jurisdiction
Whether the person has been untruthful, or omitted material information to the CCE, or has been uncooperative with the C&ED in the performance of a function under the AMLO

Whether the person has been refused or restricted from the right to carry on any trade, business or profession for which a specific licence, registration or other authorization is required by law in Hong Kong or elsewhere
notes: Correct: ¶6(b) lists whether the person has any record of non-compliance with the AMLO or relevant regulation which resulted in the taking of administrative action, prosecution, issue of written warning or has been disciplined by the CCE for the non-compliance.

Correct: ¶6(c) lists whether the person is in compliance with guidelines promulgated for money service operators in the regulatory regime, such as the Licensing Guide and the Guideline on AML/CFT issued for Money Service Operators.

Correct: ¶6(e) lists whether the person has been the subject of any proceedings of a criminal or disciplinary nature or has been notified of any potential proceedings or of any investigation which might lead to those proceedings under any law in any jurisdiction.

Correct: ¶6(i) lists whether the person has been untruthful or provided false or misleading information or omitted material information to the CCE or been uncooperative with the C&ED in the performance of a function under the AMLO.

Correct: ¶6(o) lists whether the person has been refused or restricted from the right to carry on any trade, business or profession for which a specific licence, registration or other authorization is required by law in Hong Kong or elsewhere.

tc.q: 在《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》中，下列哪些屬於關長在斷定某人是否適當人選時，視作其認為有關的其他事宜的示例？
statements: 該人是否有任何不遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或相關規例的紀錄，以致關長採取行政制裁行動、檢控、發出警告信或作出紀律處分
該人是否遵從在監管制度下為金錢服務經營者頒布的指引，例如《牌照指引》及《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》
該人是否曾面對任何刑事或紀律程序，或曾否獲告知有任何擬執行的程序或調查，而有關調查可能引致在任何司法管轄區根據任何法例執行該等程序
該人是否曾不誠實或遺漏要項資料而未有向關長提供，或在海關根據《打擊洗錢條例》執行職能時對海關採取不合作態度
該人是否被拒絕或限制享有權利，以進行根據香港或其他地方的法律規定須獲發指定牌照、註冊或其他認可方可進行的行業、業務或專業
notes: 正確：第6(b)段列出「該人是否有任何不遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或相關規例的紀錄，以致關長採取行政制裁行動、檢控、發出警告信或作出紀律處分」。
正確：第6(c)段列出「該人是否遵從在監管制度下為金錢服務經營者頒布的指引，例如為金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》及《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》」。
正確：第6(e)段列出「該人是否曾面對任何刑事或紀律程序，或曾否獲告知有任何擬執行的程序或調查，而有關調查可能引致在任何司法管轄區根據任何法例執行該等程序」。
正確：第6(i)段列出「該人是否曾不誠實或向關長提供虛假或具誤導性的資料或遺漏要項資料，或在海關根據《打擊洗錢條例》執行職能時對海關採取不合作態度」。
正確：第6(o)段列出「該人是否被拒絕或限制享有權利，以進行根據香港或其他地方的法律規定須獲發指定牌照、註冊或其他認可方可進行的行業、業務或專業」。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(g)、(h)、(j)、(k)、(n)及(r)段

en.q: Regarding the matters, and the examples of them, that the Supplementary F&P Guideline treats as relevant in determining whether a person is fit and proper, which of the following are correct?
statements: On whether effective AML/CFT systems are established, the example is that the person must have a competent MLRO of sufficient seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee them.

In assessing the person's skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism for the business's functions, the person is generally expected to display an understanding of the statutory and regulatory requirements that apply.
Among the matters is whether a regulatory authority or professional body, in Hong Kong or elsewhere, has censured, disciplined or publicly criticized the person.
Among the matters is whether the person has put in place the infrastructure and internal control systems necessary to eliminate risk, avoid conflicts of interest and leave a proper audit trail.

Among the matters is the state of affairs of any other business the person carries on, proposes to carry on or has any business relationship with, such as one exposing it to potential money laundering risk.
Among the matters is whether the person has established an organizational structure and staffing that meet the legislative or regulatory requirements relevant to it.
notes: Incorrect: ¶6(g) gives as its example that the person must have a competent compliance officer of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee the establishment and maintenance of the AML/CFT systems; it does not name the MLRO.

Correct: ¶6(h) says that, in assessing whether the person is equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism necessary to perform the business's functions, the person is generally expected to be able to display an understanding of the statutory and regulatory requirements that apply to the business.
Correct: ¶6(n) lists whether the person has been censured, disciplined or publicly criticized by any regulatory authority or professional body in Hong Kong or elsewhere.

Incorrect: ¶6(k) speaks of the infrastructure and internal control systems needed to manage risk effectively, avoid conflict of interest and provide proper audit trail; managing risk effectively is not eliminating it.

Correct: ¶6(r) lists the state of affairs of any other business which the person carries on, proposes to carry on or has any business relationship, giving as an example the other business which exposes the person to the potential risk of money laundering.
Correct: ¶6(j) lists whether the person has failed to establish organizational structure and personnel that comply with the relevant legislative or regulatory requirements.

tc.q: 關於《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》所列關長在斷定某人是否適當人選時認為有關的事宜及其示例，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 所舉有效打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度的例子，是該人必須在持牌人內有具一定資歷及權力的合資格洗錢報告主任監督。
在評核該人是否具備所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業意識時，該人一般需要展示明白業務適用的法定及監管規定。
所列事宜包括該人曾否遭受任何監管機構或專業團體（不論在香港或其他地方）譴責、紀律處分或公開批評。
所列事宜包括該人是否設有所需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，藉以消除風險、避免利益衝突，並留存適當的審計線索。
所列事宜包括該人正經營、擬經營或有任何業務關係的任何其他業務的狀況，例如有其他業務使該人面對潛在的洗錢風險。
所列事宜包括該人有否確立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構，並配備符合規定的人事安排。
notes: 不正確：第6(g)段所舉的例子是該人必須使持牌人內有一名具有一定資歷及權力的合資格合規主任，負責監督持牌人打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度的建立及維持，並非洗錢報告主任。
正確：第6(h)段訂明在評核該人所具備的技能、知識、經驗及專業意識是否足以執行業務的職能時，該人一般需要展示明白業務適用的法定及監管規定。
正確：第6(n)段列出「該人是否曾被在香港或其他地方的任何監管機構或專業團體譴責、紀律處分或公開批評」。
不正確：第6(k)段所指的是備妥所需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，以便有效管理風險、避免利益衝突及提供適當的審計線索；有效管理風險並非消除風險。
正確：第6(r)段列出該人正經營、擬經營或有任何業務關係的任何其他業務的狀況，並舉例指有其他業務使該人面對潛在的洗錢風險。
正確：第6(j)段列出「該人是否未能確立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構及人事安排」。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), items 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 12

en.q: Under the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan, which of the following are correct about the information an applicant gives on its company, its management, its customers and its business operation?
statements: The plan should give the company name, business name, website address, business logo and trademark that will be used to promote the money service business.
The plan should give the nationality, employment history, qualification and education level of each and every member of the applicant's staff.
The plan should state where senior management is located, being the place of key business decisions, and the purpose and whereabouts of any back-end office in or outside Hong Kong.
On its customers, the plan should give the geographical location and nationality of its potential and expected customers and its mode of contacting them.
The plan should elaborate the business operation to take place in Hong Kong, detailing the entire transaction process, and the reason for obtaining a licence locally.
A third party's bank account may be used for the business, provided that the plan gives that account's number and the name of its owner.
notes: Correct: item 1 asks for information on the company name, business name, website address, business logo and trademark that will be used to promote the money service business.

Incorrect: item 3 asks for the nationality, employment history, qualification and education level of the key executives of the senior management; for employees, item 12 asks for their total number, positions, roles and responsibilities, full time or part time and reporting lines.

Correct: item 4 asks for the location of senior management, where key business decision is made, and, if there is any back-end office in or outside Hong Kong, the function/purpose of this office and its whereabouts.
Correct: item 5 asks for information on the potential and expected customers including their geographical location and nationality, mode of contacting with the customers etc.

Correct: item 6 asks the applicant to elaborate in detail on what business operation will take place in Hong Kong and the reason of obtaining a licence locally, the business operation detailing the entire transaction process.
Incorrect: item 8 asks for information on any bank accounts used for the business, such as account number and owner of the bank account, and states that no third party bank account is allowed.

tc.q: 根據《遞交業務計劃的指引》，關於申請人就其公司、管理層、客戶及業務運作提供的資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 業務計劃應就將用作推廣金錢服務業務的公司名稱、業務名稱、網址、業務標誌及商標提供資料。
業務計劃應就申請人旗下每一名職員的國籍、曾任職位、資歷及教育水平分別提供資料。
業務計劃應述明作出重要業務決策的高級管理層所在位置，以及香港或香港以外任何後勤辦事處的職能及位置。
就客戶而言，業務計劃應就準客戶及預期客戶的地理位置及國籍，以及聯絡客戶的方式等提供資料。
業務計劃應詳述將在香港進行的業務運作（須詳載完整的交易過程）及在本地領取牌照的理由。
如業務計劃已提供帳戶號碼及戶口擁有人的資料，申請人的業務可使用第三方的銀行戶口經營。
notes: 正確：第1項要求就將用作推廣金錢服務業務的公司名稱、業務名稱、網址、業務標誌及商標提供資料。
不正確：第3項是就高級管理層的主要行政人員要求提供國籍、曾任職位、資歷及教育水平；至於僱員，第12項要求闡述的是僱員總數、職位、角色及責任、全職／兼職及報告流程。
正確：第4項要求述明高級管理層的位置（作出重要業務決策的地點），如在香港或香港以外有任何後勤辦事處，亦須闡述其職能／目的及位置。
正確：第5項要求就準客戶及預期客戶提供資料，包括客戶的地理位置及國籍、聯絡客戶的方式等。
正確：第6項要求詳述將在香港進行的業務運作及在本地領取牌照的理由，而業務運作應詳載完整的交易過程。
不正確：第8項要求就任何用以經營業務的銀行戶口提供資料，例如帳戶號碼及銀行戶口的擁有人，並訂明不得使用第三方銀行戶口。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), items 10, 11, 13, 14, 16 and 17

en.q: Under the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan, which of the following are correct about what an applicant sets out on its group, its premises, its systems and its dealings with other parties?
statements: The plan should attach an organizational chart of the applicant's group of companies in Hong Kong, with a brief description of each entity in the group and the business it carries out.
If its business premises are shared by other businesses, the applicant should elaborate whether those businesses are also owned by the applicant or its director, partner or staff.
For AML/CFT purposes, any outsourced service the applicant uses, e.g. an external audit function or a specified intermediary, should be named in the plan together with its nature.

The plan should elaborate the computerized and other automation systems used in the business, for example naming the commercial service or database provider for automated AML solution and sanction screening.
Where the business involves physical cash movement, whether local or cross-boundary, the plan should name the company or person involved in those activities.
If the applicant's local business, or the international group it belongs to, holds a licence granted by another regulator or competent authority, the plan should name that body.
notes: Correct: item 10 asks the applicant to elaborate the group of companies in Hong Kong, attach an organizational chart of the group of companies and provide a brief description and business carried out by each entity within the group.
Correct: item 11 asks the applicant to elaborate whether the other businesses in its business premises are also owned by the applicant/director or partner or staff of the applicant.
Correct: item 13 asks for the name and nature of any outsourced services used by the applicant for AML/CFT purpose, for example external audit function and any specified intermediary.

Correct: item 14 asks the applicant to elaborate the computerized systems and other automation systems used in the business, for example the name of the commercial service or database provider for automated AML solution and sanction screening.

Correct: item 16 says that if the applicant's business involves the activities of local/cross-boundary physical cash movement, it should provide the name of the company/person in relation to such activities.

Correct: item 17 asks whether the applicant's local business or the international group of companies to which it belongs is also subject to other type of supervision, e.g. holding licence granted by other regulator/competent authority, and if yes, for the name of the other regulator/competent authority.

tc.q: 根據《遞交業務計劃的指引》，關於申請人須就其集團、處所、系統及與其他各方的往來載述的資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 業務計劃需夾附申請人在香港的公司集團的組織圖，並概述集團內每個實體的資料及經營的業務。
如營業處所與其他業務共用，申請人應闡述該等其他業務是否同樣由申請人或其董事、合夥人或員工擁有。
業務計劃應列出申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而外判的任何服務的名稱，例如外部審核職能或指明的中介人，並說明其性質。
業務計劃應闡述用於業務的電腦系統及其他自動化系統，例如自動化打擊洗錢方案及篩查制裁名單的商業服務或數據庫提供者的名稱。
業務如涉及本地或跨境的實體現金流動活動，業務計劃需提供參與這類活動的公司或人士的名稱或姓名。
如申請人的本地業務或其所屬的國際公司集團持有其他監管機構／主管當局批給的牌照，業務計劃需提供有關名稱。
notes: 正確：第10項要求闡述在香港的公司集團的資料，並需夾附公司集團的組織圖，以及概述集團內每個實體的資料及經營的業務。
正確：第11項要求闡述位於申請人營業處所的「其他業務」是否同樣由申請人／申請人的董事或合夥人或員工擁有。
正確：第13項要求提供申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而使用的任何外判服務的名稱及性質，例如外部審核職能、任何指明的中介人。
正確：第14項要求闡述用於業務的電腦系統及其他自動化系統，例如關於自動化打擊洗錢方案及篩查制裁名單等的商業服務或數據庫提供者的名稱。
正確：第16項訂明如申請人的業務涉及本地／跨境實體現金流動活動，需提供這類活動所涉公司／人等的名稱／姓名。
正確：第17項要求述明申請人的本地業務或所屬國際公司集團是否同時受到其他形式的監管（例如持有由其他監管機構／主管當局批給的牌照），如是，需提供其他監管機構／主管當局的名稱。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), items 2 and 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第2及3項

en.q: Under the Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy, which of the following should an applicant elaborate in the part of its policy on the AML/CFT framework in Hong Kong?
statements: The legal obligations that an MSO has in respect of ML, TF and PF under different legislation
Why it is important for the applicant's business to have an AML/CFT system in place
What a politically exposed person is, and what source of funds and source of wealth are
What the three stages of ML are, and the typical signs or indicators for ML, TF and PF
Actions required of the applicant if a suspicion arises, and the procedure and timing of handling an STR
What tipping off is, and the legal obligations of the applicant in respect of it
notes: Correct: item 2 asks the applicant to state the legal obligations of money service operator in respect of ML, TF and PF under different legislation.
Correct: item 2 lists why it is important to have an AML/CFT system for the applicant's business.
Incorrect: what a PEP is (an entry under enhanced due diligence) and what SOF and SOW are both appear in item 3 (customer due diligence), not in item 2 (the AML/CFT framework in Hong Kong).
Correct: item 2 lists what the three stages of ML are and the typical signs or indicators for ML, TF and PF.
Correct: item 2 lists the actions required by the applicant if a suspicion arises, and the procedure of handling STR and timing.
Correct: item 2 lists what tipping off is and the applicant's legal obligations.

tc.q: 根據《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》，申請人應在政策中有關香港的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集框架的部分闡述下列哪些事項？
statements: 金錢服務經營者在不同法例下有關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的法律責任
就申請人的業務而言，為何必須具備打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度
何謂政治人物，以及資金來源和財富來源各自所指的是甚麼
何謂洗錢的三個階段，以及洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的典型迹象或指標
如出現可疑情況申請人須採取的行動，以及處理可疑交易報告的程序及時間
何謂通風報訊，以及申請人在通風報訊方面須承擔甚麼法律責任
notes: 正確：第2項要求述明金錢服務經營者在不同法例下有關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的法律責任。
正確：第2項列出「為何申請人的業務必須具備打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。
不正確：「何謂政治人物」（列於更嚴格的盡職審查之下）及「何謂資金來源及財富來源」均載於第3項（客戶盡職審查），並非第2項（香港的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集框架）。
正確：第2項列出「何謂洗錢的三個階段」及「洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的典型迹象或指標」。
正確：第2項列出「如出現可疑情況，申請人須採取甚麼行動」及「處理可疑交易報告的程序及時間」。
正確：第2項列出「何謂通風報訊及申請人有何法律責任」。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), items 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第6、7、8、9、10及11項

en.q: Under the Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy, which of the following are correct about what an applicant's policy should elaborate on its business and its remittance transactions?
statements: On remittance, the policy should elaborate the target jurisdictions of the applicant's inward remittance transactions and of its outward remittance transactions.
Under the revenue model, the policy should explain how the applicant earns its profit, for instance by taking a certain percentage of each transaction or a handling charge.
In elaborating its remittance and wire transfer procedures, the policy should cover how the company monitors its overseas branch and agents for compliance with its AML/CFT policy.
Its remittance procedures should include procedures for taking other reasonable measures to mitigate ML/TF risks, such as identifying the source of funds.
On sanctions screening, the example given is screening customers to mitigate risks of targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism and TF, those related to proliferation, and PEPs.
The policy should elaborate the main types of currencies provided in the money service business, and the target customers of the money service business.
notes: Correct: item 8 asks the applicant to elaborate the target jurisdictions for inward remittance transaction and outward remittance transaction.
Correct: item 9 asks for elaboration of the way by which the applicant makes profit from the business, for example profit made from a certain percentage of each transaction, handling charge, etc.

Correct: item 10 lists, among the AML/CFT procedures for remittance transactions and/or wire transfers, procedures for monitoring the company's overseas branch and agent's compliance with the AML/CFT policy.

Correct: item 10 includes procedures for taking other reasonable measures in mitigation of ML/TF risks, such as identifying the source of funds and the identity and legality of any counterparts or related parties in processing the transaction.

Correct: item 11 asks the applicant to elaborate the procedures in conducting sanctions screening, for example screening against customers for mitigating the risks of (a) TFS related to terrorism and TF, (b) TFS related to proliferation, and (c) PEP.
Correct: item 6 asks the applicant to elaborate the main types of currencies provided in the money service business, and item 7 the target customers in the money service business.

tc.q: 根據《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》，關於申請人的政策應就其業務及匯款交易闡述的內容，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就匯款的目標司法管轄區而言，政策應分別闡述「匯入匯款交易」及「匯出匯款交易」的目標司法管轄區。
政策中的收費模式部分應說明申請人如何從業務獲取利潤，例如收取每宗交易款額的某個百分率或收取手續費。
就匯款交易及／或電傳轉帳的程序而言，政策應包括如何監察公司的外地分行及代理人是否遵從其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策。
其匯款程序應包括採取其他合理措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的程序，例如識別資金來源。
就篩查制裁名單而言，所舉例子是篩查客戶，以減低涉及恐怖主義及恐怖分子資金籌集、武器擴散的針對性金融制裁及政治人物風險。
就貨幣類別及目標客戶而言，政策應闡述金錢服務業務提供的主要貨幣類別及業務的目標客戶。
notes: 正確：第8項要求闡述「匯入匯款交易」及「匯出匯款交易」的目標司法管轄區。
正確：第9項要求闡述申請人從業務賺取利潤的方式，例如就每宗交易收取某百分率的款額作為利潤、手續費等。
正確：第10項把按甚麼程序監察公司外地分行及代理人有否遵從打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，列為匯款交易及／或電傳轉帳的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集程序之一。
正確：第10項包括按甚麼程序採取其他合理措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，例如識別資金來源、處理交易的任何對口單位／相關各方的身分及合法地位。
正確：第11項要求闡述執行篩查制裁名單的程序，例如篩查客戶，以減低(a)有關恐怖主義及恐怖分子資金籌集的針對性金融制裁；(b)有關武器擴散的針對性金融制裁；及(c)政治人物所涉風險。
正確：第6項要求闡述金錢服務業務提供的主要貨幣類別，第7項要求闡述金錢服務業務的目標客戶。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), items 4, 17, 18 and 19
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第4、17、18及19項

en.q: Under the Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy, which of the following are correct about an applicant's policy on its services, its other internal controls, the other information it gives and its cooperation with the authorities?
statements: The policy states that the applicant will cooperate with the Customs and Excise Department about its routine inspection or investigation.
The policy states that the applicant will also cooperate with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of any jurisdiction.
The applicant is required to attach its internal forms, such as those for reporting suspicious transactions and conducting CRA, to its policy.
If the applicant has other internal control systems for AML/CFT purposes, its policy should elaborate the relevant policies and procedures.
On products and services, the policy should cover the money changing and/or remittance services that the applicant will offer in its business.
notes: Correct: item 19 states that the applicant will cooperate with the Customs & Excise Department about their routine inspection or investigation.
Incorrect: item 19 says the company will also cooperate with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of Hong Kong, not the laws of any jurisdiction.

Incorrect: item 18 says the applicant is advised to provide or attach other information, such as the company's internal forms for reporting suspicious transactions, customer on-boarding, account opening and conducting CRA; it is advice, not a requirement.
Correct: item 17 says that if there are other internal controls systems for AML/CFT purpose, the applicant should elaborate the relevant policies and procedures.
Correct: item 4, products and services, refers to money changing and/or remittance services.

tc.q: 根據《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》，關於申請人的政策就其服務、其他內部監控系統、提供的其他資料及配合有關當局所載的內容，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在配合監管機構及執法機構方面，政策述明申請人將配合香港海關的例行視察或調查。
政策述明申請人亦將按照任何司法管轄區的法例規定，配合其他執法機構。
申請人須在其政策夾附內部表格，例如用作舉報可疑交易及進行客戶風險評估的表格，以便闡述政策。
如申請人有為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而設立的其他內部監控系統，政策應闡述相關政策及程序。
就產品及服務而言，政策應涵蓋申請人所提供的貨幣兌換及／或匯款服務的資料。
notes: 正確：第19項訂明申請人將配合香港海關的例行視察或調查。
不正確：第19項訂明本公司亦將按照香港法例規定配合其他執法機構，並非任何司法管轄區的法例。
不正確：第18項訂明「建議」申請人提供／夾附其他資料，例如公司內部用作舉報可疑交易、與客戶建立業務關係、開戶、進行客戶風險評估的表格；這是建議，並非規定。
正確：第17項訂明如有為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而設立其他內部監控系統，則闡述相關政策及程序。
正確：第4項（產品及服務）所指的是貨幣兌換及／或匯款服務。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶1, ¶3, ¶5, ¶8 and ¶9; Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018) ¶1, ¶2, ¶4 and ¶9
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第1、3、5、8及9段；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第1、2、4及9段

en.q: Regarding the scope of the CCE's two guidelines on pecuniary penalties and the approach they describe, which of the following are correct?
statements: Under the Disciplinary Action Guideline, the CCE may, amongst other disciplinary actions, impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any of the conditions of its licence.
The Disciplinary Fining Guideline says that, for an MSO that contravenes a specified provision, the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty on its own or combine it with other disciplinary sanctions.
In deciding whether to impose a pecuniary penalty and its amount, the CCE considers all of the circumstances of the particular case, including the relevant factors the guidelines describe.
The Disciplinary Action Guideline indicates how the CCE will exercise the power to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11).
Under the Disciplinary Action Guideline, the more serious the contravention, the more likely the CCE is to impose a pecuniary penalty, the amount of which will reflect its gravity.
The factors the guidelines list for determining the seriousness of a contravention are not exhaustive, and some of them may not be applicable in a particular case.
notes: Correct: ¶1 of the Disciplinary Action Guideline says that, under section 43 of the AMLO, the CCE may, amongst other disciplinary actions, impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any regulation made under section 51, any of the conditions of the licensee's licence, or one of the sections it lists.

Correct: ¶1 of the Disciplinary Fining Guideline says the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty either on its own or together with other disciplinary sanctions on an MSO if the MSO contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11) of the AMLO.

Correct: ¶5 of the Disciplinary Action Guideline and ¶4 of the Disciplinary Fining Guideline say that, in considering whether to impose a pecuniary penalty and its amount, the CCE will consider all of the circumstances of the particular case, including the relevant factors they set out.

Incorrect: it is the Disciplinary Fining Guideline (¶1–2) that indicates how the CCE will exercise the power under section 21(2)(c) over an MSO contravening a specified provision; the Disciplinary Action Guideline (¶1–3) concerns the power under section 43(2)(c) over a licensee contravening a regulation made under section 51, a licence condition or one of the sections it lists.

Correct: ¶8 of the Disciplinary Action Guideline says the more serious the contravention, the greater the likelihood that the CCE will impose a pecuniary penalty and that the amount of the penalty will reflect the gravity of the contravention.
Correct: ¶9 of each guideline says the factors listed are not exhaustive, some of them may not be applicable in a particular case and there may be other relevant factors which are not listed.

tc.q: 關於關長就罰款發出的兩份指引的涵蓋範圍及所述的處理方式，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 根據《施加罰款紀律行動指引》，持牌人如違反其牌照的任何條件，關長除其他紀律行動外，可以向該持牌人施加罰款。
《紀律處分罰款指引》訂明，金錢服務經營者如違反指明的條文，關長可單單施加罰款，亦可將罰款與其他紀律制裁一併實施。
關長在考慮是否施加罰款及罰款金額時，會考慮有關個案的所有情況，包括兩份指引所述的相關因素。
《施加罰款紀律行動指引》示明關長如何行使權力，向違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文的金錢服務經營者施加罰款。
根據《施加罰款紀律行動指引》，違規者的行為愈嚴重，關長就愈有可能施加罰款，而罰款額也會反映該違規行為的嚴重性。
兩份指引均表明所列用以決定違規行為嚴重性的因素並非詳盡無遺，其中有些因素在某些個案中並不適用。
notes: 正確：《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第1段訂明，根據《打擊洗錢條例》第43條，若持牌人違反根據第51條訂立的規例、其牌照的任何條件或所列的條文，關長除其他紀律行動外，可以向該持牌人施加罰款。
正確：《紀律處分罰款指引》第1段訂明，若金錢服務經營者違反《打擊洗錢條例》第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文，關長可以向該人純粹實施罰款或同時實施其他紀律制裁。
正確：《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第5段及《紀律處分罰款指引》第4段均訂明，關長在考慮是否施加罰款及罰款金額時，會考慮有關個案的所有情況，以及下文所述的相關因素。
不正確：示明關長如何就違反指明的條文的金錢服務經營者行使第21(2)(c)條罰款權力的是《紀律處分罰款指引》（第1及2段）；《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（第1至3段）處理的是關長根據第43(2)(c)條，就違反第51條所訂規例、牌照條件或所列條文的持牌人施加罰款的權力。
正確：《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第8段訂明違規者的行為愈嚴重，關長就愈有可能施加罰款，而罰款額也會反映該違規行為的嚴重性。
正確：兩份指引的第9段均訂明所列的因素並非詳盡無遺，其中有些因素在某些個案中並不適用，而有些相關因素卻沒有列示出來。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶7 and ¶9(a); Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018) ¶7 and ¶9(a)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第7及9(a)段；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第7及9(a)段

en.q: Under the CCE's guidelines on pecuniary penalties, which of the following are among the factors on the nature, seriousness and impact of a contravention that the CCE takes into account in determining its seriousness?
statements: The duration and frequency of the contraventions, and the nature and extent of any financial crime facilitated or occasioned by the contravention
Whether the contravention was the licensee's or MSO's own act or was committed as part of a group, and its role within that group
Whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the reputation of the Customs and Excise Department as the regulator of MSOs
