Whether the contravention reveals serious or systemic weaknesses in the internal controls over the procedures for reporting suspicious transactions
The size and the financial resources of the particular licensee or MSO that has committed the contravention in question
Whether the contravention caused, or potentially caused, loss to any other person, or imposed costs on any other person
notes: Correct: ¶9(a)(ii) of each guideline lists the duration and frequency of the contraventions, and ¶9(a)(ix) the nature and extent of any financial crime facilitated, occasioned or otherwise attributable to the contravention.
Correct: ¶9(a)(v) of each guideline lists whether the contravention was committed by the licensee or MSO alone or as part of a group, and the role it played in that group.

Incorrect: ¶9(a)(iii) asks whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre (the Disciplinary Action Guideline adds the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong); the department's own reputation is not mentioned.

Incorrect: ¶9(a)(vi) asks about serious or systemic weaknesses in the management systems or internal controls in respect of the customer due diligence and record-keeping procedures relating to all or part of the business; suspicious transaction reporting procedures are not what it names.

Incorrect: the size and financial resources of the licensee or MSO are taken into account under ¶7 of each guideline, so that a penalty does not have the likely effect of putting it in financial jeopardy; they are not among the ¶9(a) factors on the nature, seriousness and impact of a contravention.
Correct: ¶9(a)(iv) of each guideline lists whether the contravention caused or potentially caused loss to, or imposed costs on, any other person.

tc.q: 根據關長就罰款發出的兩份指引，下列哪些屬於關長在決定違規行為的嚴重性時，就違規行為的性質、嚴重性及影響所考慮的因素？
statements: 該違規行為持續的時間及頻密程度，以及由該違規行為促成或引致的任何金融罪行的性質及程度
該違規行為是持牌人或金錢服務經營者獨自作出，還是作為集團一分子作出，以及其在集團內的角色
該違規行為是否有可能引致損害或有損香港海關作為金錢服務經營者監管機構的聲譽
該違規行為是否顯示出舉報可疑交易程序的內部監控制度存在嚴重的或系統性的弱點
作出有關違規行為的持牌人或金錢服務經營者本身的業務規模及財政資源狀況
該違規行為會否對任何其他人造成或有可能造成損失，或使任何其他人承擔支出
notes: 正確：兩份指引的第9(a)(ii)段均列出該違規行為持續的時間及頻密程度，第9(a)(ix)段則列出促成、引致或可歸因於該違規行為的任何金融罪行的性質及程度。
正確：兩份指引的第9(a)(v)段均列出該違規行為是否由持牌人或金錢服務經營者單獨作出，或是以某個集團的成員身分行事，以及其在該集團中擔當的角色。
不正確：第9(a)(iii)段所指的是該違規行為是否有可能引致損害或有損香港作為一個國際金融中心的聲譽（《施加罰款紀律行動指引》另提及在香港經營金錢服務業務的廉潔穩健），並非香港海關本身的聲譽。
不正確：第9(a)(vi)段所指的是業務的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄程序的管理制度或內部監控制度存在嚴重的或系統性的弱點，並非舉報可疑交易的程序。
不正確：持牌人或金錢服務經營者的規模及財政資源是兩份指引第7段所顧及的因素，以免罰款導致其陷入財政困難；並非第9(a)段所列有關違規行為的性質、嚴重性及影響的因素。
正確：兩份指引的第9(a)(iv)段均列出該違規行為會否對其他人造成或有可能造成損失，或使其他人承擔支出。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(b)–(d); Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018) ¶9(b)–(d)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(b)至(d)段；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第9(b)至(d)段

en.q: Under the CCE's guidelines on pecuniary penalties, which of the following are correct about the factors on a contravener's conduct and record, and the other factors, that the CCE takes into account in determining the seriousness of a contravention?
statements: A factor is the degree of cooperation with the CCE, other relevant authorities and/or law enforcement agencies during the investigation of the contravention.
A factor is the likelihood that the contravener will commit the same type of contravention in the future if no penalty, or a lighter penalty, is imposed.
Among the factors on previous record and compliance history is whether the contravener had undertaken not to engage in the conduct that resulted in the contravention.
A factor is the amount of any benefit gained or costs avoided as a result of the contravention by the customers of the licensee or MSO.
As a mitigating factor, the CCE considers whether the contravener has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to its attention.
The CCE considers what action it and/or other relevant authorities have taken in previous similar cases; in general, similar cases should be treated consistently.
notes: Correct: ¶9(b)(iii) of each guideline lists the degree of cooperation with the CCE, other relevant authorities and/or law enforcement agencies during the investigation of the contravention.
Correct: ¶9(b)(iv) of each guideline lists the likelihood that the licensee or MSO will commit the same type of contravention in the future if no or a lighter penalty is imposed.
Correct: ¶9(c)(ii) of each guideline lists whether the licensee or MSO has previously undertaken not to engage in the particular conduct that resulted in the contravention.

Incorrect: ¶9(d)(iii) of each guideline lists the amount of any benefit gained or costs avoided by the licensee or MSO or any of its directors or employees as a result of the contravention; its customers are not named.

Correct: ¶9(d)(iv) of each guideline lists, as a mitigating factor, whether the licensee or MSO has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to the attention of the CCE.

Correct: ¶9(d)(ii) of each guideline lists what action the CCE and/or other relevant authorities have taken in previous similar cases, and says that in general similar cases should be treated in a consistent manner.

tc.q: 根據關長就罰款發出的兩份指引，關於關長在決定違規行為的嚴重性時，就違規者的行為、紀錄及其他相關事宜所考慮的因素，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在調查違規行為期間與關長、其他有關當局及／或執法機構的合作程度，屬考慮因素之一。
如無施加罰款或施加較輕的罰款，違規者日後重犯同一類別違規行為的可能性，屬考慮因素之一。
在過往紀律處分紀錄及合規情況方面，違規者過往曾否承諾不會作出引致有關違規事件的行為，屬考慮因素之一。
持牌人或金錢服務經營者的客戶從違規行為中所獲得的利益或所避免開支的數額，屬考慮因素之一。
作為求情因素，關長會考慮違規者有否迅速、有效及完全地知會關長有關違規行為或可能違規行為。
關長會考慮其本身及／或其他有關當局曾就過往的類似個案採取甚麽行動；相若的個案一般應以貫徹一致的方式處理。
notes: 正確：兩份指引的第9(b)(iii)段均列出在調查該違規行為期間與關長、其他有關當局及／或執法機構的合作程度。
正確：兩份指引的第9(b)(iv)段均列出如無施加罰款或施加較輕的罰款，有關持牌人或金錢服務經營者日後重犯同一類別違規行為的可能性。
正確：兩份指引的第9(c)(ii)段均列出有關持牌人或金錢服務經營者過往曾否承諾不會作出引致該違規事件的行為。
不正確：兩份指引的第9(d)(iii)段所列的是有關持牌人或金錢服務經營者或其任何董事或僱員從違規行為中所獲得的利益或所避免開支的數額，並非其客戶。
正確：兩份指引的第9(d)(iv)段均把有關持牌人或金錢服務經營者有否迅速、有效及完全地知會關長有關違規行為或可能違規行為，列為求情因素。
正確：兩份指引的第9(d)(ii)段均列出關長及／或其他有關當局曾就過往的類似個案採取甚麽行動，並訂明相若的個案一般應以貫徹一致的方式處理。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan introduction, paragraph 2; Licensing Guide ¶5.8; Licensing Guide ¶5.5(c); FAQ AML/CFT A13
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》引言第2段; 《牌照指引》第5.8段; 《牌照指引》第5.5(c)段; 《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集常見問題答13

en.q: Which statements about the roles of people and authorities in MSO application checks and supporting documents are correct?
statements: The Money Service Supervision Bureau must examine the applicant’s entire business operation from an AML/CFT perspective.
The witness to Appendix I of Form 3A must also certify that the declarant signed that Appendix in the witness’s presence.
A corporate applicant’s interview may be attended by a staff member whom the applicant’s board has authorised in writing.
An original certificate of incorporation available in electronic form is issued by Hong Kong’s Inland Revenue Department.
notes: True: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan introduction, paragraph 2 states “The MSSB is obliged to look into the applicant’s entire business operation from the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (“AML/CFT”) perspective”.
True: Licensing Guide ¶5.8 states “The witness shall also certify that this Appendix I is signed by the declarant in his or her presence”.
True: Licensing Guide ¶5.5(c) states “the directors or staff member(s) of the applicant authorized in writing by the board of directors, where the applicant belongs to corporation”.
False: FAQ AML/CFT A13 states “an original certificate of incorporation issued by the Hong Kong Companies Registry is available in electronic form”. The issuer is the Hong Kong Companies Registry.

tc.q: 以下有關金錢服務經營者申請審查及證明文件中各人員和機關的職責，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務監理科有責任從打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的角度，研究申請人的整項業務運作。
表格3A附錄I的見證人，亦須證明聲明人是在見證人在場的情況下簽署該份附錄。
如申請人屬法團，申請人的員工可在獲董事局以書面授權後，代表申請人出席有關會面。
可以電子形式出示的香港公司註冊證書正本，是由香港稅務局向有關公司發出的文件。
notes: 正確：《遞交業務計劃的指引》引言第2段列明「金錢服務監理科有責任從打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的角度研究申請人整項業務運作」。
正確：《牌照指引》第5.8段列明「見證人亦須證明聲明人在其在場情況下簽署該附錄I」。
正確：《牌照指引》第5.5(c)段列明「董事局以書面授權的申請人的董事或員工（如申請人屬法團）」。
不正確：《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集常見問題答13列明「由香港公司註冊處發出的公司註冊證書正本可以電子形式出示」。公司註冊證書的簽發機關是香港公司註冊處。

source.en: AMLO s.24, definition of ultimate owner (b)(ii), (c)(i)–(iii); Sch. 2 s.1(1), definition of beneficial owner (a)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條最終擁有人定義(b)(ii)、(c)(i)至(iii)段；附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(a)段

en.q: Which statements correctly identify an ultimate owner of an applicant for an MSO licence or of an MSO licensee?
statements: An individual controlling more than 25% of a corporate licensee’s issued share capital indirectly through a trust or bearer shares is an ultimate owner.
An individual entitled, directly or indirectly, to control more than 25% of the votes at a corporate licensee’s general meetings is an ultimate owner.
An individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of a corporate licensee qualifies as an ultimate owner through that control.
An individual entitled, directly or indirectly, to exercise more than 25% of a partnership licensee’s voting rights qualifies as an ultimate owner.
An individual controlling a corporate customer becomes an ultimate owner of the MSO serving that customer solely because of the customer relationship.
notes: Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c)(i) states “owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital of the corporation”.
Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c)(ii) states “is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings of the corporation”.
Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (c)(iii) states “exercises ultimate control over the management of the corporation”.
Correct: s.24, ultimate owner (b)(ii) states “is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 25% of the voting rights in the partnership”.

False: s.24, ultimate owner (c)(iii); Sch. 2 s.1(1), beneficial owner (a) states “exercises ultimate control over the management of the corporation”. The licensing definition concerns control of the corporate applicant or licensee. Beneficial ownership of its customer is a separate relationship under Schedule 2.

tc.q: 以下哪些陳述正確識別金錢服務經營者牌照申請人或持牌人的最終擁有人？
statements: 個人透過信託或持票人股份，間接控制屬法團的持牌人已發行股本的25%以上，便屬該持牌人的最終擁有人。
個人直接或間接地有權支配屬法團的持牌人成員大會上25%以上投票權的行使，便屬該持牌人的最終擁有人。
個人如可行使對屬法團的持牌人的管理最終的控制權，便可憑該項控制權，符合該持牌人的最終擁有人定義。
個人直接或間接地有權行使合夥持牌人25%以上的投票權，便可憑該比重的投票權成為該持牌人的最終擁有人。
個人如控制某法團客戶，便單憑該法團與提供服務的金錢服務經營者之間的客戶關係，成為該經營者的最終擁有人。
notes: 正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)(i)段訂明「直接或間接地擁有或控制( 包括透過信託或持票人股份持有)該法團已發行股本的25% 以上」。
正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)(ii)段訂明「直接或間接地有權行使在該法團的成員大會上的投票權的25% 以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使」。
正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)(iii)段訂明「可行使對該法團的管理最終的控制權」。
正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(b)(ii)段訂明「直接或間接地有權行使在該合夥的投票權的25% 以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使」。
不正確：第24條最終擁有人定義(c)(iii)段；附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(a)段訂明「可行使對該法團的管理最終的控制權」。發牌制度的定義關乎法團申請人或持牌人本身的控制權；附表2所指客戶的實益擁有人屬另一關係。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1 Pt. 1 s.1, definitions of money changing service and remittance service; s.25, opening words and (f); Licensing Guide (May 2026) ¶2.3 and ¶4.4(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條貨幣兌換服務及匯款服務定義；第25條起首語及(f)段；《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.3及4.4(b)段

en.q: Which statements about the scope of money services and the MSO licensing regime are correct?
statements: The AMLO’s money changing service definition concerns currency exchange that is operated in Hong Kong as a business.
A service operated as a business in Hong Kong to receive, or arrange receipt of, money from abroad is a remittance service under the AMLO.
The Licensing Guide excludes a money changing service incidental to the main business, such as a retailer accepting foreign currency in a sale.
The Licensing Guide gives premises advertised for meeting customers, including by a displayed signboard, as an example of particular premises.
Part 5 of the AMLO, which regulates money service operations, does not apply to the Government, including its MSO licensing requirements.
Part 5 of the AMLO does not apply to an SVF licensee where it operates a money service ancillary to its principal business.
notes: Correct: Sch. 1 Pt. 1 s.1, money changing service states “means a service for the exchanging of currencies that is operated in Hong Kong as a business”.

Correct: Sch. 1 Pt. 1 s.1, remittance service (b) states “receiving, or arranging for the receipt of, money from a place outside Hong Kong”. Receiving money from outside Hong Kong is included; the service is not confined to outward remittances.

Correct: ¶2.3 states “but does not include such a service that is incidental to the main business e.g. retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions”. This is the Licensing Guide’s incidental-business example; it is distinct from the hotel exception specified in the statutory definition.
Correct: ¶4.4(b) states “the premises are advertised (including a signboard on display) for meeting customers there”.
True: section 25 says Part 5 does not apply to the Government. This limits the exemption to the money-service operations regime, rather than every provision of the AMLO.
True: section 25(f) excludes an SVF licensee from Part 5 where the money service is ancillary to its principal business. The statement does not exempt it from the entire AMLO.

tc.q: 以下有關金錢服務的範圍及金錢服務經營者發牌制度的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 《打擊洗錢條例》的貨幣兌換服務定義，以在香港作為業務經營的貨幣兌換服務為對象。
在香港作為業務經營、從香港以外地方收取或安排收取金錢的服務，屬《打擊洗錢條例》所指匯款服務。
《牌照指引》把附帶於主要業務的貨幣兌換服務排除，例如零售業務在交易中接受外幣的情況。
《牌照指引》把被宣傳為會見客戶地點的處所，包括以展示招牌方式宣傳者，列作特定處所的例子。
《打擊洗錢條例》第5部規管金錢服務營運，其適用範圍不包括政府，故政府無須符合該部的金錢服務發牌規定。
儲值支付工具持牌人如經營的金錢服務附帶於其主要業務，便不受《打擊洗錢條例》第5部規管金錢服務營運的條文所規限。
notes: 正確：附表1第1部第1條貨幣兌換服務定義訂明「指在香港作為業務經營的貨幣兌換服務」。
正確：附表1第1部第1條匯款服務定義(b)段訂明「從香港以外地方或安排從香港以外地方收取金錢」。從香港以外收款亦屬服務範圍，並不限於向香港以外匯出款項。
正確：第2.3段訂明「但不包括附帶於主要業務的該等服務，例如在交易中接受外幣的零售業務」。這是《牌照指引》的附帶業務例子，與法定定義載列的酒店例外分開處理。
正確：第4.4(b)段訂明「該處所被宣傳（包括展示招牌）為用作會見客戶的處所」。
正確：第25條訂明第5部不適用於政府。此豁免限於規管金錢服務營運的第5部，並非整部條例的全面豁免。
正確：第25(f)條就附帶於儲值支付工具持牌人主要業務的金錢服務，豁免該持牌人受第5部規限，並非豁免整部條例。

en.q: Under the Licensing Guide, which statements about the names in which accounts for a licensee’s money service business may be held are correct?
statements: Where bank accounts are used for its money service business, a licensee may hold an account in the name of its own company.
An operating bank account may be held in the name of the licensee’s sole proprietor, partner or director under the Licensing Guide.
The licensee’s ultimate owner is a permitted named holder of a bank account used for operating the money service business.
Appointment as MLRO, without a listed account-holder capacity, qualifies that person’s bank account for the licensee’s business use.
notes: Correct: ¶11.1(j) includes the licensee’s company among the permitted account names where bank accounts are used for the money service business.
Correct: ¶11.1(j) also permits the bank account to be in the name of the sole proprietor, partner or director of the licensee.
Correct: ¶11.1(j) expressly includes the ultimate owner of the licensee among the permitted account names.
False: ¶11.1(j) lists the licensee’s company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner. Appointment as MLRO alone is not a listed account-holder capacity.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪些關於用以經營持牌人金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶的戶名的陳述正確？
statements: 如持牌人使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務業務，銀行帳戶可以屬持牌人公司名下，符合《牌照指引》的戶名規定。
根據《牌照指引》，用以經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶，可以屬持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人或董事名下。
根據《牌照指引》，持牌人的最終擁有人是獲准名列用以經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶的持有人之一。
單憑獲委任為持牌人的洗錢報告主任，即使不具《牌照指引》所列任何帳戶持有人身分，已可使用其名下帳戶經營金錢服務。
notes: 正確：第11.1(j)段規定，如有使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務業務，持牌人公司是獲准的戶名之一。
正確：第11.1(j)段亦准許該銀行帳戶屬持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人或董事名下。
正確：第11.1(j)段明確將持牌人的最終擁有人列為獲准的銀行帳戶戶名之一。
不正確：第11.1(j)段列出持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人。單憑獲委任為洗錢報告主任，並不具列明的帳戶持有人身分。

en.q: Which statements correctly describe examples used by the Licensing Guide to distinguish operation at particular premises from operation without particular premises?
statements: Premises occupied for operating a money service there are among the Guide’s examples of particular premises for the money service business.
Premises regularly controlled by the licensee as a landlord or tenant are another example of particular premises identified in the Guide.
A door-to-door money service without any fixed premises is an example the Guide does not treat as operation at particular premises.
Conducting transactions with mobile electronic devices is listed by the Guide among its examples of operating a money service without particular premises.
notes: Correct: ¶4.4(a) lists premises “occupied for operating a money service there” as an example, rather than a test requiring all three examples together.
Correct: ¶4.4(c) expressly gives being a landlord or tenant as the example of regular control by the licensee.
Correct: ¶4.5(a) names “operating a money service without any fixed premises, e.g. door-to-door service”.
Correct: ¶4.5(c) lists “conducting transactions with the use of mobile electronic devices” among these examples.

tc.q: 以下哪些陳述正確描述《牌照指引》用以區分在特定處所及沒有特定處所經營的例子？
statements: 佔用某處所以在該處經營金錢服務，是指引所列用以經營金錢服務業務的特定處所的例子之一。
持牌人以業主或租戶身分經常控制的處所，是指引所列用以經營金錢服務業務的另一個特定處所例子。
在沒有固定處所的情況下提供上門金錢服務，是指引不視為在特定處所經營金錢服務的例子之一。
只使用流動電子設備進行交易，屬指引所列不視為在特定處所經營金錢服務業務的其中一個例子。
notes: 正確：第4.4(a)段將「被佔用作經營金錢服務的處所」列作例子，並非要求同時符合全部三個例子。
正確：第4.4(c)段把持牌人以「業主或租戶」身分經常控制處所列作例子。
正確：第4.5(a)段明列「在沒有固定處所的情況下經營金錢服務，例如提供上門服務」。
正確：第4.5(c)段的例子是「只使用流動電子設備進行交易」，題句保留這項限定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第16.3段，核對清單第1項

en.q: Which statements about the applicant’s supporting documents for an MSO licence are correct under the Licensing Guide?
statements: For a sole proprietorship or partnership, the checklist includes copies of a valid Business Registration Certificate and an extract of information on the Business Register.
For both a local company and a non-Hong Kong company applicant, the checklist specifies a Certificate of Incorporation alongside its valid Business Registration Certificate.
For a newly established local company, the incorporation-form copy is Form NNC1 for a company limited by shares, or NNC1G for one not limited by shares.
For a newly established non-Hong Kong company, the checklist includes a copy of Form NN1 giving particulars of the non-Hong Kong company registered in Hong Kong.
A non-Hong Kong company applicant supplies its latest Annual Return, Form NN3, and copies of all documents filed with the Companies Registry after that annual return.
Local and non-Hong Kong company applicants provide group structure and each member’s shareholding percentage, together with a copy of their Memorandum and Articles of Association.
notes: Correct: item 1 lists both documents for each of sole proprietorship and partnership.
False: item 1 specifies a Certificate of Incorporation for a local company, but a “Certificate of Registration of non-Hong Kong Company” for a non-Hong Kong company.
Correct: item 1 distinguishes Form NNC1 for a company limited by shares from Form NNC1G for a company not limited by shares.
Correct: item 1 lists “Particulars of a non-Hong Kong Company Registered in Hong Kong (Form NN1)” for a new established company.
Correct: item 1 names the latest Form NN3 and all documents filed after that return, rather than every annual return since incorporation.
Correct: item 1 includes these group and constitutional documents in both company categories.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者牌照申請人本身的證明文件的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 就獨資經營或合夥申請人而言，清單包括有效商業登記證的複本，以及商業登記冊內資料的摘錄複本。
就本地公司及非香港公司申請人而言，清單均要求提交公司註冊證明書的複本，以及有效商業登記證的複本。
新成立的本地公司須提交法團成立表格的複本：股份有限公司使用表格NNC1，股份有限公司以外的公司使用表格NNC1G。
新成立的非香港公司須提交表格NN1的複本，該表格載列在香港註冊的非香港公司詳情，屬清單指明的申請文件。
非香港公司申請人須提交最近的周年申報表（表格NN3），以及遞交該申報表後存檔於公司註冊處的所有文件的複本。
本地公司及非香港公司申請人均須提供集團架構、集團每一成員的持股量百分率，以及組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。
notes: 正確：第1項在獨資經營及合夥兩類申請人下，均列出有效商業登記證及商業登記冊資料摘錄的複本。
錯誤：第1項對本地公司要求公司註冊證明書，對非香港公司則要求「非香港公司註冊證明書」；兩類均須有效商業登記證。
正確：第1項為新成立公司的兩類法團成立表格分別列明NNC1（股份有限公司）及NNC1G（股份有限公司以外的公司）。
正確：第1項對新成立的非香港公司列出「在香港註冊的非香港公司詳情–表格NN1」的複本。
正確：第1項列明最近的表格NN3及其後存檔的所有文件，並非自成立以來的每一份周年申報表。
正確：第1項在本地公司及非香港公司兩類均列出集團架構及持股量百分率，以及組織章程大綱及章程細則。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第16.3段，核對清單第2至4項

en.q: Which statements correctly describe the supporting documents for persons and premises in an MSO licence application?
statements: For a local corporate partner or director, the documents include Form 3B and copies of a valid Business Registration Certificate, Certificate of Incorporation, and Memorandum and Articles of Association.

For a non-Hong Kong corporate partner or director, the listed documents include Form 3B, a valid Business Registration Certificate, a Certificate of Registration of non-Hong Kong Company, and constitutional documents.

For a corporate partner or director not registered in Hong Kong, the checklist requires Form 3B and an incorporation-certificate copy or an equivalent document certified under the Companies (Forms) Regulations.

Individual sole proprietors, partners, directors and ultimate owners provide Form 3A with both appendices, plus a Hong Kong Identity Card copy for residents or travel-document bio-data page copy for non-residents.
For both the LPS and LMO, the checklist includes a stamped tenancy-agreement or ownership-record copy, a floor plan, and a landlord-letter copy permitting the respective use of the premises.
notes: Correct: item 4 lists all four kinds of documents under “Local company”.
Correct: item 4 gives this package for a non-Hong Kong company, including its Memorandum and Articles of Association.
Correct: item 4 accepts a Certificate of Incorporation or its equivalent certified in accordance with regulation 3 of the Companies (Forms) Regulations, together with Form 3B.
Correct: item 3 covers all these individual roles; both residency categories require Form 3A and Appendices I and II, while the identity-document copy differs as stated.
Correct: item 2 lists all three document types for each premises category; the landlord letter must permit storage of books and records or local management office use, respectively.

tc.q: 以下哪些陳述正確描述金錢服務經營者牌照申請中有關人士及處所的證明文件？
statements: 法團合夥人或董事如屬本地公司，須遞交表格3B，以及有效商業登記證、公司註冊證明書、組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。
法團合夥人或董事如屬非香港公司，須遞交表格3B、有效商業登記證、非香港公司註冊證明書，以及組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。
非在香港註冊的法團合夥人或董事須交表格3B，另附公司註冊證明書複本或根據《公司（表格）規例》核證的等同文件複本。
獨資經營者、個人合夥人、董事及最終擁有人須交表格3A連附錄I及II；香港居民附身份證複本，非香港居民附旅遊證件個人資料頁複本。
本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點與本地管理辦事處均須附已加蓋釐印租約或業權紀錄複本、平面圖，以及業主准許作相應用途的同意書複本。
notes: 正確：第4項「本地公司」一欄列出表格3B、有效商業登記證、公司註冊證明書，以及組織章程大綱及章程細則。
正確：第4項的非香港公司一欄列出這些文件，包括組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。
正確：第4項列有表格3B，以及公司註冊證明書的複本或根據《公司（表格）規例》第3條等同於公司註冊證明書的經核證文件複本。
正確：第3項涵蓋上述各個人身分；兩類均須表格3A及附錄I及II，香港居民附身份證，非香港居民附旅遊證件個人資料頁。
正確：第2項在兩類處所下均列出這三種文件；業主同意書須分別准許用作本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點或本地管理辦事處。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第16.3段，核對清單第1至2及6項

en.q: Which statements about additional documents accompanying an MSO licence application are correct under the Licensing Guide?
statements: Both the Business Plan and AML/CFT policy require endorsement by the applicable listed persons: the sole proprietor, each individual partner, director and ultimate owner.
For the CO and MLRO, copies of valid contracts for external consultancy services satisfy the employment-contract document specified in the licence application checklist.
The checklist calls for copies of the CO’s and MLRO’s Hong Kong Identity Cards, in addition to the separately listed employment and residential-address documents.
The bank concerned issues the proof of bank account ownership, for example a copy of the statement for the applicant’s account used for the money service business.
Each operating premises, local storage place and local management office has a listed requirement for two 4R-sized photographs showing the premises’ exterior and interior.
For a local company applicant, the latest Annual Return, Form NAR1, is accompanied by copies of all documents filed with the Companies Registry after that annual return.
notes: Correct: item 6 requires both documents to be endorsed by “sole proprietor / each individual partner / director / ultimate owner”.
False: item 6 specifies copies of “valid employment contracts for CO and MLRO”; an external consultancy contract is not the specified employment contract.
Correct: item 6 separately lists “A copy of Hong Kong Identity Card of CO and MLRO”.
Correct: item 6 names the bank concerned as issuer of the ownership proof, separately from the acknowledgement of business use.
Correct: item 2 repeats the two-photograph requirement for all three premises categories.
Correct: item 1 requires both the latest Form NAR1 and all documents filed with the Companies Registry after that return; supplying the return alone would omit the latter category.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者牌照申請須附加的證明文件的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，均須由清單所列適用人士確認：獨資經營者、每名個人合夥人、董事及最終擁有人。
就合規主任及洗錢報告主任而言，外部顧問服務合約的有效複本，已符合牌照申請清單所指定的僱傭合約文件要求。
除另行列出的僱傭合約及住址證明文件外，牌照申請清單亦要求提交合規主任及洗錢報告主任的香港身份證複本。
證明持有銀行帳戶的文件應由有關銀行發出，例如申請人持有並用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶結單複本。
每一經營金錢服務處所、本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點及本地管理辦事處，均須提供兩張顯示外部及內部的4R照片。
本地公司申請人須提交最近的周年申報表（表格NAR1），並附上遞交該申報表後存檔於公司註冊處的所有文件複本。
notes: 正確：第6項要求業務計劃及政策均經「獨資經營者／每一名（屬個人）合夥人／董事／最終擁有人」確認。
錯誤：第6項指定的是合規主任及洗錢報告主任的「有效僱傭合約複本」，外部顧問服務合約並非所指定的僱傭合約。
正確：第6項在僱傭合約及住址證明以外，另列「合規主任及洗錢報告主任的香港身份證複本」。
正確：第6項指定由銀行發出帳戶持有證明，並舉用作經營金錢服務的帳戶結單複本為例；此項與確認業務用途的銀行確認書分開列出。
正確：第2項在三種處所類別均列有「兩張顯示該處所外部及內部的4R照片」。
正確：第1項除最近的表格NAR1外，亦要求其後存檔於公司註冊處的所有文件；單交年報不足以涵蓋後者。

source.en: Supplementary Guideline on Fitness and Propriety (Jan 2020) ¶6(q)
source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(q)段

en.q: Which statements about financial integrity as a fitness and propriety factor are correct under the Supplementary Guideline?
statements: The assessment considers whether the person has financial resources adequate for the nature and scale of its operations, rather than assessing resources independently of the business.
Under the financial-integrity criterion, adequate operating resources make an adverse effect of the person’s solvency on customers and the public irrelevant to that criterion.
Failure to satisfy a judgment debt under a court order is one example given for assessing a person’s financial integrity in the Supplementary Guideline.
A compromise or arrangement made with creditors is another example relevant to financial integrity; the examples are not confined to unpaid court-ordered judgment debts.
notes: Correct: ¶6(q) relates adequate financial resources to “the nature and scale of its operations”.
False: ¶6(q) also requires that the person’s financial position or solvency would not undermine customers’ and the public’s interests. Adequate resources do not remove that concern.
Correct: ¶6(q) expressly gives failure to satisfy “any judgment debt under a court order” as an example.
Correct: ¶6(q) separately lists “any compromise or arrangement with his creditors”.

tc.q: 根據《適當人選補充指引》，以下有關以財政穩健程度作為適當人選因素的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 評估會考慮該人是否具備充分財政資源，支持其運作的性質及規模，而非脫離業務本身來評估資源是否足夠。
在財政穩健準則下，只要該人具備足夠營運資源，其償付能力對客戶及公眾人士權益造成的不利影響便與該準則無關。
未能償還法庭命令的判決債項，是《補充指引》在評估某人的財政穩健程度時明確列出的其中一個例子。
與債權人達成債務重整協議或債務償還安排，亦屬財政穩健準則所列的例子；例子不只限於未清償的判決債項。
notes: 正確：第6(q)段要求財政資源足以支持其「運作的性質及規模」，兩者須一併考慮。
錯誤：第6(q)段亦關注財政狀況或償付能力不會損害客戶及公眾人士權益；不能以資源足夠而刪去這項考慮。
正確：第6(q)段明列「未能償還法庭命令的判決債項」的例子，毋須把一般尚未裁決的申索混入。
正確：第6(q)段在判決債項之外，另列與債權人達成的「債務重整協議或債務償還安排」。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), items 7, 12, 15 and 16

en.q: Which statements correctly describe information about delivery channels, personnel and business relationships required in the applicant’s Business Plan?
statements: For the products and services to be offered, the plan should give their types and the timeline for launching them, so the proposed offering is accompanied by its rollout information.

The delivery-channel description should follow order processing and fund flows through each foreign agent or foreign MSO in different jurisdictions, covering the entire channel for each type of product or service.

For both the management team and employees, the plan should describe numbers, positions, roles and responsibilities, full-time or part-time status, and reporting lines as part of the composition of those groups.
If the applicant also acts as agent for another local MSO or an overseas company or business entity, the plan should name the other party and elaborate the applicant’s functions as agent.
If the applicant also acts as principal for another local MSO or overseas business, the plan should name the other party and describe the applicant’s functions in that relationship as the agent.
Where the business uses a third party’s payment platform or network, such as a digital wallet, the plan should explain the role that the platform or network plays in the applicant’s business.
notes: Correct: item 7 requests both the type of product and service and “the timeline of launching these product and service”.
Correct: item 7 requires the entire delivery channel, including processing of orders and fund flows through “each foreign agent or foreign MSO”.
Correct: item 12 lists these composition details separately for both the management team and employees.
Correct: item 15 requires the other party’s name and the applicant’s functions when it acts as agent.
False: item 15 requires the functions of “acting as principal by the applicant” for that relationship, not its functions as agent.
Correct: item 16 requires an explanation of the role of the third party’s payment platform or network, with a digital wallet as an example.

tc.q: 以下哪些陳述正確描述申請人的業務計劃須載列的交付渠道、人員及業務關係資料？
statements: 對於擬提供的產品及服務，業務計劃應說明其類別及推出時間表，使計劃載明提供甚麼產品及服務，以及何時推出。
交付渠道的說明應涵蓋每類產品或服務的完整渠道，包括指令處理，以及資金如何經過不同司法管轄區的每個外地代理人或外地金錢服務經營者。
就管理團隊及僱員兩類人員，計劃均須闡述人數、職位、角色及責任、全職或兼職，以及報告流程，作為各類人員組合的資料。
如申請人同時為其他本地金錢服務經營者或海外公司／商業實體擔任代理人，計劃須列出對方名稱，並闡述申請人擔任代理人的職能。
如申請人同時為其他本地金錢服務經營者或海外業務擔任主事人，計劃須列出對方名稱，並把申請人在該關係中的職能說明為代理人的職能。
如業務使用第三方支付平台或網絡，例如電子錢包，計劃須解釋該平台或網絡在申請人業務中所擔當的角色，作為業務關係資料。
notes: 正確：第7項同時要求產品及服務的類別，以及「推出此等產品及服務的時間表」。
正確：第7項要求完整交付渠道，包括如何處理指令，以及資金如何經過「每一個外地代理人或外地金錢服務經營者」。
正確：第12項在管理團隊及僱員兩部分均列出人數、職位、角色及責任、全職／兼職及報告流程。
正確：第15項要求提供其他本地金錢服務經營者或海外公司／商業實體的名稱，並闡述申請人擔任代理人的職能。
錯誤：第15項在主事人情境要求闡述申請人「擔任主事人的職能」，不能把該關係改寫成代理人職能。
正確：第16項以電子錢包作例子，要求解釋第三方支付平台或網絡在申請人業務中所擔當的角色。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.1(iii), ¶10.6, ¶11.2 and ¶12.2

en.q: Which statements about the responsibilities of persons involved in the Competence Assessment and its procedures are correct?
statements: An eligible person nominated for the Assessment is held accountable for the company’s compliance functions and systems, alongside the other requirements for that person’s senior-management role.
Once the answer script and related materials have been collected, a candidate may leave the Assessment centre without obtaining the invigilator’s permission for departure.
A candidate leaving early must make sure that the invigilator has collected the answer script and related materials on the spot before the candidate departs.
Before answering the questions, candidates must follow the Presiding Invigilator’s instructions to enter the required particulars on the multiple-choice answer sheet provided for the Assessment.
A candidate seeking re-checking of an Assessment result may address the written request to the Licensing Control Division, subject to the time limit specified in the Guidance Notes.
notes: Correct: ¶4.1(iii) adds accountability for the company’s compliance functions and systems to the other eligibility requirements.
False: ¶10.6 says not to leave without the invigilator’s permission. Collection of materials does not replace permission to leave.
Correct: ¶10.6 requires early leavers to ensure that the answer scripts and related materials have been collected by the invigilator “on the spot”.
Correct: ¶11.2 requires the particulars to be entered before going to the questions, as instructed by the Presiding Invigilator.
Correct: ¶12.2 names the “Licensing Control Division” as the recipient of the written request, within seven days after the result notification is issued.

tc.q: 以下有關能力評核及其程序所涉及人士的責任的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 獲提名應考的合資格人士，除須符合有關高級管理層角色的其他條件外，亦須對公司的合規職能及制度負責。
答卷及相關物品一經收回，應考者便可離開試場，無須另行取得監考員就其離場所給予的准許。
如應考者提早離開，必須在離場前確保監考員已即場收回答卷及相關物品，不能把物品留下而未確認收回。
作答前，應考者須根據主考員的指示，在能力評核提供的選擇題答題紙上填寫所要求的資料。
應考者如要求覆檢能力評核成績，可在《須知》所指定的期限內，以書面致函牌照管制課提出要求。
notes: 正確：第4.1(iii)段在其他資格條件以外，另要求該人「對公司的合規職能及制度負責」。
錯誤：第10.6段規定未獲監考員准許不得離場；收回答卷及物品不能取代離場准許。
正確：第10.6段要求提早離場者確保答卷及相關物品已「即場由監考員收回」。
正確：第11.2段要求「作答前」根據「主考員指示」在選擇題答題紙填寫資料。
正確：第12.2段指明可在發出成績通知當日起計7日內「致函牌照管制課」，以書面要求覆檢。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第6、9(b)(i)至(ii)及9(c)(i)、(iii)段

en.q: Under the Disciplinary Fining Guideline, which statements about setting a pecuniary penalty and assessing a contravention are correct?
statements: Although three times the profit gained or costs avoided is one alternative maximum, the CCE does not automatically link the actual fine to that profit or saving.
In assessing conduct after a contravention, the CCE considers whether the MSO attempted to conceal it; the factor is not confined to successful concealment.
After a contravention or possible contravention is identified, the CCE considers remedial steps, action against those involved, and steps to prevent similar breaches.
For the same incident, the CCE takes account of other relevant authorities’ punishment and regulatory action, including action likely to be taken but not yet taken.
When assessing compliance history, the CCE considers earlier similar contraventions by the MSO, particularly those for which it has already been disciplined.
notes: Correct: ¶6 distinguishes the alternative statutory maximum from the actual fine, which the CCE “will not automatically link” to profit gained or costs avoided.
Correct: ¶9(b)(i) asks whether the MSO “attempted to conceal” the contravention. A failed attempt is still an attempt.
Correct: ¶9(b)(ii) lists remediation, action against those involved and steps to ensure similar contraventions do not recur.
Correct: ¶9(c)(iii) includes punishment imposed and regulatory action “taken or likely to be taken” by other relevant authorities on the same incident.
Correct: ¶9(c)(i) includes previous similar contraventions, “particularly that for which it has been disciplined before”, in the relevant previous disciplinary record.

tc.q: 根據《紀律處分罰款指引》，以下有關釐定罰款及評估違規行為的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 雖然所獲利潤或所避免開支的三倍是其中一項罰款最高額，關長不會自動把特定個案的實際罰款與該利潤或節省的開支掛鈎。
評估金錢服務經營者作出違規行為後的表現時，關長會考慮其有否嘗試隱瞞違規行為；這項因素並不限於成功隱瞞的情況。
發現違規或可能違規行為後，關長會考慮有關補救措施、對涉事人士採取的行動，以及為確保類似違規行為不再發生而採取的措施。
就相同事件，關長會考慮其他有關當局施加的懲罰及監管行動，包括尚未採取但相當可能會採取的監管行動。
關長評估金錢服務經營者的合規情況時，相關過往紀律處分紀錄包括以前的類似違規行為，尤其是已因此遭紀律處分的行為。
notes: 正確：第6段區分罰款的法定最高額與特定個案的罰款額，訂明關長不會把實際罰款與所獲利潤或所避免開支「自動掛鈎」。
正確：第9(b)(i)段所列因素是有否「嘗試隱瞞」違規行為，並沒有要求隱瞞成功。
正確：第9(b)(ii)段列明發現違規或可能違規後的補救、向所涉人士採取的行動，以及防止類似違規再發的措施。
正確：第9(c)(iii)段包括其他有關當局就相同事件施加的懲罰，及「所採取或相當可能會採取」的監管行動。
正確：第9(c)(i)段包括過往類似違規行為，「尤其是因而遭紀律處分的行為」。

en.q: Which statements about the local place for storage of books and records (LPS) and the local management office (LMO) are correct under the Licensing Guide?
statements: Every applicant is required to have an LPS, including an applicant that will operate its money service at particular premises.
The LPS is a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records of the licensee's money service transactions.
The LPS must be under the licensee's control, so that C&ED officers have access to the books and records to perform their functions under the AMLO.
The CCE will not accept an MSO’s residential premises or its service provider’s premises, such as its accounting firm, as either its LPS or its LMO.
For both the LPS and LMO, the landlord’s permission to use the premises for money service business should appear in the tenancy agreement or a landlord’s letter.
A licence or renewal application missing required LPS information, or required LMO information where an LMO is needed, is deemed invalid and will not be processed by C&ED.
notes: Correct: ¶4.10 says that all applicants are required to have a local place for storage of books and records; the requirement is not confined to applicants without particular premises.
Correct: ¶4.11 describes the LPS as a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records in respect of its money service transactions.
Correct: ¶4.11 says the LPS must be under the control of the licensee so as to facilitate the C&ED officer's access to them to perform the functions under the AMLO.
Correct: ¶4.7 excludes the MSO’s residential premises and its service provider’s premises as an LMO; ¶4.11 applies the same exclusion to the LPS.
Correct: both ¶4.7 for the LMO and ¶4.11 for the LPS require the landlord’s permission, included in the tenancy agreement or a letter to the applicant.
Correct: ¶4.7 and ¶4.11 treat failure to submit the respective required information as an invalid application that C&ED will not process. The LMO condition applies when an LMO is required.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，以下有關本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點及本地管理辦事處的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 所有申請人均須有本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，包括擬在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人。
本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點是在香港用作儲存完整金錢服務交易帳目及紀錄的實體地點。
本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點必須由持牌人控制，以便海關人員前往有關地點執行條例賦予的職能。
金錢服務經營者的住宅或服務供應商處所（如會計事務所），均不獲關長接納為本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點或本地管理辦事處。
本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點及本地管理辦事處的業主准許使用處所經營金錢服務，應載於租約或給申請人的准許信。
申請時如欠所需的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點資料，或欠須設的本地管理辦事處資料，會視作無效而不獲海關處理。
notes: 正確：第4.10段訂明所有申請人必須有本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，並不限於沒有特定處所的申請人。
正確：第4.11段訂明本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點是在香港用作儲存完整金錢服務交易帳目及紀錄的實體地點。
正確：第4.11段訂明本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點必須由持牌人控制，以便海關人員前往有關地點執行條例賦予的職能。
正確：第4.7段不接納經營者的住宅處所及服務供應商處所作本地管理辦事處；第4.11段對本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點有相同限制。
正確：第4.7及4.11段分別對本地管理辦事處及本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點要求業主准許，並把准許載於租約或給申請人的准許信。
正確：第4.7及4.11段均把未提供所需資料的申請視為無效且不予處理；本地管理辦事處的要求按須設該辦事處的情況適用。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2025 (30 May 2025) ¶3 and Annex, Parts 1–2 (PDF pp.3–4)
source.tc: 香港海關通函MSSB/MIS_02/2025（2025年5月30日）第3段及附件第1至2部（PDF第3至4頁）

en.q: Regarding the transaction data in the revamped periodic return, which of the following are correct?
statements: Part 1 contains money changing data and excludes amounts involved in remittance transactions.
The amounts of foreign currencies in the money changing part are entered in ascending order.
In the remittance part of the revamped return, transaction amounts are entered in descending order.
The relevant delivery-channel ratios and customer-type ratios for remittance transactions must each total 100%.
The extra data helps track industry trends and formulate effective and appropriate regulatory measures.
notes: Correct: Annex Part 1 expressly excludes remittance amounts from the money changing data.
Incorrect: the Annex requires DESCENDING order, rather than ascending order.
Correct: the annotation beside Part 2 requires remittance transaction amounts in DESCENDING order.
Correct: Part 2(A) shows separate totals of 100% for delivery channels and customer types.
Correct: paragraph 3 gives these purposes for requiring the additional information.

tc.q: 關於修訂定期申報表內的交易數據，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 修訂定期申報表第1部只填報貨幣兌換相關數據，不包括匯款交易金額。
修訂定期申報表的貨幣兌換部分，所填報的外幣金額須由少至多輸入。
修訂定期申報表的匯款部分，所填報的匯款交易金額須由多至少輸入。
匯款交易所用交付渠道及服務客戶種類的相關比例，各自的總額必須為100%。
新增資料有助緊貼金錢服務業的最新趨勢，並制定有效和適當的業務規管措施。
notes: 正確：附件第1部明確排除匯款交易金額，只填貨幣兌換相關數據。
不正確：附件規定所有外幣金額由多至少輸入，而非由少至多。
正確：第2部旁的標註規定匯款交易金額由多至少輸入。
正確：第2部(A)分別列示交付渠道及客戶類別的總額為100%。
正確：第3段說明要求額外資料是為緊貼行業趨勢及制定有效、適當的規管措施。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2025 (30 May 2025), Annex, Parts 1(B), 2(D), 3–4 (PDF pp.3–5)
source.tc: 香港海關通函MSSB/MIS_02/2025（2025年5月30日）附件第1部(B)、第2部(D)及第3至4部（PDF第3至5頁）

en.q: Regarding the compliance and asset fields in the revamped periodic return, which of the following are correct?
statements: Both the money changing and remittance parts record the numbers of CDD conducted, EDD conducted and rejected transactions or cases.
The transaction monitoring part records how many suspicious transactions the company has reported to the JFIU.
The law enforcement request field counts letters of no consent, restraint orders or confiscation orders issued by the company.
The asset field asks for the estimated total assets of the company's money service business in Hong Kong as of the return's submission date, in HKD.
notes: Correct: the fields appear in Part 1(B) and Part 2(D); the English labels use rejected transaction and rejected cases respectively.
Correct: Part 3(A) asks for the number of suspicious transactions reported to the JFIU.
Incorrect: Part 3(B) counts the instruments issued under the relevant legislation and received by the company, rather than instruments the company issues.
Correct: Part 4 specifies estimated total assets of the company's Hong Kong money service business as of the submission date, in HKD.

tc.q: 關於修訂定期申報表內的合規及資產欄位，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 貨幣兌換及匯款部分均記錄執行盡職審查、執行更嚴格的盡職審查及拒絕交易或個案的數目。
修訂定期申報表的交易監察部分，須填報公司向聯合財富情報組報告的可疑交易數目。
執法機構要求欄位計算由公司發出的不同意通知書、限制令或沒收令數目。
資產欄位要求以港元填報公司在香港經營金錢服務業務截至申報表提交日期的估算資產總額。
notes: 正確：第1部(B)及第2部(D)均列有執行盡職審查數目、執行更嚴格的盡職審查數目及拒絕個案數目。
正確：第3部(A)要求填寫向聯合財富情報組報告的可疑交易數目。
不正確：第3部(B)計算公司接獲根據相關法例發出的不同意通知書、限制令或沒收令，並非公司發出的文件。
正確：第4部指定填報公司在香港經營金錢服務業務截至申報表提交日期的估算資產總額，並以港元計算。

source.en: Circular on Counter-Proliferation Financing (22 December 2021) p.1 ¶1–2
source.tc: 《打擊大殺傷力武器擴散融資通函》（2021年12月22日） 第1頁 第1至2段

en.q: An MSO reviews how the PF circular changes its risk assessment. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The new assessment requirement extends to proliferation financing rather than merely repeating ML/TF assessment.
The institutional PF assessment can omit existing customers because it is a requirement for new business only.
Identifying PF risks is followed by taking appropriate measures to mitigate the risks the assessment identifies.
The FATF guidance requires risk identification by member jurisdictions alone, leaving private firms outside it.
notes: True: p.1 ¶1–2 — The amendment added PF risk assessment.
False: p.1 ¶1–2 — A thorough review of all existing business and customers is expressly required.
True: p.1 ¶1–2 — Identification is followed by mitigation.
False: p.1 ¶1–2 — Both jurisdictions and private sectors are addressed.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者檢討擴散融資通函對風險評估的影響。以下哪些結論正確？
statements: 新增評估規定涵蓋擴散融資，而不只是重複洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集評估。
機構層面擴散融資評估可略去現有客戶，因為這項規定只適用於新業務。
識別擴散融資風險之後，須採取適當措施緩解評估所識別的風險。
特別組織指引只要求成員司法管轄區識別風險，私營機構不在要求之內。
notes: 正確：第1頁 第1至2段：修訂新增擴散融資風險評估。
錯誤：第1頁 第1至2段：明文要求全面檢視現有業務及客戶。
正確：第1頁 第1至2段：識別風險後須進行緩解。
錯誤：第1頁 第1至2段：要求同時涵蓋司法管轄區及私營機構。

source.en: Circular on Counter-Proliferation Financing (22 December 2021) p.1–2
source.tc: 《打擊大殺傷力武器擴散融資通函》（2021年12月22日） 第1至2頁

en.q: An MSO updates its PF procedures after the circular. Which proposed actions meet the circular?
statements: Use an effective, updated screening mechanism to follow the latest UNSC-designated persons and entities.
Report genuine designated-party hits found in transaction monitoring to the JFIU as soon as practicable.
Limit PF suspicious-activity reporting to name matches, leaving other suspicious PF activity outside the procedure.
Provide financial services to a designated entity if enhanced checking makes its assessed PF risk low.
notes: True: p.1–2 — The screening mechanism must be effective and kept updated.
True: p.1–2 — The circular requires prompt STRs for genuine hits.
False: p.1–2 — The duty also covers other suspicious PF activity.
False: p.1–2 — The circular states a prohibition in all circumstances; a low assessment is no exception.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者按通函更新擴散融資程序。以下哪些建議符合通函？
statements: 採用有效及適時更新的篩查機制，密切留意安理會最新指明人士及實體。
交易監察發現真正吻合指明各方的個案，須盡快向聯合財富情報組報告。
把擴散融資可疑活動報告限於姓名吻合，其他可疑擴散融資活動不納入程序。
如加強核查後把擴散融資風險評為低，便向受制裁指明實體提供金融服務。
notes: 正確：第1至2頁：篩查機制須有效並適時更新。
正確：第1至2頁：真正吻合者須盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告；責任與時間要求接續於第2頁。
錯誤：第1至2頁：責任亦涵蓋其他可疑擴散融資活動。
錯誤：第1至2頁：通函規定在任何情況下均不得提供；低風險評估並非例外。

source.en: Circular on United Nations Sanctions (7 February 2018) s.1 p.1
source.tc: 《聯合國制裁通函》（2018年2月7日） 第1條 第1頁

en.q: An MSO designs the scope of sanctions monitoring from the circular. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: Sanctions resolutions can target particular activities, including trade in certain commodities.
The published sanctions lists concern people and companies but exclude designated vessels.
Sanctions can respond to corruption as well as terrorism or weapons proliferation activities.
After receiving a list update, the MSO can wait for its next annual review before screening new designations.
notes: True: s.1 p.1 — The scope is not limited to named people.
False: s.1 p.1 — The lists may include vessels as well.
True: s.1 p.1 — The circular lists corruption among the relevant activities.
False: s.1 p.1 — Screen new designations as soon as practicable, not at an annual cycle.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者按通函設計制裁監察範圍。以下哪些結論正確？
statements: 制裁決議可針對特定活動，包括若干商品的貿易。
公布的制裁名單涉及個人及公司，但不涵蓋被指定的船隻。
除恐怖主義或武器擴散活動外，制裁亦可針對貪污活動。
收到名單更新後，經營者可等到下次年度檢討才篩查新指定各方。
notes: 正確：第1條 第1頁：範圍並不限於被點名的人。
錯誤：第1條 第1頁：制裁名單亦可包括船隻。
正確：第1條 第1頁：通函把貪污列為相關活動之一。
錯誤：第1條 第1頁：須盡快篩查新指定名單，並非等待年度週期。

source.en: Circular on United Nations Sanctions (7 February 2018) s.1 p.1 and Note 1
source.tc: 《聯合國制裁通函》（2018年2月7日） 第1條 第1頁 及 註 1

en.q: A new UN sanctions resolution is not yet implemented locally. Which conclusions follow from the circular?
statements: A time gap can arise between issuing a new resolution and putting it into effect through Hong Kong law.
During that gap, existing AML/CFT offences cease to be relevant to the activities in the resolution.
Overseas conduct can count as an indictable offence for proceeds dealing if it would be indictable in Hong Kong.
The overseas-conduct rule also requires that the conduct be illegal under the law of the place where it occurred.
notes: True: s.1 p.1 and Note 1 — The circular expressly recognises this time gap.
False: s.1 p.1 and Note 1 — Existing offences can still be relevant before local implementation.
True: s.1 p.1 and Note 1 — The footnote applies the Hong Kong-law test to overseas conduct.
False: s.1 p.1 and Note 1 — The footnote expressly disregards the foreign jurisdiction’s legal position.

tc.q: 新的聯合國制裁決議尚未在本地實施。按通函，以下哪些結論正確？
statements: 新決議發出與透過香港法例實施之間，可能出現時間上的落差。
在這段落差期間，現行洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集罪行不再適用於相關活動。
海外行為假若在香港發生會構成可公訴罪行，可納入處理得益的罪行範圍。
海外行為規則另要求有關行為在發生地的當地法律之下也屬違法。
notes: 正確：第1條 第1頁 及 註 1：通函明確認識到這個時間落差。
錯誤：第1條 第1頁 及 註 1：本地實施之前，現行罪行仍可適用。
正確：第1條 第1頁 及 註 1：註腳對海外行為採用香港法律測試。
錯誤：第1條 第1頁 及 註 1：註腳明文指不論當地法律觀點為何。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第2.3至2.4段、 第3.1段

en.q: Which conclusions correctly apply the licensing boundaries to these proposed businesses?
statements: A retailer accepting foreign currency as an ancillary part of its retail sales is outside the money-changing definition.
A hotel that sells foreign notes to guests qualifies for the hotel exclusion just because all customers are guests.
A Hong Kong business arranging receipt of money overseas can be remittance even without sending the money itself.
An applicant already exempt from the MSO licensing requirements cannot elect to obtain an MSO licence nonetheless.
notes: True: ¶2.3–2.4, ¶3.1 — The exclusion concerns a service ancillary to the principal business.
False: ¶2.3–2.4, ¶3.1 — The hotel exclusion is confined to purchasing foreign currency for Hong Kong currency, with the other conditions.
True: ¶2.3–2.4, ¶3.1 — Arranging overseas receipt is itself within the remittance definition.
True: ¶2.3–2.4, ¶3.1 — The CCE will not accept an exempt applicant’s application.

tc.q: 以下哪些結論正確把發牌範圍應用於這些擬議業務？
statements: 零售商在零售交易中附帶接受外幣，不屬貨幣兌換服務定義的範圍。
酒店只向住客賣出外幣鈔票，便因所有客戶均為住客而符合酒店排除條件。
在香港經營並安排於香港以外收取金錢，即使不自行送款也可構成匯款服務。
已獲豁免金錢服務經營者發牌規定的申請人，不能仍選擇取得該牌照。
notes: 正確：第2.3至2.4段、 第3.1段：這項排除適用於附帶主要業務的服務。
錯誤：第2.3至2.4段、 第3.1段：酒店排除只涵蓋以港元購入外幣，並須符合其他條件。
正確：第2.3至2.4段、 第3.1段：安排香港以外收款本身已屬匯款服務定義。
正確：第2.3至2.4段、 第3.1段：關長不會接納獲豁免申請人的申請。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第4.4至4.8段

en.q: An applicant combines home visits with a customer meeting room and another business. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: Calling the business a door-to-door service means a room advertised for meeting customers need not be registered.
A visit to an accountant solely to process the applicant’s accounts does not turn that office into business premises.
A clear partition permits the applicant to share its money-service premises with another MSO operating there.
Sharing with a non-MSO business requires the money-service business to be clearly partitioned and distinguished.
notes: False: ¶4.4–4.8 — The advertised customer meeting room is a particular-premises example.
True: ¶4.4–4.8 — Merely visiting for accounting or legal documentation is excluded.
False: ¶4.4–4.8 — Partitioning another business does not permit sharing with another MSO.
True: ¶4.4–4.8 — This is the stated condition for other business on the premises.

tc.q: 申請人同時提供上門服務、設有會客室並經營另一業務。以下哪些結論正確？
statements: 把業務稱為上門服務，即表示宣傳用作會客的房間無須登記為特定處所。
純粹到會計師行處理申請人的帳目，不會令該辦事處成為經營金錢服務處所。
只要設有明顯分隔，申請人便可與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所經營。
與非金錢服務業務共用處所時，金錢服務業務須設明顯分隔並清楚區分。
notes: 錯誤：第4.4至4.8段：宣傳用作會客的房間屬特定處所例子。
正確：第4.4至4.8段：純粹為處理會計或法律文件而到訪，屬排除情況。
錯誤：第4.4至4.8段：分隔其他業務並不代表准許與另一金錢服務經營者共用。
正確：第4.4至4.8段：這是在同一處所經營其他業務的規定。

en.q: An online-only MSO proposes a virtual address, residential record storage and a mixed-building backup office. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: A mail-forwarding address alone cannot meet the requirement for a physical local management office.
Keeping all records in the owner’s residential flat does not satisfy the accepted local storage-place requirement.
A mixed commercial-residential customer premises needs every occupant’s written consent for authorised inspection.
Landlord permission for money-service use should be recorded in the LMO tenancy agreement or a landlord’s letter.
notes: True: ¶4.6–4.7, ¶4.10–4.11 — The LMO is a physical office reachable in person and by telephone.
True: ¶4.6–4.7, ¶4.10–4.11 — Paragraph 4.11 says residential premises are not accepted as the LPS.
True: ¶4.6–4.7, ¶4.10–4.11 — Mixed-building premises require every occupant’s written consent.
True: ¶4.6–4.7, ¶4.10–4.11 — Paragraph 4.7 specifies these two documentary routes.

tc.q: 純網上經營者建議使用虛擬地址、住宅儲存紀錄及商住樓宇後備辦事處。哪些結論正確？
statements: 單憑轉寄郵件地址，不能符合設有實體本地管理辦事處的要求。
把全部紀錄存於東主的住宅單位，並不符合可接受的本地紀錄儲存地點要求。
商住混合樓宇的客戶交易處所，須獲每名佔用人書面同意讓獲授權人視察。
業主准許作金錢服務用途，應載於管理辦事處租約或業主發出的准許信。
notes: 正確：第4.6至4.7段、 第4.10至4.11段：本地管理辦事處須可供親身前往及電話聯絡。
正確：第4.6至4.7段、 第4.10至4.11段：第4.11段指住宅處所不獲接納為紀錄儲存地點。
正確：第4.6至4.7段、 第4.10至4.11段：商住混合樓宇處所須獲每名佔用人書面同意。
正確：第4.6至4.7段、 第4.10至4.11段：第4.7段列明這兩種書面方式。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第4.1至4.2段、 第5.7段

en.q: A corporate applicant has a non-shareholding director and a person controlling 30% of votes indirectly. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The director must undergo the fit-and-proper test even though the director owns no shares.
The indirect controller of 30% of general-meeting votes is an ultimate owner for licensing purposes.
Testing the voting controller allows the company to omit a different individual who meets another ultimate-owner limb.
Being fit and proper is required for association with the company’s money-service business, not only for frontline work.
notes: True: ¶4.1–4.2, ¶5.7 — Director status independently triggers the test.
True: ¶4.1–4.2, ¶5.7 — The voting-right test includes indirect control above 25%.
False: ¶4.1–4.2, ¶5.7 — Every qualifying ultimate owner must be covered.
True: ¶4.1–4.2, ¶5.7 — The corporate test concerns association with the business.

tc.q: 法團申請人有一名沒有股份的董事及一名間接控制三成投票權的人。哪些結論正確？
statements: 該名董事即使並無持有股份，仍須接受適當人選判定。
間接控制成員大會三成投票權的人，就發牌而言屬最終擁有人。
公司完成投票權控制人的判定後，可略去另一名符合其他最終擁有人條件的人。
適當人選要求關乎與法團金錢服務業務的聯繫，並非只針對前線工作。
notes: 正確：第4.1至4.2段、 第5.7段：董事身分本身已須接受判定。
正確：第4.1至4.2段、 第5.7段：投票權測試包括間接控制超過四分之一。
錯誤：第4.1至4.2段、 第5.7段：每名符合條件的最終擁有人均須接受判定。
正確：第4.1至4.2段、 第5.7段：法團測試涉及與經營業務的聯繫。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第5.4至5.5段、 第5.8段

en.q: A company sends an authorised employee to its licensing interview and submits witnessed declarations. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: Written board authorisation can permit a corporate applicant’s employee to attend the licensing interview.
The interview can require clarification of the business plan rather than being limited to checking identities.
A declaration witness can certify Appendix I after seeing only an emailed copy of the identity document.
The declarant may sign before meeting the witness if the witness later confirms the personal particulars.
notes: True: ¶5.4–5.5, ¶5.8 — Paragraph 5.5(c) permits this representative.
True: ¶5.4–5.5, ¶5.8 — The applicant must be able to explain the submitted material.
False: ¶5.4–5.5, ¶5.8 — The witness checks the original identity document.
False: ¶5.4–5.5, ¶5.8 — The witness must certify signing in the witness’s presence.

tc.q: 公司派獲授權員工出席發牌會面並遞交經見證的聲明。哪些結論正確？
statements: 董事局書面授權可讓法團申請人的員工出席發牌會面。
會面可要求澄清業務計劃，而不只限於核對身分。
聲明見證人只看過電郵寄來的身分證明文件複本，即可核證附錄。
聲明人可在會見見證人前簽署，只要見證人其後確認個人資料即可。
notes: 正確：第5.4至5.5段、 第5.8段：第5.5(c)段准許這類代表。
正確：第5.4至5.5段、 第5.8段：申請人須能解釋已遞交資料。
錯誤：第5.4至5.5段、 第5.8段：見證人須核對身分證明文件正本。
錯誤：第5.4至5.5段、 第5.8段：見證人須證明聲明人在其在場時簽署。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第6.2至6.4段

en.q: A licensee lodged renewal papers on time but missed the Assessment nomination deadline and supporting-document deadline. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: Timely filing of the main form alone does not cure failure to nominate an eligible person within seven days.
Missing the specified period for outstanding documents after a reminder can render the renewal invalid.
The invalid application automatically extends the existing licence until C&ED has time to process it.
The licensee must cease money-service operation when the existing licence lapses under these circumstances.
notes: True: ¶6.2–6.4 — The nomination failure is a separate invalidity ground.
True: ¶6.2–6.4 — Paragraph 6.4(b) treats this as invalid.
False: ¶6.2–6.4 — An invalid renewal does not preserve the licence beyond expiry.
True: ¶6.2–6.4 — Continuing unlicensed operation would be an offence.

tc.q: 持牌人準時遞交續牌表格，卻錯過評核提名及證明文件期限。哪些結論正確？
statements: 單是準時遞交主要表格，不能補救未於七日內提名合資格人士的問題。
收到催交通知後未於指明期限遞交尚欠文件，可使續牌申請無效。
無效申請會自動延長現有牌照，直至海關有時間處理為止。
在這種情況下現有牌照失效時，持牌人必須停止經營金錢服務。
notes: 正確：第6.2至6.4段：未有提名是獨立的無效申請原因。
正確：第6.2至6.4段：第6.4(b)段把此情況視為無效。
錯誤：第6.2至6.4段：無效續牌申請不會令牌照在期滿後繼續有效。
正確：第6.2至6.4段：繼續無牌經營即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第7.1至7.3段

en.q: A licensee passed its original checks, but a new occupant refuses inspection consent and its periodic return is late. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The new occupant’s refusal can support suspension or revocation despite the original consent having been obtained.
The late periodic return is also listed among possible grounds for suspension or revocation of the licence.
The licensee must be given an opportunity to be heard before the CCE revokes or suspends the licence.
An appeal can be made to the Review Tribunal within the stated period after the decision notice is sent.
notes: True: ¶7.1–7.3 — Paragraph 7.1(c) separately covers a new occupant.
True: ¶7.1–7.3 — Paragraph 7.1(f) expressly lists late returns.
True: ¶7.1–7.3 — Paragraph 7.2 requires the pre-decision opportunity.
True: ¶7.1–7.3 — Paragraph 7.3 specifies 21 days from sending the notice.

tc.q: 持牌人原先通過檢查，但新佔用人拒絕視察同意且申報表遲交。哪些結論正確？
statements: 即使原先已取得同意，新佔用人拒絕同意仍可成為暫時吊銷或撤銷理由。
定期申報表遲交，亦屬可能暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的列明理由。
關長作出撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的決定之前，須給予持牌人陳詞機會。
關長告知決定的通知送出後，可在所訂期限內向覆核審裁處提出上訴。
notes: 正確：第7.1至7.3段：第7.1(c)段另外涵蓋新佔用人。
正確：第7.1至7.3段：第7.1(f)段明文列出遲交申報表。
正確：第7.1至7.3段：第7.2段要求在撤銷或暫時吊銷前給予機會。
正確：第7.1至7.3段：第7.3段訂明通知送出後二十一日期間。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》 第8.1至8.4段、 第8.9段

en.q: A mobile-service licensee plans to open its first shop and appoint a new director. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The move to a shop requires the premises-addition application even though the licensee already holds a licence.
Submitting the premises form removes the need to submit a business plan and an updated AML policy.
The proposed director must submit a fit-and-proper declaration with the prior-approval application.
The licensee may start shop transactions while the premises application is awaiting the CCE’s decision.
notes: True: ¶8.1–8.4, ¶8.9 — The existing licence does not bypass prior premises approval.
False: ¶8.1–8.4, ¶8.9 — The change of operating mode requires these documents as well.
True: ¶8.1–8.4, ¶8.9 — The director application requires that declaration.
False: ¶8.1–8.4, ¶8.9 — Operation must await the addition of the premises to the licence.

tc.q: 流動服務持牌人計劃開設首間店舖及委任新董事。哪些結論正確？
statements: 即使已持有牌照，轉到店舖經營仍須提出加入處所申請。
遞交加入處所表格後，便無須另外遞交業務計劃及更新打擊洗錢政策。
擬任董事須配合事先批准申請，遞交適當人選聲明表格。
處所申請仍等待關長決定期間，持牌人可先開始在店舖進行交易。
notes: 正確：第8.1至8.4段、 第8.9段：現有牌照並不免除事先取得處所批准。
錯誤：第8.1至8.4段、 第8.9段：改變經營模式亦須遞交這些文件。
正確：第8.1至8.4段、 第8.9段：董事申請須有該聲明。
錯誤：第8.1至8.4段、 第8.9段：須待處所加入牌照後才可經營。

en.q: A licensee considers incorporation, a different service type, or closing its shop to become mobile-only. Which routes are correct?
statements: Changing the legal entity from a sole proprietor to a corporation requires a fresh licence application.
Changing from money changing to remittance requires a written submission with an updated plan and AML policy.
Closing the shop to operate without particular premises requires only a routine change-of-address notification.
The shop closure can first be reported within one month afterwards under the ordinary particulars-change deadline.
notes: True: ¶9.2–9.4, ¶10.1–10.2 — A change of legal entity requires a new application.
True: ¶9.2–9.4, ¶10.1–10.2 — The change of service nature requires this submission.
False: ¶9.2–9.4, ¶10.1–10.2 — Paragraph 10.1 requires cessation notification and a new licence application.
False: ¶9.2–9.4, ¶10.1–10.2 — Cessation has its own requirement to notify before the cessation date.

tc.q: 持牌人考慮改為法團、改變服務種類或關店改為純流動經營。哪些程序正確？
statements: 把法律實體由獨資經營者改為法團，須重新遞交牌照申請。
從貨幣兌換改為匯款，須遞交書面陳詞及更新的業務計劃與打擊洗錢政策。
關店改為沒有特定處所經營，只需作一般地址變更通知。
店舖停止經營可依一般詳情變更期限，在停業後一個月內才首次具報。
notes: 正確：第9.2至9.4段、 第10.1至10.2段：改變法律實體須重新申請。
正確：第9.2至9.4段、 第10.1至10.2段：改變服務性質須作出這項陳述。
錯誤：第9.2至9.4段、 第10.1至10.2段：第10.1段要求具報停業及提出新牌照申請。
錯誤：第9.2至9.4段、 第10.1至10.2段：停業有獨立要求，須於停業日期前具報。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》 第4.1至4.4段

en.q: A company wants to nominate its compliance manager and four directors for different Assessment sessions. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The compliance manager’s responsibility for compliance alone makes the manager eligible without being a director.
The company may nominate four individual directors provided they all take an active part in governance.
A nominated director must oversee operations, directly participate in policy decisions and be accountable for compliance.
Directors nominated under the same company application may split sessions to maintain business staffing.
notes: False: ¶4.1–4.4 — A corporate candidate must meet the defined director category and eligibility conditions.
False: ¶4.1–4.4 — The maximum is three directors.
True: ¶4.1–4.4 — Paragraph 4.1 sets all three eligibility requirements.
False: ¶4.1–4.4 — Company candidates must attend the same session in all circumstances.

tc.q: 公司擬提名合規經理及四名董事分開時段應考。以下哪些結論正確？
statements: 合規經理單憑負責合規的職務，即使並非董事也具備法團應考資格。
只要均積極參與管治，公司便可提名四名自然人董事應考。
獲提名董事須監督業務、直接參與政策決策並對合規負責。
同一公司申請下獲提名的董事可分開時段應考，以維持業務人手。
notes: 錯誤：第4.1至4.4段：法團應考者須符合所訂董事身分及資格條件。
錯誤：第4.1至4.4段：最多只可提名三名董事。
正確：第4.1至4.4段：第4.1段同時訂立這三項資格條件。
錯誤：第4.1至4.4段：同公司應考者在任何情況下均須同時段應考。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》 第5.3段、 第11.4至11.6段

en.q: Which conclusions correctly apply the Assessment marking and pass rules to these cases?
statements: A candidate scoring 30 overall but only two correct in one module fails despite the high total score.
A candidate scoring three in every module fails because the total does not reach the required 25 marks.
Marking two answers to one question earns no marks even when one marked answer is the correct answer.
A request to correct a misplaced answer after the Assessment time ends will not be considered.
notes: True: ¶5.3, ¶11.4–11.6 — Two correct out of five means three errors in that module.
True: ¶5.3, ¶11.4–11.6 — Seven modules of three correct total only 21.
True: ¶5.3, ¶11.4–11.6 — More than one mark invalidates that question’s answer.
True: ¶5.3, ¶11.4–11.6 — Corrections must be within the Assessment time.

tc.q: 以下哪些結論正確把評分及合格規則應用於這些情況？
statements: 總分三十分但其中一個單元只答對兩題，即使總分高仍不合格。
每個單元答對三題的考生，因總分未達二十五分而不合格。
一題填寫兩個答案，即使其中一個正確，該題亦不獲分數。
答題時間完結後才要求更正填錯位置的答案，將不獲考慮。
notes: 正確：第5.3段、 第11.4至11.6段：五題只答對兩題，表示該單元答錯三題。
正確：第5.3段、 第11.4至11.6段：七個單元各三題，總分只有二十一分。
正確：第5.3段、 第11.4至11.6段：一題填寫多於一個答案便不獲分數。
正確：第5.3段、 第11.4至11.6段：更正必須在答題時間內作出。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》 第10.6至10.9段

en.q: A candidate plans how to store a phone and retain notes during the Assessment. Which proposals comply?
statements: A switched-off phone can stay in a trouser pocket because it cannot make any sound during the Assessment.
A phone placed under the chair must remain uncovered and clearly visible to invigilators as well as switched off.
An unused answer sheet can be kept as a souvenir because the ban on removal concerns completed scripts.
Copying a question onto the invitation letter breaches the rules even if the candidate does not take the question book.
notes: False: ¶10.6–10.9 — Unauthorised devices cannot be kept on the body or in pockets even if off.
True: ¶10.6–10.9 — Visibility and switching off are separate requirements.
False: ¶10.6–10.9 — The removal ban covers both used and unused materials.
True: ¶10.6–10.9 — Copying onto the invitation letter is expressly prohibited.

tc.q: 考生計劃在評核時存放電話及保留筆記。以下哪些做法符合規定？
statements: 已關機電話可留在褲袋內，因為評核期間不會發出聲響。
放在座位下的電話須保持不受遮蓋、讓監考員看清楚，並關掉電源。
未使用的答題紙可留下作紀念，因為禁止帶走只針對已填寫的答卷。
即使沒有帶走問卷，把試題抄在邀請信上仍違反規則。
notes: 錯誤：第10.6至10.9段：即使已關機，未准許裝置仍不可放在身上或衣袋。
正確：第10.6至10.9段：保持可見與關機是不同要求。
錯誤：第10.6至10.9段：禁止帶走同時涵蓋已使用及未使用材料。
正確：第10.6至10.9段：規則明文禁止抄寫在邀請信上。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》 第12.1至12.5段

en.q: A candidate disputes a FAIL result and asks for a re-check and disclosure of the question paper. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The seven-day period for requesting a re-check runs from issuance of the result notification.
Re-checking includes technical problems such as incorrectly entered marks and inconsistent data.
An accepted re-check request entitles the candidate to see the exact score and the correct answers.
Even a final PASS after re-checking leaves the applicant subject to the other licensing requirements.
notes: True: ¶12.1–12.5 — The starting point is issuance, not the date the candidate chooses to read it.
True: ¶12.1–12.5 — These are the stated examples of technical errors.
False: ¶12.1–12.5 — No such disclosure entitlement arises.
True: ¶12.1–12.5 — Passing does not replace other licensing requirements.

tc.q: 考生不滿不合格成績，要求覆檢及披露試題。以下哪些結論正確？
statements: 要求覆檢的七日期限，從成績通知發出當日起計算。
覆檢包括輸入分數出錯及數據前後不一等技術問題。
覆檢要求獲接納後，考生有權查看實際分數及正確答案。
即使覆檢後最終合格，申請人仍須符合其他發牌規定。
notes: 正確：第12.1至12.5段：起算點是發出日期，不是考生選擇閱讀的日期。
正確：第12.1至12.5段：這些是所述技術錯誤例子。
錯誤：第12.1至12.5段：覆檢不會產生這種披露權利。
正確：第12.1至12.5段：評核合格不能代替其他發牌要求。

source.tc: 《適當人選補充指引》 第6(d)至(f)段、 第6(m)段、 第7段

en.q: A director faces an unresolved overseas charge and a good-faith customer complaint, while the licensed firm has been dormant. Which conclusions are correct?
statements: The unresolved foreign charge is irrelevant until it results in a conviction in a Hong Kong court.
A complaint about business conduct made reasonably and in good faith can be relevant without proving dishonesty.
A prolonged period of providing no money service can raise questions about genuine intention and readiness.
Failure on any one illustrative factor automatically requires the CCE to find that the director is not fit and proper.
notes: False: ¶6(d)–(f), ¶6(m), ¶7 — Unresolved charges in Hong Kong or elsewhere are expressly relevant.
True: ¶6(d)–(f), ¶6(m), ¶7 — The example does not require a dishonesty conviction.
True: ¶6(d)–(f), ¶6(m), ¶7 — This is the guideline’s express example of intention and readiness concerns.
False: ¶6(d)–(f), ¶6(m), ¶7 — Each case is considered on its merits, considering all relevant factors.

tc.q: 董事面對未結海外刑事檢控及真誠客戶投訴，持牌公司亦久未營業。哪些結論正確？
statements: 海外刑事檢控在香港法院定罪之前，與適當人選評估無關。
合理及真誠提出的經營行為投訴，即使未證明不誠實也可屬相關事宜。
長時間沒有提供金錢服務，可令人質疑真正經營意向及是否準備就緒。
任何一項示例因素不符合，關長便必須自動斷定董事並非適當人選。
notes: 錯誤：第6(d)至(f)段、 第6(m)段、 第7段：香港或其他地方尚未結案的檢控均屬相關事宜。
正確：第6(d)至(f)段、 第6(m)段、 第7段：這個例子並不要求不誠實罪行定罪。
正確：第6(d)至(f)段、 第6(m)段、 第7段：這是指引明列的意向及準備情況例子。
錯誤：第6(d)至(f)段、 第6(m)段、 第7段：須按每案特點考慮所有相關因素。

source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》 第7段、 第9(a)段、 第9(b)段、 第9(d)段

en.q: An MSO’s small repeated breaches caused no completed customer loss, and it promptly reported and remedied them. Which factors may the CCE consider?
statements: Several individually small issues may collectively justify a penalty even where one alone would not.
Potential customer loss can affect seriousness even where the threatened loss did not actually occur.
Prompt, effective and complete reporting to the CCE may be considered among the mitigating factors.
Remedial and prevention steps are relevant, and the firm’s financial resources also inform the penalty decision.
notes: True: ¶7, ¶9(a), ¶9(b), ¶9(d) — The guideline expressly allows collective assessment of smaller issues.
True: ¶7, ¶9(a), ¶9(b), ¶9(d) — Potential harm is expressly relevant.
True: ¶7, ¶9(a), ¶9(b), ¶9(d) — Reporting is a stated mitigating consideration.
True: ¶7, ¶9(a), ¶9(b), ¶9(d) — Paragraph 9(b) covers remedial steps; paragraph 7 covers size and financial resources.

tc.q: 經營者多次輕微違規但未造成實際客戶損失，並迅速報告及補救。關長可考慮哪些因素？
statements: 個別未足以罰款的多項輕微問題，合併考慮仍可能足以施加罰款。
即使未實際發生所涉損失，可能造成的客戶損失仍可影響嚴重性。
迅速、有效及完全地向關長報告，可納入求情因素考慮。
補救及防止重犯步驟屬相關因素，而財政資源亦會影響罰款決定。
notes: 正確：第7段、 第9(a)段、 第9(b)段、 第9(d)段：指引明文准許合併評估較輕微事項。
正確：第7段、 第9(a)段、 第9(b)段、 第9(d)段：可能損害屬明文相關因素。
正確：第7段、 第9(a)段、 第9(b)段、 第9(d)段：報告屬所述求情考慮因素。
正確：第7段、 第9(a)段、 第9(b)段、 第9(d)段：第9(b)段涵蓋補救，第7段涵蓋規模及財政資源。

source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》 項目 4、 7、 8、 16至17

en.q: An applicant uses an overseas back office and agent, no bank account, and a cash courier. Which disclosures belong in its business plan?
statements: The overseas back office’s purpose, function and location must be explained rather than omitted as offshore.
Information about the overseas agent used to transfer funds must be provided together with the service agreement.
The plan must explain how money services will be provided without a bank account rather than leaving this blank.
The identity of the cash-movement company or person must be included for local or cross-boundary cash movements.
If the applicant’s international group is supervised by another regulator, the plan must name that authority.
notes: True: items 4, 7, 8, 16–17 — Item 4 covers back offices in or outside Hong Kong.
True: items 4, 7, 8, 16–17 — Item 7 calls for the agent information and agreement.
True: items 4, 7, 8, 16–17 — Item 8 includes an express no-bank-account explanation.
True: items 4, 7, 8, 16–17 — Item 16 covers physical cash movement.
True: items 4, 7, 8, 16–17 — Item 17 includes supervision of the international group.

tc.q: 申請人使用海外後勤辦事處及代理人、沒有銀行戶口並聘現金運送者。業務計劃應包括哪些披露？
statements: 海外後勤辦事處的目的、職能及位置須予闡述，不能因位於香港以外而略去。
須提供用作轉帳的海外代理人資料，並一併提供有關服務協議。
計劃須解釋如何在沒有銀行戶口下提供金錢服務，不能把這部分留空。
本地或跨境現金流動所涉及的公司或人員，其名稱或姓名須列入計劃。
如申請人的國際集團另受其他監管機構監管，計劃須列明該當局名稱。
notes: 正確：項目 4、 7、 8、 16至17：項目4涵蓋香港境內及香港以外後勤辦事處。
正確：項目 4、 7、 8、 16至17：項目7要求代理人資料及協議。
正確：項目 4、 7、 8、 16至17：項目8明文要求解釋沒有銀行戶口的模式。
正確：項目 4、 7、 8、 16至17：項目16涵蓋實體現金流動。
正確：項目 4、 7、 8、 16至17：項目17包括國際集團所受監管。

source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》 引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16

en.q: An applicant adapts a generic AML policy to an online remittance business using overseas agents. Which revisions meet the submission guidelines?
statements: Base the policy on the applicant’s own risk assessment and make it fit the particular business risk profile.
Describe the proportions of face-to-face and non-face-to-face transactions along with the distribution channels.
Explain the procedure for monitoring whether the overseas agents comply with the company’s AML/CFT policy.
Limit the record-keeping description to transaction receipts because screening and customer-risk records are optional.
Explain training effectiveness checks that test staff understanding and their ability to recognise suspicious transactions.
Keep a training record of who attended, when training occurred and what type of training each member received.
notes: True: Introduction; items 3, 5, 10, 16 — A generic template requires business-specific adaptation.
True: Introduction; items 3, 5, 10, 16 — Item 5 requires the channel proportions.
True: Introduction; items 3, 5, 10, 16 — Item 10 expressly requires this monitoring procedure.
False: Introduction; items 3, 5, 10, 16 — Item 3 requires the description to cover all these record categories.
True: Introduction; items 3, 5, 10, 16 — Item 16 calls for effectiveness monitoring through these tests.
True: Introduction; items 3, 5, 10, 16 — Item 16 specifies these training record fields.

tc.q: 申請人把通用政策改為適合使用海外代理人的網上匯款業務。哪些修訂符合遞交指引？
statements: 以申請人本身的風險評估為政策基礎，並使政策與特定業務風險狀況相稱。
除描述分銷渠道外，亦闡述面對面及非面對面交易各自所佔的百分率。
闡述按甚麼程序監察海外代理人有否遵從公司的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策。
把備存紀錄描述只限於交易收據，因為篩查及客戶風險紀錄均屬自願提供。
闡述培訓成效的檢查方法，測試職員的理解及辨認可疑交易的能力。
備存誰人已接受培訓、何時接受培訓及各人所獲培訓類別的紀錄。
notes: 正確：引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16：通用範本須按業務具體情況調整。
正確：引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16：項目5要求交代渠道比例。
正確：引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16：項目10明文要求這項監察程序。
錯誤：引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16：項目3要求描述涵蓋這些紀錄類別。
正確：引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16：項目16要求透過這些測試監察成效。
正確：引言； 項目 3、 5、 10、 16：項目16訂明這些培訓紀錄內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.11至2.12段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the ML/TF risks of new products, new business practices and new technologies under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: An MSO should identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise in relation to the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms
An MSO should identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise from the use of new or developing technologies for both new and pre-existing products
The risk assessment should be undertaken prior to the launch of the new products or new business practices, or the use of the new or developing technologies
The MSO should then take appropriate measures to manage and to mitigate all of the risks that the assessment has in fact identified
notes: True: ¶2.11(a) states “the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms”.
True: ¶2.11(b) states “the use of new or developing technologies for both new and pre-existing products”.
True: ¶2.12 states “An MSO should undertake the risk assessment prior to the launch of the new products, new business practices, or the use of new or developing technologies”.
True: ¶2.12 states “should take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關新產品、新經營方法及嶄新科技的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 經營者應識別和評估因開發新產品及新經營方法（包括新交付機制）而可能產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
經營者應識別和評估因新產品及既有產品使用嶄新或開發中科技而可能產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
風險評估應在推出新產品或新經營方法，或使用嶄新或開發中的科技之前進行
金錢服務經營者其後應採取適當的措施，以管理和減低評估所識別出的各項風險
notes: 正確：第2.11(a)段列明「開發新產品及新經營方法，包括新的交付機制」。
正確：第2.11(b)段列明「新產品及既有產品均使用嶄新或開發中的科技」。
正確：第2.12段列明「金錢服務經營者推出新產品、新經營方法或使用嶄新或開發中的科技前，應事先進行風險評估」。
正確：第2.12段列明「並應採取適當措施管理和減低已識別的風險」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the customer risk assessment described in the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process determines whether any statutory CDD measures need to be applied, rather than the extent of the measures to be applied
The assessment is of no assistance in differentiating between the risks of individual customers and business relationships, since the same CDD measures are applied to every relationship
An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, an exercise usually referred to as a customer risk assessment
Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher, the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased
Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower, the information obtained and the extent of its verification may be simplified
notes: False: ¶2.13 states “The assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process would determine 9 the extent of CDD measures to be applied”. The assessment determines the extent of CDD, not whether any CDD measures need to be applied.

False: ¶2.13 states “The risk assessment conducted will also assist the MSO to differentiate between the risks of individual customers and business relationships”. The assessment assists differentiation; it does not require the same extent of CDD for every relationship.
True: ¶2.13 states “An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, which is usually referred to as a customer risk assessment”.

True: ¶2.13 states “the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which this information is verified, should be increased where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher”.
True: ¶2.13 states “It may also be simplified where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關客戶風險評估的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 在客戶盡職審查程序初期所作的評估，決定的是是否需要採取任何盡職審查措施，而非需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施
該評估無助於分辨個別客戶與業務關係所涉的風險，因為每項業務關係均採取相同的盡職審查措施
金錢服務經營者應評估與客戶或擬開展的業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，這類評估一般稱為客戶風險評估
如與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高，便需索取數量及類別更多的資料，並以更嚴謹的方式核實資料
如與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較低，金錢服務經營者則可簡化審查程序
notes: 不正確：第2.13段列明「在盡職審查程序初期所作的評估，將決定需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施」。評估決定需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施，並非決定是否需要採取任何措施。
不正確：第2.13段列明「評估風險有助金錢服務經營者分辨個別客戶與業務關係所涉的風險」。評估有助分辨風險，並非每項業務關係都採取相同程度的盡職審查。
正確：第2.13段列明「金錢服務經營者應評估與客戶或擬開展的業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，這類評估一般稱為客戶風險評估」。
正確：第2.13段列明「如果與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高，便需索取數量及類別更多的資料，並以更嚴謹方式核實資料」。
正確：第2.13段列明「如果與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較低，則可簡化審查程序」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.2段

en.q: Which of the following statements about what an MSO should do in relation to its AML/CFT Systems under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The purpose of the AML/CFT Systems is to enable the MSO to effectively manage and mitigate the risks that are relevant to the MSO
The AML/CFT Systems should be submitted to the CCE for approval before they are implemented by the MSO
The MSO should monitor the implementation of those AML/CFT Systems and enhance them if necessary
The MSO should take enhanced measures to manage and to mitigate those risks where any higher risks are identified
notes: True: ¶3.2(a) states “to enable the MSO to effectively manage and mitigate the risks that are relevant to the MSO”.
False: ¶3.2(a) states “have AML/CFT Systems, which are approved by senior management”. The approving actor is senior management, not the CCE.
True: ¶3.2(b) states “monitor the implementation of those AML/CFT Systems referred to in (a), and to enhance them if necessary”.
True: ¶3.2(c) states “take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate the risks where higher risks are identified”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者就其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應採取的行動的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的目的，是確保經營者能有效管理和減低與其相關的風險
打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應在該經營者推行前，呈交海關關長審批
該經營者應監察該等制度的推行情況，並在有需要時優化有關的制度
該經營者應在識別出較高風險時採取更為嚴格的措施，以管理和減低該等有關風險
notes: 正確：第3.2(a)段列明「確保金錢服務經營者能夠有效管理和減低與該金錢服務經營者相關的風險」。
不正確：第3.2(a)段列明「備有經高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。審批者是高級管理層，並非海關關長。
正確：第3.2(b)段列明「監察(a)項提及的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的推行情況，並視乎需要優化有關制度」。
正確：第3.2(c)段列明「在識別出較高風險時採取更嚴格的措施，以管理和減低風險」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the responsibilities of senior management, and the appointments it should make, under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: Responsibility for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems rests with the CCE rather than with the MSO's own senior management
Senior management should appoint a Compliance Officer at the management level within the MSO itself
The CO has the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
Senior management should appoint a senior staff member as the MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting
notes: False: ¶3.7 states “The senior management of an MSO is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems”. Responsibility rests with the MSO's senior management, not the CCE.
True: ¶3.7 states “the senior management should appoint a CO at the management level”.
True: ¶3.7 states “a CO at the management level to have the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems”.
True: ¶3.7 states “a senior staff as the MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者高級管理層的責任及其應作出的委任的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的責任，在於海關關長而非該經營者的高級管理層
高級管理層應委任一名屬該經營者管理層的人員，出任其合規主任一職
合規主任全面負責建立及維持該經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度
高級管理層應委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點
notes: 不正確：第3.7段列明「金錢服務經營者的高級管理層有責任推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險制度」。推行制度的責任在於金錢服務經營者的高級管理層，並非海關關長。
正確：第3.7段列明「高級管理層尤其應該委任一名屬管理層的合規主任」。
正確：第3.7段列明「委任一名屬管理層的合規主任，全面負責建立及維持金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。
正確：第3.7段列明「委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8段

en.q: Under the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following should senior management, as far as practicable, ensure in respect of the CO and MLRO so that they can discharge their responsibilities effectively?
statements: They should be appropriately qualified, with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge to discharge their responsibilities properly
They should be placed within, rather than independent of, the MSO's own operational and business functions, regardless of the MSO's size
They should normally be based in Hong Kong and be of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO
They should be capable of accessing, on a timely basis, all available internal information such as CDD records and external sources such as CCE circulars
They should be provided with an alternate or deputy who is appointed by the CCE rather than by the MSO's senior management
notes: True: ¶3.8(a) states “appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge”.

False: ¶3.8(b) states “subject to constraint of size of the MSO, independent of all operational and business functions”. The source calls for independence, subject to the MSO's size constraint, rather than placement within operational and business functions.
True: ¶3.8(c)–(d) states “normally based in Hong Kong; (d) of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO”.
True: ¶3.8(g) states “capable of accessing, on a timely basis, all available information (both from internal sources such as CDD records and external sources such as circulars from the CCE)”.

False: ¶3.8 states “senior management should, as far as practicable, ensure that the CO and MLRO are”. Senior management should ensure the arrangements, including cover under ¶3.8(h); the paragraph does not assign appointment of cover to the CCE.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，為使金錢服務經營者的合規主任及洗錢報告主任能有效履行職責，高級管理層應在切實可行範圍內確保以下哪些事項？
statements: 他們應擁有合適資格，並具備足夠的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識以履行職責
不論該經營者的規模如何，他們均應置於該經營者的營運及業務職能之內，而非獨立於該等職能
他們通常應長駐香港，並在該金錢服務經營者具有一定的資歷及權力
他們應能及時取得一切可得資料，包括客戶盡職審查紀錄等內部來源及關長通函等外部來源
他們應獲配替補人選，而該替補人選由關長而非由高級管理層委任
notes: 正確：第3.8(a)段列明「擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識」。
不正確：第3.8(b)段列明「獨立於所有營運及業務職能（視乎金錢服務經營者規模的限制）」。原文要求獨立於營運及業務職能，並保留經營者規模的限制，並非置於該等職能之內。
正確：第3.8(c)–(d)段列明「通常長駐香港； (d) 在該金錢服務經營者具有一定的資歷及權力」。
正確：第3.8(g)段列明「能夠及時取得一切可取得的資料（來自內部來源如盡職審查紀錄及外部來源如關長通函）」。
不正確：第3.8段列明「高級管理層應在切實可行的範圍內，確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任」。高級管理層應確保所列安排，包括第3.8(h)段的適當替補人選；原文沒有把委任替補人選的職責交予關長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the role and principal functions of the MLRO under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
The MLRO's functions include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and deciding whether a JFIU report is necessary
Oversight of the records of internal reviews of disclosures and exception reports is the Compliance Officer's responsibility
The MLRO's principal functions include oversight of the provision of guidance on how to avoid “tipping off”
notes: True: ¶3.10 states “An MSO should appoint an MLRO as a central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and also as the main point of contact with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) and law enforcement agencies”.
