True: ¶3.10(a) states “review of internal disclosures and exception reports and, in light of all available relevant information, determining whether or not it is necessary to make a report to the JFIU”.
False: ¶3.10(b) states “maintenance of all records related to such internal reviews”. Record maintenance is among the functions overseen by the MLRO, not a function assigned instead to the CO.
True: ¶3.10(c) states “provision of guidance on how to avoid “tipping off””.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關洗錢報告主任的角色及主要職能的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，也是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點
洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否須向財富情報組報告
監督備存內部披露及例外情況報告的覆核紀錄，屬合規主任的主要職能
洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督提供有關如何避免「通風報訊」的導引
notes: 正確：第3.10段列明「金錢服務經營者應委任一名洗錢報告主任作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，並作為與聯合財富情報組（財富情報組）及執法機構的主要聯絡點」。
正確：第3.10(a)段列明「覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並根據一切知悉的資料，決定是否有需要向財富情報組作出報告」。
不正確：第3.10(b)段列明「備存該等內部覆核的所有紀錄」。備存內部覆核紀錄屬洗錢報告主任監督的職能，並非改由合規主任負責。
正確：第3.10(c)段列明「提供有關如何避免「通風報訊」的導引」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.1段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the risk-based approach (RBA) to AML/CFT described in the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: An RBA means that jurisdictions, competent authorities and MSOs are expected to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks to which they are exposed
Under an RBA, an MSO takes AML/CFT measures commensurate with its ML/TF risks in order to manage and mitigate those risks effectively
An RBA allows an MSO to allocate its resources more effectively and to apply preventive measures commensurate with the nature and level of the risks
An MSO should adopt an RBA in the implementation of its AML/CFT Systems, the design of those Systems following the CCE's standard template
notes: True: ¶2.1 states “jurisdictions, competent authorities, and MSOs are expected to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks to which they are exposed”.
True: ¶2.1 states “take AML/CFT measures commensurate with those risks in order to manage and mitigate them effectively”.
True: ¶2.1 states “RBA allows an MSO to allocate its resources more effectively and apply preventive measures that are commensurate with the nature and level of risks”.

False: ¶2.1 states “an MSO should adopt an RBA in the design and implementation of its AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls”. The RBA applies to both design and implementation; the paragraph does not replace design with a CCE standard template.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關以風險為本的方法打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 採用風險為本的方法，意指預期司法管轄區、主管當局及金錢服務經營者要識別、評估和了解本身面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
在風險為本的方法下，金錢服務經營者採取與其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集措施，以有效管理和減低該等風險
風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者能夠更有效地分配資源，並採取與有關風險的性質及水平相稱的預防措施
金錢服務經營者在執行其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度時採用風險為本的方法，而該等制度的制訂則按關長的範本進行
notes: 正確：第2.1段列明「預期司法管轄區、主管當局及金錢服務經營者要識別、評估和了解本身面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。
正確：第2.1段列明「繼而採取與有關風險相稱的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集措施，以有效管理和減低風險」。
正確：第2.1段列明「風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者能夠更有效分配資源，並採取與風險性質及水平相稱的預防措施」。
不正確：第2.1段列明「當金錢服務經營者制訂和執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施」。制訂及執行制度均須採用風險為本的方法，並非以關長範本取代制訂時的風險為本方法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.2段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the institutional ML/TF risk assessment described in the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The institutional ML/TF risk assessment is an optional supplement to the RBA rather than the basis on which the RBA is built
The assessment enables an MSO to understand how, and to what extent, its own business is vulnerable to ML/TF
The assessment should identify, assess and understand the MSO's ML/TF risks in relation to its customers and the jurisdictions its customers are from or in
The assessment should identify, assess and understand the MSO's ML/TF risks in relation to the countries or jurisdictions the MSO has operations in
The assessment covers the MSO's products, services, transactions and delivery channels once the CCE has confirmed the scope of the assessment in writing
notes: False: ¶2.2 states “The institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA”. The assessment forms the basis of the RBA; it is not an optional supplement.
True: ¶2.2 states “enabling an MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF”.
True: ¶2.2(a)–(b) states “its customers; (b) the countries or jurisdictions its customers are from or in”.
True: ¶2.2(c) states “the countries or jurisdictions the MSO has operations in”.

False: ¶2.2(d) states “the products, services, transactions and delivery channels of the MSO”. These are part of the assessment without any condition requiring the CCE to confirm its scope in writing.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估屬風險為本方法的可有可無的補充，而非風險為本方法賴以建立的基礎
該評估讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響，以及所受影響的程度
該評估應識別、評估和了解該經營者與其客戶，以及其客戶所屬或所在的國家或司法管轄區有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該評估應識別、評估和了解該經營者與其業務所在的國家或司法管轄區有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該評估須待關長書面確認評估範圍後，才涵蓋該經營者的產品、服務、交易及交付渠道
notes: 不正確：第2.2段列明「機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估是風險為本方法的基礎」。機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估是風險為本方法的基礎，並非可有可無的補充。
正確：第2.2段列明「讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響，以及所受影響的程度」。
正確：第2.2(a)–(b)段列明「其客戶； (b) 其客戶所屬或所在的國家或司法管轄區」。
正確：第2.2(c)段列明「金錢服務經營者業務所在的國家或司法管轄區」。
不正確：第2.2(d)段列明「金錢服務經營者的產品、服務、交易及交付渠道」。產品、服務、交易及交付渠道均屬評估範圍，沒有須先由關長書面確認範圍的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(b)段

en.q: The AML/CFT Guideline has a paragraph listing the factors an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment. Which of the following statements about the country risk factors in that paragraph are correct?
statements: The country risk factors concern the countries or jurisdictions the MSO is exposed to, either through its own activities or through the activities of its customers
Particular attention is given to countries or jurisdictions with greater vulnerability identified by credible sources due to contextual and other risk factors
The prevalence of corruption, organised crime or TF in a jurisdiction is not among the contextual risk factors that the paragraph lists
The general level and quality of a jurisdiction's law enforcement efforts related to AML/CFT is listed as a customer risk factor rather than a country risk factor
The transparency of beneficial ownership in a jurisdiction is among the contextual risk factors that the paragraph lists
notes: True: ¶2.4(b) states “the countries or jurisdictions it is exposed to, either through its own activities or the activities of customers”.
True: ¶2.4(b) states “especially countries or jurisdictions with greater vulnerability identified by credible sources3 due to contextual and other risk factors”.
False: ¶2.4(b)(i) states “the prevalence of corruption, organised crime, or TF”. The paragraph expressly includes this prevalence among country risk factors.
False: ¶2.4(b)(ii) states “the general level and quality of the jurisdiction’s law enforcement efforts related to AML/CFT”. This appears under country risk factors, not customer risk factors.
True: ¶2.4(b)(iv) states “transparency of beneficial ownership”.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》其中一段列出金錢服務經營者進行機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估時應考慮的因素。以下有關該段所列國家風險因素的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 國家風險因素關乎該經營者所面對的國家或司法管轄區，不論是透過其本身的活動抑或客戶的活動
尤其須注意由可靠消息來源識別為因環境性及其他風險因素而具有較大漏洞的國家或司法管轄區
某司法管轄區貪污、有組織罪行或恐怖分子資金籌集的普遍程度，並非該段所列的環境性風險因素之一
某司法管轄區就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集所採取執法工作的水平及質素，被列為客戶風險因素而非國家風險因素
某司法管轄區在實益擁有權方面的透明程度，亦屬該段所列的其中一項環境性風險因素
notes: 正確：第2.4(b)段列明「所面對的國家或司法管轄區（不論是透過本身的活動抑或客戶的活動）」。
正確：第2.4(b)段列明「尤其是由各可靠消息來源3識別為因環境性及其他風險因素（例子如下）而具有較大漏洞的國家或司法管轄區」。
不正確：第2.4(b)(i)段列明「貪污、有組織罪行或恐怖分子資金籌集的普遍程度」。國家風險因素明確包括貪污、有組織罪行或恐怖分子資金籌集的普遍程度。
不正確：第2.4(b)(ii)段列明「有關司法管轄區就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集而採取的執法工作的一般水平及質素」。此項列於國家風險因素之下，並非客戶風險因素。
正確：第2.4(b)(iv)段列明「實益擁有權的透明度」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(d)段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the delivery or distribution channel risk factors that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment are correct?
statements: These factors concern the delivery and distribution channels through which the MSO distributes its own products or services
The extent to which the MSO deals directly with the customer, and the extent to which it relies on a third party to conduct CDD, are listed among the factors
The extent to which agent or counterpart networks are used is listed as a product, service or transaction risk factor rather than a delivery channel risk factor
The complexity of the payment chain, and of the settlement systems used among operators in the payment chain, is listed among the factors
notes: True: ¶2.4(d) states “delivery or distribution channel risk factors, for example, the distribution channels through which the MSO distributes its products or services”.

True: ¶2.4(d)(i) states “the extent to which the MSO deals directly with the customer, the extent to which the MSO relies on (or is allowed to rely on) third party to conduct CDD or other AML/CFT obligations”.

False: ¶2.4(d)(ii) states “the extent to which agent or counterpart networks are used”. Agent or counterpart networks appear under delivery or distribution channel risk factors, not the product, service or transaction category.
True: ¶2.4(d)(iii) states “the complexity of the payment chain and the settlement systems used among operators in the payment chain”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者在機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估中應考慮的交付或分銷渠道風險因素的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該等有關因素關乎該經營者藉以分銷其本身的產品或服務的有關交付及分銷渠道
該經營者直接與客戶往來的程度，以及其依賴第三者進行客戶盡職審查的程度，均列為該等因素
該經營者代理人或交易對手網絡的使用程度，列為產品、服務或交易風險因素，而非交付或分銷渠道風險因素
支付鏈的複雜程度，以及支付鏈中各經營者之間使用的交收系統的複雜程度，列為該等因素
notes: 正確：第2.4(d)段列明「交付或分銷渠道風險因素，例如金錢服務經營者藉以分銷其產品或服務的分銷渠道」。
正確：第2.4(d)(i)段列明「金錢服務經營者直接與客戶往來的程度；其依賴（或獲准依賴）第三者進行盡職審查或履行其他打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集責任的程度」。
不正確：第2.4(d)(ii)段列明「金錢服務經營者代理人或交易對手網絡的使用程度」。代理人或交易對手網絡的使用程度屬交付或分銷渠道風險因素，並非產品、服務或交易風險因素。
正確：第2.4(d)(iii)段列明「支付鏈的複雜程度，以及支付鏈中各經營者之間使用的交收系統的複雜程度」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(e)段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the “other risk factors” that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment are correct?
statements: The results of internal or external audits are excluded from the other risk factors, audit findings being reported directly to the CCE instead
The nature, scale and quality of the ML/TF risk management resources available to the MSO are given as an example of the other risk factors
The availability of appropriately qualified staff with access to ongoing AML/CFT training and development forms part of the risk management resources considered
Any compliance and regulatory findings that relate to the MSO itself are also given as an example of these other risk factors
notes: False: ¶2.4(e)(iii) states “results of internal or external audits”. Audit results are expressly included among other risk factors; reporting findings to the CCE is not a stated substitute.
True: ¶2.4(e)(i) states “the nature, scale and quality of available ML/TF risk management resources”.
True: ¶2.4(e)(i) states “including appropriately qualified staff with access to ongoing AML/CFT training and development”.
True: ¶2.4(e)(ii) states “compliance and regulatory findings”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者在機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估中應考慮的「其他風險因素」的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 內部或外部審計的有關結果並不屬其他風險因素，有關的審計發現會直接向關長匯報
該經營者可供運用的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理資源的性質、規模及質素，是本指引所舉其他風險因素的例子
是否具備可持續接受打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓並具合適資格的員工，屬所考慮的風險管理資源的一部分
有關該經營者的合規及監管方面的各項發現，亦是本指引所舉其他風險因素的例子
notes: 不正確：第2.4(e)(iii)段列明「內部或外部審計的結果」。其他風險因素明確包括內部或外部審計的結果；原文沒有以直接向關長匯報來取代考慮該等結果。
正確：第2.4(e)(i)段列明「可供運用的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理資源的性質、規模及質素」。
正確：第2.4(e)(i)段列明「包括可在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面持續接受培訓及進修並具備合適資格的員工」。
正確：第2.4(e)(ii)段列明「合規及監管的發現」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶2.6; C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_05/2021 (13 Dec 2021) Note 1
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.6段；香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_05/2021（2021年12月13日）註1

en.q: Which of the following statements about the information that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, an MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment should consider are correct?
statements: The assessment should consider information from the MSO's own internal sources, external information being considered at the customer level instead
The assessment should consider both quantitative and qualitative information in order to identify, manage and mitigate the risks
The assessment may take into account relevant risk assessments and guidance issued by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities
The assessment may take into account Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment, and should take into account any higher risks notified to MSOs by the CCE
notes: False: ¶2.6 states “The institutional ML/TF risk assessment should consider quantitative and qualitative information obtained from relevant internal and external sources”. The institutional assessment considers relevant external as well as internal sources; external information is not reserved for customer-level assessment.
True: ¶2.6 states “quantitative and qualitative information obtained from relevant internal and external sources to identify, manage and mitigate the risks”.
True: ¶2.6 states “This may include consideration of relevant risk assessments and guidance by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities from time to time”.

True: ¶2.6 includes Hong Kong’s jurisdiction-wide assessment. Circular MSSB/MIS_05/2021 Note 1 says MSOs are required to “take into account higher risks identified, including higher risks notified to the MSOs by the C&ED”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者的機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估應考慮的資料的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 評估應考慮該經營者本身內部來源的資料，外部來源的資料則在客戶層面考慮
評估應考慮數量及質量兩方面的分析資料，以識別、管理及減低有關風險
評估可考慮財務行動特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局發出的相關風險評估及導引
評估可考慮香港在司法管轄區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，並應顧及關長通報的任何較高風險
notes: 不正確：第2.6段列明「機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估應顧及從相關的內部與外部來源取得的數量及質量分析資料」。機構層面的評估同時顧及相關內部與外部來源，並非把外部資料留待客戶層面評估。
正確：第2.6段列明「從相關的內部與外部來源取得的數量及質量分析資料，以識別、管理及減低風險」。
正確：第2.6段列明「此過程可能包括考慮由特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關風險評估及導引」。
正確：第2.6段包括香港在司法管轄區層面的風險評估。2021年12月13日交付渠道通函註1要求經營者「須顧及」較高風險，包括「海關向金錢服務經營者通報的較高風險」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.8段

en.q: An MSO is part of a financial group whose group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment adequately reflects the MSO’s local ML/TF risks. Which statements about relying on that assessment are correct?
statements: It applies for the purposes of both the institutional ML/TF risk assessment in paragraph 2.2 and the group-wide ML/TF risk assessment in paragraph 2.7
It applies where the MSO is part of a financial group and a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment has been conducted
The MSO may make reference to, or place reliance on, the financial group’s group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment
Such reliance is permitted only where the assessment adequately reflects the ML/TF risks that are posed to the MSO in the local context
notes: True: ¶2.8 states “For the purpose of paragraphs [2.2] and [2.7]”.
True: ¶2.8 states “if an MSO is a part of a financial group and a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment has been conducted”.
True: ¶2.8 states “it may make reference to or rely on those assessments provided that the assessments adequately reflect ML/TF risks posed to the MSO in the local context”.
True: ¶2.8 states “provided that the assessments adequately reflect ML/TF risks posed to the MSO in the local context”.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者屬某金融集團的成員，集團或地區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估充分反映經營者在本地面對的風險。以下有關依賴該評估的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該項依賴為施行第2.2及2.7段（機構層面及集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估）而適用
該項依賴適用於該經營者屬某金融集團的成員，而在集團或地區層面已進行有關風險評估的情況
金錢服務經營者可參考或依賴所屬金融集團在集團或地區層面所進行的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估
惟有關評估須充分反映該經營者在本地層面所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，方可如此依賴
notes: 正確：第2.8段列明「為施行第[2.2]及[2.7]段」。
正確：第2.8段列明「如金錢服務經營者屬某金融集團的成員，而在集團或地區層面已進行洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估」。
正確：第2.8段列明「則該金錢服務經營者可參考或依賴有關評估，惟有關評估須充分反映金錢服務經營者在本地層面所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。
正確：第2.8段列明「惟有關評估須充分反映金錢服務經營者在本地層面所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.10段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the records of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment that an MSO should maintain under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The records should cover the risk factors that were identified and assessed in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment
The records should cover the information sources that were taken into account in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment
The records should cover the evaluation made on the adequacy and appropriateness of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
The records and relevant documents may be discarded once senior management has approved the results of the assessment
notes: True: ¶2.10 states “including the risk factors identified and assessed”.
True: ¶2.10 states “the information sources taken into account”.
True: ¶2.10 states “the evaluation made on the adequacy and appropriateness of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems”.

False: ¶2.10 states “An MSO should maintain records and relevant documents of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment”. The records and documents should be maintained; senior management approval is not permission to discard them.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者應備存的機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估紀錄的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 紀錄應涵蓋在進行該項風險評估時已識別及評估的各項風險因素
紀錄應涵蓋在進行該項風險評估時已加以考慮的各項資料來源
紀錄應涵蓋就該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的充分性及適當性所作的評估
有關的評估結果經高級管理層批准後，該等紀錄及相關的所有文件便可予以棄置
notes: 正確：第2.10段列明「包括所識別及評估的風險因素」。
正確：第2.10段列明「所考慮的資料來源」。
正確：第2.10段列明「就金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度是否充分和適當而作出的評估」。
不正確：第2.10段列明「金錢服務經營者應備存機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的紀錄和相關文件」。紀錄及相關文件應予備存，高級管理層批准評估結果並非棄置文件的許可。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.14段

en.q: Which of the following statements about finalising and maintaining the customer risk assessment under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The customer risk assessment should be finalised on the basis of a holistic view of all of the information that is obtained in applying CDD measures
The finalised assessment determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring, including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring
The finalised assessment plays no part in the MSO's decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate the business relationship
As the customer risk profile will change over time, the MSO should review and update the assessment from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring
notes: True: ¶2.14 states “Based on a holistic view of the information obtained in the context of the application of CDD measures, an MSO should be able to finalise the customer risk assessment”.
True: ¶2.14 states “determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring (including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring)”.

False: ¶2.14 states “support the MSO’s decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate, the business relationship”. The finalised assessment supports these relationship decisions; it is not unrelated to them.
True: ¶2.14 states “As the customer risk profile will change over time, an MSO should review and update the risk assessment of a customer from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者敲定及維持客戶風險評估的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 客戶風險評估應基於在採取客戶盡職審查措施過程中所取得資料的整體看法而敲定
敲定的評估決定持續監察的程度及類別，包括持續的盡職審查及交易監察
敲定的評估與該經營者就是否建立、繼續或終止業務關係所作的決定無關
由於客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，該經營者應不時（尤其在持續監察期間）覆核及更新該評估
notes: 正確：第2.14段列明「金錢服務經營者綜合審視在執行盡職審查措施期間所索取的資料後，應能據此敲定客戶風險評估」。
正確：第2.14段列明「評估結果將決定持續監察（包括持續的盡職審查及持續的交易監察）的程度和類別」。
不正確：第2.14段列明「並支持金錢服務經營者就建立、繼續或終止業務關係所作的決定」。敲定的評估支持建立、繼續或終止業務關係的決定，並非與決定無關。
正確：第2.14段列明「鑑於客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，金錢服務經營者應不時覆核和更新客戶的風險評估，尤以持續監察時為然」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.15段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the customer risk assessment framework under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: An MSO should adopt a risk-based approach in both the design and in the implementation of its own customer risk assessment framework
The complexity of the framework should be commensurate with the nature and the size of the MSO's business
The framework should be designed based on the results of the MSO's own institutional ML/TF risk assessment
The framework will in general include customer and country risk factors, product and channel factors being left to the institutional assessment
notes: True: ¶2.15 states “an MSO should adopt an RBA in the design and implementation of its customer risk assessment framework”.
True: ¶2.15 states “the complexity of the framework should be commensurate with the nature and size of the MSO’s business”.
True: ¶2.15 states “should be designed based on the results of MSO’s institutional ML/TF risk assessment”.

False: ¶2.15 states “the customer risk assessment framework will include customer risk factors; country risk factors; and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors”. Product, service, transaction and delivery channel risk factors also belong in the customer framework; they are not reserved for the institutional assessment.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關客戶風險評估框架的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 金錢服務經營者制訂及執行其客戶風險評估框架時，均應採用風險為本的方法
該框架的複雜程度應與金錢服務經營者所經營的各項業務的性質和規模相稱
該框架應根據金錢服務經營者機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的有關結果制訂
該框架一般包含客戶及國家風險因素，產品及交付渠道因素則由機構層面評估處理
notes: 正確：第2.15段列明「金錢服務經營者制訂及執行本身的客戶風險評估框架時，應採用風險為本的方法」。
正確：第2.15段列明「框架的複雜程度亦應與金錢服務經營者業務的性質和規模相稱」。
正確：第2.15段列明「並應根據金錢服務經營者在機構層面進行洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果制訂」。
不正確：第2.15段列明「客戶風險評估框架會包含客戶風險因素；國家風險因素；以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道的風險因素」。客戶風險評估框架亦包含產品、服務、交易或交付渠道風險因素，並非留待機構層面的評估處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the conditions under which the AML/CFT Guideline allows the nature, scale and complexity of an MSO's AML/CFT Systems to be simplified are correct?
statements: The MSO must comply with the statutory requirements in Schedule 2 to the AMLO and those in paragraphs 2.2, 2.3 and 3.2 of the Guideline
The lower ML/TF risks relied on may be assumed from the MSO's small size, without being identified through any risk assessment
The simplified AML/CFT Systems must be approved by senior management and be subject to review from time to time
The AML/CFT Systems are never permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML or TF
notes: True: ¶3.3(a) states “an MSO complies with the statutory requirements set out in the Schedule 2 to the AMLO and the requirements set out in paragraphs [2.2], [2.3] and [3.2]”.

False: ¶3.3(b) states “the lower ML/TF risks which form the basis for doing so have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment”. Lower risks must be identified through an appropriate risk assessment, not assumed solely from the MSO's size.
True: ¶3.3(c) states “simplified AML/CFT Systems, which are approved by senior management, are subject to review from time to time”.
True: ¶3.3 states “AML/CFT Systems are not permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關可簡化金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的性質、規模及複雜程度的條件的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該經營者須遵從《打擊洗錢條例》附表2所訂的法定規定，以及《指引》第2.2、2.3及3.2段的規定
作為簡化基礎的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，可從該經營者規模較小推定，而無須透過任何風險評估識別
簡化了的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度須經高級管理層審批，並須不時接受覆核
凡有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，一律不准簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度
notes: 正確：第3.3(a)段列明「金錢服務經營者符合打擊洗錢條例附表2載列的法定規定及第[2.2]、[2.3]及[3.2]段載列的規定」。
不正確：第3.3(b)段列明「基於適當的風險評估（例如機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估）識別出較低的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險而進行簡化」。較低風險須透過適當的風險評估識別，並非單憑經營者規模較小推定。
正確：第3.3(c)段列明「不時覆核經高級管理層審批的簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。
正確：第3.3段列明「如懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況，則不准簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.5 and footnote 9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.5段及註腳9

en.q: Which of the following statements about the compliance management arrangements that an MSO should have under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The arrangements should facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with its relevant legal and regulatory obligations
The arrangements should also facilitate the MSO in managing its own ML/TF risks in an effective way and manner
At a minimum, the arrangements should include oversight by the MSO's senior management and the appointment of a CO and an MLRO
Depending on the size of the MSO, the functions of the CO and the MLRO may be performed by the same person
notes: True: ¶3.5 states “facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations”.
True: ¶3.5 states “as well as to manage ML/TF risks effectively”.
True: ¶3.5 requires the arrangements to “at a minimum, include oversight by the MSO’s senior management”, together with appointment of a CO and an MLRO.
True: footnote 9 to ¶3.5 states “Depending on the size of an MSO, the functions of CO and MLRO may be performed by the same person”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者應有的合規管理安排的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該等安排應便利該經營者推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以履行其相關法律及監管責任
該等安排亦應便利該經營者有效管理其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該等安排最低限度應包括由該經營者的高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任
視乎該經營者的規模，合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人執行
notes: 正確：第3.5段列明「以便金錢服務經營者推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以履行相關法律及監管責任」。
正確：第3.5段要求合規管理安排有助「有效管理」洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
正確：第3.5段列明「合規管理安排最低限度應包括由金錢服務經營者的高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任」。
正確：第3.5段註腳9列明「合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人執行，視乎金錢服務經營者的規模而定」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.6段

en.q: Which of the following statements about senior management oversight under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: Effective management of ML/TF risk requires adequate governance arrangements to be put in place within the MSO
The board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, and the senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks
The board, or its delegated committee, and senior management should ensure the MSO's ML/TF risks are adequately managed
Management information on ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated to senior management in a timely, complete and accurate manner
notes: Correct: ¶3.6 states “Effective ML/TF risk management requires adequate governance arrangements”.
Correct: ¶3.6 states “The board of directors or its delegated committee (where applicable), and senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks”.

Correct: ¶3.6 states “The board of directors or its delegated committee (where applicable), and senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks and ensure that the risks are adequately managed”.
Correct: ¶3.6 states “Management information regarding ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated to them in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關高級管理層監督的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 要有效管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，金錢服務經營者必須在其機構內作出適當的管治安排
金錢服務經營者的董事會（或獲其授權的委員會，如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解該經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
董事會或獲其授權的委員會及高級管理層應確保已妥善管理金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的管理資料，應以合時、完整及準確方式通知高級管理層
notes: 正確：第3.6段訂明「要有效管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，必須作出適當的管治安排」。
正確：第3.6段訂明「金錢服務經營者的董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。
正確：第3.6段訂明「金錢服務經營者的董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並確保已妥善管理有關風險」。
正確：第3.6段訂明「關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9段

en.q: Which of the following are responsibilities that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, the Compliance Officer should assume?
statements: Developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory requirements and are effective
Overseeing all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including monitoring their effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary
Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including, where appropriate, significant compliance deficiencies
Ensuring that the AML/CFT training provided to the staff of the MSO is adequate, appropriate and effective
notes: Correct: ¶3.9(a) states “to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory and regulatory requirements and are effective in managing ML/TF risks arising from the MSO’s business”.
Correct: ¶3.9(b) states “overseeing all aspects of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems which include monitoring effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary”.
Correct: ¶3.9(c) states “communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including, where appropriate, significant compliance deficiencies”.
Correct: ¶3.9(d) states “ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下哪些是合規主任應承擔的職責？
statements: 制定及／或持續覆核金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以確保其反映現況、符合現行法定規定並且有效
監督金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的所有方面，包括監察其成效並在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序
與高級管理層就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的主要問題進行溝通，包括（如適用）重大的合規不足情況
確保向金錢服務經營者的職員所提供的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓充足、適當及有效
notes: 正確：第3.9(a)段訂明「以確保制度反映現況及符合當前的法定及監管規定，並能有效管理金錢服務經營者的業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。
正確：第3.9(b)段訂明「全方位監督金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括監察成效及在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序」。
正確：第3.9(c)段訂明「與高級管理層就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的主要問題進行溝通，包括（如適用）重大的合規不足情況」。
正確：第3.9(d)段訂明「確保打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的職員培訓充足、適當及有效」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.11段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the independent audit function that an MSO should establish under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
The audit function should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO
The audit function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities
The audit function's reviews are carried out under the direction of the Compliance Officer, to whom the function reports
notes: Correct: ¶3.11 states “An MSO should establish an independent audit function which should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO. The function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities, including independent reviews of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems”.
Correct: ¶3.11 states “which should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO”.
Correct: ¶3.11 states “The function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities”.

False: ¶3.11 states “An MSO should establish an independent audit function which should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO”. The function is independent and communicates directly with senior management; it is not a review function directed by and reporting to the CO.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者應設立的獨立審核職能的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核
該審核職能應設有與該經營者高級管理層直接溝通的渠道及途徑
該審核職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，以使其能夠履行其職責
該審核職能的有關覆核在合規主任的指示下進行，並向合規主任作出匯報
notes: 正確：第3.11段訂明「金錢服務經營者應設立獨立的審核職能。這職能應能與金錢服務經營者的高級管理層直接溝通。此職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，讓其履行職責，包括對金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作出獨立覆核」。
正確：第3.11段訂明「這職能應能與金錢服務經營者的高級管理層直接溝通」。
正確：第3.11段訂明「此職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，讓其履行職責」。
不正確：第3.11段訂明「金錢服務經營者應設立獨立的審核職能。這職能應能與金錢服務經營者的高級管理層直接溝通」。審核職能須獨立並能直接與高級管理層溝通，並非由合規主任指揮及向其匯報的覆核職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.12段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the audit function's regular review of the AML/CFT Systems under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The review should cover the adequacy of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, its ML/TF risk assessment framework and its application of the RBA
The review covers the effectiveness of the MSO's suspicious transaction reporting systems every third year rather than at each review
The review should also cover the effectiveness of the compliance function operating within the MSO
The review should cover the level of awareness of the MSO's staff who have AML/CFT responsibilities of their own
notes: Correct: ¶3.12(a) states “adequacy of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems, ML/TF risk assessment framework and application of RBA”.

False: ¶3.12(b) states “effectiveness of suspicious transaction reporting systems”. This is part of the regular review under ¶3.12; there is no exception allowing it to be reviewed only every third year.
Correct: ¶3.12(c) states “effectiveness of the compliance function”.
Correct: ¶3.12(d) states “level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關審核職能定期覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 覆核應涵蓋打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用情況是否合適
該項覆核每三年才涵蓋金錢服務經營者報告可疑交易的制度的有關成效，而非每次覆核均涵蓋
審核職能的覆核亦應涵蓋金錢服務經營者內部所運作的合規職能是否有效
覆核應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平
notes: 正確：第3.12(a)段訂明「金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用情況是否合適」。
不正確：第3.12(b)段訂明「報告可疑交易的制度是否有效」。這是第3.12段定期覆核的範圍之一，並無每三年才覆核此項的例外。
正確：第3.12(c)段訂明「合規職能是否有效」。
正確：第3.12(d)段訂明「職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.13段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the frequency and extent of the audit function's review of the AML/CFT Systems under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business
The frequency and extent of the review should also be commensurate with the ML/TF risks that arise from the MSO's own businesses
The review must be carried out by external parties whenever the MSO's own audit function has been in place for less than three years
Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review of its own AML/CFT Systems from any external parties
notes: Correct: ¶3.13 states “The frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of its business and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses”.
Correct: ¶3.13 states “The frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of its business and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses”.
False: ¶3.13 states “Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review from external parties”. The trigger is appropriateness, not an audit function established for less than three years.
Correct: ¶3.13 states “Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review from external parties”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關審核職能覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的頻密程度及範圍的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 有關覆核的頻密程度及範圍應與金錢服務經營者的業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱
覆核的頻密程度及範圍亦應與金錢服務經營者的業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱
凡金錢服務經營者本身的審核職能設立不足三年，有關的覆核均須由外界人士進行，而非由內部職能進行
在適當情況下，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度進行覆核
notes: 正確：第3.13段訂明「覆核的頻密程度及範圍應與金錢服務經營者的業務性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱」。
正確：第3.13段訂明「覆核的頻密程度及範圍應與金錢服務經營者的業務性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱」。
不正確：第3.13段訂明「在適當情況下，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界進行覆核」。條件是「在適當情況下」，並非審核職能設立不足三年。
正確：第3.13段訂明「在適當情況下，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界進行覆核」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.4、3.14段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the AML/CFT Systems that an MSO should implement under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The Systems should be implemented having regard to the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's businesses and the ML/TF risks arising from them
The Systems should also include appropriate compliance management arrangements and an independent audit function of the MSO's own
The Systems should include procedures for the screening of the MSO's employees before their appointment
An ongoing employee training programme is not one of the elements that the AML/CFT Systems should include
notes: Correct: ¶3.4 states “An MSO should implement AML/CFT Systems having regard to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses”.
Correct: ¶3.4(a)–(b) states “(a) compliance management arrangements; (b) an independent audit function”.
Correct: ¶3.14 states “An MSO should have adequate and appropriate screening procedures in order to ensure high standards when hiring employees”.
False: ¶3.4(d) states “an ongoing employee training programme”. The programme is expressly included, so excluding it reverses the requirement.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者應推行的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 推行該等制度時，應顧及該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及所引致的風險
該等制度亦應包括適當的合規管理方面的安排，以及其本身的獨立審核職能
該等制度應包括在委任之前甄選該經營者各名僱員的相關程序
持續的僱員培訓計劃，並非該等制度應予包括的其中一項要素
notes: 正確：第3.4段訂明「金錢服務經營者應顧及本身的業務性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。
正確：第3.4(a)–(b)段訂明「(a) 合規管理安排； (b) 獨立的審核職能」。
正確：第3.14段訂明「金錢服務經營者應設立妥善而適當的甄選程序，確保聘用僱員時採用崇高標準」。
不正確：第3.4(d)段訂明「持續的僱員培訓計劃」。該段明確列出持續培訓計劃，把它排除是顛倒規定。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.15, ¶3.18; AMLO Sch. 2, s.22(1)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.15及3.18段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條

en.q: Which of the following statements about the requirement for group-wide AML/CFT Systems under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The requirement applies to every MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings, whether or not the MSO is incorporated in Hong Kong
It applies where the overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO
Subject to host laws and regulations, group-wide Systems should apply the Guideline's relevant and applicable requirements to all overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings in the financial group
Where a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ, the MSO should require the branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets, so far as host laws permit
notes: False: AMLO Sch. 2 s.22(1) states “A financial institution that is incorporated in Hong Kong or is a re-domiciled entity must ensure that”. The statutory scope is Hong Kong incorporation or re-domiciliation; it does not extend indiscriminately to every MSO with overseas operations.

Correct: ¶3.15 states “a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution (FI) as defined in the AMLO should implement group-wide AML/CFT Systems”.

Correct: ¶3.15, ¶3.18 states “to all of its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings in its financial group, wherever the requirements in this Guideline are relevant and applicable to the overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings concerned”. This scope is subject to ¶3.18 and ¶3.19; ¶3.18 limits application to the extent permitted by host laws and regulations.

Correct: ¶3.18 states “the MSO should require that branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that host jurisdiction’s laws and regulations permit”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關集團層面打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的規定的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該規定適用於所有設有外地分行或附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，不論該經營者是否在香港成立為法團
該規定適用於外地分行或附屬企業經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的情況
在當地法律及規例准許的範圍內，集團層面制度應向金融集團所有外地分行及附屬企業執行相關及適用的指引規定
如所在的司法管轄區的規定有所不同，須規定分行或附屬企業在當地法律准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定
notes: 不正確：《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條訂明「在香港成立為法團或屬經遷冊實體的金融機構須確保」。法定範圍是在香港成立為法團或屬經遷冊實體，並非一概適用於所有設有外地業務的金錢服務經營者。
正確：第3.15段訂明「在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者如有外地分行或符合打擊洗錢條例所界定的經營與金融機構相同的業務的附屬企業」。
正確：第3.15、3.18段訂明「當本指引的規定關乎及適用於有關外地分行及附屬企業時，便應推行集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以便對所有屬其金融集團的外地分行及附屬企業執行本指引載列的所有相關規定」。此範圍受第3.18及3.19段規限；第3.18段以所在司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍為限。
正確：第3.18段訂明「則金錢服務經營者應規定該分行或附屬企業於所在的司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.16段

en.q: Which of the following statements about what the AML/CFT Guideline requires a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO to ensure in respect of its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings are correct?
statements: The duty applies to a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO and is discharged through its own group-wide AML/CFT Systems in place
It covers all of the MSO's overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings which carry on the same business as an FI as that term is defined in the AMLO
Those branches and subsidiaries should have procedures for CDD and record-keeping rules similar to Schedule 2 Parts 2–3, as far as local law permits
Those procedures must be applied in full regardless of what the laws and regulations of the place concerned permit
notes: Correct: ¶3.16 states “a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO should, through its group-wide AML/CFT Systems, ensure that all of its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings”.
Correct: ¶3.16 states “all of its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as an FI as defined in the AMLO”.

Correct: ¶3.16 states “have procedures in place to ensure compliance with the CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to those imposed under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of that place”.
False: ¶3.16 states “to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of that place”. Compliance is limited by what the local law permits, not required regardless of it.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者應就其外地分行及附屬企業確保的事項的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該責任適用於在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者，並透過其集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度履行
該責任涵蓋該經營者經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的外地分行及附屬企業
該等分行及附屬企業應設程序，在當地法律准許範圍內遵從與附表2第2及3部類似的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定
不論有關所在地方的法律及規例是否有所准許，該等有關的程序均須全面地予以貫徹實施
notes: 正確：第3.16段訂明「在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者尤其應該透過其集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。
正確：第3.16段訂明「確保所有外地分行及符合打擊洗錢條例所界定的經營與金融機構相同的業務的附屬企業」。
正確：第3.16段訂明「設有程序，確保與根據附表2第2及3部施加的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定在該地方法律及規例准許的範圍內獲遵守」。
不正確：第3.16段訂明「在該地方法律及規例准許的範圍內獲遵守」。遵從規定以當地法律及規例准許的範圍為限，並非不論當地法律均須全面實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the group-wide information-sharing measures that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO should implement are correct?
statements: The measures are required only to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of the jurisdictions that are involved in the matter
The measures are subject to adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of the information being shared, including safeguards to prevent tipping off
The measures should provide for the sharing of information required for the purposes of CDD and ML/TF risk management within the group
The group-level compliance, audit or AML/CFT functions should receive customer, account and transaction information from overseas branches when necessary for AML/CFT purposes
notes: Correct: ¶3.17 states “To the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of the jurisdictions involved”.
Correct: ¶3.17 states “subject to adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of information being shared, including safeguards to prevent tipping off”.
Correct: ¶3.17(a) states “sharing information required for the purposes of CDD and ML/TF risk management”.

Correct: ¶3.17(b) states “provision to the MSO’s group-level compliance, audit and/or AML/CFT functions, of customer, account, and transaction information from its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as an FI as defined in the AMLO, when necessary for AML/CFT purposes”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者應實施的集團層面資料分享措施的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 金錢服務經營者透過集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度實施資料共用措施，以所涉司法管轄區法律及規例准許為限
金錢服務經營者實施集團層面的資料共用措施，須妥善保障共用資料的保密需要及用途，包括設有防止通風報訊的保障
金錢服務經營者的集團層面資料共用措施，應涵蓋為客戶盡職審查及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理目的所需的資料
集團合規、審核或打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集職能應按打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集需要獲提供外地分行的客戶、帳戶及交易資料
notes: 正確：第3.17段訂明「在所涉司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內」。
正確：第3.17段訂明「並在妥善保障共用資料的保密需要及用途（包括防止通風報訊）的情況下」。
正確：第3.17(a)段訂明「為盡職審查及管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的目的共用資料」。
正確：第3.17(b)段訂明「在有需要時為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的目的，將金錢服務經營者的外地分行及經營與符合打擊洗錢條例所界定的金融機構相同的業務的附屬企業呈交的客戶、帳戶及交易資料，交予金錢服務經營者在集團層面的合規、審核及∕或打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集職能」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17段註腳11

en.q: Which of the following statements about the information to be provided to an MSO's group-level functions, as described in the AML/CFT Guideline, are correct?
statements: The information should include information and analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual, where such analysis was done
A suspicious transaction report, or the fact that one has been submitted, may be provided to group-level functions only after the JFIU gives its consent
The information could also include the underlying information that lies behind any such suspicious transaction report itself
Branches and subsidiary undertakings should likewise receive such information from the group-level functions when relevant and appropriate to risk management
notes: Correct: ¶3.17 footnote 11 states “This should include information and analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual (if such analysis was done)”.

False: ¶3.17 footnote 11 states “could include a suspicious transaction report, its underlying information, or the fact that a suspicious transaction report has been submitted”. The footnote permits inclusion of an STR or the fact of submission. It imposes no JFIU-consent condition; ¶3.17 supplies the legal and confidentiality safeguards.
Correct: ¶3.17 footnote 11 states “could include a suspicious transaction report, its underlying information, or the fact that a suspicious transaction report has been submitted”.
Correct: ¶3.17 footnote 11 states “Similarly, branches and subsidiary undertakings should receive such information from these group-level functions when relevant and appropriate to risk management”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關交予金錢服務經營者集團層面職能的資料的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該等資料應包括似乎異常的交易或活動的相關資料及分析（如已作這類分析）
可疑交易報告或已提交報告一事，須先取得財富情報組的同意，才可交予集團層面的職能
該等資料亦可以包括任何有關可疑交易報告背後所依據的相關資料
在與風險管理有關及適用的情況下，分支機構及附屬企業亦應從該等集團層面職能取得這類資料
notes: 正確：第3.17段註腳11訂明「此應包括似乎異常的交易或活動的資料及分析（如已作這類分析）」。
不正確：第3.17段註腳11訂明「亦可以包括可疑交易報告、相關資料或已提交可疑交易報告一事」。註腳容許包括可疑交易報告或已提交報告一事，並無財富情報組先同意的條件；第3.17段另訂法律及保密保障。
正確：第3.17段註腳11訂明「亦可以包括可疑交易報告、相關資料或已提交可疑交易報告一事」。
正確：第3.17段註腳11訂明「同樣地，在與風險管理有關及適用的情況下，分行及附屬企業應能夠從此等集團層面的職能取得這類資料」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.18段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the position under the AML/CFT Guideline, where a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ from those set out in the Guideline, are correct?
statements: The position concerns the overseas branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO and the jurisdiction in which it is located, referred to as the host jurisdiction
Where requirements differ, the MSO should require its branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher standard to the extent permitted by host laws and regulations
The branch or the subsidiary undertaking is required to apply the higher requirements to the extent that the host jurisdiction's own laws and regulations permit
Where the host jurisdiction's requirements are the less stringent of the two, the branch or subsidiary undertaking may choose to follow them instead
notes: Correct: ¶3.18 states “the jurisdiction where the overseas branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO is located (host jurisdiction)”.

Correct: ¶3.18 states “the MSO should require that branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that host jurisdiction’s laws and regulations permit”.
Correct: ¶3.18 states “apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that host jurisdiction’s laws and regulations permit”.

False: ¶3.18 states “apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that host jurisdiction’s laws and regulations permit”. The required comparison selects the higher standard where permitted; the branch has no general choice to adopt the less stringent host standard.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關所在的司法管轄區的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定與本指引載列的相關規定有所不同時的情況的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該情況關乎在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，以及其位處的司法管轄區（即所在的司法管轄區）
如兩套規定有所不同，金錢服務經營者應規定外地分行或附屬企業在當地法律及規例准許的範圍內執行較嚴格的規定
外地分行或附屬企業執行兩套規定中較嚴格的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定，以所在司法管轄區法律及規例准許為限
如所在的司法管轄區的有關規定是兩套規定中較為寬鬆者，外地分行或附屬企業可選擇改為遵從該套較寬鬆的規定
notes: 正確：第3.18段訂明「在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者的外地分行或附屬企業位處的司法管轄區（所在的司法管轄區）」。
正確：第3.18段訂明「則金錢服務經營者應規定該分行或附屬企業於所在的司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定」。
正確：第3.18段訂明「於所在的司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定」。
不正確：第3.18段訂明「於所在的司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定」。在當地法律准許的範圍內，須採用較嚴格的規定，分行並無任意改選較寬鬆的當地規定的權利。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.19段

en.q: Which of the following statements about what the AML/CFT Guideline requires where the host jurisdiction's laws do not permit the higher AML/CFT requirements to be applied are correct?
statements: The requirement applies where the laws of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements
The MSO informs the CCE of the failure in its next routine filing, having first recorded the failure and its causes in its own internal records
The requirements of particular concern are the CDD and record-keeping requirements that are imposed under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2
The MSO should take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking as a result of its inability to comply with the requirements
notes: Correct: ¶3.19 states “If the laws and regulations of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements”.
False: ¶3.19(a) states “inform the CCE of such failure”. The rule requires notification of the failure and does not grant a right to defer it until the next routine filing.
Correct: ¶3.19 states “particularly the CDD and record-keeping requirements imposed under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2”.
Correct: ¶3.19(b) states “take additional measures to effectively mitigate ML/TF risks faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking as a result of its inability to comply with the requirements”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關所在的司法管轄區的法律不准許執行較嚴格打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定時金錢服務經營者應採取的行動的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 有關規定適用於在香港成立為法團的經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，因所在地法律不准許而未能執行較嚴格規定的情況
該經營者會在下一次例行提交資料時將該情況通知關長，並先在其內部記錄該情況及其成因
尤其受關注的規定，是根據附表2第2及3部所施加的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定
該經營者應採取額外措施，以有效地減低分行或附屬企業因不能遵從該等規定而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
notes: 正確：第3.19段訂明「如在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者的外地分行或附屬企業因所在的司法管轄區的法律及規例不准許而未能執行較嚴格的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定」。
不正確：第3.19(a)段訂明「將有關不能遵從規定的情況通知關長」。規定是將不能遵從的情況通知關長，並無准許延至下一次例行提交資料的安排。
正確：第3.19段訂明「尤其是根據附表2第2及3部施加的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定」。
正確：第3.19(b)段訂明「採取額外措施，以便有效地減低該分行或附屬企業因不能遵從該等規定而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: Which of the following statements about keeping the institutional ML/TF risk assessment up-to-date under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The assessment should be conducted every two years, and also upon trigger events which are material to the MSO's business and risk exposure
A significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems is given as an example of a trigger event for such a review
The launch of new products and services by the MSO is not regarded as a trigger event for such a review
The results of the review should be documented and approved by the CCE rather than by the MSO's senior management
Significant changes of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts are given as examples of trigger events
notes: Correct: ¶2.9 states “an MSO should conduct its assessment every two years and upon trigger events which are material to the MSO’s business and risk exposure”.
Correct: ¶2.9 states “Trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems”.

False: ¶2.9 states “the acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels, the launch of new products and services by the MSO”. A launch of new products and services is expressly an example of a trigger event; the statement wrongly excludes it.
False: ¶2.9 states “Results of the review should be documented and approved by the MSO’s senior management”. Approval belongs to the MSO’s senior management, not the CCE.
Correct: ¶2.9 states “any significant changes of the MSO’s operational processes, target customers and business counterparts”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者使機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估反映現況的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 評估應每兩年進行一次，而當會顯著影響該經營者業務及所面對風險的觸發事件發生後亦應覆核其評估
嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，是本指引所舉觸發覆核的事件例子
金錢服務經營者推出新的產品及服務，並不視為觸發有關覆核的事件之一
覆核的結果應記錄在案，並由海關關長（而非該經營者的高級管理層）審批
該經營者的營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手有重大改變，是本指引所舉觸發事件的例子
notes: 正確：第2.9段訂明「金錢服務經營者應每兩年進行一次評估，而當會顯著影響該金錢服務經營者的業務及所面對風險的觸發事件發生後亦應覆核其評估」。
正確：第2.9段訂明「觸發事件可包括嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。
不正確：第2.9段訂明「收購新的客戶類別或交付渠道、金錢服務經營者推出新的產品及服務」。推出新的產品及服務明確列為觸發事件的例子，把它排除是顛倒原意。
不正確：第2.9段訂明「覆核的結果應記錄在案，並由金錢服務經營者的高級管理層審批」。審批者是金錢服務經營者的高級管理層，並非關長。
正確：第2.9段訂明「金錢服務經營者的營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手有重大改變」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.5段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the scale and scope of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The scale and scope of the assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's own business
Every MSO must adopt an equally sophisticated risk assessment process, whatever the size or complexity of its own business
For an MSO whose range of products and services is very limited, or whose customers have a homogeneous risk profile, a simpler risk assessment approach might suffice
Where an MSO's products and services are more varied and complex, or its customers have more diverse risk profiles, a more sophisticated risk assessment process will be required
notes: Correct: ¶2.5 states “The scale and scope of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO’s business”.

False: ¶2.5 states “For MSOs whose businesses are smaller in size or less complex in nature (for example, where the range of products and services offered by the MSO are very limited or its customers have a homogeneous risk profile), a simpler risk assessment approach might suffice”. The process is proportionate to the business; the same degree of sophistication is not required of every MSO.

Correct: ¶2.5 states “where the range of products and services offered by the MSO are very limited or its customers have a homogeneous risk profile), a simpler risk assessment approach might suffice”.
Correct: ¶2.5 states “more varied and complex, or the MSO’s customers have more diverse risk profiles, a more sophisticated risk assessment process will be required”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的規模和範圍的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 有關評估的規模和範圍應與金錢服務經營者本身各項業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱
不論業務的規模或複雜程度如何，每一金錢服務經營者均須採用同樣精密的風險評估程序
如金錢服務經營者所提供的產品和服務種類非常有限，或其客戶的風險狀況相若，較簡單的風險評估方法可能已足夠
如金錢服務經營者的產品和服務較為多樣及複雜，或其客戶的風險狀況差異較大，便須進行較為精密的風險評估程序
notes: 正確：第2.5段訂明「機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的規模和範圍應與金錢服務經營者的業務性質、規模及複雜程度相稱」。
不正確：第2.5段訂明「對於業務的規模較小或複雜性較低的金錢服務經營者（例如金錢服務經營者所提供的產品和服務的種類非常有限，或其客戶的風險狀況相若），較為簡單的風險評估方法可能已經足夠」。程序須與業務相稱，並非每一經營者均須採用同樣精密的程序。
正確：第2.5段訂明「例如金錢服務經營者所提供的產品和服務的種類非常有限，或其客戶的風險狀況相若），較為簡單的風險評估方法可能已經足夠」。
正確：第2.5段訂明「如金錢服務經營者的產品和服務較為多樣及複雜，或金錢服務經營者的客戶的風險狀況差異較大，金錢服務經營者便須進行較為精密的風險評估程序」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.16段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the records of customer risk assessments that an MSO should keep under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: An MSO should keep records and relevant documents of all the customer risk assessments that it conducts
The records should enable the MSO to demonstrate to the CCE, among others, how it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks
The records should show that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment
The appropriateness of the CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is to be demonstrated by reference to that particular customer's ML/TF risks
notes: Correct: ¶2.16 states “An MSO should keep records and relevant documents of its customer risk assessments”.
Correct: ¶2.16 states “so that it can demonstrate to the CCE, among others: (a) how it assesses the customer’s ML/TF risks”.

False: ¶2.16(b) states “the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on that customer’s ML/TF risks”. The benchmark here is that customer’s risk, not the institutional risk assessment.
Correct: ¶2.16(b) states “the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on that customer’s ML/TF risks”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者應就客戶風險評估備存的紀錄的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 金錢服務經營者均應就其所進行的每一項客戶風險評估備存有關的紀錄及相關的所有文件
該等紀錄應使該經營者能向海關關長證明（其中包括）它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該等紀錄應證明客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是否合適，並以機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估為基準
客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是否合適，須以個別客戶本身的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險為基準證明
notes: 正確：第2.16段訂明「金錢服務經營者應就客戶風險評估備存紀錄及相關文件」。
正確：第2.16段訂明「以便向關長證明（其中包括）：(a)它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。
不正確：第2.16(b)段訂明「基於該客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的」。此處的基準是個別客戶本身的風險，並非機構層面的風險評估。
正確：第2.16(b)段訂明「基於該客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.1段

en.q: Which of the following statements about an MSO's duty under Schedule 2 to the AMLO to ensure that proper safeguards exist, as described in the AML/CFT Guideline, are correct?
statements: An MSO must take such measures as the CCE directs in writing from time to time to ensure that proper safeguards do exist against ML/TF
One purpose of the required safeguards is to mitigate the risks of money laundering and terrorist financing
The safeguards are also required to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2
To ensure compliance with this requirement, the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA stated in paragraph 2.1
notes: False: ¶3.1 states “An MSO must take all reasonable measures to ensure that proper safeguards exist”. The duty covers all reasonable measures, not a set defined by the CCE’s written directions.
Correct: ¶3.1 states “proper safeguards exist to mitigate the risks of ML/TF”.
Correct: ¶3.1 states “to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2”.
Correct: ¶3.1 states “To ensure compliance with this requirement, the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA as stated in paragraph [2.1]”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者須按《打擊洗錢條例》附表2確保設有合適的保障措施的責任的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 金錢服務經營者須採取關長以書面指示的措施，以確保設有保障措施防範洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集
設有所需保障措施的目的之一，是減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集方面的風險
有關保障措施亦須用以防止違反附表2第2或3部所訂明的任何規定
為確保符合此項規定，金錢服務經營者應按第2.1段所述的風險為本的方法執行適當的內部制度
notes: 不正確：第3.1段訂明「金錢服務經營者必須採取一切合理措施，確保設有合適的保障措施」。責任涵蓋一切合理措施，並非以關長書面指示界定所需措施。
正確：第3.1段訂明「確保設有合適的保障措施，以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的風險」。
正確：第3.1段訂明「以及防止違反附表2第2或3部的任何規定」。
正確：第3.1段訂明「為確保符合此項規定，金錢服務經營者應依第[2.1]段所述按風險為本的方法執行適當的內部打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(a)段

en.q: Which of the following statements about the customer risk factors that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment are correct?
statements: Customer risk factors are among the range of factors that an MSO should holistically consider in conducting its institutional ML/TF risk assessment
The MSO's own target market and its own customer segments are given as an example of such a customer risk factor
The Guideline refers to the number of customers identified as high risk, but not to their proportion, as a customer risk factor
The customer risk factors listed in the Guideline are examples, so the factors an MSO considers are not confined to those listed
notes: Correct: ¶2.4(a) states “customer risk factors, for example”. Customer risk factors form part of the range of factors to be considered holistically in the institutional assessment under ¶2.4.
Correct: ¶2.4(a)(i) states “its target market and customer segments”.
False: ¶2.4(a)(ii) states “the number and proportion of customers identified as high risk”. The source includes both number and proportion; excluding the proportion narrows the factor.
Correct: ¶2.4(a) states “customer risk factors, for example”. “For example” introduces illustrations, not an exhaustive list.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者在機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估中應考慮的客戶風險因素的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 客戶風險因素屬經營者進行機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估時應全面考慮的因素之一
該經營者本身的目標市場及客戶類別，是本指引所舉客戶風險因素的例子之一
本指引只提及識別為高風險的客戶數目作為客戶風險因素，而沒有提及其比例
本指引所列的客戶風險因素只是一些例子，故該經營者所考慮的因素並不限於本指引所列者
notes: 正確：第2.4(a)段訂明「客戶風險因素，例如」。客戶風險因素是第2.4段機構層面評估時須全面考慮的一系列因素之一。
正確：第2.4(a)(i)段訂明「其目標市場及客戶類別」。
不正確：第2.4(a)(ii)段訂明「識別為高風險的客戶數目及比例」。原文同時包括數目及比例，排除比例便縮窄了考慮因素。
正確：第2.4(a)段訂明「客戶風險因素，例如」。「例如」引出例子，並非盡列無遺的清單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3、2.9段

en.q: Which of the following are among the appropriate steps that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, an MSO should take in conducting its institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
statements: Documenting the risk assessment process on the basis of quantitative analysis alone, without any qualitative analysis at all
Considering all the relevant risk factors before determining the level of overall risk and the appropriate level and type of mitigation
Obtaining the approval of the MSO's own senior management on the results of the risk assessment
Reviewing the institutional risk assessment after acquiring a delivery channel that materially affects the MSO's business and risk exposure
Having mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the JFIU, rather than to the CCE, when required to do so
notes: False: ¶2.3(a) states “supported by qualitative and quantitative analysis and information obtained from relevant internal and external sources”. Both qualitative and quantitative analysis are specified, so quantitative analysis alone is insufficient.
Correct: ¶2.3(b) states “considering all the relevant risk factors before determining what the level of overall risk is, and the appropriate level and type of mitigation to be applied”.
Correct: ¶2.3(c) states “obtaining the approval of senior management on the risk assessment results”.

Correct: ¶2.9 states “an MSO should conduct its assessment every two years and upon trigger events which are material to the MSO’s business and risk exposure. Trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO’s AML/CFT Systems, the acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels”.
False: ¶2.3(e) states “having appropriate mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the CCE when required to do so”. The recipient is the CCE, not the JFIU.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下哪些屬金錢服務經營者進行機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估時應採取的適當步驟？
statements: 記錄風險評估程序時以定量分析為基礎，而不進行定質方面的分析
在釐定整體風險水平及減低風險措施的適當程度及類別前，考慮所有相關的風險因素
就該項風險評估的結果，取得該經營者本身高級管理層的審批
收購新交付渠道顯著影響業務及風險後，覆核機構層面的風險評估
設有適當機制，在被要求時向財富情報組（而非海關關長）提供該風險評估
notes: 不正確：第2.3(a)段訂明「並輔以從相關內部與外部來源取得的定質與定量分析及資料」。須有定質與定量分析，僅有定量分析並不足夠。
正確：第2.3(b)段訂明「在釐定整體風險水平及擬採用何種程度和類別合適的減低風險措施前，事先考慮所有相關風險因素」。
正確：第2.3(c)段訂明「由高級管理層審批風險評估結果」。
正確：第2.9段訂明「金錢服務經營者應每兩年進行一次評估，而當會顯著影響該金錢服務經營者的業務及所面對風險的觸發事件發生後亦應覆核其評估。觸發事件可包括嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、收購新的客戶類別或交付渠道」。
不正確：第2.3(e)段訂明「設有適當機制應關長要求提供風險評估結果」。接收者是關長，並非財富情報組。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶2.4(b)–(c) and footnote 3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(b)至(c)段及註腳3

en.q: Which of the following statements about the country risk factors and the product, service or transaction risk factors that, under the AML/CFT Guideline, an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment are correct?
statements: Whether the volume and size of the MSO's transactions are in line with limits the CCE sets for MSOs is given as a product, service or transaction risk factor
The effectiveness of a jurisdiction's AML/CFT regulatory regimes and controls is among the contextual and other risk factors that can give it greater vulnerability
The extent of conducting occasional transactions is given as an example of how far the MSO's products and services are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse
The credible sources that identify jurisdictions of greater vulnerability may include the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the Egmont Group
notes: False: ¶2.4(c)(iii) states “whether the volume and size of its transactions are in line with the usual activity of the MSO and the profile of its customers”. The benchmark is the MSO’s usual activity and customer profile, not limits set by the CCE.
Correct: ¶2.4(b)(iii) states “the effectiveness of AML/CFT regulatory regimes and controls”.
Correct: ¶2.4(c)(ii) states “the characteristics of products and services offered, and the extent to which they are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse (e.g. the extent of conducting occasional transactions)”.

Correct: ¶2.4 footnote 3 states “such sources may include, but are not limited to, supra-national or international bodies such as the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者在機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估中應考慮的國家風險因素，以及產品、服務或交易風險因素的陳述，哪些是正確的？
statements: 該經營者的交易量及交易規模是否符合關長為金錢服務經營者所訂的限額，被列為產品、服務或交易風險因素之一
某司法管轄區打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集監管制度和管控措施的成效，屬可令其具有較大漏洞的環境性及其他風險因素之一
進行非經常交易的程度，被列為該經營者所提供產品及服務面對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度的例子
用以識別具有較大漏洞的司法管轄區的可靠消息來源，可包括國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特金融情報組織
notes: 不正確：第2.4(c)(iii)段訂明「其交易量及交易規模是否與金錢服務經營者的慣常活動及其客戶概況一致」。基準是金錢服務經營者的慣常活動及客戶概況，並非關長所訂限額。
正確：第2.4(b)(iii)段訂明「打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集監管制度和管控措施的成效」。
正確：第2.4(c)(ii)段訂明「所提供產品及服務的特點，以及它們所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度（例如進行非經常交易的程度）」。
正確：第2.4段註腳3訂明「這些來源可包括（但不限於）超國家或國際組織，例如國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特金融情報組織」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶2.4; Sample Questions MSSB/CA_01/2021, Example (1)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4段；參考試題 MSSB/CA_01/2021 例子(1)

en.q: Which of the following factors should be considered by an Money Service Operator (MSO) licensee in conducting the institutional money laundering and terrorist financing risk assessment?
statements: The MSO’s target market and customer segments
The profitability of the MSO’s business
The nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the MSO’s business
The delivery channels of the MSO
notes: Correct: ¶2.4(a) lists the MSO's target market and customer segments among the customer risk factors.
Incorrect: ¶2.4 lists customer, country, product, service or transaction, delivery channel and other risk factors; the profitability of the business is not among them.
Correct: ¶2.4(c)(i) lists the nature, scale, diversity and complexity of its business as a product, service or transaction risk factor.
Correct: ¶2.4(d) lists delivery or distribution channel risk factors, such as the extent to which the MSO deals directly with the customer.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者進行機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估時，應顧及下列哪種因素？
statements: 金錢服務經營者的目標市場及客戶類別
金錢服務經營者業務的盈利能力
金錢服務經營者業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度
金錢服務經營者的交付渠道
notes: 正確：第2.4(a)段把其目標市場及客戶類別列為客戶風險因素。
不正確：第2.4段列出的是客戶、國家、產品、服務或交易、交付或分銷渠道及其他風險因素，業務的盈利能力並不在其中。
正確：第2.4(c)(i)段把其業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度列為產品、服務或交易風險因素。
正確：第2.4(d)段列出交付或分銷渠道風險因素，例如金錢服務經營者直接與客戶往來的程度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8段

en.q: In order that the compliance officer (CO) and the money laundering reporting officer (MLRO) can discharge their responsibilities effectively, which of the following should senior management, as far as practicable, ensure?
statements: They are appropriately qualified, with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge.
They are independent of all operational and business functions.
They are of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO.
They hold a professional AML qualification recognised by the CCE.
They have regular contact with senior management and, when required, direct access.
notes: Correct: ¶3.8(a) asks that they be appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge.
Incorrect: ¶3.8(b) makes independence of all operational and business functions subject to the constraint of the MSO's size; without that qualifier the statement asks more than the Guideline does.
Correct: ¶3.8(d) asks that they be of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO.
Incorrect: ¶3.8 asks that they be appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge; it requires no qualification recognised by the CCE.
Correct: ¶3.8(e) asks that they be provided with regular contact with, and when required, direct access to senior management.

tc.q: 為使合規主任及洗錢報告主任能有效地履行他們的職責，高級管理層應在切實可行的範圍內確保下列哪些事項？
statements: 擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識。
獨立於金錢服務經營者的所有營運及業務職能。
在金錢服務經營者內部具有一定的資歷及權力。
持有關長認可的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集專業資格。
與高級管理層保持定期聯絡，並在有需要時能直接聯絡高級管理層。
notes: 正確：第3.8(a)段要求他們擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識。
不正確：第3.8(b)段訂明獨立於所有營運及業務職能須視乎金錢服務經營者規模的限制；漏了這個限定，陳述便超出指引的要求。
正確：第3.8(d)段要求他們在金錢服務經營者內具有一定的資歷及權力。
不正確：第3.8段只要求他們擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識，並無要求持有關長認可的專業資格。
正確：第3.8(e)段要求他們與高級管理層能夠保持定期聯絡，並在有需要時能直接聯絡高級管理層。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.1至2.2段

en.q: Regarding the risk-based approach (RBA) to AML/CFT, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO should adopt an RBA in both the design and the implementation of its AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.
The AML/CFT measures an RBA expects an MSO to take are commensurate with its ML/TF risks and are meant to eliminate those risks.
An RBA lets an MSO apply preventive measures commensurate with the nature and level of risks, so as to focus its AML/CFT efforts most effectively.
Jurisdictions, competent authorities, MSOs and their agents are all expected, under an RBA, to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks they face.
The institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA, enabling an MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF.
notes: Correct: ¶2.1 says an MSO should adopt an RBA in the design and implementation of its AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls, which the Guideline calls its AML/CFT Systems.
Incorrect: ¶2.1 says the measures commensurate with the risks are taken in order to manage and mitigate them effectively; the RBA does not set out to eliminate ML/TF risks.
Correct: ¶2.1 says an RBA allows an MSO to apply preventive measures that are commensurate with the nature and level of risks, in order to focus its AML/CFT efforts in the most effective way.
Incorrect: ¶2.1 says jurisdictions, competent authorities and MSOs are expected to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks to which they are exposed; an MSO's agents are not named.
Correct: ¶2.2 says the institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA, enabling an MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF.

tc.q: 關於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的風險為本的方法，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者制訂和執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施時，均應採用風險為本的方法。
風險為本的方法預期金錢服務經營者採取與有關風險相稱的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集措施，旨在消除有關風險。
風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者採取與風險性質及水平相稱的預防措施，以最有效的方式着力於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集工作。
按風險為本的方法，預期要識別、評估和了解本身所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險者，包括司法管轄區、主管當局、金錢服務經營者及其代理人。
機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估是風險為本方法的基礎，讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響及所受影響的程度。
notes: 正確：第2.1段訂明，金錢服務經營者制訂和執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施（即打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度）時，應採用風險為本的方法。
不正確：第2.1段訂明，採取與有關風險相稱的措施，是為了有效管理和減低風險；風險為本的方法並非以消除洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險為目的。
正確：第2.1段訂明，風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者採取與風險性質及水平相稱的預防措施，務求以最有效的方式着力於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集工作。
不正確：第2.1段訂明，預期司法管轄區、主管當局及金錢服務經營者要識別、評估和了解本身面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；金錢服務經營者的代理人並不在其列。
正確：第2.2段訂明，機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估是風險為本方法的基礎，讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響，以及所受影響的程度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3段

en.q: The appropriate steps for an MSO to conduct its institutional ML/TF risk assessment should include:
statements: weighing all relevant risk factors before deciding the overall level of risk and the mitigation to apply
having the risk assessment results approved by the senior management of the MSO
having a process that keeps the institutional ML/TF risk assessment up-to-date
having appropriate mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the CCE when required to do so
having the results of the risk assessment validated by an external party before they are adopted
notes: Correct: ¶2.3(b) lists considering all the relevant risk factors before determining what the level of overall risk is, and the appropriate level and type of mitigation to be applied.
Correct: ¶2.3(c) lists obtaining the approval of senior management on the risk assessment results.
Correct: ¶2.3(d) lists having a process by which the risk assessment is kept up-to-date.
Correct: ¶2.3(e) lists having appropriate mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the CCE when required to do so.

Incorrect: ¶2.3 lists documenting the process, considering all relevant risk factors, senior management approval of the results, a process to keep the assessment up-to-date and mechanisms to provide it to the CCE; validation by an external party is not among the steps.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者進行機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的適當步驟應包括：
statements: 在釐定整體風險水平及合適的減低風險措施前，事先考慮所有相關風險因素
由金錢服務經營者的高級管理層審批洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果
設有程序，確保機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估反映現況
設有適當機制，以便應關長要求提供洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果
在採納風險評估結果前，先由外界人士核實洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果
notes: 正確：第2.3(b)段列出在釐定整體風險水平及擬採用何種程度和類別合適的減低風險措施前，事先考慮所有相關風險因素。
正確：第2.3(c)段列出由高級管理層審批風險評估結果。
正確：第2.3(d)段列出設有程序確保風險評估反映現況。
正確：第2.3(e)段列出設有適當機制應關長要求提供風險評估結果。
不正確：第2.3段列出的步驟是記錄風險評估程序、考慮所有相關風險因素、由高級管理層審批結果、設有程序確保評估反映現況，以及設有機制應關長要求提供結果；由外界人士核實結果並不在其中。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.5至2.8段

en.q: Regarding the scale, scope and sources of an MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment, which of the following are correct?
statements: A simpler risk assessment approach must be used by an MSO whose products and services are very limited in range or whose customers have a homogeneous risk profile.
The assessment should consider quantitative and qualitative information obtained from relevant internal and external sources.
The assessment may take into account risk assessments by governments and authorities, such as Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment.
An MSO with branches or subsidiaries should perform a group-wide ML/TF risk assessment even if it is incorporated outside Hong Kong.
An MSO that is part of a financial group may refer to or rely on a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment once one has been conducted.
notes: Incorrect: ¶2.5 says that for such an MSO a simpler risk assessment approach might suffice; it permits a simpler approach but does not require one.
Correct: ¶2.6 says the institutional ML/TF risk assessment should consider quantitative and qualitative information obtained from relevant internal and external sources.
Correct: ¶2.6 says this may include relevant risk assessments by governments and authorities, including Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment.

Incorrect: ¶2.7 requires a group-wide ML/TF risk assessment of a locally-incorporated MSO with branches or subsidiaries, including those located outside Hong Kong; it does not extend that requirement to an MSO incorporated outside Hong Kong.
Incorrect: ¶2.8 lets the MSO refer to or rely on such an assessment provided that it adequately reflects the ML/TF risks posed to the MSO in the local context; the statement drops that condition.

tc.q: 關於機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的規模、範圍及資料來源，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 產品和服務種類十分有限，或客戶的風險狀況相若的金錢服務經營者，必須採用較為簡單的風險評估方法。
機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估應顧及從相關的內部與外部來源取得的數量及質量分析資料。
評估可考慮各地政府及主管當局的相關風險評估，例如香港在司法管轄區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。
設有分行或附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，即使在香港以外成立為法團，亦應進行集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。
屬金融集團成員的金錢服務經營者，可參考或依賴在集團或地區層面已進行的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。
notes: 不正確：第2.5段訂明，對於這類金錢服務經營者，較為簡單的風險評估方法可能已經足夠；指引容許但並無規定須採用較簡單的方法。
正確：第2.6段訂明，機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估應顧及從相關的內部與外部來源取得的數量及質量分析資料。
正確：第2.6段訂明，此過程可能包括考慮各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關風險評估，包括香港在司法管轄區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。
不正確：第2.7段規定在本地成立為法團並設有分行或附屬企業（位於香港以外者亦計算在內）的金錢服務經營者應進行集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估；這項規定並不延伸至在香港以外成立為法團的金錢服務經營者。
不正確：第2.8段訂明，金錢服務經營者可參考或依賴有關評估，惟有關評估須充分反映其在本地層面所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；陳述漏了這項條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9至2.10段

en.q: Regarding keeping an MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment up-to-date and keeping its records, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO should conduct the assessment every three years and upon trigger events which are material to its business and risk exposure.
Trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems or the acquisition of new customer segments.
Trigger events may include any change of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts.
Records of the assessment should include the risk factors identified and assessed, and the information sources taken into account.
The records kept should include the evaluation made on whether the MSO's AML/CFT Systems are adequate and appropriate.
notes: Incorrect: ¶2.9 says an MSO should conduct its assessment every two years and upon trigger events which are material to its business and risk exposure, not every three years.
Correct: ¶2.9 says trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems and the acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels.

Incorrect: ¶2.9 gives as trigger events any significant changes of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts; without 'significant' the statement takes in changes that are not material.
Correct: ¶2.10 says the records and relevant documents should include the risk factors identified and assessed and the information sources taken into account.
Correct: ¶2.10 says the records should include the evaluation made on the adequacy and appropriateness of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems.

tc.q: 關於確保機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估反映現況及備存其紀錄，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應每三年進行一次評估，並在發生會顯著影響其業務及所面對風險的觸發事件後覆核評估。
觸發事件可包括嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，或收購新的客戶類別。
觸發事件可包括金錢服務經營者的營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手出現的任何改變。
評估的紀錄和相關文件應包括所識別及評估的風險因素，以及所考慮的資料來源。
評估的紀錄應包括就金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度是否充分和適當而作出的評估。
notes: 不正確：第2.9段訂明，金錢服務經營者應每兩年進行一次評估，並在發生會顯著影響其業務及所面對風險的觸發事件後覆核評估，並非每三年。
正確：第2.9段訂明，觸發事件可包括嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以及收購新的客戶類別或交付渠道。
不正確：第2.9段所舉的觸發事件是營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手有「重大」改變；漏了「重大」，陳述便把不會顯著影響業務的改變也包括在內。
正確：第2.10段訂明，紀錄和相關文件應包括所識別及評估的風險因素，以及所考慮的資料來源。
正確：第2.10段訂明，紀錄應包括就金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度是否充分和適當而作出的評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.11至2.12段

en.q: Regarding the ML/TF risks of new products, new business practices and new or developing technologies, which of the following are correct?
statements: Developing new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms, is one of the matters whose ML/TF risks an MSO should identify and assess.
The ML/TF risks of a new or developing technology should be assessed even where it is used only for the MSO's pre-existing products.
An MSO should carry out the risk assessment before it launches the new products or business practices, or starts to use the technologies.
The MSO should take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the ML/TF risks that its prior risk assessment identifies.
notes: Correct: ¶2.11(a) has an MSO identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise in relation to the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms.
Correct: ¶2.11(b) covers the use of new or developing technologies for both new and pre-existing products, so their use with pre-existing products alone is included.
Correct: ¶2.12 says an MSO should undertake the risk assessment prior to the launch of the new products, new business practices, or the use of new or developing technologies.
Correct: ¶2.12 says the MSO should take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified.

tc.q: 關於新產品、新經營方法及使用嶄新或開發中的科技所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 開發新經營方法（包括新的交付機制）可能產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，金錢服務經營者應加以識別和評估。
即使嶄新或開發中的科技只用於既有產品，金錢服務經營者亦應評估使用這類科技的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
金錢服務經營者應在推出新產品、新經營方法或使用嶄新或開發中的科技前，事先進行風險評估。
金錢服務經營者應採取適當措施，管理和減低事先進行的風險評估所識別的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
notes: 正確：第2.11(a)段規定金錢服務經營者應識別和評估可能因開發新產品及新經營方法（包括新的交付機制）而產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
正確：第2.11(b)段涵蓋新產品及既有產品均使用嶄新或開發中的科技的情況，因此只在既有產品使用這類科技亦在其列。
正確：第2.12段訂明，金錢服務經營者推出新產品、新經營方法或使用嶄新或開發中的科技前，應事先進行風險評估。
正確：第2.12段訂明，金錢服務經營者應採取適當措施管理和減低已識別的風險。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶2.13–2.14 and footnote 5
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13至2.14段及註腳5

en.q: Regarding the customer risk assessment, which of the following are correct?
statements: The assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process determines the extent of the CDD measures to be applied.
Where a business relationship's ML/TF risks are higher, the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent of its verification, should increase.
An MSO should review and update the risk assessment of each customer every two years, as the customer risk profile will change over time.
Once finalised, the customer risk assessment supports the MSO's decision on whether to enter into, continue or terminate the business relationship.
Except in certain situations the Guideline specifies, an MSO should always apply all the CDD measures and conduct ongoing monitoring of its customers.
notes: Correct: ¶2.13 says the assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process would determine the extent of CDD measures to be applied.

Correct: ¶2.13 says the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher.

Incorrect: ¶2.14 has an MSO review and update a customer's risk assessment from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring; the two-year cycle in ¶2.9 is for the institutional ML/TF risk assessment.
Correct: ¶2.14 says the finalised customer risk assessment supports the MSO's decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate the business relationship.
