Correct: footnote 5 to ¶2.13 says that, except for certain situations specified in Chapter 4, an MSO should always apply all the CDD measures set out in ¶4.1.3 and conduct ongoing monitoring of its customers.

tc.q: 關於客戶風險評估，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在盡職審查程序初期所作的客戶風險評估，將決定需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施。
業務關係所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高時，便需索取更多數量及類別的資料，並更嚴謹地核實。
鑑於客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，金錢服務經營者應每兩年覆核和更新一次每名客戶的風險評估。
敲定的客戶風險評估支持金錢服務經營者就建立、繼續或終止業務關係所作的決定。
除指引指明的若干情況外，金錢服務經營者應時刻執行所有盡職審查措施，並持續監察其客戶。
notes: 正確：第2.13段訂明，在盡職審查程序初期所作的評估，將決定需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施。
正確：第2.13段訂明，如果與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高，便需索取數量及類別更多的資料，並以更嚴謹方式核實資料。
不正確：第2.14段規定金錢服務經營者應不時覆核和更新客戶的風險評估，尤以持續監察時為然；第2.9段每兩年一次的規定適用於機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。
正確：第2.14段訂明，客戶風險評估的結果支持金錢服務經營者就建立、繼續或終止業務關係所作的決定。
正確：第2.13段的註腳5訂明，除第4章指明的若干情況外，金錢服務經營者應時刻執行所有第4.1.3段載列的盡職審查措施，並持續監察其客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.15至2.16段

en.q: Regarding an MSO's customer risk assessment framework and the records of its customer risk assessments, which of the following are correct?
statements: The MSO should use an RBA in designing its customer risk assessment framework, whose complexity should be proportionate to the nature and size of its business.
The results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment should form the basis on which the framework is designed.
In general, the framework will include customer, country, and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors.
The MSO should keep the records so that it can demonstrate to the JFIU how it assesses a customer's ML/TF risks.
The records should show that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring for a customer is appropriate to the customer's ML/TF risks.
notes: Correct: ¶2.15 says an MSO should adopt an RBA in the design and implementation of its customer risk assessment framework, and that the complexity of the framework should be commensurate with the nature and size of the MSO's business.
Correct: ¶2.15 says the framework should be designed based on the results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment.
Correct: ¶2.15 says that in general the framework will include customer risk factors, country risk factors, and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors.
Incorrect: ¶2.16 has the MSO keep the records so that it can demonstrate to the CCE, not the JFIU, how it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks.
Correct: ¶2.16 has the records demonstrate that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on that customer's ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者的客戶風險評估框架及客戶風險評估的紀錄，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應採用風險為本的方法制訂客戶風險評估框架，而框架的複雜程度應與其業務的性質和規模相稱。
金錢服務經營者應以其機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果為依據，制訂客戶風險評估框架。
一般來說，框架會包含客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道的風險因素。
有關紀錄應讓金錢服務經營者能夠向聯合財富情報組證明它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
有關紀錄應能證明，基於個別客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的。
notes: 正確：第2.15段訂明，金錢服務經營者制訂及執行客戶風險評估框架時應採用風險為本的方法，而框架的複雜程度亦應與其業務的性質和規模相稱。
正確：第2.15段訂明，框架應根據金錢服務經營者在機構層面進行洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果制訂。
正確：第2.15段訂明，一般來說，客戶風險評估框架會包含客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道的風險因素。
不正確：第2.16段規定，備存紀錄是為了向關長（而非聯合財富情報組）證明它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
正確：第2.16段規定紀錄應能證明，基於該客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: Regarding simplifying the nature, scale and complexity of an MSO's AML/CFT Systems, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where lower ML/TF risks have been identified, the MSO must simplify the nature, scale and complexity of its AML/CFT Systems.
The lower ML/TF risks on which a simplification is based must have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment.
Simplified AML/CFT Systems need the approval of senior management and must be reviewed from time to time.
AML/CFT Systems are not permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF, even if the conditions are otherwise met.
A simplification requires the MSO to comply with Schedule 2 to the AMLO and to notify the CCE of the simplification in advance.
notes: Incorrect: ¶3.3 says the nature, scale and complexity of AML/CFT Systems may be simplified provided that its conditions are met; it permits simplification but does not require it.
Correct: ¶3.3(b) requires the lower ML/TF risks which form the basis for doing so to have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment, such as the institutional ML/TF risk assessment.
Correct: ¶3.3(c) requires simplified AML/CFT Systems, which are approved by senior management, to be subject to review from time to time.
Correct: ¶3.3 adds that AML/CFT Systems are not permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF.

Incorrect: ¶3.3(a) requires compliance with the statutory requirements set out in Schedule 2 to the AMLO and with ¶2.2, ¶2.3 and ¶3.2; ¶3.3 sets no requirement to notify the CCE of a simplification in advance.

tc.q: 關於簡化金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的性質、規模及複雜程度，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如已識別出較低的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，便須簡化有關制度的性質、規模及複雜程度。
作為簡化基礎的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，須是基於適當的風險評估而識別出來的。
簡化的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度須經高級管理層審批，並須由金錢服務經營者不時覆核。
即使符合其他條件，如懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況，亦不准簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
金錢服務經營者須符合《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的法定規定，並事先把簡化安排通知關長，方可簡化有關制度。
notes: 不正確：第3.3段訂明，如符合所列情況，則「可」簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的性質、規模及複雜程度；指引容許但並無規定須簡化。
正確：第3.3(b)段規定，須基於適當的風險評估（例如機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估）識別出較低的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，才可進行簡化。
正確：第3.3(c)段規定須不時覆核經高級管理層審批的簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
正確：第3.3段訂明，不過，如懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況，則不准簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
不正確：第3.3(a)段規定須符合打擊洗錢條例附表2載列的法定規定，以及第2.2、2.3及3.2段載列的規定；第3.3段並無規定須事先把簡化安排通知關長。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.4, ¶3.5 and footnote 9, ¶3.14
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.4段、第3.5段及註腳9、第3.14段

en.q: Regarding compliance management arrangements and employee screening, which of the following are correct?
statements: Compliance management arrangements should include, as a minimum, senior management oversight and the appointment of both a CO and an MLRO.
Subject to the size of the MSO, the CO function and the MLRO function need not be performed by two different people.
Compliance management arrangements should help the MSO implement AML/CFT Systems so as to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations.
An MSO should have adequate and appropriate screening procedures in order to ensure high standards when hiring employees.
Employee screening procedures and an ongoing employee training programme are both elements that the AML/CFT Systems should include.
notes: Correct: ¶3.5 says compliance management arrangements should, at a minimum, include oversight by the MSO's senior management and appointment of a CO and an MLRO.
Correct: footnote 9 to ¶3.5 says that, depending on the size of an MSO, the functions of CO and MLRO may be performed by the same person.
Correct: ¶3.5 says the arrangements should facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations as well as to manage ML/TF risks effectively.
Correct: ¶3.14 says an MSO should have adequate and appropriate screening procedures in order to ensure high standards when hiring employees.

Correct: ¶3.4 lists employee screening procedures and an ongoing employee training programme, with compliance management arrangements and an independent audit function, among what the AML/CFT Systems should include.

tc.q: 關於合規管理安排及僱員甄選，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者的合規管理安排最低限度應涵蓋高級管理層的監督，以及合規主任和洗錢報告主任各一名的委任。
視乎金錢服務經營者的規模，合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能無須由不同人士執行。
合規管理安排應有助金錢服務經營者推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以履行相關法律及監管責任。
金錢服務經營者應設立妥善而適當的甄選程序，確保聘用僱員時採用崇高標準。
打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應包括僱員甄選程序，以及持續的僱員培訓計劃。
notes: 正確：第3.5段訂明，合規管理安排最低限度應包括由金錢服務經營者的高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任。
正確：第3.5段的註腳9訂明，合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人執行，視乎金錢服務經營者的規模而定。
正確：第3.5段訂明，金錢服務經營者應有適當的合規管理安排，以便推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以履行相關法律及監管責任，並有效管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
正確：第3.14段訂明，金錢服務經營者應設立妥善而適當的甄選程序，確保聘用僱員時採用崇高標準。
正確：第3.4段把僱員甄選程序及持續的僱員培訓計劃，連同合規管理安排及獨立的審核職能，列為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應包括的項目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.6至3.7段

en.q: Regarding senior management oversight of an MSO's ML/TF risks, which of the following are correct?
statements: Both senior management and the board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, should clearly understand the MSO's ML/TF risks.
Management information on ML/TF risks should reach senior management in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner.
Senior management is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems that can adequately manage the ML/TF risks identified.
Senior management should appoint the MLRO at the management level, with overall responsibility for establishing and maintaining the AML/CFT Systems.
notes: Correct: ¶3.6 says the board of directors or its delegated committee (where applicable), and senior management, should have a clear understanding of the MSO's ML/TF risks and ensure that the risks are adequately managed.

Correct: ¶3.6 says management information regarding ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner so that they are equipped to make informed decisions.
Correct: ¶3.7 says the senior management of an MSO is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems that can adequately manage the ML/TF risks identified.

Incorrect: ¶3.7 has senior management appoint a CO at the management level to have the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the AML/CFT Systems; the MLRO is a senior staff member acting as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting.

tc.q: 關於高級管理層對金錢服務經營者洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的監督，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 高級管理層，以及董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用），均應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層。
金錢服務經營者的高級管理層有責任推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以妥善管理已識別的風險。
高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的洗錢報告主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
notes: 正確：第3.6段訂明，金錢服務經營者的董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並確保已妥善管理有關風險。
正確：第3.6段訂明，關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層，讓他們能夠在掌握充足資料的情況下作出決定。
正確：第3.7段訂明，金錢服務經營者的高級管理層有責任推行有效的制度，以妥善管理已識別的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
不正確：第3.7段規定高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的合規主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度；洗錢報告主任則由一名高級職員擔任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9段

en.q: Which of the following are functions or responsibilities of an MSO's compliance officer (CO)?
statements: Acting as the focal point for the oversight of all activities relating to the prevention and detection of ML/TF
Continuously reviewing the AML/CFT Systems, including any group-wide Systems of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to keep them up-to-date
Overseeing every aspect of the AML/CFT Systems, which includes monitoring how effective they are and enhancing controls where necessary
Communicating every AML/CFT issue that arises to senior management, the minor issues as well as the key ones
Making sure that the AML/CFT training of the MSO's staff is adequate, appropriate and effective
notes: Correct: ¶3.9 says the principal function of the CO is to act as the focal point within an MSO for the oversight of all activities relating to the prevention and detection of ML/TF.

Correct: ¶3.9(a) makes the CO responsible for developing and/or continuously reviewing the AML/CFT Systems, including any group-wide AML/CFT Systems in the case of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to ensure they remain up-to-date.
Correct: ¶3.9(b) makes the CO responsible for overseeing all aspects of the AML/CFT Systems, which include monitoring effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary.

Incorrect: ¶3.9(c) has the CO communicate key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including, where appropriate, significant compliance deficiencies; it does not extend to every issue, minor ones included.
Correct: ¶3.9(d) makes the CO responsible for ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective.

tc.q: 下列哪些屬金錢服務經營者的合規主任的職能或應負責的事項？
statements: 作為金錢服務經營者的中心點，監督一切防止及偵察洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的活動
持續覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度（在香港成為法團者包括集團層面的制度），確保制度反映現況
全方位監督打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括監察成效及在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控
就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的每一個問題（包括輕微的問題）與高級管理層進行溝通
確保為職員提供的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓是充足、適當而且有效的
notes: 正確：第3.9段訂明，合規主任的主要職能是作為金錢服務經營者的一個中心點，監督一切防止及偵察洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的活動。
正確：第3.9(a)段規定合規主任應負責制訂及／或持續覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度（在香港成為法團的金錢服務經營者則包括任何集團層面的制度），以確保制度反映現況。
正確：第3.9(b)段規定合規主任應負責全方位監督打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括監察成效及在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序。
不正確：第3.9(c)段規定合規主任應與高級管理層就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的「主要」問題進行溝通，包括（如適用）重大的合規不足情況，並非每一個問題，包括輕微的問題。
正確：第3.9(d)段規定合規主任應負責確保打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的職員培訓充足、適當及有效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10段

en.q: Regarding the role and principal functions of an MSO's money laundering reporting officer (MLRO), which of the following are correct?
statements: Besides law enforcement agencies, the MLRO is the MSO's main point of contact with the Joint Financial Information Unit.
The MLRO's principal functions should include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports.
The MLRO should play an active role in the identification, as well as the reporting, of suspicious transactions.
Keeping all records related to the internal reviews of disclosures is among the matters the MLRO should oversee.
Among the functions the MLRO should oversee is the provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off.
notes: Incorrect: ¶3.10 makes the MLRO the main point of contact with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) and law enforcement agencies; no "Joint Financial Information Unit" exists.
Correct: ¶3.10(a) lists the review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and determining whether a report to the JFIU is necessary, among the functions the MLRO should have oversight of.
Correct: ¶3.10 says the MLRO should play an active role in the identification and reporting of suspicious transactions.
Correct: ¶3.10(b) lists the maintenance of all records related to such internal reviews among the functions the MLRO should have oversight of.
Correct: ¶3.10(c) lists the provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off among the functions the MLRO should have oversight of.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者的洗錢報告主任的角色及主要職能，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 除執法機構外，洗錢報告主任亦是金錢服務經營者與聯合財務情報組聯繫的主要聯絡點。
洗錢報告主任的主要職能應包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告。
洗錢報告主任應在識別及報告可疑交易方面擔當積極的角色。
備存內部覆核的所有紀錄，屬洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能之一。
提供有關如何避免通風報訊的導引，屬洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能之一。
notes: 不正確：第3.10段所指的是聯合財富情報組（財富情報組），並非「聯合財務情報組」。
正確：第3.10(a)段把覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否有需要向財富情報組作出報告，列為洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能。
正確：第3.10段訂明，洗錢報告主任應在識別及報告可疑交易方面擔當積極的角色。
正確：第3.10(b)段把備存該等內部覆核的所有紀錄列為洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能。
正確：第3.10(c)段把提供有關如何避免「通風報訊」的導引列為洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.12至3.13段

en.q: Regarding the reviews of an MSO's AML/CFT Systems by its independent audit function and by external parties, which of the following are correct?
statements: The audit function's regular review should cover the adequacy of the AML/CFT Systems, ML/TF risk assessment framework and use of the RBA.
The regular review the audit function makes should cover how effective the MSO's compliance function is.
The regular review the audit function makes should cover the level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities.
The regular review the audit function makes should cover the accuracy of the MSO's financial statements.
In addition to the audit function's own review, the MSO should seek a review of its AML/CFT Systems from external parties.
notes: Correct: ¶3.12(a) includes the adequacy of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, ML/TF risk assessment framework and application of RBA in the review.
Correct: ¶3.12(c) includes the effectiveness of the compliance function in the review.
Correct: ¶3.12(d) includes the level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities in the review.

Incorrect: ¶3.12 lists the adequacy of the AML/CFT Systems, risk assessment framework and RBA, the effectiveness of the suspicious transaction reporting systems and of the compliance function, and staff awareness; the accuracy of financial statements is not among them.
Incorrect: ¶3.13 says the MSO should also seek a review from external parties where appropriate; without that qualifier the statement makes an external review a requirement in every case.

tc.q: 關於獨立審核職能及外界對金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度所作的覆核，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度及風險評估框架是否合適，以及風險為本方法的應用，均屬定期覆核應涵蓋的事項。
審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的合規職能是否有效。
審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平。
審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的財務報表是否準確。
除審核職能本身的覆核外，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界覆核其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
notes: 正確：第3.12(a)段把金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用情況是否合適列入覆核範圍。
正確：第3.12(c)段把合規職能是否有效列入覆核範圍。
正確：第3.12(d)段把職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平列入覆核範圍。
不正確：第3.12段列出的覆核範圍是打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用是否合適，報告可疑交易的制度及合規職能是否有效，以及職員的意識水平；財務報表是否準確並不在其中。
不正確：第3.13段訂明，金錢服務經營者「在適當情況下」亦應尋求外界進行覆核；漏了這個限定，陳述便變成在所有情況下均須尋求外界覆核。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.15, ¶3.17–3.19 and footnote 11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.15段、第3.17至3.19段及註腳11

en.q: Regarding the group-wide AML/CFT Systems of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as an FI as defined in the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Through the group-wide Systems, the MSO should apply the Guideline's requirements to every overseas branch and subsidiary undertaking in its financial group, wherever relevant and applicable.
The information provided to the MSO's group-level functions could include a suspicious transaction report or the fact that one has been submitted.
The MSO should inform the CCE whenever the AML/CFT requirements of a host jurisdiction differ from those set out in the Guideline.
If a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ, the MSO should have the branch or subsidiary apply whichever set is higher, to the extent the host's laws and regulations permit.
Subject to the laws involved and to safeguards, group-level functions should receive the overseas branches' customer, account and transaction information monthly.
notes: Correct: ¶3.15 has the group-wide AML/CFT Systems apply the Guideline's requirements to all of the MSO's overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings in its financial group, wherever those requirements are relevant and applicable.
Correct: footnote 11 to ¶3.17 says the information could include a suspicious transaction report, its underlying information, or the fact that a suspicious transaction report has been submitted.

Incorrect: under ¶3.18 a difference in requirements calls for the higher set to be applied; ¶3.19 requires the MSO to inform the CCE only where the host jurisdiction's laws do not permit the higher requirements to be applied.

Correct: ¶3.18 says the MSO should require the branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that the host jurisdiction's laws and regulations permit.

Incorrect: ¶3.17(b) provides for customer, account and transaction information from overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings to go to the group-level compliance, audit and/or AML/CFT functions when necessary for AML/CFT purposes; it sets no monthly schedule.

tc.q: 在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者如有外地分行或符合《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的經營與金融機構相同的業務的附屬企業，就其集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度而言，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，應在本指引的規定關乎及適用時，對所有屬其金融集團的外地分行及附屬企業執行相關規定。
交予集團層面的合規及審核等職能的資料，亦可以包括可疑交易報告或已提交可疑交易報告一事。
如所在的司法管轄區的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定與本指引有差異，金錢服務經營者便應通知關長。
如所在的司法管轄區的規定有所不同，金錢服務經營者應規定分行或附屬企業於當地法律及規例准許的範圍內執行較嚴格者。
在法律准許及設有妥善保障的情況下，集團層面的職能應每月收取外地分行的客戶、帳戶及交易資料。
notes: 正確：第3.15段規定，在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者應推行集團層面的制度，以便對所有屬其金融集團的外地分行及附屬企業執行本指引載列的所有相關規定。
正確：第3.17段的註腳11訂明，有關資料亦可以包括可疑交易報告、相關資料或已提交可疑交易報告一事。
不正確：按第3.18段，兩地規定不同時應執行兩者中較嚴格的規定；第3.19段只在所在的司法管轄區的法律及規例不准許執行較嚴格的規定時，才要求金錢服務經營者通知關長。
正確：第3.18段規定，金錢服務經營者應規定該分行或附屬企業於所在的司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定。
不正確：第3.17(b)段規定在有需要時為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的目的，把外地分行及附屬企業的客戶、帳戶及交易資料交予集團層面的職能，並無訂明每月提交。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), items 1, 12, 13, 14 and 15
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1、12、13、14及15項

en.q: Under the Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy, which of the following are correct about what an applicant's AML/CFT policy should contain?
statements: The policy's introduction should state that a qualified CO and MLRO are employed to implement its policies and procedures, with the line of reporting clearly stated.
In elaborating its AML/CFT compliance function, the applicant may describe, for example, management oversight and any relevant committee or panel.
The applicant should elaborate its procedures for reporting suspicious transactions, the relevant reporting lines and the roles of the MLRO and relevant staff.
In elaborating its AML/CFT audit function, the applicant may describe, for example, an internal or an external audit function.
The applicant should elaborate its risk assessment methodology for AML/CFT purposes, for example the relevant risk factors and its risk assessment procedures.
notes: Correct: item 1 has the introduction state that a qualified Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officers are employed to implement appropriate AML/CFT policies and procedures, and says the line of reporting should be clearly stated.

Correct: item 13 gives management oversight, the roles of the compliance department, any relevant committee/panel and the duties and responsibilities of the compliance officer and compliance staff as examples.

Correct: item 14 asks the applicant to elaborate the procedures of the company in reporting suspicious transactions, the relevant reporting lines, and the roles of the money laundering reporting officer and relevant staff.
Correct: item 15 gives, as an example of how the AML/CFT audit function may be elaborated, an internal/external audit function, with relevant policy and procedures.
Correct: item 12 asks the applicant to elaborate its risk assessment methodology for AML/CFT purposes, giving relevant risk factors and procedures to conduct risk assessment as examples.

tc.q: 根據《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》，關於申請人的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策應載有的內容，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 政策簡介應述明僱用合資格的合規主任及洗錢報告主任執行政策及程序，並清楚訂明報告流程。
闡述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的合規職能時，申請人可例如說明管理層的監督及任何相關委員會／小組。
申請人應闡述舉報可疑交易的程序及相關報告流程，並說明洗錢報告主任與相關職員所擔當的角色。
闡述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的審核職能時，申請人可例如說明採用內部或外部審核職能。
申請人應闡述其為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而進行風險評估的方法，例如相關風險因素及風險評估程序。
notes: 正確：第1項訂明政策簡介應述明僱用合資格的合規主任及洗錢報告主任，以執行適當的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策及程序，並應清楚訂明報告流程。
正確：第13項以管理層的監督、合規部門的角色、任何相關委員會／小組，以及合規主任及合規職員的職務及責任，作為闡述合規職能的例子。
正確：第14項要求闡述公司舉報可疑交易的程序、相關報告流程，以及洗錢報告主任與相關職員的角色。
正確：第15項以採用內部／外部審核職能、相關政策及程序等，作為闡述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審核職能的例子。
正確：第12項要求申請人闡述其為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而進行風險評估的方法，並以相關風險因素及進行風險評估的程序等為例。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline ¶3.8(f); AML/CFT Guideline ¶3.8(h); AML/CFT Guideline ¶3.9; AML/CFT Guideline ¶5.5
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第3.8(f)段; 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第3.8(h)段; 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第3.9段; 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第5.5段

en.q: Which statements about the information and support needed by staff carrying out AML/CFT responsibilities are correct?
statements: As far as practicable, senior management should ensure the CO and MLRO are fully conversant with applicable rules and the business’s ML/TF risks.
As far as practicable, senior management should ensure the CO and MLRO have sufficient resources, including staff, to discharge their responsibilities effectively.
The CO’s principal function includes supporting and guiding senior management so that the MSO’s ML/TF risks are adequately identified, understood and managed.
Transaction monitoring systems should give all relevant monitoring and investigation staff timely, sufficient information to identify, analyse and monitor transactions.
notes: True: ¶3.8(f) calls for full familiarity with the MSO’s statutory and regulatory requirements and with the ML/TF risks arising from its business, subject to the “as far as practicable” qualification in ¶3.8.
True: AML/CFT Guideline ¶3.8(h) states “equipped with sufficient resources, including staff and appropriate cover for the absence of the CO and MLRO”.
True: AML/CFT Guideline ¶3.9 states “providing support and guidance to the senior management to ensure that ML/TF risks are adequately identified, understood and managed”.

True: AML/CFT Guideline ¶5.5 states “provide all relevant staff who are tasked with conducting transaction monitoring and investigation with timely and sufficient information required to identify, analyse and effectively monitor customers’ transactions”.

tc.q: 以下有關履行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集職責的職員所需的資料及支援，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 高級管理層應在切實可行範圍內，確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任完全熟悉適用的法定及監管規定，以及業務帶來的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
高級管理層應在切實可行的範圍內，確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任配備充足資源，包括職員，以便有效履行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集職責。
合規主任的主要職能包括向高級管理層提供支援及導引，以確保妥為識別、了解和管理金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
交易監察系統及程序應向所有負責交易監察及調查的相關職員提供適時而充分的資料，足以識別、分析及有效監察客戶的交易。
notes: 正確：第3.8(f)段要求完全熟悉適用於經營者的法定及監管規定，以及業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並受第3.8段「在切實可行範圍內」的限定。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第3.8(h)段列明「配備充足資源，包括職員及合規主任及洗錢報告主任的適當替補人選」。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第3.9段列明「向高級管理層提供支援及導引，確保妥為識別、了解和管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第5.5段列明「向所有負責執行交易監察及調查的相關職員提供適時而充分的資料，足以識別、分析及有效監察客戶的交易」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(c)段

en.q: Which of the following are given in the AML/CFT Guideline as examples of the product, service or transaction risk factors that an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
statements: The nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the business that is carried on by the MSO
The characteristics of the products and services offered, and the extent to which they are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse
Whether the volume and size of the MSO's transactions are in line with its usual activity and the profile of its customers
Whether the products or services offered by the MSO may inherently favour anonymity
The extent to which the MSO uses technology and the extent to which these channels are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse
notes: True: ¶2.4(c)(i) states “the nature, scale, diversity and complexity of its business”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(ii) states “the characteristics of products and services offered, and the extent to which they are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(iii) states “whether the volume and size of its transactions are in line with the usual activity of the MSO and the profile of its customers”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(v) states “whether the products or services that may inherently favour anonymity”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(iv) states “the extent to which the MSO uses technology, and the extent to which these channels are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下哪些是金錢服務經營者在機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估中應考慮的產品、服務或交易風險因素的例子？
statements: 該經營者所經營的業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度
所提供產品及服務的特點及其所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度
該經營者的交易量及交易規模是否與其慣常活動及其客戶概況一致
該經營者所提供的產品或服務是否本身可能有利於以匿名行事
運用科技的程度，以及此等渠道所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度
notes: 正確：第2.4(c)(i)段列明「其業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度」。
正確：第2.4(c)(ii)段列明「所提供產品及服務的特點，以及它們所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度」。
正確：第2.4(c)(iii)段列明「其交易量及交易規模是否與金錢服務經營者的慣常活動及其客戶概況一致」。
正確：第2.4(c)(v)段列明「產品或服務是否本身可能有利於以匿名行事」。
正確：第2.4(c)(iv)段列明「金錢服務經營者運用科技的程度，以及此等渠道所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度」。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.2
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第2頁

en.q: Which statements about using trade-based money laundering indicators are correct?
statements: Whether indicators suggest TBML depends partly on the institution’s business lines, products and services.
How the institution interacts with customers is excluded from interpreting the significance of indicators.
An institution’s human and technological resources are relevant when interpreting indications of TBML.
The customer’s full profile, trade financing methods and contextual risk factors should inform use of indicators.
notes: True: p.2 The assessment depends on the business lines, products or services offered.
False: p.2 Customer interaction is expressly relevant to interpreting the indicators.
True: p.2 Human and technological resources are expressly included.
True: p.2 The totality of the customer profile and relevant context must be considered.

tc.q: 關於使用貿易洗錢風險指標，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 指標是否顯示貿易洗錢，部分取決於機構的業務類別、產品及服務。
機構與客戶的互動方式，不屬於解讀風險指標意義的考慮因素。
解讀貿易洗錢跡象時，機構的人力及科技資源屬相關考慮因素。
使用指標時，應考慮客戶的完整狀況、貿易融資方式及相關背景風險因素。
notes: 正確：第2頁，判斷須考慮機構提供的業務類別、產品或服務。
錯誤：第2頁，與客戶互動的方式正是列明的相關因素。
正確：第2頁，原文明確包括機構的人力及科技資源。
正確：第2頁，須考慮客戶整體狀況，包括盡職審查資料、貿易融資方式及其他背景風險因素。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.2
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第2頁

en.q: Which statements about organising information to identify trade-based money laundering are correct?
statements: Some indicators require comparing financial transactions with customs data and open-market prices.
Their own customer records give private entities access to every listed indicator without input from public authorities.
Some indicators require further context from authorities, including law enforcement or financial intelligence units.
Within private businesses, relationship-management personnel fall outside the intended users of these indicators.
notes: True: p.2 Cross-comparison can involve transaction, customs and open-market price data.
False: p.2 Reliance on external data means the private sector will not observe every indicator.
True: p.2 Engagement with law enforcement or FIUs can provide additional context.
False: p.2 Investigative analysis, onboarding and relationship management personnel are also included.

tc.q: 關於整理資料以識別貿易洗錢，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 部分風險指標須把金融交易與海關資料及公開市場價格作交叉比較。
私營機構憑自身客戶紀錄，便可觀察全部所列指標，不需公營機構資料。
部分指標須從主管當局取得額外背景，例如執法部門或金融情報單位。
在私營企業內，客戶關係管理人員不在這些風險指標的預定使用者範圍內。
notes: 正確：第2頁，原文列明金融交易、海關資料及公開市場價格的交叉比較。
錯誤：第2頁，原文說明對外部資料的依賴意味私營機構無法觀察所有指標。
正確：第2頁，原文指出私營機構可能須透過執法部門或金融情報單位取得額外背景。
錯誤：第2頁，原文亦包括調查分析、客戶開戶及客戶關係管理等人員。

source.en: Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022) ¶5.4.15
source.tc: 《香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告》（2022年）第5.4.15段

en.q: According to the 2022 risk assessment report, which statements about C&ED’s supervisory risk model are correct?
statements: Each MSO receives both an overall risk rating and an impact rating under the enhanced model.
The impact rating reflects the MSO’s number of premises rather than its annual turnover.
The two ratings form a matrix to determine the appropriate supervisory extent and priority.
The supervisory priority categories are high, medium-high, medium, medium-low and low.
notes: True: ¶5.4.15 The enhanced model distinguishes overall risk from impact.
False: ¶5.4.15 The impact rating reflects annual turnover.
True: ¶5.4.15 The combined matrix determines supervisory extent and priority.
False: ¶5.4.15 There are four listed categories; medium-low is not included.

tc.q: 根據2022年風險評估報告，關於海關的監管風險模型，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 每名金錢服務經營者在經改良模型下，同時獲整體風險評級及影響評級。
影響評級反映金錢服務經營者的處所數目，而不是其每年營業額。
兩類評級組合成總滙模型，以確定適當的監管範圍及優先次序。
監督優次類別分為高級、中高級、中級、中低級及低級五個級別。
notes: 正確：第5.4.15段，模型區分整體風險評級與對行業影響的評級。
錯誤：第5.4.15段，影響評級所反映的是每年營業額，並非處所數目。
正確：第5.4.15段，評級組合用於確定監管範圍與優先次序。
錯誤：第5.4.15段，列明的類別只有高、中高、中及低，沒有中低級。

source.en: Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022) ¶5.4.13
source.tc: 《香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告》（2022年）第5.4.13段

en.q: According to the 2022 risk assessment report, which statements about the supervisory response to sector vulnerabilities are correct?
statements: The report describes enhanced licensing requirements intended to be proper and proportionate.
The sector-wide outreach programme targeted existing licensees’ understanding of institutional risk.
Marginal MSOs identified during outreach could receive relevant guidance as supervisory follow-up.
Tailor-made training could be used to remedy deficiencies identified in marginal MSOs.
notes: True: ¶5.4.13 The response stresses proper and proportionate licensing requirements.
True: ¶5.4.13 The programme for existing licensees prioritised institutional risk understanding.
True: ¶5.4.13 Relevant AML/CFT guidance is one example of follow-up action.
True: ¶5.4.13 Tailor-made training is another stated remedial follow-up measure.

tc.q: 根據2022年風險評估報告，關於針對行業脆弱性的監管措施，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 報告指出加強發牌制度，目的是實施更適當合宜的發牌條件。
全行業外展計劃重點提升現有持牌人對機構風險的理解及意識。
在外展中發現稍低於標準的經營者，可獲相關指引作為監管跟進。
海關可提供專門培訓，以彌補稍低於標準的經營者所發現的不足。
notes: 正確：第5.4.13段，報告明列措施是實施更適當合宜的發牌條件。
正確：第5.4.13段，計劃針對現有持牌人，重點是對制度風險的理解及認識。
正確：第5.4.13段，報告以提供相關打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引作為跟進例子。
正確：第5.4.13段，原文列明可提供專門培訓以彌補不足。

source.en: Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022) ¶5.4.27
source.tc: 《香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告》（2022年）第5.4.26段

en.q: According to the 2022 risk assessment report, which statements about the territory-wide outreach programme launched in May 2020 are correct?
statements: The programme sought to assist C&ED in assessing and determining individual MSOs’ risk profiles.
The programme aimed to replace each MSO’s own AML/CFT policy with one prescribed by C&ED.
The programme sought to address concerns and difficulties in adapting to the regulatory regime.
The programme addressed shortcomings alongside the implementation of risk-based monitoring.
notes: True: ¶5.4.27 Individual risk-profile assessment is an express programme purpose.
False: ¶5.4.27 The aim is to help MSOs formulate their own policies, not replace them.
True: ¶5.4.27 Adapting to the regulatory regime is explicitly covered.
True: ¶5.4.27 Addressing shortcomings was linked to risk-based monitoring.

tc.q: 根據2022年風險評估報告，關於2020年5月展開的全港外展計劃，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 計劃協助海關評估及確定個別金錢服務經營者的風險狀況。
計劃以海關政策取代業者自身的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策。
計劃亦處理業界適應監管制度時所遇到的關注事項及困難。
計劃配合實行風險為本的監察工作，協助處理業界的不足之處。
notes: 正確：第5.4.26段，原文明列協助海關評估及確定個別經營者風險狀況。
錯誤：第5.4.26段，目的是協助經營者制訂本身的政策，並非以統一政策取代。
正確：第5.4.26段，原文包含適應監管制度時的關注及困難。
正確：第5.4.26段，報告將處理不足與風險為本監察工作相連。

source.en: Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022) ¶5.4.30
source.tc: 《香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告》（2022年）第5.4.29段

en.q: According to the 2022 risk assessment report, which statements about the report’s next steps for the MSO sector are correct?
statements: Innovation and new technology were to be encouraged to make AML/CFT compliance more efficient.
Special theme-based reviews were to focus proactively on low-risk areas of the sector.
Further study of cybercrime-related ML/TF/PF threats would inform supervisory measures and guidance.
Capability-building priorities covered risk understanding, reporting duties and TF/PF sanctions screening.
notes: True: ¶5.4.30 The report encourages innovation to enhance compliance efficiency.
False: ¶5.4.30 The targeted areas are high-risk, not low-risk.
True: ¶5.4.30 The proposed cybercrime work covers ML, TF and PF threats.
True: ¶5.4.30 The stated capability priorities include all three subjects.

tc.q: 根據2022年風險評估報告，關於報告就金錢服務業提出的下一步工作，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 鼓勵創新及新科技，旨在提升遵從打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集規定的效率。
計劃會積極進行特別的專題檢討，並將監管注意力集中在行業內的低風險範疇。
進一步研究網絡犯罪所帶來的洗錢、恐怖分子及擴散資金籌集威脅，以制訂措施及指引。
能力提升重點涵蓋風險理解、可疑交易舉報責任及恐怖分子與擴散資金籌集的制裁篩查。
notes: 正確：第5.4.29段，原文鼓勵創新及科技以更有效遵守規定。
錯誤：第5.4.29段，原文指針對高風險範疇，並非低風險範疇。
正確：第5.4.29段，研究涵蓋網絡犯罪引起的洗錢、恐怖分子及擴散資金籌集威脅。
正確：第5.4.29段，能力提升重點包括風險、舉報責任及針對性制裁篩查。

en.q: An MSO adds remote onboarding and complex remittance routes while keeping the same staff and existing products. Which statements are correct?
statements: Keeping the product names unchanged does not exempt the new delivery mechanism from risk assessment.
Because the workforce is unchanged, the old simple assessment necessarily remains sufficient for the business.
The MSO should assess risks before using the remote mechanism, rather than after its first customer.
The material change in delivery channels triggers review even if the last institutional assessment was recent.
notes: True: ¶2.5, ¶2.9, ¶2.11–2.12 New delivery mechanisms are covered even where products retain their names.
False: ¶2.5, ¶2.9, ¶2.11–2.12 Business complexity matters alongside size; unchanged staffing does not settle sufficiency.
True: ¶2.5, ¶2.9, ¶2.11–2.12 The assessment must precede the new practice or technology.
True: ¶2.5, ¶2.9, ¶2.11–2.12 Material channel or operational changes trigger review independently of the two-year cycle.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者維持現有人手及產品，但加入遙距開戶及複雜匯款路線。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 產品名稱維持不變，並不使新的交付機制豁免風險評估。
由於人手不變，原有簡單風險評估必然仍足以應付業務。
經營者應在使用遙距機制前評估風險，而非接待首名客戶後才做。
交付渠道的重大改變會觸發覆核，即使最近才完成機構層面的風險評估。
notes: 正確：第2.5, 第2.9, 第2.11–2.12段，新交付機制屬評估範圍，不能因產品名稱不變而豁免。
錯誤：第2.5, 第2.9, 第2.11–2.12段，評估須與業務複雜程度相稱，人手不變不能確定舊方法仍足夠。
正確：第2.5, 第2.9, 第2.11–2.12段，推出新經營方法或使用新科技前應事先評估。
正確：第2.5, 第2.9, 第2.11–2.12段，重大渠道或營運轉變可觸發覆核，不限於兩年週期。

en.q: A financial group offers its Hong Kong MSO an overseas assessment that omits Hong Kong customers and delivery channels. Which statements are correct?
statements: Overseas board approval permits reliance on the assessment despite its omission of the Hong Kong risks.
An amended group assessment can be relied on if it adequately captures the MSO’s local risks.
A locally completed assessment can bypass senior management approval because the group approved its own report.
The MSO should retain records showing its added local factors and evaluation of control adequacy.
notes: False: ¶2.3, ¶2.8–2.10 Reliance requires adequate reflection of local risks, not merely group approval.
True: ¶2.8 reliance is permissible once the local-risk condition is met.
False: ¶2.3, ¶2.8–2.10 The MSO must obtain senior management approval of its assessment results.
True: ¶2.3, ¶2.8–2.10 Assessment records include factors, information sources and control evaluation.

tc.q: 金融集團向香港經營者提供一份忽略香港客戶及交付渠道的海外評估。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 海外董事會批准後，經營者便可依賴這份遺漏香港風險的評估。
集團評估修訂後如充分反映經營者本地風險，便可予以依賴。
集團曾批准自己的報告，因此本地完成的評估可以免經高級管理層審批。
經營者應保存紀錄，顯示補充的本地因素及對管控充分程度的評估。
notes: 錯誤：第2.3, 第2.8–2.10段，依賴評估的條件是充分反映本地風險，並非只有集團批准。
正確：第2.8段，充分反映本地風險後，便符合依賴的條件。
錯誤：第2.3, 第2.8–2.10段，經營者仍須由高級管理層審批本身風險評估結果。
正確：第2.3, 第2.8–2.10段，評估紀錄應包括風險因素、資料來源及制度充分程度的評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.2–3.3段

en.q: A small MSO has evidence of lower institutional risks but now suspects laundering in part of its business. Which statements are correct?
statements: Its small size permits simplified systems to continue despite the newly identified suspicion.
Even before the suspicion arose, simplified systems did not authorise abandoning statutory CDD obligations.
The earlier low-risk assessment automatically excuses any further monitoring of system implementation.
The new suspicion can be ignored until the next two-year institutional assessment falls due.
notes: False: ¶3.2–3.3 Suspicion bars simplification irrespective of small size.
True: ¶3.3 simplification requires continued compliance with Schedule 2.
False: ¶3.2–3.3 Implementation must continue to be monitored and enhanced when necessary.
False: ¶3.2–3.3 Higher identified risks call for enhanced measures rather than waiting for the cycle.

tc.q: 小型經營者原有較低機構風險的證據，但現在懷疑部分業務涉及洗錢。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者規模細小，因此即使新出現懷疑，仍可繼續採用簡化制度。
即使在懷疑出現之前，簡化制度亦不代表可以放棄法定盡職審查責任。
先前的低風險評估，自動免除今後監察制度推行情況的工作。
新出現的懷疑可以暫不理會，待兩年一度機構評估到期再處理。
notes: 錯誤：第3.2–3.3段，有洗錢懷疑時不准簡化制度，規模細小亦不例外。
正確：第3.3段，簡化制度仍須符合附表2的法定要求。
錯誤：第3.2–3.3段，仍須監察制度推行情況，並視乎需要優化。
錯誤：第3.2–3.3段，識別較高風險須採取更嚴格措施，不能等候週期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.5–3.8段

en.q: A two-person MSO proposes one senior manager as both CO and MLRO and reviews whether the arrangement is workable. Which statements are correct?
statements: Holding both roles can be permissible depending on the MSO’s size rather than automatically prohibited.
Combining the roles transfers the senior management’s responsibility for effective systems to the JFIU.
The small size is relevant to operational independence but does not erase the need for sufficient knowledge.
Practicable arrangements for absence cover remain relevant even when both roles are held by one person.
notes: True: ¶3.5–3.8 The footnote permits the same person to perform both functions depending on size.
False: ¶3.5–3.8 Senior management retains responsibility for implementing effective systems.
True: ¶3.5–3.8 Qualification and knowledge remain requirements despite size constraints on independence.
True: ¶3.5–3.8 Sufficient resources include appropriate cover for absence where practicable.

tc.q: 兩人經營的金錢服務商擬由一名高級管理人員兼任合規及洗錢報告主任，並評估安排是否可行。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 視乎經營者的規模，同一人兼任兩項職能可以獲准，並非自動被禁止。
合併兩項職務會把高級管理層推行有效制度的責任轉交財富情報組。
規模細小與營運獨立性有關，但不會取消具備充足專業知識的需要。
即使兩項職能由一人兼任，切實可行的缺勤替補安排仍然相關。
notes: 正確：第3.5–3.8段，註明視乎規模，同一人可以履行兩項職能。
錯誤：第3.5–3.8段，高級管理層仍負責推行有效制度，責任不會轉交財富情報組。
正確：第3.5–3.8段，規模限制影響獨立性安排，但仍須合適資格及充足知識。
正確：第3.5–3.8段，充足資源包括在切實可行情況下的適當替補人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.6–3.9段

en.q: A board receives accurate AML figures, but unexplained codes make the dashboard unintelligible and serious defects are omitted. Which statements are correct?
statements: Accurate figures make this dashboard acceptable despite the missing material deficiencies and unexplained codes.
The CO should raise significant compliance deficiencies with senior management where appropriate.
Using unexplained codes is acceptable merely because the dashboard arrived before the board meeting.
The board’s obligation to understand risks remains even though it appointed an experienced CO.
notes: False: ¶3.6–3.9 Management information must also be complete, understandable and timely.
True: ¶3.6–3.9 Significant deficiencies are within the CO’s communication responsibilities.
False: ¶3.6–3.9 Timeliness does not remove the separate requirement for understandable information.
True: ¶3.6–3.9 Appointment does not remove the board’s clear-understanding requirement.

tc.q: 董事會收到準確的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集數字，但報表充滿未解釋代碼，並遺漏嚴重缺失。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 數字準確已令這份報表合格，即使遺漏重大缺失並使用未解釋代碼。
合規主任應在適當情況下向高級管理層提出重大的合規不足。
報表在董事會開會前送達，便足以使未解釋代碼的做法符合要求。
即使委任有經驗的合規主任，董事會仍有清楚了解風險的責任。
notes: 錯誤：第3.6–3.9段，管理資料亦須完整、易於理解及合時，僅準確並不足夠。
正確：第3.6–3.9段，重大合規不足屬合規主任須與管理層溝通的問題。
錯誤：第3.6–3.9段，合時不能取代易於理解這項獨立要求。
正確：第3.6–3.9段，委任合規主任不會取消董事會清楚了解風險的要求。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.11–3.13段

en.q: An MSO designs an audit after rapid business growth and discovers its compliance team has never been reviewed. Which statements are correct?
statements: The audit plan should consider whether its frequency and extent still match the expanded business.
Reviewing the effectiveness of the compliance function belongs within the independent audit scope.
An appropriate external review can supplement the MSO’s own independent review arrangements.
Audit staff need sufficient expertise and resources as well as direct communication with senior management.
notes: True: ¶3.11–3.13 Review frequency and extent must fit business nature, size and complexity.
True: ¶3.11–3.13 Compliance-function effectiveness is an express review subject.
True: ¶3.11–3.13 The Guideline calls for external review where appropriate.
True: ¶3.11–3.13 Expertise and resources complement the direct communication requirement.

tc.q: 經營者在業務迅速增長後設計審核，發現合規團隊從未接受覆核。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審核計劃應考慮覆核頻密程度及範圍是否仍與擴大的業務相稱。
覆核合規職能是否有效，屬獨立審核應包含的範圍。
在適當情況下，外界覆核可補充經營者本身的獨立覆核安排。
審核人員須有充足專門知識及資源，並可直接與高級管理層溝通。
notes: 正確：第3.11–3.13段，覆核頻密程度及範圍應與業務性質、規模及複雜程度相稱。
正確：第3.11–3.13段，合規職能的成效是明列覆核項目。
正確：第3.11–3.13段，指引要求在適當情況下亦尋求外界覆核。
正確：第3.11–3.13段，充足專門知識及資源與直接溝通要求同樣重要。

en.q: A Hong Kong-incorporated MSO’s foreign financial subsidiary faces a law prohibiting the higher record-keeping standard. Which statements are correct?
statements: The parent should notify the CCE of the inability to comply and take additional risk-mitigation measures.
The subsidiary must break the host law to give effect to the higher Hong Kong record-keeping standard.
Group information sharing remains subject to applicable laws and safeguards against tipping off.
A grocery subsidiary with no financial business falls under the financial-subsidiary rule through common ownership.
notes: True: ¶3.17–3.19 Host-law barriers require notification and additional mitigation.
False: ¶3.17–3.19 Application of the higher requirements is limited by what host law permits.
True: ¶3.17–3.19 Confidentiality and tipping-off safeguards apply to group sharing.
False: ¶3.15 the relevant subsidiary must carry on the same business as an FI.

tc.q: 香港成立的經營者之外地金融附屬企業，受法律禁止執行較嚴格的備存紀錄標準。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 母公司應通知關長未能遵從規定的情況，並採取額外減低風險措施。
附屬企業須違反當地法律，以執行較嚴格的香港備存紀錄標準。
集團共用資料仍受適用法律及防止通風報訊的保障措施限制。
不經營金融業務的雜貨附屬企業，因同屬集團而適用金融附屬企業規定。
notes: 正確：第3.17–3.19段，所在司法管轄區法律阻礙遵從時，須通知關長及採取額外措施。
錯誤：第3.17–3.19段，較嚴格規定只在所在司法管轄區法律准許範圍內執行。
正確：第3.17–3.19段，共用資料須有保密及防止通風報訊的保障。
錯誤：第3.15段，有關附屬企業須經營與金融機構相同的業務，僅同屬集團並不足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第2.4–2.6段

en.q: An MSO assesses a new corridor with transparent ownership records but weak enforcement and an external audit reporting control failures. Which statements are correct?
statements: Transparent ownership permits the assessment to disregard the findings about weak law enforcement.
The external audit findings belong among other institutional risk factors despite the corridor’s advantages.
The assessment may discard all qualitative evidence if transaction-volume statistics are available.
Control resources should be evaluated, including qualified staff’s access to continuing AML/CFT training.
notes: False: ¶2.4–2.6 Law-enforcement quality is a separate country risk factor.
True: ¶2.4–2.6 External audit results are among the institutional risk factors.
False: ¶2.4–2.6 Both quantitative and qualitative information must be considered.
True: ¶2.4–2.6 Access to ongoing training forms part of the resources considered.

tc.q: 經營者評估一條新匯款路線：當地擁有權資料透明，但執法薄弱，外部審計亦發現管控缺失。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 擁有權透明容許評估不理會執法水平薄弱的發現。
即使匯款路線有優點，外部審計發現仍屬其他機構風險因素。
已有交易量統計，便容許評估丟棄全部定質證據。
應評估人員持續接受打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集培訓的資源。
notes: 錯誤：第2.4–2.6段，執法水平及質素是獨立的國家風險因素。
正確：第2.4–2.6段，外部審計結果屬機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估因素。
錯誤：第2.4–2.6段，評估應顧及定量及定質資料，不能只保留統計。
正確：第2.4–2.6段，風險管理資源包括合資格職員持續接受培訓及進修的機會。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第2.13–2.16段

en.q: A customer initially appears low risk, but CDD reveals a complex business and high-risk foreign links before onboarding is completed. Which statements are correct?
statements: The initial low-risk score must stay unchanged until at least one transaction has been completed.
The newly established higher risks warrant more information and more extensive verification of it.
The final profile should inform both whether to onboard and the type of subsequent monitoring.
The final colour code, recorded without reasons, demonstrates the chosen CDD intensity is appropriate.
notes: False: ¶2.13–2.16 The assessment is finalised from all information obtained through CDD.
True: ¶2.13–2.16 Higher relationship risk increases the information and verification required.
True: ¶2.13–2.16 The final assessment informs monitoring and relationship decisions.
False: ¶2.13–2.16 Records must demonstrate the assessment and appropriateness of the measures.

tc.q: 客戶初步看似低風險，但在開戶完成前的盡職審查揭示複雜業務及高風險香港以外聯繫。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 初步低風險分數須保留不變，直至客戶完成最少一項交易。
新確定的較高風險，需要索取更多資料及作更深入核實。
最後風險狀況應影響是否開戶，以及其後持續監察的類別。
記下最終顏色代碼而不記理由，已足以證明盡職審查程度合適。
notes: 錯誤：第2.13–2.16段，應綜合盡職審查取得的全部資料敲定評估，毋須等首項交易。
正確：第2.13–2.16段，業務關係風險較高，須增加資料數量、類別及核實程度。
正確：第2.13–2.16段，最後評估用於持續監察及建立業務關係的決定。
錯誤：第2.13–2.16段，紀錄須能證明如何評估風險及措施的合適性，只有代碼未必足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第2.4, 第2.15段

en.q: An MSO introduces an algorithm that rates customers using nationality alone, ignoring products, transaction size and delivery channels. Which statements are correct?
statements: The algorithm’s speed by itself establishes that the customer risk framework is sufficiently risk-based.
Delivery channels belong in the institutional assessment but fall outside customer-risk scoring.
The institution’s risk assessment results should inform the design of this customer-rating framework.
A framework for a large, varied business can ignore its complexity if every customer has a nationality code.
notes: False: ¶2.4, ¶2.15 A risk-based design must consider risk, not merely processing speed.
False: ¶2.4, ¶2.15 Customer frameworks also generally include delivery-channel factors.
True: ¶2.4, ¶2.15 The framework should be based on the institutional assessment results.
False: ¶2.4, ¶2.15 Framework complexity must be commensurate with business nature and size.

tc.q: 經營者引入只按國籍評分的系統，忽略產品、交易規模及交付渠道。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 系統運作快速，本身足以證明客戶風險評估框架符合風險為本。
交付渠道屬機構層面評估因素，卻不在客戶風險評分的範圍內。
經營者應按機構層面的風險評估結果設計這個客戶風險評分框架。
每位客戶有國籍代碼，便容許大型多元業務框架忽略業務複雜性。
notes: 錯誤：第2.4, 第2.15段，風險為本的設計須考慮風險，而非單憑處理速度。
錯誤：第2.4, 第2.15段，客戶風險框架一般亦包括交付渠道因素。
正確：第2.4, 第2.15段，客戶框架應根據機構層面的風險評估結果制訂。
錯誤：第2.4, 第2.15段，框架複雜程度須與業務性質及規模相稱，國籍代碼不能代替。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.9–3.10段

en.q: A compliance review finds poor staff training and an internal suspicion report awaiting evaluation; the CO and MLRO are different people. Which statements are correct?
statements: Ensuring that the deficient training becomes adequate and effective belongs to the CO’s responsibilities.
The MLRO should oversee evaluation of the internal disclosure and the decision whether to report to JFIU.
The sales supervisor replaces the MLRO as the principal external contact because the customer is commercially important.
Guidance to prevent staff from tipping off this customer falls within the MLRO’s oversight functions.
notes: True: ¶3.9–3.10 The CO ensures staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective.
True: ¶3.9–3.10 Internal disclosure evaluation and external reporting decisions are MLRO functions.
False: ¶3.9–3.10 The MLRO is the main JFIU and law-enforcement contact.
True: ¶3.9–3.10 The MLRO oversees guidance on avoiding tipping off.

tc.q: 合規覆核發現職員培訓不足，另有內部懷疑報告待評估；合規與洗錢報告主任由不同人士擔任。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 合規主任應確保打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集培訓充足、適當及有效。
洗錢報告主任應監督內部披露評估，以及是否向財富情報組報告的決定。
客戶對業務重要，所以營業主管取代洗錢報告主任作為主要對外聯絡人。
向職員提供避免向此客戶通風報訊的指引，屬洗錢報告主任監督職能。
notes: 正確：第3.9–3.10段，合規主任負責確保職員培訓充足、適當及有效。
正確：第3.9–3.10段，內部披露覆核及是否對外報告的決定屬洗錢報告主任職能。
錯誤：第3.9–3.10段，與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡人是洗錢報告主任。
正確：第3.9–3.10段，洗錢報告主任監督提供如何避免通風報訊的導引。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.17 and footnote 11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.17段及註11

en.q: Subject to lawful sharing and confidentiality safeguards, an overseas financial branch asks its Hong Kong parent for relevant unusual-activity analysis. Which statements are correct?
statements: The group framework can permit relevant information to flow from group-level functions back to the branch.
Existing analysis of apparently unusual activities should be included when the information-sharing conditions apply.
The fact that an STR was filed may be shared within the conditions stated for group information sharing.
The underlying information behind an STR can be included without making every internal report public.
notes: True: ¶3.17 and footnote 11 Relevant and appropriate information can also flow to branches and subsidiaries.
True: ¶3.17 and footnote 11 The information should include analysis of unusual activities where done.
True: ¶3.17 and footnote 11 The footnote permits the report or fact of reporting, subject to the paragraph safeguards.
True: ¶3.17 and footnote 11 Underlying STR information is included as a possible category for controlled sharing.

tc.q: 在合法共用及保密保障下，外地金融分行向香港母公司索取與風險管理相關的異常活動分析。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 集團框架可讓相關資料由集團層面職能回傳外地分行。
符合共用條件時，應包括已完成的看似異常活動分析。
按集團共用資料所訂條件，可以包括已提交可疑交易報告這項事實。
共用可包括可疑交易報告背後資料，並不代表須公開所有內部報告。
notes: 正確：第3.17段及註11，與風險管理有關及適用的資料，亦應可由集團職能傳給分行。
正確：第3.17段及註11，資料應包括似乎異常活動的分析，如已作此類分析。
正確：第3.17段及註11，註釋容許包括報告或已提交報告一事，仍受本段保障條件限制。
正確：第3.17段及註11，註釋列明可包括可疑交易報告的相關資料，並非公開披露要求。

en.q: An MSO completed its institutional assessment in January and acquires a materially different customer business in June. Which statements are correct?
statements: The June acquisition requires consideration as a material trigger rather than waiting until the two-year date.
Management can give the June assessment directly to CCE instead of arranging senior management approval.
The assessment process should identify all relevant factors before deciding the appropriate mitigation level.
Retaining the June approval email permits destruction of the evidence used to assess the acquired business.
notes: True: ¶2.3, ¶2.9–2.10 The two-year cycle also has material event triggers.
False: ¶2.3, ¶2.9–2.10 Review results require the MSO senior management’s approval.
True: ¶2.3, ¶2.9–2.10 Risk factors precede determination of overall risk and mitigation.
False: ¶2.3, ¶2.9–2.10 Assessment records include information sources, not just approval.

tc.q: 經營者在一月完成機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，六月收購客戶類別有重大不同的業務。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 六月收購須按重大觸發事件處理，而非等候兩年期限才考慮。
管理人員可直接把六月評估送交關長，取代安排高級管理層審批。
應在決定適當減低風險程度之前，考慮所有相關風險因素。
保留六月批准電郵，便可銷毁評估被收購業務時所用的證據。
notes: 正確：第2.3, 第2.9–2.10段，兩年週期以外，重大觸發事件亦須覆核。
錯誤：第2.3, 第2.9–2.10段，覆核結果須由經營者高級管理層審批，不能以送交關長代替。
正確：第2.3, 第2.9–2.10段，須先考慮所有相關因素，再釐定整體風險及減低風險措施。
錯誤：第2.3, 第2.9–2.10段，風險評估紀錄包括所考慮資料來源，並非只有批准證明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第2.4(a), 第2.4(c)–(e)段

en.q: An MSO classifies findings from a business review: more high-risk customers, anonymous products, new agents and understaffed compliance. Which statements are correct?
statements: The proportion of high-risk customers belongs to customer risk, even if the customer headcount is unchanged.
A product favouring anonymity is classified as a staffing-resource factor in this assessment.
Greater use of the agent network belongs to delivery-channel risk rather than customer nationality.
Reduced compliance staffing can be relevant even if customer and transaction totals remain stable.
notes: True: ¶2.4(a), ¶2.4(c)–(e) The customer factor includes both number and proportion of high-risk customers.
False: ¶2.4(a), ¶2.4(c)–(e) Anonymity is a product or service characteristic, not a staffing resource.
True: ¶2.4(a), ¶2.4(c)–(e) Agent and counterpart network use is a channel risk factor.
True: ¶2.4(a), ¶2.4(c)–(e) Available risk-management resources are independently relevant.

tc.q: 經營者把業務覆核發現分類：高風險客戶增加、匿名產品、新代理人及合規人手不足。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 即使客戶總數不變，高風險客戶的比例仍屬客戶風險因素。
有利匿名的產品，在評估中應分類為人手資源因素。
更多使用代理人網絡，屬交付渠道風險而不是客戶國籍因素。
即使客戶及交易總數穩定，合規人手減少仍可影響風險評估。
notes: 正確：第2.4(a), 第2.4(c)–(e)段，客戶因素包括高風險客戶數目及比例。
錯誤：第2.4(a), 第2.4(c)–(e)段，匿名性屬產品或服務特點，並非人手資源因素。
正確：第2.4(a), 第2.4(c)–(e)段，代理人及交易對手網絡使用程度屬渠道風險因素。
正確：第2.4(a), 第2.4(c)–(e)段，可用風險管理資源的性質、規模及質素本身屬相關因素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第3.8–3.10段

en.q: The MLRO goes on leave during an alert backlog; a junior temporary assistant has no record access and cannot contact management. Which statements are correct?
statements: Merely naming an assistant establishes adequate cover even without authority or access to information.
Management should, as far as practicable, ensure the replacement arrangement has sufficient resources.
Any temporary cover must be appointed by the CCE before the MSO may allow access to its CDD files.
The backlog can be closed without reviewing disclosures because the designated MLRO is away.
notes: False: ¶3.8–3.10 Effective discharge requires timely access to available information and appropriate authority.
True: ¶3.8–3.10 Resources including staff and suitable absence cover support effective discharge.
False: ¶3.8–3.10 Absence cover is a senior-management arrangement, not a CCE appointment.
False: ¶3.8–3.10 Internal disclosure review remains an MLRO function requiring effective coverage.

tc.q: 警報積壓期間洗錢報告主任休假；臨時初級助理無法取閱紀錄，亦不能聯絡管理層。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 指定一名沒有權力或資料權限的助理，仍可構成充分替補安排。
管理層應在切實可行範圍內，確保替補安排具備充足資源。
任何臨時替補均須先由關長委任，經營者才可讓其取閱盡職審查檔案。
指定洗錢報告主任不在，因此可不覆核披露便把積壓個案結束。
notes: 錯誤：第3.8–3.10段，有效履職須有及時取得資料的能力及適當權力，僅指定姓名不足夠。
正確：第3.8–3.10段，充足資源及適當替補是有效履職的條件。
錯誤：第3.8–3.10段，替補人選屬高級管理層應確保的安排，不是關長委任。
錯誤：第3.8–3.10段，內部披露仍須有效覆核，休假不會取消該職能。

en.q: An MSO recruits staff for a new branch and commissions an external audit of its new controls. Which statements are correct?
statements: Recruitment through personal referrals can replace the MSO’s adequate employee-screening procedures.
An external audit appointment does not by itself remove the need for an ongoing employee training programme.
An audit confined to filing cabinets can omit staff awareness although staff perform AML/CFT duties.
The independent audit needs a direct communication line to senior management despite being externally supplied.
notes: False: ¶3.4, ¶3.11–3.14 Employee-screening procedures apply to hiring despite the recruitment source.
True: ¶3.4, ¶3.11–3.14 Training is a separate required systems component.
False: ¶3.4, ¶3.11–3.14 Staff awareness among those with AML/CFT responsibilities is in review scope.
True: ¶3.4, ¶3.11–3.14 Direct senior-management communication belongs to the audit function.

tc.q: 經營者為新分行招聘職員，並委託外界審核新管控措施。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 透過熟人轉介招聘，可取代經營者適當僱員甄選程序。
委任外界審核本身，並不取消設立持續僱員培訓計劃的需要。
審核可省略負責打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集職員的意識水平。
即使由外界提供，獨立審核仍須能直接與經營者高級管理層溝通。
notes: 錯誤：第3.4, 第3.11–3.14段，招聘來源不會取代聘用僱員時的妥善甄選程序。
正確：第3.4, 第3.11–3.14段，持續僱員培訓是制度中獨立的必要組成部分。
錯誤：第3.4, 第3.11–3.14段，負責打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集職員的意識水平屬審核覆核範圍。
正確：第3.4, 第3.11–3.14段，獨立審核職能應能直接與高級管理層溝通。

en.q: A Hong Kong-incorporated MSO opens a domestic branch and a foreign remittance subsidiary, and considers a regional group assessment. Which statements are correct?
statements: The local incorporation and branch structure bring a group-wide risk assessment into consideration.
A regional assessment is unusable merely because it is regional rather than worldwide.
The foreign remittance subsidiary needs similar CDD procedures to the extent that host law permits.
The foreign subsidiary can be omitted from group systems because no Hong Kong customers use it.
notes: True: ¶2.7–2.8, ¶3.15–3.16 A locally incorporated MSO with branches or subsidiaries should perform a group assessment.
False: ¶2.7–2.8, ¶3.15–3.16 Group-wide or regional assessments may qualify where local risks are adequately reflected.
True: ¶2.7–2.8, ¶3.15–3.16 Relevant foreign FI businesses need similar CDD and record-keeping procedures.
False: ¶2.7–2.8, ¶3.15–3.16 Relevant overseas branches and subsidiaries are included regardless of that customer claim.

tc.q: 香港成立的經營者開設本地分行及外地匯款附屬企業，並考慮採用地區集團評估。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 本地成立為法團並設分行的結構，涉及集團層面風險評估的要求。
評估在地區層面而非全球層面進行，便失去可供依賴的資格。
外地匯款附屬企業須在當地法律准許範圍內，設有相類盡職審查程序。
由於沒有香港客戶使用外地附屬企業，可把它排除於集團制度外。
notes: 正確：第2.7–2.8, 第3.15–3.16段，本地成立並有分行或附屬企業的經營者應作集團評估。
錯誤：第2.7–2.8, 第3.15–3.16段，集團或地區層面評估均可，條件是充分反映本地風險。
正確：第2.7–2.8, 第3.15–3.16段，從事金融機構業務的外地企業須設相類盡職審查及備存紀錄程序。
錯誤：第2.7–2.8, 第3.15–3.16段，規定適用的外地分行及附屬企業不因沒有香港客戶而被排除。

source.tc: 《打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引》通函，第1項

en.q: A trade customer develops several risk indicators and major profile changes. Which responses accord with the 2026 circular?
statements: Escalation to senior management should wait until the MSO has proved the customer committed money laundering.
The reasonableness of the customer’s changed profile should be understood and assessed before additional controls are selected.
Training supporting the response should build risk awareness in both the first and second lines of defence.
Additional controls should be proportionate to the customer’s risks rather than copied without assessing the profile.
notes: False: section 1 Multiple indicators warrant flagging and escalation; proof of an offence is not stipulated.
True: section 1 The circular links profile understanding to proportionate additional controls.
True: section 1 Both lines of defence are expressly included.
True: section 1 Additional controls must be effective and proportionate to the assessed risks.

tc.q: 貿易客戶出現多項風險指標，且狀況有相當程度改變。哪些應對符合2026年通函？
statements: 應等到經營者證實客戶犯洗錢罪後，才把情況上報高級管理層。
選擇額外管控前，應充分了解並評估客戶狀況轉變的合理性。
支持應對措施的培訓，應同時提升第一及第二道防線的風險意識。
額外管控應與客戶風險相稱，不能不評估狀況便照抄其他客戶安排。
notes: 錯誤：通函第1項，多項指標已須標記及上報，沒有先證實犯罪的條件。
正確：通函第1項，通函把理解客戶轉變與執行相稱額外措施相連。
正確：通函第1項，原文明列第一及第二道防線均須有充足風險意識。
正確：通函第1項，額外措施須有效及與風險相稱。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.6; Sample Questions MSSB/CA_01/2021, Example (7)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.6段；參考試題 MSSB/CA_01/2021 例子(7)

en.q: In carrying out CDD, for a customer that is a legal person, which of the following identification information should normally be obtained?
statements: Date of incorporation, establishment or registration
Place of incorporation, establishment or registration
Company Secretary
Principal place of business
notes: Correct: ¶4.3.6(b) lists the date of incorporation, establishment or registration.
Correct: ¶4.3.6(c) lists the place of incorporation, establishment or registration, including the address of the registered office.
Incorrect: ¶4.3.6 lists the full name, date and place of incorporation, unique identification number and document type, and principal place of business; the company secretary is not among them.
Correct: ¶4.3.6(e) lists the principal place of business, if different from the address of the registered office.

tc.q: 就客戶執行盡職審查時，就屬法人的客戶而言，一般須收集下列哪項識別資料？
statements: 註冊、成立或登記的日期
註冊、成立或登記的地點
公司秘書
主要營業地點
notes: 正確：第4.3.6(b)段列出註冊、成立或登記的日期。
正確：第4.3.6(c)段列出註冊、成立或登記的地點（包括註冊辦事處地址）。
不正確：第4.3.6段列出的是全名、註冊、成立或登記的日期及地點、獨特識別號碼及文件的類別，以及主要營業地點；公司秘書並不在其中。
正確：第4.3.6(e)段列出主要營業地點（如與註冊辦事處地址不同）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.2–4.3.5 and footnote 18
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.2至4.3.5段及註腳18

en.q: For a customer that is a natural person, which of the following are correct about identifying and verifying the customer's identity?
statements: The MSO should obtain at least the customer's full name, date of birth, nationality, and identity number and document type.
The MSO should verify the customer's nationality, along with the name and date of birth, against a reliable and independent source.
The MSO should verify the customer's residential address by reference to a proof of address.
An identification document without a photograph may be accepted in exceptional circumstances, once the risks are assessed and mitigated.
The MSO should obtain the customer's occupation as part of the minimum identification information.
notes: Correct: ¶4.3.2 has the MSO obtain at least the full name, date of birth, nationality, and unique identification number and document type.
Incorrect: ¶4.3.3 has the MSO verify the name, date of birth, unique identification number and document type; nationality is obtained but is not among the details verified.
Incorrect: ¶4.3.5 asks the MSO to obtain residential address information; footnote 18 treats verifying the address as something an MSO may require only for other purposes.
Correct: ¶4.3.4 allows an identification document without a photograph in exceptional circumstances, if the associated risks have been properly assessed and mitigated.
Incorrect: the minimum identification information in ¶4.3.2 is the full name, date of birth, nationality, and unique identification number and document type; occupation is not among it.

tc.q: 就屬自然人的客戶而言，下列哪些關於識別和核實客戶身分的陳述正確？
statements: 最低限度應收集客戶的全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨特識別號碼及文件類別。
金錢服務經營者應根據可靠及獨立來源，核實客戶的國籍、姓名及出生日期。
金錢服務經營者應參考住址證明文件，核實屬自然人的客戶的住址資料。
如情況特殊，經妥善評估和減低所涉及的風險後，可以接納沒有照片的身分證明文件。
金錢服務經營者最低限度應收集客戶的職業，作為識別資料的一部分。
notes: 正確：第4.3.2段規定金錢服務經營者最低限度應收集全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨特識別號碼及文件的類別。
不正確：第4.3.3段規定須核實的是客戶的姓名、出生日期、獨特識別號碼及文件的類別；國籍須收集，但不在須核實之列。
不正確：第4.3.5段只要求金錢服務經營者向客戶索取住址資料；註腳18指要求提供住址證明只是在若干情況下為其他目的而作。
正確：第4.3.4段訂明，如因情況特殊未能取得載有照片的身分證明文件，經妥善評估和減低所涉及的風險後，可以接納沒有照片的身分證明文件。
不正確：第4.3.2段所列最低限度須收集的識別資料是全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨特識別號碼及文件的類別；職業並不在其中。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.4.6, ¶4.4.7 and ¶4.4.9; FAQ applicable to all MSOs (C&ED portal), Q10
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.6、4.4.7及4.4.9段；《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》（海關網站）第10問

en.q: Regarding the beneficial owners of a customer that is a corporation or a partnership, which of the following are correct?
statements: An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of a corporation's issued share capital is its beneficial owner.
An individual who is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 10% of the voting rights at a corporation's general meetings is its beneficial owner.
An individual who is entitled to or controls, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of a partnership is its beneficial owner.
Where nothing obtained in the CDD process suggests that a person exercising ultimate control over the customer exists, there is no requirement to actively identify such a person.
Where no natural person meets the beneficial owner definition, the MSO should instead identify, and take reasonable measures to verify, the natural persons holding senior managing official positions.
notes: Correct: ¶4.4.6(a)(i) defines a beneficial owner of a corporation to include an individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of its issued share capital.
Incorrect: ¶4.4.6(a)(ii) sets the voting-rights test at more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings of the corporation, not more than 10%.
Correct: ¶4.4.7(a)(i) defines a beneficial owner of a partnership to include an individual who is entitled to or controls, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of its capital or profits.

Correct: the FAQ, Q10, says there is no requirement to actively identify a person exercising ultimate control over a customer where nothing obtained during the CDD process suggests that such a person exists.

Correct: ¶4.4.9 says that if no natural person falls within the definition of beneficial owners, the MSO should identify the relevant natural persons who hold the position of senior managing official and take reasonable measures to verify their identities.

tc.q: 就屬法團或合夥的客戶的實益擁有人而言，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 直接或間接地擁有或控制（包括透過信託或持票人股份持有）法團已發行股本的25%以上的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。
直接或間接地有權行使在法團的成員大會上的投票權的10%以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。
直接或間接地有權攤分或控制合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的個人，是合夥的實益擁有人。
如在客戶盡職審查過程中所得資料並沒有顯示有人能對客戶行使最終控制權，則無要求積極地識別該人。
如沒有自然人符合實益擁有人的定義，金錢服務經營者便應改為識別擔任高級管理人員的自然人，並採取合理措施核實其身分。
notes: 正確：第4.4.6(a)(i)段把直接或間接地擁有或控制（包括透過信託或持票人股份持有）法團已發行股本的25%以上的個人界定為法團的實益擁有人。
不正確：第4.4.6(a)(ii)段的投票權準則是直接或間接地有權行使在法團的成員大會上的投票權的25%以上，並非10%以上。
正確：第4.4.7(a)(i)段把直接或間接地有權攤分或控制合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的個人界定為合夥的實益擁有人。
正確：常見問題第10問指出，如在客戶盡職審查過程中所得資料並沒有顯示有人能對客戶行使最終控制權，則無要求積極地識別該人。
正確：第4.4.9段規定，如沒有自然人符合第4.4.6至4.4.8段所載有關實益擁有人的定義，金錢服務經營者應識別擔任高級管理人員的相關自然人，並採取合理措施核實他們的身分。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.5.1; FAQ applicable to all MSOs (C&ED portal), Q11 and Q12; Circular MSSB/MIS_03/2023 (22 Nov 2023), Appendix section (3)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.5.1段；《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》（海關網站）第11及12問；通函MSSB/MIS_03/2023（2023年11月22日）附錄第(3)節

en.q: Regarding a person purporting to act on behalf of a customer (PPTA), which of the following are correct?
statements: Whether a person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of the person's roles and authorised activities, and the ML/TF risks associated with those roles and activities.
Although FATF Recommendation 10 and the AMLO require any PPTA to be identified and verified, neither the FATF Recommendations nor the AMLO defines the scope of a PPTA.
Where a business relationship presents a high ML/TF risk, the MSO could verify the PPTAs' identities by reference to a list of PPTAs confirmed by an independent department of the customer.
An MSO is not required to identify and verify every authorized signatory of a customer: signatories are only required to be identified and verified if they are PPTAs.
As a general proposition, each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, namely the person acting on its behalf to establish the business relationship with the MSO.
notes: Correct: ¶4.5.1 says whether the person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of that person's roles and the activities which the person is authorised to conduct, as well as the ML/TF risks associated with these roles and activities.

Correct: the FAQ, Q11, says FATF Recommendation 10 requires financial institutions to identify and verify the identity of any PPTA, that the AMLO adopts the same requirement, and that neither of them defines the scope of PPTA.

Incorrect: the FAQ, Q12, gives verification against a list of PPTAs confirmed by an independent department or person within the customer as a measure where a business relationship is assessed to present a low ML/TF risk, not a high one.
Correct: the FAQ, Q12, says authorized signatories are only required to be identified and verified if they are a PPTA.

Correct: circular MSSB/MIS_03/2023, Appendix section (3), says that as a general proposition each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, the person acting on behalf of the customer to establish the business relationship with the MSO.

tc.q: 關於看似代表客戶行事的人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
特別組織第10項建議及《打擊洗錢條例》雖要求識別及核實任何看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，但兩者均沒有界定其涵蓋範圍。
如業務關係的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險被評為屬於高，金錢服務經營者可根據經客戶內部獨立部門核實的清單，核實看似代表客戶行事的人的身分。
金錢服務經營者無須識別及核實客戶的所有獲授權簽署人；僅當獲授權簽署人為看似代表客戶行事的人時，才需要進行識別及核實。
一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。
notes: 正確：第4.5.1段規定，要判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
正確：常見問題第11問指出，特別組織第10項建議要求金融機構識別及核實任何看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，《打擊洗錢條例》亦採納相同要求，但兩者均沒有界定看似代表客戶行事的人的涵蓋範圍。
不正確：常見問題第12問是以業務關係的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險被評為屬於低的情況為例，說明可根據經客戶內部獨立部門或個人核實的清單核實身分，並非風險屬於高的情況。
正確：常見問題第12問指出，僅當獲授權簽署人為看似代表客戶行事的人時，才需要進行識別及核實。
正確：通函MSSB/MIS_03/2023附錄第(3)節指出，一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12 and footnote 23, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.10段、第4.3.12段及註腳23、第4.4.11至4.4.12段

en.q: For a customer that is a trust, which of the following are correct?
statements: If the trustee enters into a business relationship or carries out occasional transactions on behalf of the trust, the MSO should also regard the trustee as its customer, and identify and verify the trustee's identity.
A written confirmation from a trust company within the same financial group as the MSO is among the examples of documents for verifying the trust's identity.
The MSO should identify the settlor, the trustee, any protector or enforcer, the beneficiaries or class of beneficiaries, and any other natural person exercising ultimate control over the trust.
For a beneficiary designated by characteristics or by class, the MSO should obtain enough information to establish the beneficiary's identity when the business relationship is established.
In verifying the trust's identity, the MSO may, under exceptional circumstance, choose to retain a redacted copy of the trust deed or similar instrument.
notes: Correct: ¶4.3.10 says the MSO should also regard the trustee as its customer if the trustee enters into a business relationship or carries out occasional transactions on behalf of the trust, and should then identify and verify the identity of the trustee.

Incorrect: ¶4.3.12(e) lists a written confirmation from a trust company within the same financial group as the MSO only if the trust concerned is managed by that trust company; the statement drops that condition.

Correct: ¶4.4.11 has the MSO identify the settlor, the trustee, the protector (if any), the enforcer (if any), the beneficiaries or class of beneficiaries, and any other natural person exercising ultimate control over the trust.

Incorrect: ¶4.4.12 asks for sufficient information to establish the identity of the beneficiary at the time of payout or when the beneficiary intends to exercise vested rights, not when the business relationship is established.
Correct: footnote 23, attached to the trust deed or similar instrument in ¶4.3.12(a), says that under exceptional circumstance the MSO may choose to retain a redacted copy.

tc.q: 就屬信託的客戶而言，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如受託人代表信託建立業務關係或執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者應把受託人視作客戶，並識別和核實其身分。
由與金錢服務經營者同屬一個金融集團的信託公司所簽發的書面確認書，是可用以核實信託身分的文件例子之一。
金錢服務經營者應識別信託的財產授予人、受託人、保護人或執行人（如有）、受益人或某類別受益人，及任何行使最終控制權的自然人。
如信託以特徵或類別方式指定受益人，金錢服務經營者應就受益人索取足夠資料，以便在建立業務關係時確立受益人的身分。
在核實屬信託的客戶的身分時，如情況特殊，金錢服務經營者可選擇保存信託契據或類似文書的刪節本。
notes: 正確：第4.3.10段規定，如受託人代表信託建立業務關係或執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者應把受託人視作客戶，並按照識別和核實屬自然人或法人的客戶的規定，識別和核實受託人的身分。
不正確：第4.3.12(e)段所列的是由與金錢服務經營者同屬一個金融集團的信託公司簽發的書面確認書，但須有關信託由該信託公司管理；陳述漏了這個條件。
正確：第4.4.11段規定金錢服務經營者應識別信託的財產授予人、受託人、保護人（如有）、執行人（如有）、受益人或某類別受益人，及任何對信託行使最終控制權的自然人。
不正確：第4.4.12段要求索取的資料，須足以讓金錢服務經營者可以在付款時，或受益人擬行使歸屬於該受益人的權益時，確立受益人的身分，並非在建立業務關係時。
正確：第4.3.12(a)段的信託契據或類似文書所附的註腳23指出，在特殊情況下，金錢服務經營者可選擇保存文書的刪節本。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.8–4.3.9; FAQ applicable to all MSOs (C&ED portal), Q7
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.8至4.3.9段；《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》（海關網站）第7問

en.q: Regarding verifying the identity of a customer that is a partnership or an unincorporated body, which of the following are correct?
statements: The identity of a customer that is a partnership can be verified by reference to a record of registration, or to a partnership agreement or deed.
Where the customer or the circumstances are not deemed to present a high ML/TF risk, an extract or redacted version of the partnership agreement or deed may be accepted.
Even where a record of registration is obtained, an additional document may be required to understand the powers that regulate and bind the partnership.

Confirming a partnership's membership of a relevant professional or trade association is likely to suffice to verify its identity if it is a well-known, reputable organisation with a long industry history.
For an association, club, society, charity or religious body, the MSO should satisfy itself as to the legitimate purpose of the organisation, for example by requesting sight of its constitution.
notes: Correct: the FAQ, Q7, says the identity of a partnership can be verified by a record of registration or a partnership agreement or deed.
Correct: the FAQ, Q7, says the partnership agreement or deed may be an extract or redacted version for customers or circumstances that are not deemed to present a high ML/TF risk.

Correct: the FAQ, Q7, says that if a record of registration is obtained, an additional document may be required to understand the powers that regulate and bind the partnership, which that record may not cover.
Incorrect: ¶4.3.8 sets a third condition as well, that there is substantial public information about the customer, its partners and controllers; the statement drops it.

Correct: ¶4.3.9 says that for associations, clubs, societies, charities, religious bodies and similar organisations, the MSO should satisfy itself as to the legitimate purpose of the organisation, e.g. by requesting sight of the constitution.

tc.q: 關於核實屬合夥或非法團團體的客戶的身分，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者可參考合夥的註冊記錄，或其合夥協議或契約，以核實屬合夥的客戶的身分。
如客戶或情況並非被視為會造成高度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，可接納合夥協議或契約的摘錄或刪節本。
即使已取得合夥的註冊記錄，金錢服務經營者可能仍需額外文件，才能了解規管和約束合夥的權力。
如合夥為眾所周知、有信譽及在業內歷史悠久的組織，確認其具有相關專業或行業協會會員身分便可能足以核實其身分。
就協會、會所、社團、慈善組織或宗教組織而言，金錢服務經營者應令其信納該等機構的合法目的，例如要求閱覽組織章程。
notes: 正確：常見問題第7問指出，要核實合夥的身分，可參考註冊記錄、合夥協議或契約。
正確：常見問題第7問指出，如客戶或情況並非被視為會造成高度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，合夥協議或契約的摘錄或刪節本亦可接納。
正確：常見問題第7問指出，即使已取得註冊記錄，可能仍需額外文件，才能了解規管和約束合夥的權力，因為註冊記錄本身或未有涵蓋有關內容。
不正確：第4.3.8段另設第三項條件，即有大量有關該客戶、其合夥人及控制人的公開資料；陳述漏了這項條件。
正確：第4.3.9段規定，至於客戶為協會、會所、社團、慈善組織、宗教組織等機構，金錢服務經營者應令其信納該等機構的合法目的，例如要求閱覽該等機構的組織章程。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.6.1 and ¶4.8.8(e); Circular MSSB/MIS_03/2023 (22 Nov 2023), Appendix section (1)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.6.1及4.8.8(e)段；通函MSSB/MIS_03/2023（2023年11月22日）附錄第(1)節

en.q: Regarding the purpose and intended nature of a business relationship, which of the following are correct?
statements: The MSO must understand the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship; in some instances this is self-evident, but in many cases it may have to obtain information.
The information the MSO obtains to understand the purpose and intended nature should be commensurate with the customer's risk profile and the nature of the business relationship.
Where the customer is a natural person, the MSO should also understand the nature of the customer's business, in addition to the purpose and intended nature of the relationship.
As an SDD measure, the MSO may infer the purpose and intended nature from the type of transactions or business relationship established, without collecting specific information.
Where the MSO ascertains that a customer has misled it about the purpose and intended nature, it should take prompt action to identify if there are any grounds for suspicion.
notes: Correct: ¶4.6.1 says an MSO must understand the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship; in some instances this will be self-evident, but in many cases the MSO may have to obtain information in this regard.
Correct: ¶4.6.1 says the information obtained to understand the purpose and intended nature should be commensurate with the risk profile of the customer and the nature of the business relationship.
Incorrect: ¶4.6.1 asks the MSO also to understand the nature of the customer's business where a customer is not a natural person, not where it is one.

Correct: ¶4.8.8(e) gives as an example of a possible SDD measure not collecting specific information to understand the purpose and intended nature, but inferring them from the type of transactions or business relationship established.

Correct: circular MSSB/MIS_03/2023, Appendix section (1), says that where an MSO ascertains that a customer has misled it about the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship, it should take prompt action to identify if there are any grounds for suspicion.

tc.q: 關於業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者必須了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質；這在某些情況下不言而喻，但在許多情況下或須取得這方面的資料。
金錢服務經營者為了解目的及擬具有的性質而取得的資料，應與客戶的風險狀況及業務關係的性質相稱。
如客戶屬自然人，金錢服務經營者除了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質外，亦應了解客戶的業務性質。
作為簡化盡職審查措施，金錢服務經營者可不收集特定資料，僅按交易的類別或建立的業務關係推斷目的及擬具有的性質。
金錢服務經營者如確定客戶就業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質誤導了它，應迅速採取行動，以識別是否有理由作出懷疑。
notes: 正確：第4.6.1段規定金錢服務經營者必須了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質；在某些情況下，這是不言而喻的，但在許多情況下，金錢服務經營者或須取得這方面的資料。
正確：第4.6.1段規定，金錢服務經營者為了解有關目的及擬具有的性質而取得的資料，應與客戶的風險狀況及業務關係的性質相稱。
不正確：第4.6.1段規定，如客戶並非自然人，金錢服務經營者亦應了解客戶的業務性質；並非客戶屬自然人的情況。
正確：第4.8.8(e)段以不就業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質收集特定資料，僅按交易的類別或建立的業務關係推斷目的及擬具有的性質，作為可能執行的簡化盡職審查措施的例子。
正確：通函MSSB/MIS_03/2023附錄第(1)節指出，當金錢服務經營者確定客戶就業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質誤導該金錢服務經營者，該金錢服務經營者應迅速採取行動，以識別是否有理由作出懷疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.4及5.7段

en.q: In designing its transaction monitoring systems and processes, including setting parameters and thresholds, which of the following should an MSO have regard to?
statements: The size and complexity of the MSO's business, and the ML/TF risks arising from the MSO's business
The nature of its systems and controls, and the monitoring procedures that already exist to satisfy other business needs
The nature of the products and services provided, which includes the means of delivery or communication
The nature and type of transactions, such as abnormal size or frequency, and the counterparties of transactions
The nature of a series of transactions, such as structuring a single transaction into a number of cash deposits
notes: Correct: ¶5.4(a) and (b) list the size and complexity of its business and the ML/TF risks arising from its business among the factors to which the design, degree of automation and sophistication of the systems should have regard.
Correct: ¶5.4(c) and (d) list the nature of its systems and controls and the monitoring procedures that already exist to satisfy other business needs.
Correct: ¶5.4(e) lists the nature of the products and services provided, which includes the means of delivery or communication.

Correct: ¶5.7(a) and (c) list the nature and type of transactions (e.g. abnormal size or frequency) and the counterparties of transactions among the transaction characteristics to take into account in designing the systems, including setting parameters and thresholds.
Correct: ¶5.7(b) lists the nature of a series of transactions, e.g. structuring a single transaction into a number of cash deposits.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在設計交易監察系統及程序（包括設定參數及門檻）時，應顧及下列哪些事項？
statements: 業務規模及複雜程度，以及業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
系統及管控措施的性質，以及滿足其他業務需要的現存監察程序
金錢服務經營者所提供的產品及服務的性質，包括交付或溝通途徑
交易性質及類別（例如不尋常金額或頻密程度），以及交易對手
一連串交易的性質，例如將單一交易分成多次現金存款的情況
notes: 正確：第5.4(a)及(b)段把業務的規模及複雜程度，以及業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，列為交易監察系統及程序的設計、自動化程度及精密程度應因應的因素。
正確：第5.4(c)及(d)段列出系統及管控措施的性質，以及滿足其他業務需要的現存監察程序。
正確：第5.4(e)段列出產品及服務的性質（包括交付或溝通途徑）。
正確：第5.7(a)及(c)段把交易性質及類別（例如不尋常金額或頻密程度）及交易對手，列為設計交易監察系統及程序（包括設定參數及門檻）時應顧及的交易特徵。
正確：第5.7(b)段列出一連串交易的性質（例如將單一交易分成多次現金存款）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶5.2 footnote 53, ¶5.3 and ¶5.9; FAQ applicable to all MSOs (C&ED portal), Q15 and Q23
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段註腳53、第5.3及5.9段；《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》（海關網站）第15及23問

en.q: Regarding an MSO's ongoing monitoring of its business relationships, which of the following are correct?
statements: Customers that present high ML/TF risks need not be reviewed more than once every two years, unless the MSO deems more frequent reviews necessary.
The MSO need not re-verify any aspect of a customer's identification just because an identity document obtained earlier, such as a passport, has expired.
