評估前政治人物地位所帶來的風險時，所列職位等級因素是指該名個人的繼任者在接掌有關公職時所擔任職位的等級。
前政治人物以往及現有職能是否有連繫，是相關風險因素，包括委任繼任的政治人物，或繼續實質處理相同重要事務。
常見問題把政治人物業務關係批准人選的數目及職銜差異，歸因於金錢服務經營者的規模、類別及個別客戶層面的風險評估。
notes: 正確：第4.9.12(a)及4.9.18(a)段列出「該名個人仍可運用的（非正式）影響力」作為前政治人物風險因素。
錯誤：第4.9.12(b)及4.9.18(b)段列出「該名個人作為政治人物時所擔任職位的等級」。考慮的是前政治人物本人的職位，並非繼任者的職位。
正確：第4.9.12(c)及4.9.18(c)段考慮以往及現有職能是否有連繫，並舉出「委任繼任的政治人物」及「處理相同重要事務」。
錯誤：常見問題答21所指的是經營者的「規模、類別及機構層面的風險評估」。把機構層面改為個別客戶層面，改變了所指定的評估範圍。

source.en: FAQ applicable to all MSOs, AML/CFT A4; AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.3.2–4.3.3
source.tc: 《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集部分答4；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.3.2至4.3.3段

en.q: Which of the following are correct about a natural person customer changing their name?
statements: If an existing natural person customer changes their name, the MSO should verify the new name using documents, data or information provided by a reliable and independent source.

To mitigate impersonation after a name change, the MSO should corroborate other details on the new identification document, such as date of birth or identity number, against the customer's new declaration.
If there is doubt about a natural person customer's name change, the MSO may request a copy of applicable documentation relating to the change, such as a marriage certificate or deed poll.
Where a natural person customer changed their name before the business relationship was established, the MSO is required to identify and verify both the current name and the former name.
notes: True: FAQ A4 says to verify the new name by reference to documents, data or information 'provided by a reliable and independent source', following Guideline ¶4.3.3.

False: FAQ A4 requires the other details on the new document to be checked 'against its existing records'. Substituting a fresh customer declaration removes that check against the information already held.
True: FAQ A4 permits requesting 'a copy of applicable documentation' in case of doubt, and gives a marriage certificate or deed poll as examples.
False: FAQ A4 expressly says that if the change preceded the relationship, 'only the current name is required to be identified and verified'. Adding the former name extends the requirement.

tc.q: 關於自然人客戶更改姓名，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如現有自然人客戶更改姓名，金錢服務經營者應以可靠及獨立來源所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實該名客戶的新姓名。
為減低改名後的假冒風險，金錢服務經營者應以客戶的新聲明，核對新身分證明文件上的其他資料，例如出生日期或身分證號碼。
如對自然人客戶的改名有疑問，金錢服務經營者可索取與更改姓名有關的適用文件複本，例如結婚證書或改名契，以作查核。
如自然人客戶於建立業務關係前已更改姓名，金錢服務經營者在建立業務關係時，須識別及核實現時姓名以及更改前的姓名。
notes: 正確：常見問題答4要求按指引第4.3.3段，根據「可靠及獨立來源提供的文件、數據或資料」，核實新姓名。
錯誤：常見問題答4要求「利用現有紀錄核對」新身分證明文件上的其他資料。改用客戶的新聲明，沒有與經營者原有紀錄作核對。
正確：常見問題答4容許在有疑問時索取「與更改姓名有關的適用文件複本」，例子包括結婚證書及改名契。
錯誤：常見問題答4明確規定，建立業務關係前已改名時，「只須識別和核實現時的姓名」。額外要求核實舊姓名擴大了規定。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.11.7–4.11.8, 4.11.13; AMLO Sch. 2 s.18(7), related foreign financial institution (a), (b)(ii)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.11.7至4.11.8、4.11.13段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(7)條相關外地金融機構定義(a)、(b)(ii)段

en.q: Which statements about an MSO's reliance on intermediaries for customer due diligence are correct under the AMLO and the AML/CFT Guideline?
statements: If the MSO doubts an intermediary's reliability, it should take reasonable steps to review the intermediary's ability to perform its customer due diligence duties.
If the MSO intends to terminate its relationship with an intermediary, it should obtain all CDD information from the intermediary at the next periodic customer review.
For a domestic legal professional to act as intermediary, the MSO must be satisfied that it has adequate ML/TF prevention procedures and is subject to Schedule 2 for the customer.
For a related foreign FI acting as intermediary, the applicable group policy should be able to eliminate any higher country risk associated with the FI's jurisdiction.
An MSO that is a re-domiciled entity can have its own branch as a related foreign FI if the branch carries on business outside Hong Kong similar to an intermediary FI's.
notes: True: ¶4.11.7 requires “reasonable steps to review the intermediary’s ability to perform its CDD duties” whenever reliability is in doubt.
False: ¶4.11.7 says that an intention to terminate triggers obtaining all CDD information “immediately”, not at the next customer review.

True: ¶4.11.8 requires both “adequate procedures in place to prevent ML/TF” and being “required to comply” with Schedule 2 for the customer. The customer-specific requirement is part of the Guideline's test.
False: ¶4.11.13 says the group policy should “mitigate adequately any higher country risk”; it does not require elimination of the risk.
True: AMLO Sch. 2 s.18(7), definition (a) and (b)(ii), includes an MSO that “is a re-domiciled entity” on the own-branch route, subject to the outside-Hong-Kong similar-business condition.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》及《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者依賴中介人執行客戶盡職審查的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 經營者如對中介人的可靠性產生懷疑，應採取合理步驟覆核該中介人履行其客戶盡職審查職責的能力。
經營者如欲終止與中介人的關係，應在下次定期覆核客戶資料時，向中介人取得所有的客戶盡職審查資料。
本地法律專業人士擔任中介人時，經營者須信納其有充分程序防止洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，並須就有關客戶遵從附表2。
相關外地金融機構擔任中介人時，適用的集團政策應能完全消除因該金融機構所處司法管轄區而涉及的較高國家風險。
屬經遷冊實體的經營者，其分行如在香港以外經營與中介人金融機構相類似的業務，可屬經營者的相關外地金融機構。
notes: 正確：第4.11.7段要求在可靠性存疑時「採取合理步驟覆核該中介人履行其盡職審查職責的能力」。
不正確：第4.11.7段說如欲終止關係，應「立即向中介人取得所有的盡職審查資料」，並非等到下次客戶覆核。
正確：第4.11.8段要求有「充分程序以防止洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集」，並須就有關客戶遵從附表2的相關規定；後者是指引對中介人的客戶適用條件。
不正確：第4.11.13段要求集團政策「充分減低」較高國家風險，並非把風險完全消除。
正確：附表2第18(7)條相關外地金融機構定義(a)、(b)(ii)段把「經遷冊實體」納入本身分行的途徑，並須符合在香港以外經營相類似業務的條件。

en.q: Under the AML/CFT Guideline, which statements about simplified due diligence for particular customers, accounts and products are correct?
statements: Before omitting a listed customer's beneficial-owner checks, the MSO should assess whether applicable disclosure requirements ensure adequate transparency of the customer's beneficial ownership.
Where an employee in a qualifying retirement scheme establishes a separate business relationship with the MSO, the scheme's simplified treatment exempts that relationship from customer due diligence.

If the MSO reasonably believes a transaction relates to a life policy with a single premium no greater than HK$20,000 or its equivalent, it may omit the relevant beneficial-owner identification and verification.
For a nominee company holding fund units for an FI's underlying customers, the account concession requires that customer FI to have conducted CDD on those underlying customers.

For the investment-vehicle account concession, the customer FI acting as the vehicle's service provider must have conducted CDD under the AMLO on the vehicle's investment manager instead of the vehicle.
For either the nominee-company or investment-vehicle account concession, the customer FI must be authorised to operate the account, with the authority evidenced by contractual document or agreement.
notes: True: ¶4.8.12 says the MSO should assess disclosure requirements ensuring “adequate transparency of beneficial ownership”. This is the Guideline's assessment, beyond merely identifying listed status.
False: ¶4.8.18 says that a separate business relationship with an employee requires the MSO to “apply CDD measures” under the Chapter's relevant requirements.

True: ¶4.8.17(c)(ii) lists “a single premium of no more than $20,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency”. The paragraph requires reasonable grounds to believe the transaction relates to that product.
True: ¶4.8.13, proviso (a)(i), requires the FI to have conducted CDD “on its underlying customers” when the nominee company holds fund units for the FI or its underlying customers.
False: ¶4.8.13, proviso (a)(ii), requires CDD “on the investment vehicle pursuant to the provisions of the AMLO”, not on its investment manager as a substitute.
True: ¶4.8.13, proviso (b), requires the FI to be “authorised to operate the account as evidenced by contractual document or agreement”. This condition accompanies both account routes.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關特定客戶、帳戶及產品的簡化盡職審查陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 選擇不識別或核實上市客戶的實益擁有人前，經營者應評估適用的披露規定是否確保該客戶的實益擁有權具充分透明度。
合資格退休計劃的僱員另與經營者建立獨立業務關係時，計劃所獲的簡化處理使這段獨立業務關係免於執行客戶盡職審查。
經營者有合理理由相信交易涉及一筆整付保費不多於港幣20,000元或等值外幣的人壽保險單時，可不識別或核實有關實益擁有人。
代名人公司代表客戶金融機構的相關客戶持有基金單位時，採用有關帳戶簡化安排，須該金融機構已對相關客戶進行盡職審查。
適用投資公司帳戶的簡化安排時，作為服務供應商的客戶金融機構，須根據條例對基金經理進行盡職審查，以代替審查投資公司。
適用代名人公司或投資公司帳戶的簡化安排時，客戶金融機構須獲授權操作有關帳戶，並有合約文件或協議作為該項授權的證據。
notes: 正確：第4.8.12段要求評估披露規定是否確保「客戶的實益擁有權具充分透明度」；這是指引要求的評估，並非只確認上市身分。
不正確：第4.8.18段說與僱員建立「獨立的業務關係」時，應按本章的相關規定執行盡職審查，不能沿用計劃的簡化處理。
正確：第4.8.17(c)(ii)段列出「一筆整付保費不多於20,000元」或等值外幣，並以有合理理由相信交易涉及有關產品為條件。
正確：第4.8.13段但書(a)(i)要求，代名人公司代金融機構或其相關客戶持有基金單位時，金融機構「已對它的相關客戶進行盡職審查」。
不正確：第4.8.13段但書(a)(ii)要求根據條例「對投資公司進行盡職審查」，並非以審查基金經理代替審查投資公司。
正確：第4.8.13段但書(b)要求「根據合約文件或協議獲授權操作有關帳戶」，此條件適用於兩項帳戶途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.8.14至4.8.15、4.8.19至4.8.20段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(6)條

en.q: Which statements about beneficial-owner concessions for investment vehicles and solicitors' client accounts are correct under the AML/CFT Guideline?
statements: Even with a qualifying institution responsible for investor CDD, the MSO must be satisfied that the investment vehicle ensures reliable systems and controls for CDD on all its underlying investors under requirements similar to Schedule 2.

For the solicitor's client-account concession, the clients' money or securities must be mingled in the account; keeping the account in the solicitor's name does not by itself satisfy the conditions for that concession.

For the solicitor's client-account concession, the account must be managed by the MSO as agent of the solicitor's clients, alongside the conditions on whose name the account bears and the mingling of clients' assets.

Where each solicitor's client has a separate sub-account and the funds are not co-mingled at the MSO, the MSO should establish the underlying clients' identities in addition to the identity of the solicitor opening the account.
notes: True: ¶4.8.15 permits the concession only “provided that it is satisfied” with reliable systems and controls for investor CDD under requirements similar to Schedule 2. Qualifying institutional status does not replace that condition.
True: ¶4.8.19(b) requires that clients' “moneys or securities” are mingled. This is cumulative with the account-name and agency-management conditions, not satisfied by the name alone.
False: ¶4.8.19(c) says the account is managed “by the customer as those clients’ agent”. The customer here is the solicitor or firm of solicitors, not the MSO.
True: ¶4.8.20 expressly covers “sub-accounts for each individual client where funds are not co-mingled at the MSO” and requires identification of the underlying clients as well as the solicitor.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關投資公司及律師當事人戶口的實益擁有人簡化安排的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 即使負責投資者盡職審查的機構屬合資格類別，經營者仍須信納投資公司保證設有可靠制度及管控措施，按與附表2相類似的規定對所有相關投資者進行盡職審查。
採用律師當事人戶口的簡化安排，須把當事人的金錢或證券混合在戶口內；單憑當事人戶口以律師名義開設，並不足以符合該項簡化安排的全部適用條件。
採用律師當事人戶口的簡化安排，戶口須由金錢服務經營者以律師當事人的代理人身分管理，並同時符合有關戶口名稱及把當事人資產混合存放的條件。
律師每名個別當事人各有附屬戶口，資金並未匯集在經營者內時，經營者除了核實開戶律師的身分外，亦應識別那些附屬戶口的相關當事人的身分。
notes: 正確：第4.8.15段要求「信納該投資公司已保證設有可靠的制度及管控措施」，按與附表2相類似的規定對投資者進行盡職審查；負責機構合資格不能替代此條件。
正確：第4.8.19(b)段說當事人的「金錢或證券已混合在一起」，並須同時符合戶口名稱及代理管理的條件。
不正確：第4.8.19(c)段說「由客戶以其當事人的代理人身分管理」；這裏的客戶是律師或律師行，並非金錢服務經營者。
正確：第4.8.20段明指每名客戶各有附屬戶口而資金未匯集的情況，經營者除核實開戶律師外，「亦應識別相關當事人的身分」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.8.3(c)、4.9.2段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(e)條

en.q: Which statements about responding to identification doubts and residual ML/TF risk in customer due diligence are correct?
statements: An MSO doubting the veracity or adequacy of earlier identification information may begin or continue simplified due diligence while the customer remains classified as low risk.
If the applicable enhanced due diligence measures cannot fully mitigate the identified ML/TF risks, the MSO should take other measures to mitigate the residual risks.
The Guideline gives placing transaction limits as an example of another measure an MSO can use for residual ML/TF risk that applicable enhanced due diligence has not fully mitigated.
The Guideline gives restricting account functionalities as an example of another measure for residual ML/TF risk that applicable enhanced due diligence has not fully mitigated.
notes: False: ¶4.8.3(c) requires SDD to stop when previous identification or verification information is in doubt. AMLO Sch. 2 s.3(1)(e) uses the test “veracity or adequacy”; a low risk rating does not preserve SDD in that situation.
True: ¶4.9.2 says that where EDD cannot fully mitigate identified risks, the MSO “should take other measures to mitigate the residual risks”.
True: ¶4.9.2 gives “placing transaction limits” as an example. It is a possible additional measure, not a requirement to impose both examples in every case.
True: ¶4.9.2 gives “restricting account functionalities” as an example alongside transaction limits. The examples do not impose a single compulsory package of controls.

tc.q: 以下有關客戶盡職審查中應對身分資料疑點及剩餘洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 經營者對過往識別身分資料的真實性或充分性存疑時，只要客戶仍被評為低風險，便可開始或繼續執行簡化客戶盡職審查措施。
適用的更嚴格盡職審查措施未能完全減低已識別的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時，經營者應採取其他措施減低剩餘風險。
指引把設立交易限額列為其他措施的例子，用以處理適用的更嚴格盡職審查措施未能完全減低的剩餘洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
指引把限制帳戶功能列為其他措施的例子，用以處理適用的更嚴格盡職審查措施未能完全減低的剩餘洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
notes: 不正確：第4.8.3(c)段把過往身分識別或核實資料「是否真實或充分存疑」列為不應執行或繼續簡化盡職審查的情況，不能因低風險評級而繼續。
正確：第4.9.2段說如更嚴格盡職審查未能完全減低風險，經營者「應採取其他措施減低剩餘風險」。
正確：第4.9.2段明列「設立交易限額」為例子，屬可採用的額外措施，並非每次都要同時採取兩項例子。
正確：第4.9.2段明列「限制帳戶功能」為例子，與交易限額同為例子，並非規定必須一併採用的固定組合。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A第1至4段

en.q: Under Appendix A of the AML/CFT Guideline, which statements about documents used to verify an individual's identity are correct?
statements: When a non-resident individual is physically present in Hong Kong for customer due diligence, the MSO should verify that person's identity by reference to a valid travel document.

For a non-resident outside Hong Kong, listed documents include a current national identity card with a photograph or a valid national driving licence with a photograph issued by a competent national or state authority.
For a minor born in Hong Kong who holds neither a valid travel document nor a Hong Kong identity card, the minor's Hong Kong birth certificate is the identity-verification document specified.
The Permanent Resident Identity Card of the Macau Special Administrative Region is among the documents Appendix A recognises as travel documents for verifying an individual customer's identity.
notes: True: Appendix A ¶1 places the rule in the context of physical presence in Hong Kong and says a non-resident should be verified by a “valid travel document”.

True: Appendix A ¶2(b)–(c) lists photographic national identity cards and current valid national driving licences for non-residents “not physically present in Hong Kong”. This statement concerns CDD documents.
True: Appendix A ¶4 specifies the “minor’s Hong Kong birth certificate” where the Hong Kong-born minor has no valid travel document or Hong Kong identity card.
True: Appendix A ¶3(a) expressly names the “Permanent Resident Identity Card of Macau Special Administrative Region” as a travel document.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A，以下有關核實個人身分所用文件的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 非香港居民為客戶盡職審查而實際身在香港時，金錢服務經營者應根據該名非香港居民持有的有效旅遊證件，核實其個人身分。
對於沒有現身香港的非香港居民，所列文件包括附有照片的有效國民身分證，或由主管國家或政府機構簽發並附有照片的有效國家駕駛執照。
在香港出生的未成年人，如並無持有有效旅遊證件或香港身份證，附錄所指明用以核實該名未成年人身分的文件，是其香港出生證明書。
就金錢服務經營者核實個人客戶身分而言，澳門特別行政區永久居民身分證，屬附錄A明列可作身分核實用途的旅遊證件之一。
notes: 正確：附錄A第1段以實際身在香港為背景，說非居民的身分應根據「有效旅遊證件」核實。
正確：附錄A第2(b)至(c)段就「沒有現身香港的非香港居民」列出附照片的國民身分證及有效國家駕駛執照；這裏談的是客戶盡職審查文件。
正確：附錄A第4段明列在香港出生且沒有有效旅遊證件或香港身份證的未成年人，可根據「香港出生證明書」核實身分。
正確：附錄A第3(a)段明列「澳門特別行政區永久居民身分證」，屬可作身分核實用途的旅遊證件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.6段

en.q: Which statements about the identity-document requirement for third-party cash transactions under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: A cash transaction of exactly $120,000 triggers the document-and-copy requirement when the person conducting it is not named on the account mandate.
For a qualifying cash transaction by someone absent from the account mandate, the requested identity document should be the account customer’s.
For a qualifying cash transaction by someone absent from the mandate, the MSO can meet the retention requirement by recording the document number.
Keeping the document copy for a qualifying third-party cash transaction is intended to facilitate ongoing monitoring by the MSO after the transaction.
notes: Correct: ¶4.2.6 says “equal to or exceeding $120,000” and requires the person’s name to be absent from the account mandate.
False: ¶4.2.6 requires the identity document of the person undertaking the cash transaction, not a substitution of the account customer’s document.
False: ¶4.2.6 says to “retain a copy”; retaining the document number alone does not meet that requirement.
Correct: ¶4.2.6 expressly gives the purpose as facilitating “ongoing monitoring”; the copy is not merely for inspecting the document during the transaction.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關第三方現金交易的身分證明文件規定，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 現金交易款額剛好為120,000元，而進行交易的人的姓名不在帳戶委託書上，便觸發要求提供身分證明文件及將副本存檔的規定。
對於由姓名不在帳戶委託書上的人進行、並達到款額門檻的現金交易，應要求提供的身分證明文件，是帳戶客戶本人的文件。
對於由姓名不在帳戶委託書上的人進行、並達到款額門檻的現金交易，金錢服務經營者記下證件號碼，便已符合文件留存規定。
就符合條件的第三方現金交易而言，保存進行交易的人的身分證明文件副本，是為了讓金錢服務經營者在交易後持續進行監察。
notes: 正確：第4.2.6段訂明「相等於120,000元或以上」，並以進行交易的人的姓名不在帳戶委託書上為條件；剛好達到門檻也包括在內。
錯誤：第4.2.6段要求進行現金交易而姓名不在帳戶委託書上的人提供本人的身分證明文件，並非以帳戶客戶的文件代替。
錯誤：第4.2.6段要求將身分證明文件的「副本存檔」；只記下證件號碼，並未符合留存副本的規定。
正確：第4.2.6段明文說明將文件副本存檔是「以便持續監察」，用途並不止於辦理當次交易時查閱文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第10.4(c)(i)至(iii)段

en.q: For the card-related exclusion from the wire transfer requirements, assume the card number accompanies each transfer. Which statements are correct?
statements: A wire transfer arising from a debit-card withdrawal from a bank account through an automated teller machine falls within the card-related exclusion.
A wire transfer arising from obtaining a cash advance on a credit card can fall within the exclusion, even though the transaction provides cash.
A wire transfer arising from paying for goods or services with a prepaid card can qualify, as the exclusion extends beyond credit-card purchases.
If the card serves as a payment system for a person-to-person transfer, including its number in the message preserves the card-related exclusion.
notes: Correct: ¶10.4(c)(i) expressly gives an ATM debit-card withdrawal as an example. The described bank withdrawal is not a person-to-person transfer, and the stem supplies the card-number condition in (iii).
Correct: ¶10.4(c)(i) expressly includes “obtaining a cash advance on a credit card”. Providing cash does not remove that example from the exclusion.
Correct: ¶10.4(c)(i) lists paying for goods or services with a “credit card, debit card or prepaid card”.
False: ¶10.4(c)(ii) separately requires that the card not be used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer; including the number does not cure that defect.

tc.q: 就不適用電傳轉帳規定的咭交易而言，假設每項轉帳均附隨咭號。以下哪些陳述正確？
statements: 以扣帳咭經由自動櫃員機從銀行戶口提取金錢而引致的電傳轉帳，屬於不適用電傳轉帳規定的咭交易範圍。
以信用咭取得現金墊支而引致的電傳轉帳，可屬於不適用電傳轉帳規定的咭交易範圍，即使交易所提供的是現金。
以預付咭就貨品及服務付款而引致的電傳轉帳，可屬於不適用電傳轉帳規定的咭交易範圍，並不限於信用咭消費。
若咭用作執行人對人轉帳的支付系統，只要附隨轉帳的信息載有咭號，便仍可適用不受電傳轉帳規定約束的安排。
notes: 正確：第10.4(c)(i)段明列以扣帳咭經由自動櫃員機提款的例子；所述銀行提款並非人對人轉帳，而題幹已符合(iii)的咭號附隨條件。
正確：第10.4(c)(i)段明列「以信用咭取得現金墊支」；交易提供現金，不會因此把這個例子排除於所述範圍之外。
正確：第10.4(c)(i)段列明以「信用咭、扣帳咭或預付咭」就貨品及服務付款，預付咭亦包括在內。
錯誤：第10.4(c)(ii)段另行規定咭不得用作執行人對人轉帳的支付系統；附上咭號並不能取代這項條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.6至4.3.7、4.3.11段

en.q: Which of the following are correct about identifying and verifying legal person and trust customers?
statements: A legal person customer may be identified by obtaining its trading name instead of its full name, alongside the other minimum identification information.
For a legal person customer, the minimum identification information includes its registered office address and unique identification number together with the document type.
For a trust or similar legal arrangement customer, the minimum identification information includes its name, establishment or settlement date, and the jurisdiction whose laws govern it.
For a trust or similar legal arrangement customer, the MSO should obtain any unique identification number granted by an applicable official body, if any, and the document type.
For a trust or similar legal arrangement customer, the MSO should obtain a registered office address in every case, whether or not a registered office is applicable.
For a legal person customer, the MSO should normally use reliable, independent sources to verify its name, legal form, current existence and powers that regulate and bind it.
notes: False: ¶4.3.6(a) states “For a customer that is a legal person, an MSO should identify the customer by obtaining at least the following identification information: (a) full name;”. The minimum is the full name; a trading name is not an alternative.

True: ¶4.3.6(c)–(d) states “place of incorporation, establishment or registration (including address of registered office); (d) unique identification number (e.g. incorporation number or business registration number) and document type;”.
True: ¶4.3.11(a)–(c) states “name of the trust or legal arrangement; (b) date of establishment or settlement; (c) the jurisdiction whose laws govern the trust or legal arrangement;”.
True: ¶4.3.11(d) states “unique identification number (if any) granted by any applicable official bodies and document type”.
False: ¶4.3.11(e) states “address of registered office (if applicable).”. The requirement is qualified by “if applicable”.

True: ¶4.3.7 states “verify its name, legal form, current existence (at the time of verification) and powers that regulate and bind the legal person by reference to documents, data or information provided by a reliable and independent source”.

tc.q: 關於識別及核實法人及信託客戶，以下哪些陳述正確？
statements: 識別屬法人的客戶時，金錢服務經營者可收集其商業名稱代替全名，並收集其他最低限度的識別資料。
屬法人的客戶的最低限度識別資料，包括其註冊辦事處地址，以及獨特識別號碼連同該文件的類別。
屬信託或其他類似法律安排的客戶的最低限度識別資料，包括其名稱、成立或結算日期，以及以法律監管它的司法管轄區。
屬信託或其他類似法律安排的客戶，如有官方機構授予的獨特識別號碼，金錢服務經營者應收集該號碼及文件的類別。
屬信託或其他類似法律安排的客戶，不論註冊辦事處是否適用，金錢服務經營者均應收集其註冊辦事處地址。
核實屬法人的客戶時，金錢服務經營者一般應參考可靠及獨立來源，核實其名稱、法定形式、現時仍然存在及規管和約束它的權力。
notes: 錯誤：第4.3.6(a)段列明「就屬法人的客戶而言，金錢服務經營者最低限度應收集以下識別資料以識別該客戶： (a) 全名；」。最低限度須收集全名，不能以商業名稱代替。
正確：第4.3.6(c)至(d)段列明「註冊、成立或登記的地點（包括註冊辦事處地址）； (d) 獨特識別號碼（例如註冊號碼或商業登記號碼）及文件的類別；」。
正確：第4.3.11(a)至(c)段列明「信託或法律安排的名稱； (b) 成立或結算日期； (c) 以法律監管有關信託或法律安排的司法管轄區；」。
正確：第4.3.11(d)段列明「任何官方機構授予的獨特識別號碼（如有）及文件的類別」。
錯誤：第4.3.11(e)段列明「註冊辦事處地址（如適用）。」。規定附有「如適用」的條件。
正確：第4.3.7段列明「一般應參考由可靠及獨立來源所提供的相關文件、數據或資料，以核實該法人的名稱、法定形式、現時（核實時）仍然存在及規管和約束該法人的權力」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.12(b), (d) and fn24; ¶4.4.16–4.4.17
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.12(b)、(d)段及註24；第4.4.16至4.4.17段

en.q: Which of the following are correct about evidence for trusts and bearer-share ownership?
statements: An appropriate register in the trust’s country of establishment may be used for verification; the MSO should consider adequate transparency and up-to-date ownership and control information.
A lawyer’s written confirmation is a listed source for verifying a trust even where that lawyer has not reviewed the relevant instrument, provided the lawyer is professionally qualified.
As part of its ongoing periodic review, an MSO should obtain evidence confirming the authorised or registered custodian where its customer’s bearer shares are held by such a custodian.
Where bearer shares are not deposited with an authorised or registered custodian, the MSO should require its customer to notify ownership changes at the next annual declaration.
notes: True: ¶4.3.12(b), fn24 states “In determining whether a register is appropriate, the MSO should have regard to adequate transparency”. Paragraph 4.3.12(b) permits the relevant country’s appropriate register; fn24 also requires ownership and control changes to be kept up-to-date.
False: ¶4.3.12(d) states “written confirmation from a lawyer who has reviewed the relevant instrument”. The listed lawyer must have reviewed the instrument.
True: ¶4.4.16 states “As part of the MSO’s ongoing periodic review, it should obtain evidence to confirm the authorised/registered custodian of the bearer shares.”.

False: ¶4.4.17 states “The MSO should also require the customer to notify it immediately of any changes in the ownership of the shares.”. Ownership changes require immediate notification, independently of the annual declaration.

tc.q: 關於信託及持票人股份擁有權的證據，以下哪些陳述正確？
statements: 核實信託可採用其成立國家的合適登記冊記錄；金錢服務經營者應顧及足夠透明度，以及擁有權及控制權資料的更新。
律師的書面確認書屬核實信託的列明來源；只要該律師具有專業資格，即使未覆核相關文書，亦可使用該確認書。
客戶的持票人股份由認可或註冊保管人保管時，金錢服務經營者應取得證據確定該保管人，作為持續定期覆核的一部分。
持票人股份如非存放於認可或註冊保管人，金錢服務經營者應要求客戶在下一次年度聲明時，知會股份擁有權的變動。
notes: 正確：第4.3.12(b)段及註24列明「金錢服務經營者在決定登記冊是否合適時，應顧及須有足夠透明度」。第4.3.12(b)段列出成立國家的合適登記冊；註24亦規定擁有權及控制權資料如有改變，必須更新。
錯誤：第4.3.12(d)段列明「由已覆核相關文書的律師簽發的書面確認書」。所列律師須已覆核相關文書；只有專業資格並不足夠。
正確：第4.4.16段列明「金錢服務經營者應取得證據以確定持票人股份的認可╱註冊保管人，作為其持續定期覆核的一部分。」。
錯誤：第4.4.17段列明「金錢服務經營者亦應要求客戶即時知會有關股份擁有權的任何變動情況。」。擁有權變動須即時通知，並非等候年度聲明。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.14, 4.3.16, 4.14.1; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, AML/CFT A27
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.14、4.3.16、4.14.1段；所有金錢服務經營者適用的常見問題，打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答27

en.q: Which of the following are correct about identification documents, certification and access to CDD records?
statements: Documents, data or information obtained for verifying a customer’s identity should be current when they are provided to or obtained by the MSO, including those used for a legal person customer.

For in-person CDD with a natural person customer or someone establishing a relationship for a legal person, trust or similar arrangement, staff should generally sight the original ID document and keep a copy.
Alongside official documents used to verify identity, the MSO is expected to require certification of every other item of CDD information or documentation supplied by the customer.
Certification is not required where the MSO is able to check the customer’s documents against public sources; this is an express exception to the general certification expectation.
As a general principle, customers should always be given the opportunity, if they wish, to present their original documents to the MSO’s staff for the identification process.
Even for numbered accounts, CDD records must be available to the CCE, other competent authorities, the compliance officer, auditors and other staff with appropriate authority.
notes: True: ¶4.3.14 states “is current at the time they are provided to or obtained by the MSO”.

True: ¶4.3.16 covers a natural person customer or a person representing a legal person, trust or similar arrangement to establish a business relationship, when physically present during CDD; staff should generally sight the original and retain a copy.

False: AML/CFT A27 states “There is no expectation to require certification for all other CDD information or documents provided by the customer”. The FAQ expressly rejects an across-the-board certification requirement.
True: AML/CFT A27 states “or to require certification if an MSO is able to check the documents against public sources”.
True: AML/CFT A27 states “customers should always be provided with the opportunity, if they wish to do so, to present their original documents to the staff of the MSO”.
True: ¶4.14.1 states “the customer’s CDD record must be available to the CCE, other competent authorities, the CO, auditors, and other staff with appropriate authority”.

tc.q: 關於識別文件、認證及查閱客戶盡職審查紀錄，以下哪些陳述正確？
statements: 為核實客戶身分而取得的文件、數據或資料，包括用於法人客戶的資料，應反映提交給金錢服務經營者時或其取得時的現況。
自然人客戶或代表法人、信託或類似安排建立業務關係的人為盡職審查而現身時，通常可由職員查看識別文件正本，並保存複本。
除用於核實身分的官方文件外，金錢服務經營者亦須要求客戶提供的每一項其他客戶盡職審查資料或文件均經認證。
金錢服務經營者如能將客戶的文件與公開來源核對，便無須認證該等文件；這是一般認證要求的一項明確例外。
一般而言，金錢服務經營者應盡量容許有意出示正本的客戶，向該經營者的職員出示文件正本，以供身分識別程序使用。
即使涉及保密號碼戶口，客戶盡職審查紀錄亦必須提供予關長、其他主管當局、合規主任、核數師及其他獲適當授權的人員。
notes: 正確：第4.3.14段列明「反映提交時或該金錢服務經營者取得時的現況」。
正確：第4.3.16段涵蓋為盡職審查而現身的自然人客戶，或代表法人、信託或其他類似法律安排建立業務關係的人；「通常可由其職員查看識別文件的正本，並保存該文件的複本」。
錯誤：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答27列明「金錢服務經營者無須對客戶提供的所有其他客戶盡職審查資料或文件進行認證」。常見問題明確否定對所有其他資料一律認證的要求。
正確：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答27列明「金錢服務經營者在能將有關文件與公開來源進行核對的情況下，亦無須認證該等文件。」。
正確：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答27列明「金錢服務經營者應盡量容許客戶（如客戶有意）向金錢服務經營者的職員出示文件正本」。
正確：第4.14.1段列明「金錢服務經營者必須向關長、其他主管當局、合規主任、核數師及其他獲適當授權的人員提供客戶盡職審查紀錄」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶8–10 and fn74
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第8至10段及註74

en.q: Which statements about appropriate certifiers and certification of identity documents under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: A certifier who signs and dates a copy and states their capacity may omit the statement that it is a true copy of the original.
MSOs may accept copies from a legal person customer’s internal professional who is bound by a relevant professional body’s conduct rules and certifies in a professional capacity.
A member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction is included among the examples of appropriate persons to certify identity documents.
A Justice of the Peace is included among the non-exhaustive examples of appropriate persons to certify identity documents.
The Guideline expressly lists certified public accountants, lawyers, notaries public and chartered secretaries among its examples of appropriate professional certifiers.
If the MSO doubts the authenticity of certified documents or whether they relate to the customer, it should take additional measures to mitigate ML/TF risk.
notes: False: AML/CFT Guideline App.A ¶9 states “The certifier should state that it is a true copy of the original (or words to similar effect)”. Signing and dating do not replace the required true-copy statement.

True: AML/CFT Guideline App.A footnote 74 states “an MSO may accept the copy documents certified by a professional person within a legal person customer if that professional person is subject to the professional conduct requirements of a relevant professional body, and has certified the copy documents in his or her professional capacity”.
True: AML/CFT Guideline App.A ¶8(b) states “a member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction”.
True: AML/CFT Guideline App.A ¶8(d) states “a Justice of the Peace; and (e) other professional person”.

True: Appendix A ¶8(e) lists other professional persons such as certified public accountants, lawyers, notaries public and chartered secretaries. The examples are non-exhaustive; the paragraph is not a claim that company directors can never otherwise qualify.

True: Appendix A ¶10 states “In any circumstances where an MSO is unsure of the authenticity of certified documents, or that the documents relate to the customer, MSOs should take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk.”.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關合適的證明人及身分文件認證的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 證明人在複本上簽署、寫上日期及註明身分後，便可省略說明該文件為正本的真確複本。
法人客戶內的專業人士如須遵守相關專業團體的操守規定，並以專業身分認證，經營者可接納有關文件複本。
在對等司法管轄區的司法人員，屬指引列出的認證身分核實文件的合適人選例子之一。
太平紳士亦列於認證身分核實文件的合適人選例子之中，而該名單並非詳盡無遺。
指引明列的合適專業證明人例子包括會計師、律師、公證人及特許秘書，可認證身分核實文件。
認證文件真確性或與客戶的關係存疑時，應採取額外措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
notes: 不正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A第9段列明「證明人必須說明該複本文件為正本文件的真確複本(或具類似效力的字詞)」。簽署及寫上日期不能取代說明文件為真確複本的要求。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A註腳74列明「金錢服務經營者可接納經法人客戶內的專業人士認證的文件複本，惟該專業人士本身須遵守相關專業團體的專業操守規定，並已經以其專業身分認證該等文件複本」。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A第8(b)段列明「在對等司法管轄區的司法人員」。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A第8(d)段列明「太平紳士；及 (e) 其他專業人士」。
正確：附錄A第8(e)段明列其他專業人士，例如會計師、律師、公證人及特許秘書。此為非詳盡例子，不能從沒有列出公司董事便推斷任何董事均不得合資格。
正確：附錄A第10段列明「在任何情況下，當金錢服務經營者未能確定認證文件的真確性，或懷疑有關文件與客戶無關，金錢服務經營者應採取額外措施，以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。」。

source.en: FAQ applicable to all MSOs, AML/CFT A16
source.tc: 所有金錢服務經營者適用的常見問題，打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答16

en.q: Which of the following are correct about applying a risk-based approach to source of wealth and customer profiles?
statements: For high risk customers, the MSO is expected to apply the same source of wealth procedures to all such customers in the same manner, regardless of differences in their circumstances.
For high risk customers, there is no expectation to collect source of wealth evidence dating back decades when the risk does not justify doing so, as this is often impractical.
For non-high risk customers, information used to understand the relationship’s purpose and nature, such as occupation or corporate business nature, should often suffice for a basic customer profile.
For non-high risk customers, that basic profile should enable the MSO to monitor whether the account balance and transaction value and volume accord with the customer’s expected wealth and profile.
notes: False: AML/CFT A16 states “there is no expectation to apply the same source of wealth procedures to all these customers in the same manner”. The FAQ rejects a uniform approach even within the high risk group.
True: AML/CFT A16 states “or collect evidence dating back decades when the risk does not justify doing so, as it is often impractical”.

True: AML/CFT A16 states “occupation of individual customers, business nature of corporate customers, etc.) should often be sufficient for the MSO to have a basic understanding of the customer’s profile”.
True: AML/CFT A16 states “monitor that the account balance, and value and volume of transactions, is in line with the expected wealth and profile of the customer”.

tc.q: 關於以風險為本的方法處理財富來源及客戶狀況，以下哪些陳述正確？
statements: 對所有高風險客戶，金錢服務經營者均須以完全相同的方式應用相同財富來源程序，不論各人的情況有何差異。
對高風險客戶，如風險水平不足以支持收集數十年前的財富來源證據，便無須收集，因為此舉通常並不切實可行。
對非高風險客戶，為了解業務關係的目的及性質而取得的職業或公司業務性質等資料，一般足以對客戶狀況有基本了解。
對非高風險客戶，基本狀況資料應使金錢服務經營者能監察戶口結餘及交易金額和交易量，是否與客戶的預期財富及狀況一致。
notes: 錯誤：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答16列明「金錢服務經營者無須就所有客戶的財富來源以相同方式應用相同的程序」。即使屬高風險客戶，也不須一律使用相同方式。
正確：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答16列明「亦無須在風險水平不足以支持收集數十年前的證據的情況下收集有關證據，因為此舉通常並不切實可行」。
正確：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答16列明「例如個人客戶的職業資料、公司客戶的業務性質等），一般應足以讓金錢服務經營者對客戶狀況有基本的了解」。
正確：打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集答16列明「監察戶口結餘及交易金額和交易量是否與客戶的預期財富及狀況一致」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.16.2; Circular MSSB/MIS_05/2021 ¶3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.2段；通函MSSB/MIS_05/2021第3段

en.q: Which of the following are correct about jurisdictional risk assessment and controls for cross-border delivery channels?
statements: The factors include whether the jurisdiction is a member of FATF-style regional bodies and the recent mutual evaluation report published by those bodies.
The factors include whether the FATF identifies the jurisdiction as having strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and its recent progress in improving its AML/CFT regime.
The advisory circulars named in the factors are those the JFIU issues to alert MSOs to jurisdictions with poor AML/CFT controls.
The factors include other AML/CFT-related publications issued by specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations.
When evaluating whether jurisdictions other than FATF members apply requirements similar to Schedule 2 for equivalence purposes, the MSO should document its assessment of each jurisdiction.
MSOs should regularly review their remittance delivery channels to comply with the latest regulatory requirements and mitigate potential ML/TF risks in the jurisdictions concerned.
notes: Correct: ¶4.16.2(a) lists membership of “FATF-style regional bodies” and the “recent mutual evaluation report” published by those bodies.
Correct: ¶4.16.2(b) includes both the FATF’s identification of strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and “the recent progress of improving its AML/CFT regime”.
False: ¶4.16.2(c) names advisory circulars “issued by the CCE”, not the JFIU. This substitutes the issuing body in that listed factor.
Correct: ¶4.16.2(d) lists other AML/CFT-related publications by “specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations”.
True: ¶4.16.2 states “The MSO should document its assessment of the jurisdiction”.

True: Circular MSSB/MIS_05/2021 ¶3 states “these channels should be reviewed by MSOs on a regular basis to comply with the latest regulatory requirements and mitigate the potential ML/TF risks in the jurisdictions concerned”.

tc.q: 關於司法管轄區風險評估及跨境交付渠道的管控措施，以下哪些陳述正確？
statements: 考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否屬於與財務行動特別組織相類似職能的地區組織的成員，以及這些地區組織發表的相互評估報告。
考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否被財務行動特別組織識別為缺乏執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略，以及近期改善制度的進度。
考慮因素列出的忠告通函，是聯合財富情報組發出、提醒金錢服務經營者哪些司法管轄區在管控打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面表現欠佳的通函。
考慮因素包括專門化的國家、國際、非政府及商業機構所發布、關於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的其他刊物。
就對等目的評估特別組織成員以外的司法管轄區是否施加類似附表2的規定時，金錢服務經營者應將其對該司法管轄區的評估記錄在案。
金錢服務經營者須定期覆核其匯款交付渠道，以符合相關司法管轄區的最新監管規定，並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的潛在風險。
notes: 正確：第4.16.2(a)段列明與特別組織相類似職能的地區組織的成員資格，以及這些地區組織發表的相互評估報告。
正確：第4.16.2(b)段包括特別組織識別的策略不足，以及「近期改善打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的進度」。
錯誤：第4.16.2(c)段列明「任何由關長不時發出的忠告通函」，發出者是關長，並非聯合財富情報組。
正確：第4.16.2(d)段列明「專門化的國家、國際、非政府及商業機構」發布的相關其他刊物。
正確：第4.16.2段列明「金錢服務經營者應將其對該司法管轄區的評估記錄在案」。
正確：通函MSSB/MIS_05/2021第3段列明「金錢服務經營者亦須定期覆核此等渠道，以符合相關司法管轄區的最新監管規定，並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的潛在風險。」。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024, red flags and key controls 7–8, fn6; AML/CFT Guideline ¶5.7(d)–(e)
source.tc: 通函MSSB/MIS_01/2024可疑交易訊號及主要管控措施第7至8項、註6；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第5.7(d)至(e)段

en.q: Which statements about third-party payment risks and transaction-monitoring parameters are correct?
statements: Seemingly unrelated customers sharing the same transaction pattern, such as transferring funds to one individual's account, is a listed red flag for third-party payments.
A customer's inability to provide additional identification documents immediately when required is listed as an indication that the third-party payment presents relatively low risk.
The customer's affiliated companies and regulated financial institutions are examples of third parties generally considered to pose relatively low risks in the third-party payment circular.
Extra caution is called for if the customer cannot provide identity details of the third-party payer for verification before the payment is made.
In setting transaction-monitoring parameters and thresholds, the listed transaction characteristics include the geographical origin or destination of a payment or receipt handled for a customer.
In setting transaction-monitoring parameters and thresholds, the listed normal account activity or turnover is that of the MSO itself, rather than that of the customer.
notes: Correct: the circular's red-flag list names seemingly unrelated customers sharing a transaction pattern, including transfers to a single individual's account.
False: the circular lists customers who cannot immediately provide additional identification documents as a red flag or potentially higher risk factor, not a low-risk indication.
Correct: key control 7 fn6 names affiliated companies of the customers and regulated financial institutions among examples generally considered relatively low risk.
Correct: key control 8 requires extra caution when identity details cannot be supplied for verification before payment; the timing is part of the condition.
Correct: ¶5.7(d) lists the geographical origin/destination of a payment or receipt among transaction characteristics relevant to parameters and thresholds.
False: ¶5.7(e) says the customer's normal account activity or turnover, not the MSO's own activity or turnover.

tc.q: 關於第三方支付風險及交易監察參數，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 多名看似沒有關連的客戶採用一樣的交易模式，例如將資金轉帳至同一名個人的帳戶，是第三方支付通函列出的可疑交易訊號。
客戶不能應要求立即提供額外身分證明文件，通函把這種情況列作有關第三方支付具有相對較低風險的指標。
客戶的聯繫公司及受規管金融機構，是第三方支付通函列舉的一般可視為具有較低風險的第三方例子。
如客戶在進行支付前無法就第三方付款人的身分提供詳細資料作核實之用，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。
設計交易監察參數及門檻時，所列應顧及的交易特徵，包括金錢服務經營者為客戶處理的付款或收款的地點。
設計交易監察參數及門檻時，所列的正常戶口活動或營業額，指的是金錢服務經營者本身的活動或營業額，而非客戶的。
notes: 正確：通函可疑交易訊號清單列明，多名看似沒有關連的客戶採用一樣的交易模式，包括將資金轉帳至同一名個人的帳戶。
錯誤：通函把「客戶不能應要求立即提供額外的身分證明文件」列作可疑交易訊號或潛在較高風險因素，並非較低風險指標。
正確：主要管控措施第7項註6，列出客戶的聯繫公司及受規管金融機構，作為一般可視為具有較低風險的第三方例子。
正確：主要管控措施第8項列明，如客戶在支付前無法提供第三方付款人身分的詳細資料作核實之用，便應格外留神。
正確：第5.7(d)段把「付款╱收款的地點」列作設定參數及門檻時應顧及的交易特徵。
錯誤：第5.7(e)段所列的是「該客戶的正常戶口活動或營業額」，並非金錢服務經營者本身的。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.12.1, ¶10.5 footnote 70 and Appendix A ¶3; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q5
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.12.1段、第10.5段附註70及附錄A第3段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第5問

en.q: Which of the following correctly describe terms used to identify customers and their business relationships?
statements: A legal person’s principal place of business is where it primarily operates or carries on its main activities, and may be the same as or different from its registered office address.
For the CDD requirements, the expression “pre-existing customer” covers a customer with whom the MSO established a business relationship before 1 April 2018.
A customer identification number uniquely identifies the originator to the originating institution and is the same number as the unique transaction reference number for a wire transfer.
A travel document is a passport or other document bearing the holder’s photograph and establishing the holder’s identity and nationality, domicile or place of permanent residence.
If a legal person’s principal business address does not fit the MSO’s understanding of its business nature or customer profile, the MSO should seek the rationale for that address.
notes: True: FAQ Q5 defines the place by the legal person’s principal operations or activities, not by requiring a match with its registered office.
False: ¶4.12.1 fixes the boundary at “1 April 2012”, when the AMLO came into effect, not 1 April 2018.
False: ¶10.5 footnote 70 says it “is a different number from the unique transaction reference number”; identifying a customer differs from identifying a transaction.
True: Appendix A ¶3 requires a photograph and the specified identity and nationality or residence information; the definition is not limited to passports.
Correct: FAQ A5 requires the MSO to seek to understand why the address is provided when it does not fit the business nature or customer profile.

tc.q: 關於識別客戶及其業務關係所用的詞語，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 法人的主要營業地點是營運主要所在地或主要活動的地點，其地址可與註冊辦事處地址相同或不同。
就客戶盡職審查規定而言，先前客戶是指在2018年4月1日前，已與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的客戶。
客戶識別號碼是用作識別就發起機構而言屬匯款人的獨特號碼，並與電傳轉帳的獨特交易參考編號屬同一號碼。
旅遊證件是附有持有人照片，能確定其身分及國籍、原居地或永久居留地的護照或其他證件。
如法人的主要營業地址不符合金錢服務經營者對其業務性質或客戶狀況的了解，經營者應致力找出獲提供該地址的理據。
notes: 正確：常見問題第5問按法人的主要營運或活動界定主要營業地點，並說可與註冊辦事處地址「相同或不同」。
錯誤：第4.12.1段以打擊洗錢條例生效的「2012年4月1日」為界線，並非2018年4月1日。
錯誤：第10.5段附註70說客戶識別號碼與獨特交易參考編號「並不相同」；兩者並非同一號碼。
正確：附錄A第3段要求持有人照片，以及所列的身分及國籍或居留地資料；旅遊證件並不限於護照。
正確：常見問題答5要求在主要營業地點地址不符合業務性質或客戶狀況的了解時，致力找出獲提供該地址的理據。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.3
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第3頁

en.q: Which statements about trade entities’ addresses and online presence are correct?
statements: A likely mass-registration address without a specific unit is a structural risk indicator.
A business address unsuitable for the stated activity remains an indicator despite a reasonable explanation.
A website filled with copied boilerplate material can indicate a problematic online business presence.
A website showing poor knowledge of the traded product or industry is a structural risk indicator.
notes: True: p.3 The list includes a likely mass-registration address, especially without a specific unit.
False: p.3 This example requires no reasonable explanation for the unsuitable address.
True: p.3 Copied boilerplate is given as an example of a problematic online presence.
True: p.3 A lack of product or industry knowledge on the website is expressly listed.

tc.q: 關於貿易實體的地址及網上資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 疑似大量公司共用的註冊地址而沒有具體單位，屬結構性風險指標。
營業地址不適合申報業務，即使有合理解釋，仍符合此項風險指標。
網站主要充斥從其他網站抄錄的範本文字，可反映有問題的網上業務資料。
網站顯示對所交易產品或行業缺乏認識，屬結構性風險指標。
notes: 正確：第3頁，原文列出疑似大量公司共用的註冊地址，尤其沒有具體單位的情況。
錯誤：第3頁，此例子的條件是沒有合理解釋；刪去該條件會擴大指標範圍。
正確：第3頁，原文以主要抄錄其他網站範本文字作為網上資料有問題的例子。
正確：第3頁，原文列出網站反映對交易產品或行業缺乏知識。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.3
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第3頁

en.q: Which statements about trade entities’ corporate structures and staffing are correct?
statements: An unusually complex and illogical corporate structure involving shell companies is a risk indicator.
Registration or offices in a jurisdiction with weak AML/CFT compliance is a structural risk indicator.
A minimal workforce is a staffing indicator even when it matches the volume of traded commodities.
Nominee owners hiding beneficial ownership may reveal themselves through ignorance of transaction details.
notes: True: p.3 Both unusual complexity and illogical structure are relevant; shell companies are an example.
True: p.3 The location may concern registration or offices; it is not confined to incorporation.
False: p.3 The workforce must be inconsistent with the volume of traded commodities.
True: p.3 Lack of knowledge of transaction details can suggest nominee ownership or management.

tc.q: 關於貿易實體的公司結構及人手，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 公司結構異常複雜且不合邏輯，並涉及空殼公司，屬風險指標。
在打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集合規薄弱地區設辦事處，屬風險指標。
僱員很少即屬人手風險指標，即使人手與商品交易量相符亦然。
代名擁有人掩飾實益擁有權，可能因不熟悉交易詳情而露出跡象。
notes: 正確：第3頁，原文列出異常複雜且不合邏輯的結構，並以空殼公司為例。
正確：第3頁，原文涵蓋註冊地或辦事處所在地，不限於成立地點。
錯誤：第3頁，原文要求少量人手與商品交易量不符；不能刪去此條件。
正確：第3頁，原文以缺乏交易詳情知識作為代名擁有人或管理人員的例子。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.3
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第3頁

en.q: Which statements about trade entities’ business footprints are correct?
statements: Missing routine payroll, operating-cost payments or tax remittances may indicate a lack of typical business activity.
An unrelated entity copying a famous corporation’s name may be trying to appear affiliated with that corporation.
Dormant periods are listed as structural risk indicators where they are adequately explained by the entity.
Failure to meet ordinary business obligations, such as filing VAT returns, is a structural risk indicator.
notes: True: p.3 The absence of these expected business transactions is expressly illustrated.
True: p.3 The indicator concerns a misleading apparent connection to a well-known corporation.
False: p.3 The listed condition is unexplained dormancy, not adequately explained dormancy.
True: p.3 Non-compliance with regular business obligations is expressly listed.

tc.q: 關於貿易實體的業務活動跡象，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 缺乏正常薪金、營運開支付款或繳稅交易，可顯示缺少典型業務活動。
無關連實體模仿知名公司的名稱，可能試圖令人誤以為是該公司的一部分。
貿易實體對休眠期有充分解釋的情況，列作結構性風險指標。
未履行一般業務責任，例如提交增值稅申報表，屬結構性風險指標。
notes: 正確：第3頁，原文以缺乏與申報僱員數目相稱的薪金交易、營運開支及繳稅作為例子。
正確：第3頁，指標關注模仿名稱而造成與知名公司有聯繫的假象。
錯誤：第3頁，原文指沒有解釋的休眠期，而非已充分解釋的休眠期。
正確：第3頁，原文明列不履行一般業務責任，並以增值稅申報為例。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.4
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第4頁

en.q: Which statements about trade activity inconsistent with a customer’s business are correct?
statements: A car dealer exporting clothing is an example of trade inconsistent with its stated line of business.
Numerous intermediaries in incongruent industries within a complex trade deal are a trade activity indicator.
Consistently low margins qualify under the listed indicator even when they are commercially reasonable.
Estimating a fair price for commodities outside an open market may make profit-margin assessment difficult.
notes: True: p.4 The document gives this example of an inconsistent business line.
True: p.4 The concern is numerous third-party intermediaries in incongruent lines of business.
False: p.4 The condition is unreasonably low margins, not every low margin.
True: p.4 Footnote 5 cautions that fair-price estimation may be difficult for some commodities.

tc.q: 關於與客戶業務不一致的貿易活動，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 汽車經銷商出口服裝，是貿易活動與申報業務不一致的例子。
複雜貿易涉及多個業務不相稱行業的中介人，屬貿易活動風險指標。
持續低利潤率即符合所列指標，即使在商業上屬合理亦然。
估算非公開市場交易商品的公平價格，可能令利潤率評估困難。
notes: 正確：第4頁，原文以汽車經銷商出口服裝作為業務不一致的例子。
正確：第4頁，原文關注複雜貿易中多個業務不相稱的第三方中介人。
錯誤：第4頁，原文要求利潤率低得不合理，並非所有低利潤率均符合。
正確：第4頁，註5提醒某些商品難以估算公平價格，例如不在公開市場交易的商品。

source.en: Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators p.4
source.tc: 《以貿易為本的洗錢風險指標》（英文原文；中文為學習譯文）第4頁

en.q: Which statements about trade financing and rapid business expansion are correct?
statements: Purchases supposedly for an entity’s own account that clearly exceed its economic capacity are an indicator.
Sudden cash deposits financing excessive purchases are an example of the economic-capacity indicator.
The high-volume, high-value activity indicator applies to newly formed entities but excludes recently reactivated entities.
Mixing different trade finance products across segments of a transaction may show overly complex product use.
notes: True: p.4 The mismatch between own-account purchases and economic capacity is listed.
True: p.4 Sudden cash inflows or third-party transfers illustrate financing beyond apparent capacity.
False: p.4 Recently reactivated entities are expressly included alongside newly formed entities.
True: p.4 The mixing of different products across transaction segments is an example.

tc.q: 關於貿易融資及業務快速擴張，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 聲稱為實體自身購買但明顯超出其經濟能力的商品採購，屬風險指標。
突然存入現金以融資超出能力的採購，是經濟能力不符指標的例子。
大量高額貿易活動的指標適用於新成立實體，但不包括近期重新活躍的實體。
在一項貿易的不同環節混用各種貿易融資產品，可能顯示產品運用過度複雜。
notes: 正確：第4頁，原文列出自用名義採購與實體經濟能力明顯不符的情況。
正確：第4頁，原文以突然的現金存款或第三方轉帳支持超出經濟能力的交易為例。
錯誤：第4頁，原文明列新成立或近期重新活躍的實體，並沒有排除後者。
正確：第4頁，原文以在貿易交易不同環節混用不同融資產品作為例子。

source.tc: 《打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引》通函，第2項

en.q: A newly incorporated trade company has almost no assets, employees or active business. Which statements reflect the 2026 circular?
statements: The lack of an operating history makes this type of customer automatically suitable for simplified due diligence.
The MSO should proactively consider anti-fraud procedures to scrutinise customer information and transaction genuineness.
The originator belongs within the shell-company assessment, while the recipient falls outside its scope.
The MSO should consider funds-source and wealth-source information to understand the customer’s profile better.
notes: False: section 2 The circular highlights higher, not automatically lower, risk.
True: section 2 Anti-fraud scrutiny supports verification of transaction genuineness.
False: section 2 The assessment covers originator or recipient.
True: section 2 The circular calls for considering both types of source information.

tc.q: 新成立貿易公司幾乎沒有資產、僱員或活躍業務。哪些陳述符合2026年通函？
statements: 這類客戶缺乏營運歷史，便自動適合採用簡化盡職審查。
經營者應主動考慮反欺詐程序，審查客戶資料及核實交易真實性。
空殼公司評估範圍涵蓋匯款人，卻把收款人排除在外。
經營者應考慮索取資金來源及財富來源資料，以更有效了解客戶狀況。
notes: 錯誤：通函第2項，通函強調較高風險，而非自動較低風險。
正確：通函第2項，反欺詐程序用於審查資料及核實交易真實性。
錯誤：通函第2項，評估涵蓋匯款人或收款人，不能排除收款方。
正確：通函第2項，通函要求考慮兩類來源資料，而非只考慮匯款本身。

source.tc: 《打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引》通函，第3項

en.q: A monitoring alert concerns trade payments inconsistent with a customer’s history. Which responses follow the 2026 circular?
statements: Closing the alert without sufficient analysis is acceptable if the trade documents have a professional appearance.
Appropriate enquiries or additional CDD information can help establish whether grounds for suspicion exist.
The reasonableness assessment can consider the customer’s risk profile, funds and wealth sources and historical transactions.
The monitoring system may wait for proof of criminal conduct before generating an alert on unusual transactions.
notes: False: section 3 Document appearance does not replace sufficient justification and analysis.
True: section 3 These steps are expressly given for examining alerts.
True: section 3 All these contextual factors are listed.
False: section 3 Unusual or suspicious transactions are sufficient for identification and alerts.

tc.q: 監察警報涉及與客戶過往紀錄不符的貿易付款。哪些處理符合2026年通函？
statements: 貿易文件外觀專業，便可在沒有充分分析下結束警報。
適當查詢或額外盡職審查資料，可協助識別是否有懷疑理據。
合理性評估可考慮客戶風險狀況、資金及財富來源，以及交易歷史。
監察系統可等待證實犯罪後，才對不尋常交易發出警報。
notes: 錯誤：通函第3項，文件外觀不能取代充分理由及分析。
正確：通函第3項，通函把這些步驟列作調查警報的例子。
正確：通函第3項，原文列明這些背景因素均與交易合理性相關。
錯誤：通函第3項，不尋常或可疑交易已屬應識別及作警報的對象。

en.q: A walk-in customer requests three linked occasional wire transfers of HK$3,000 to the same recipient within an hour. Which statements are correct?
statements: The total of HK$9,000 reaches the occasional wire-transfer CDD threshold despite each transfer being smaller.
The same recipient and short timeframe are relevant when judging whether the payments are linked.
Calling each payment a separate order conclusively prevents aggregation for the CDD threshold.
If laundering is suspected, the CDD duty would apply even had the linked total stayed below HK$8,000.
notes: True: ¶4.2.1–4.2.5 Linked operations are considered against the wire-transfer threshold.
True: ¶4.2.1–4.2.5 Recipient, sources and timeframe are relevant linking characteristics.
False: ¶4.2.1–4.2.5 Linkage depends on transaction characteristics, not the order labels.
True: ¶4.2.1–4.2.5 Suspicion is an independent CDD trigger irrespective of the occasional threshold.

tc.q: 街客在一小時內要求向同一收款人作三筆有關連的非經常電傳轉帳，每筆3,000港元。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 合共9,000港元達到非經常電傳轉帳的盡職審查門檻，即使每筆較小。
同一收款人及短暫時間間隔，是判斷付款是否有關連的因素。
把每筆付款稱作獨立訂單，便可分開計算每筆的盡職審查門檻。
如懷疑洗錢，即使有關連總額仍低於8,000港元，亦須盡職審查。
notes: 正確：第4.2.1–4.2.5段，有關連操作須一併考慮是否達到電傳轉帳門檻。
正確：第4.2.1–4.2.5段，收款人、來源及交易時間均屬判斷聯繫的相關特徵。
錯誤：第4.2.1–4.2.5段，交易聯繫取決於特徵而非訂單名稱。
正確：第4.2.1–4.2.5段，洗錢懷疑是獨立觸發條件，不受非經常交易門檻限制。

en.q: An individual presents an unexpired foreign passport and supplies a residential address, but staff insist only Hong Kong identity cards are acceptable. Which statements are correct?
statements: An unexpired passport is an example of a source that can support identity verification.
The customer’s nationality forms part of the minimum identification information to obtain.
Because a passport was shown, staff may omit obtaining any residential address information.
The document’s photograph helps meet the identification-document requirement for this individual.
notes: True: ¶4.3.2–4.3.5 A valid travel document is an accepted example; Hong Kong ID is not exclusive.
True: ¶4.3.2–4.3.5 Nationality appears in the minimum identification data list.
False: ¶4.3.2–4.3.5 Residential address information should still be obtained.
True: ¶4.3.2–4.3.5 Identification documents should contain the customer’s photograph.

tc.q: 個人客戶出示未過期外國護照及提供住址，但職員堅持只接受香港身份證。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 未過期護照是可用來支持身分核實的文件例子。
客戶的國籍屬最低限度應收集的身分識別資料。
客戶出示護照，即可讓職員省略索取其住址資料。
證件上的照片有助符合對此個人的身分證明文件要求。
notes: 正確：第4.3.2–4.3.5段，有效旅遊證件是認可例子，並非只能用香港身份證。
正確：第4.3.2–4.3.5段，國籍明列於最低識別資料清單。
錯誤：第4.3.2–4.3.5段，仍應向自然人客戶索取住址資料。
正確：第4.3.2–4.3.5段，取得的身分證明文件應載有客戶照片。

en.q: A company is owned 25% by May and 75% by a holding company; Ken ultimately controls management without owning shares. Which statements are correct?
statements: May qualifies as a beneficial owner through her holding of exactly 25% of the issued share capital.
Ken’s ultimate management control can make him a beneficial owner despite having no shares.
The MSO can stop at the holding company without identifying the relevant ultimate natural persons.
Identifying Ken as the controlling person removes the need to use the senior-managing-official fallback.
notes: False: ¶4.4.6–4.4.9 The ownership limb is more than 25%, not exactly 25%.
True: ¶4.4.6–4.4.9 Ultimate management control is a separate beneficial-ownership limb.
False: ¶4.4.6–4.4.9 Legal-person customers require tracing the relevant ultimate natural persons.
True: ¶4.4.6–4.4.9 The fallback is for the absence of a natural person meeting the beneficial-owner definition.

tc.q: 美持有公司25%股本，控股公司持有75%；健沒有股份但最終控制管理。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 美正好持有已發行股本25%，已憑此達到實益擁有人的股權標準。
健即使沒有股份，仍可因最終管理控制權而是實益擁有人。
經營者可停留於控股公司層面，不識別相關最終自然人。
已識別健為控制的自然人，便毋須改用高級管理人員後備安排。
notes: 錯誤：第4.4.6–4.4.9段，股本條件是多於25%，不是剛好25%。
正確：第4.4.6–4.4.9段，對管理的最終控制是實益擁有人的另一獨立條件。
錯誤：第4.4.6–4.4.9段，法人客戶須識別相關最終控制的自然人，不能只停留在公司層面。
正確：第4.4.6–4.4.9段，後備安排適用於沒有自然人符合實益擁有人定義的情況。

en.q: A corporate customer has nominees and bearer shares, some held by a registered custodian and some not deposited with one. Which statements are correct?
statements: For the custodied shares, independent evidence should identify the custodian and persons entitled to attached rights.
For uncustodied shares, one declaration on opening removes the need for annual declarations thereafter.
The nominee arrangement requires evidence of both the nominee and the person for whom the nominee acts.
Ownership changes in uncustodied bearer shares may wait for the next annual declaration before notification.
notes: True: ¶4.4.13–4.4.18 Custodian confirmation should identify the custodian and persons entitled to the share rights.
False: ¶4.4.13–4.4.18 Declarations are needed before opening and annually thereafter for such shares.
True: ¶4.4.13–4.4.18 Both sides of the nominee arrangement must be established.
False: ¶4.4.13–4.4.18 The customer should notify ownership changes immediately.

tc.q: 公司客戶有代名人及持票人股份，部分股份由註冊保管人持有，部分未存放於保管人。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 已保管股份須有獨立證據，識別保管人及享有股份所附權利的人。
未保管股份在開戶時聲明一次，即可免除其後每年索取聲明的需要。
代名人安排須取得代名人及其所代表行事人士的身分證據。
未保管持票人股份的擁有權轉變，可等下次年度聲明才通知。
notes: 正確：第4.4.13–4.4.18段，獨立確認證據應包括保管人及有權享有股份權利人士的身分。
錯誤：第4.4.13–4.4.18段，此類股份須在開戶前及其後每年索取聲明。
正確：第4.4.13–4.4.18段，須確立代名人及其所代表人士的身分。
錯誤：第4.4.13–4.4.18段，客戶應即時知會股份擁有權的任何變動。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.5.4, ¶4.10.5; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第4.5.4, 第4.10.5段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第9題

en.q: A company sends one properly authorised employee, who is neither a director nor an owner, to establish a relationship face to face. Which statements are correct?
statements: The employee may act without being a director or beneficial owner, provided the authority is properly established.
One authorised natural person physically attending can meet the stated face-to-face attendance requirement.
The employee’s identity card serves as evidence of the company’s authorisation to establish the relationship.
Copies of the company’s verification documents may require additional measures to mitigate the increased risk.
notes: True: FAQ Q9 The Guideline does not mandate director or beneficial-owner status.
True: FAQ Q9 At least one, rather than two, authorised natural persons is required.
False: ¶4.5.4, ¶4.10.5 Authority requires appropriate documentary evidence in addition to identity.
True: ¶4.5.4, ¶4.10.5 Copies can increase risk even where a representative attends physically.

tc.q: 公司派一名獲適當授權、但並非董事或擁有人的僱員，親身建立業務關係。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 僱員如已獲適當授權，可代表公司行事，毋須必然是董事或實益擁有人。
一名獲授權自然人親身到場，可符合所述會面開戶的人數要求。
僱員的身份證可作為公司授權其建立業務關係的證據。
如使用公司核實文件的複本，可能須以額外措施減低增加的風險。
notes: 正確（常見問題第9題）：第4.5.4, 第4.10.5段，指引沒有規定代表必須是董事或實益擁有人。
正確（常見問題第9題）：第4.5.4, 第4.10.5段，規定是至少一名獲授權自然人親身出席，而非兩名。
錯誤：第4.5.4, 第4.10.5段，授權須有適當文件證據，身分文件本身不能必然證明公司授權。
正確：第4.5.4, 第4.10.5段，使用複本增加的風險仍須減低，不因代表到場而免除。

en.q: Verification remains incomplete after an MSO exceptionally starts a relationship; the customer now requests an unexplained payment to a stranger. Which statements are correct?
statements: Pending verification, appropriate limits should restrict the number, types or amounts of transactions.
The request qualifies for the third-party-payment exception simply because the customer urgently wants it.
If verification misses the set timeframe, the unexplained request is particularly relevant to considering an STR.
Having accepted the relationship prevents the MSO from including suspension among its follow-up actions.
notes: True: ¶4.7.3–4.7.4 Limits apply while verification is pending.
False: ¶4.7.3–4.7.4 The exception includes a low-risk assessment and senior management approval.
True: ¶4.7.3–4.7.4 An unjustified third-party payment request is a particular concern after timeout.
False: ¶4.7.3–4.7.4 Follow-up procedures may include suspension or termination.

tc.q: 經營者例外地先建立關係，但身分核實仍未完成；客戶現要求向陌生人付款而無合理解釋。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 身分核實仍未完成期間，經營者應適當限制可進行交易的次數、類別或款額。
客戶急於付款，便足以符合向第三方付款的例外安排。
如核實超出所訂時限，無合理解釋的付款要求尤其值得考慮可疑交易報告。
既已接受業務關係，經營者便不能把暫停關係列為跟進行動。
notes: 正確：第4.7.3–4.7.4段，核實未完成時應設適當交易限制。
錯誤：第4.7.3–4.7.4段，例外條件包括評估為低風險及高級管理層批准，急切本身不足夠。
正確：第4.7.3–4.7.4段，逾期後無合理理由要求向第三方付款，是特別須考慮報告的情況。
錯誤：第4.7.3–4.7.4段，逾時跟進程序可包括暫停或終止業務關係。

en.q: An MSO relies on an eligible intermediary’s own CDD; the intermediary plans to cease trading and has been slow to supply records. Which statements are correct?
statements: A promise to supply underlying records on cessation is relevant and should have been secured from the intermediary.
Sample retrieval tests from time to time can check whether documents are produced without undue delay.
The MSO must classify the arrangement as outsourcing because the intermediary applied its own CDD procedures.
If doubts arise about earlier CDD, reliance can continue unchanged because eligibility cures any earlier defects.
notes: True: ¶4.11.1–4.11.2, ¶4.11.5–4.11.7 The undertaking covers ceasing trading or ceasing to act as intermediary.
True: ¶4.11.1–4.11.2, ¶4.11.5–4.11.7 Sample tests check timely production upon demand.
False: ¶4.11.1–4.11.2, ¶4.11.5–4.11.7 Own procedures and an independent customer relationship characterise third-party reliance.
False: ¶4.11.1–4.11.2, ¶4.11.5–4.11.7 Doubts require action rather than treating eligibility as a cure.

tc.q: 經營者依賴合資格中介人的自身盡職審查；中介人計劃停業，且供應紀錄一向緩慢。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 應取得中介人在停業時提供相關紀錄的承諾，這項承諾在此仍然重要。
不時抽樣測試取閱紀錄，可檢查文件是否能不受不當延誤地提供。
中介人採用自己的盡職審查程序，因此經營者必須把安排列為外判。
即使對早前盡職審查產生疑慮，中介人合資格仍可使經營者維持原有依賴。
notes: 正確：第4.11.1–4.11.2, 第4.11.5–4.11.7段，承諾須涵蓋停業或停止擔任中介人的情況。
正確：第4.11.1–4.11.2, 第4.11.5–4.11.7段，抽樣測試用於確保要求時能及時提供文件。
錯誤：第4.11.1–4.11.2, 第4.11.5–4.11.7段，自己的程序及獨立客戶關係是第三方依賴的特徵。
錯誤：第4.11.1–4.11.2, 第4.11.5–4.11.7段，對早前審查有疑慮須採取行動，合資格本身不會彌補缺失。

en.q: A remote individual customer is verified through a digital identification system recognised by CCE as reliable and independent. Which statements are correct?
statements: The specified digital-system exception can remove the additional-measure requirement for non-face-to-face identification.
Every commercial identity app qualifies for the non-face-to-face exception if the customer finds the app convenient.
Outside an exception, the extent of extra measures should reflect the product characteristics and assessed risks.
Where supplementary measures are used, the MSO should be able to show they adequately guard against impersonation.
notes: True: ¶4.10.1–4.10.4 Verification by a qualifying recognised digital system is an express exception.
False: ¶4.10.1–4.10.4 The system must have the specified CCE recognition.
True: ¶4.10.1–4.10.4 Risk and product characteristics govern the extent of additional measures.
True: ¶4.10.1–4.10.4 Impersonation-risk protection must be demonstrable.

tc.q: 遙距個人客戶透過關長認可為可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統核實身分。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 所述數碼系統例外，可免除非會面身分識別的額外措施要求。
客戶覺得方便，便可讓商業身分應用程式符合這項例外。
不屬例外時，額外措施程度應反映產品特點及所評估的風險。
使用補充措施時，經營者應能證明措施可充分防範冒認身分風險。
notes: 正確：第4.10.1–4.10.4段，透過符合條件的認可數碼系統核實，是明列的例外。
錯誤：第4.10.1–4.10.4段，系統須獲關長作指定認可，並非所有商業程式均可。
正確：第4.10.1–4.10.4段，額外措施程度按風險及產品特點決定。
正確：第4.10.1–4.10.4段，經營者應能證明補充措施可充分防範冒認風險。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶5.2, ¶5.6, ¶5.8; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q22
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第5.2, 第5.6, 第5.8段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第22題

en.q: A customer uses several accounts in different business lines; each looks ordinary separately, but combined activity has changed substantially. Which statements are correct?
statements: A holistic monitoring approach can require considering the accounts together across business lines.
The CDD file can remain untouched until the next routine review regardless of material trigger events.
The monitoring system’s thresholds should be documented and independently validated rather than assumed effective.
An intermediary can assist with collecting updated CDD information without replacing the MSO’s ongoing duty.
notes: True: ¶5.2, ¶5.6, ¶5.8 Holistic monitoring may cover multiple accounts across business lines.
False: ¶5.2, ¶5.6, ¶5.8 Trigger events can require review alongside the periodic cycle.
True: ¶5.2, ¶5.6, ¶5.8 Parameters and thresholds require documentation and independent validation.
True: FAQ Q22 Intermediary assistance with updates is permitted.

tc.q: 客戶使用不同業務線的多個帳戶；逐個看似正常，但合併活動已大幅改變。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 整體監察方法可要求跨業務線一併考慮這些帳戶。
無論有何重大觸發事件，盡職審查檔案均可留待下次例行覆核。
應記錄及獨立驗證監察系統門檻，而非假設門檻有效。
中介人可協助收集更新的盡職審查資料，但不會取代經營者的持續責任。
notes: 正確：第5.2, 第5.6, 第5.8段，整體方法可涵蓋不同業務線的多個帳戶。
錯誤：第5.2, 第5.6, 第5.8段，定期週期以外，觸發事件亦可要求覆核。
正確：第5.2, 第5.6, 第5.8段，參數及門檻須記錄並獨立驗證。
正確（常見問題第22題）：第5.2, 第5.6, 第5.8段，可利用中介人協助收集及協調更新資料。

en.q: An unusual payment is explained satisfactorily after enquiries, but the enquiry also reveals a lasting change in the customer’s business. Which statements are correct?
statements: The MSO may conclude there are no grounds for suspicion from the transaction after a satisfactory explanation.
The absence of suspicion prevents the MSO from updating the customer’s risk profile using the new information.
The findings and reasons for closing the enquiry should be recorded in writing and remain available for authorised review.
If the explanation had been unsatisfactory, the Guideline would require an automatic conclusion of suspicion.
notes: True: ¶5.10–5.12, ¶5.14 A satisfactory explanation may support a no-suspicion conclusion.
False: ¶5.10–5.12, ¶5.14 Relevant new information should still be considered for updating the risk profile.
True: ¶5.10–5.12, ¶5.14 Written findings, outcomes and decision rationale are required.
False: ¶5.10–5.12, ¶5.14 The Guideline says the MSO may, not must, conclude there are grounds.

tc.q: 查詢後，不尋常付款獲滿意解釋，但亦揭示客戶業務有持續性的改變。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經滿意解釋後，經營者可斷定此交易沒有懷疑理據。
沒有懷疑便妨礙經營者利用新資料更新客戶風險狀況。
應以書面記錄查詢發現及結束理由，並備供獲授權覆核。
如解釋未能令人滿意，指引便要求自動斷定已有懷疑。
notes: 正確：第5.10–5.12, 第5.14段，滿意解釋可以支持沒有懷疑的結論。
錯誤：第5.10–5.12, 第5.14段，即使沒有懷疑，仍應考慮利用相關資料更新風險狀況。
正確：第5.10–5.12, 第5.14段，發現、結果及決定理據須以書面妥為記錄。
錯誤：第5.10–5.12, 第5.14段，指引用語是可斷定，而非必須自動斷定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第6.12–6.15段

en.q: A low-risk customer appears on a newly announced UN list not yet implemented through Hong Kong legislation. Which statements are correct?
statements: The MSO may ignore the new entry entirely until local legislation catches up with the UN announcement.
The internal database should be updated in a timely manner and be accessible to relevant staff.
A consolidated database helps detect possible designated parties as well as prohibited transactions.
Training can be omitted for sanctions staff because a commercial database supplies the list automatically.
notes: False: ¶6.12–6.15 A listing can create knowledge or suspicion under existing laws before implementation.
True: ¶6.12–6.15 Timely update and easy access are required database features.
True: ¶6.12–6.15 The database supports identifying designated parties and prohibited transactions.
False: ¶6.12–6.15 Staff still need guidance and training on their obligations.

tc.q: 低風險客戶出現在新公布、尚未經香港立法實施的聯合國名單。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在本地立法追上聯合國公告前，經營者可不處理新名單項目。
內部數據庫應及時更新，並讓相關職員容易取閱。
綜合數據庫有助識別可能被指認各方，以及偵測被禁止交易。
商業數據庫自動供應名單，因此可省略制裁職員培訓。
notes: 錯誤：第6.12–6.15段，未完成本地立法實施前，名單仍可能構成現行法律下的知悉或懷疑理據。
正確：第6.12–6.15段，數據庫須及時更新及讓相關職員容易取閱。
正確：第6.12–6.15段，數據庫支持識別被指認各方及被禁止交易。
錯誤：第6.12–6.15段，職員仍須接受責任方面的充分導引及培訓。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶10.7–10.9; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q25 and Guideline footnote 70
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第10.7–10.9段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第25題及指引註腳70

en.q: An ordering MSO processes a wire transfer without an account number after previously verifying the originator under the applicable requirements. Which statements are correct?
statements: A substitute unique reference number must still permit the transfer to be traced.
Previously compliant identity verification can make the required originator information deemed accurate.
The ordering MSO has no discretion to verify again even if this particular case warrants it.
Any customer identification number used must refer to a record held by the beneficiary institution.
notes: True: ¶10.7–10.9 A substitute reference must permit traceability.
True: FAQ Q25 Accuracy is deemed when identity was verified in accordance with the requirements.
False: FAQ Q25 Further verification is normally unnecessary but remains discretionary in individual cases.
False: ¶10.7–10.9 The relevant record is held by the ordering institution.

tc.q: 匯款機構處理沒有帳戶號碼的電傳轉帳，並已按適用規定核實匯款人。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 替代的獨特參考編號仍須使該筆電傳轉帳可被追蹤。
先前符合規定的身分核實，可使所需匯款人資料視作準確。
即使此個案有需要，匯款機構亦沒有酌情再核實資料的權力。
所用客戶識別號碼須指向收款機構所保存的紀錄。
notes: 正確：第10.7–10.9段，替代參考編號必須可追蹤電傳轉帳。
正確（常見問題第25題）：第10.7–10.9段，按條例及指引核實身分後，所需資料可視作準確。
錯誤（常見問題第25題）：第10.7–10.9段，通常不必再核實，但個別情況仍可酌情進一步核實。
錯誤：第10.7–10.9段，有關紀錄應由匯款機構持有，而非收款機構。

en.q: An ordering MSO batches one originator’s overseas transfers and separately sends domestic transfers without full originator details. Which statements are correct?
statements: The overseas batch file should include the required recipient information as well as required accurate originator information.
For the incomplete domestic transfer, complete originator information must be available immediately on a law-enforcement request.
Regular audit or internal-control testing can help identify outgoing transfers missing required information.
Finding an information-control defect calls for timely rectification, alongside risk-based handling policies.
notes: True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 The batch file must contain both categories, fully traceable in the recipient country.
True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 Domestic originator information should be available immediately to law enforcement.
True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 Regular review or testing is an example of a reasonable detection measure.
True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 Risk-based handling and timely rectification are both required.

tc.q: 匯款機構把同一匯款人的海外轉帳批量處理，另有本地轉帳未附完整匯款人資料。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 海外批量檔案除所需準確匯款人資料外，亦應包含所需收款人資料。
本地轉帳未附完整資料時，執法機構要求後應即時可取得完整匯款人資料。
定期審核或內部管控測試，可協助識別欠缺所需資料的匯出轉帳。
發現資料管控缺失時，應及時糾正，並備有風險為本處理政策。
notes: 正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，批量檔案應包括兩類資料，並可在收款人國家全面追蹤。
正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，執法機構要求時，應即時可提供本地轉帳匯款人資料。
正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，定期覆核或測試是識別欠缺資料的合理措施例子。
正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，所列要求包括風險為本處理及及時糾正缺失。

en.q: A cross-border transfer loses accompanying information when an intermediary converts it to a domestic message because of technical limits. Which statements are correct?
statements: The intermediary may discard the received information once the domestic transfer has been completed.
The intermediary should use reasonable measures consistent with straight-through processing to detect missing information.
Every transfer with missing information must automatically be executed because the problem is technical.
The beneficiary institution may include post-event monitoring among measures to detect missing required information.
notes: False: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Technical limitations trigger retention of all received information for at least five years.
True: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Reasonable detection measures must be consistent with straight-through processing.
False: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Risk-based policies determine execution, rejection or suspension and follow-up.
True: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Post-event monitoring is expressly an example for beneficiary institutions.

tc.q: 跨境轉帳因技術限制，在中介機構轉為本地訊息時未能保留隨附資料。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 本地轉帳完成後，中介機構便可丟棄收到的資料。
中介機構應採取與直接處理方式相符的合理措施，識別缺漏資料。
欠缺資料被歸類為技術問題，因此每筆此類轉帳均須自動執行。
收款機構可把事後監察列為識別缺少所需資料的措施。
notes: 錯誤：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，技術限制下應把收到的全部資料保存最少五年。
正確：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，識別欠缺資料的合理措施須與直接處理方式相符。
錯誤：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，應按風險為本政策決定執行、拒絕或暫停及跟進。
正確：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，指引明列收款機構可用事後監察作識別措施。

en.q: A beneficiary institution receives a HK$9,000 wire transfer with meaningless originator information; the recipient’s identity was previously verified. Which statements are correct?
statements: Prior verification means the amount alone does not require the recipient’s identity to be verified afresh.
The prior recipient verification makes meaningless originator information acceptable without risk-mitigation steps.
Risk-based handling procedures should determine execution, rejection or suspension and suitable follow-up.
Domestic transfers fall outside the duty to detect missing required information that applies to international transfers.
notes: True: ¶10.19–10.22 At or above the threshold, recipient verification is required if not previously verified.
False: ¶10.19–10.22 Meaningless accompanying information requires reasonable risk-mitigation measures.
True: ¶10.19–10.22 The beneficiary institution needs risk-based handling and follow-up policies.
False: ¶10.19–10.22 Beneficiary detection covers domestic and cross-border transfers alike.

tc.q: 收款機構收到9,000港元轉帳，匯款人資料無意義；收款人身分先前已核實。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 既已核實身分，毋須僅因轉帳款額而再次核實收款人身分。
收款人已核實，便使無意義的匯款人資料可在不減低風險下接受。
應按風險為本程序決定執行、拒絕或暫停，並作適當跟進。
本地轉帳不在適用於跨境轉帳的識別欠缺所需資料責任範圍內。
notes: 正確：第10.19–10.22段，達門檻時的核實要求適用於先前尚未核實的收款人。
錯誤：第10.19–10.22段，隨附資料無意義須採取合理減低風險措施，收款人核實不能代替。
正確：第10.19–10.22段，收款機構須備有風險為本處理及跟進政策。
錯誤：第10.19–10.22段，收款機構識別要求同時涵蓋本地及跨境轉帳。

en.q: A trustee establishes a relationship for a family trust whose beneficiaries are defined as the settlor’s children. Which statements are correct?
statements: The trustee acting for the trust should also be regarded as a customer and have its identity verified.
Defining beneficiaries by class removes the need to obtain information about that class before payout.
Any protector and any other natural person with ultimate control belong within the relevant identification exercise.
A redacted trust deed suffices even where exceptional circumstances do not justify its use.
notes: True: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 The trustee entering the relationship on behalf of the trust is also a customer.
False: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 Sufficient information is needed to establish identity at payout or exercise of vested rights.
True: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 The trust identification scope includes protector and ultimate controllers.
False: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 Use of a redacted copy is framed as an exceptional circumstance.

tc.q: 受託人為家族信託建立關係，受益人按財產授予人的子女類別界定。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 代表信託行事的受託人亦應視為客戶，並核實其身分。
按類別界定受益人，可免除在付款前取得該類別相關資料的需要。
任何保護人及其他有最終控制權的自然人，屬相關識別工作的範圍。
經編輯的信託契據仍然足夠，即使缺乏支持採用的特殊情況。
notes: 正確：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，代表信託建立關係的受託人亦屬客戶。
錯誤：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，須先取得足夠資料，以在付款或行使歸屬權益時確立身分。
正確：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，信託識別範圍包括保護人及最終控制的自然人。
錯誤：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，採用經編輯副本屬特殊情況安排，不是無條件規則。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q21
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第21題

en.q: A former non-Hong Kong PEP supplies the name of a sending bank and says retirement automatically ended all enhanced checks. Which statements are correct?
statements: Knowing the sending bank’s name establishes the activity that generated the particular funds.
A fixed period out of office does not by itself automatically end the former PEP’s enhanced measures.
Source of wealth is the origin of the particular remittance, rather than the person’s overall wealth.
Suitable overseas senior management may approve where the MSO’s organisational arrangements support this.
notes: False: ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25 Source of funds extends beyond the transfer location to the activity generating the funds.
True: ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25 Former PEP treatment requires risk assessment rather than an automatic prescribed period.
False: ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25 The description given is source of funds, not source of wealth.
True: FAQ Q21 Senior management can include personnel in another jurisdiction where appropriate.

tc.q: 一名已卸任非香港政治人物提供匯出銀行名稱，並稱退休自動終止一切更嚴格審查。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 知道匯出銀行名稱，已能確立產生該筆特定資金的活動。
卸任達某固定年期，本身不會自動終止前政治人物的更嚴格措施。
財富來源是這筆特定匯款的來源，而不是當事人的整體財富來源。
如符合組織及風險管理安排，合適的海外高級管理人員可作審批。
notes: 錯誤：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，資金來源不僅是匯出地點，亦包括產生資金的活動。
正確：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，前政治人物的處理須按風險判斷，而非自動按固定年期終止。
錯誤：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，陳述描述的是資金來源，而非財富來源。
正確（常見問題第21題）：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，視乎組織架構及風險管理做法，高級管理層可包括其他司法管轄區人員。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.4.5; Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024, controls 6, 8–9 and 11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第4.4.5段；第三方付款通函，管控措施第6、8至9及11項

en.q: An individual receives frequent funding from an unrelated payer, but claims there is no need to identify anyone beyond the named customer. Which statements are correct?
statements: Indications that the customer acts for someone else should prompt enquiries about beneficial ownership.
The payer may itself be the true beneficial owner, a possibility the MSO should consider.
Difficulty verifying the relationship with the unrelated payer is a reason to exercise less scrutiny.
Documented enquiry findings and corroboration help demonstrate the third-party payment’s acceptance assessment.
notes: True: ¶4.4.5 The ordinary natural-person assumption yields to indications of acting for others.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 6, 8–9 and 11: The third-party circular expressly highlights the true-owner possibility.
False: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 6, 8–9 and 11: Difficulty verifying the relationship calls for extra caution.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 6, 8–9 and 11: Findings and corroborative evidence should be documented.

tc.q: 個人客戶經常由無關連付款人提供資金，卻稱毋須識別客戶以外任何人。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 有跡象顯示客戶代表他人行事時，應就實益擁有權作適當查詢。
付款人本身可能才是真正實益擁有人，經營者應留意這種可能。
難以核實與無關連付款人的關係，是應減少審查的理由。
記錄查詢發現及佐證，有助顯示如何評估是否接納第三方付款。
notes: 正確：第4.4.5段，如有代他人行事跡象，不能只依賴自然人客戶通常就是實益擁有人的假設。
正確：第三方付款通函第6、8至9及11項，第三方付款通函特別提醒付款人可能是真正實益擁有人。
錯誤：第三方付款通函第6、8至9及11項，難以核實關係應提高警惕，並非減少審查。
正確：第三方付款通函第6、8至9及11項，評估及審批中的查詢發現及佐證應妥為記錄。

source.tc: 第三方付款通函，管控措施第2、6及8至9項

en.q: An MSO is asked to accept payments by one unregulated person for several unrelated customers, without a credible commercial explanation. Which statements are correct?
statements: Repeated payments by the same person establish low risk simply because the payer is familiar to staff.
The reasons and need for the payments, payer identity and customer relationship should be critically assessed.
The MSO can replace management approval with the customer’s written assurance that the payment is legitimate.
Potentially suspicious activity calls for enquiries and investigation; a report does not require proof of laundering.
notes: False: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: A single payer for unrelated customers is a specific extra-caution situation.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: Due diligence includes reasons, identity and relationship.
False: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: Acceptance requires stringent management approval, not a customer assurance substitute.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: Suspicion, rather than confirmed laundering, is the reporting threshold.

tc.q: 經營者被要求接受同一未受規管人士為多個無關連客戶付款，卻沒有可信的商業解釋。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 職員熟悉反覆付款的同一人，即可把相關重複付款評為低風險。
應審慎評估付款理由及需要、付款人身分，以及其與客戶的關係。
經營者可用客戶聲稱付款合法的書面保證，取代管理層批准。
可能可疑的活動須查詢及調查，提交報告並不要求先證實洗錢。
notes: 錯誤：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，同一付款人為無關連客戶付款，是須額外警惕的特定情況。
正確：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，第三方付款盡職審查包括理由、身分及關係。
錯誤：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，接納須受嚴格管理層審批，客戶保證不能取代。
正確：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，報告以懷疑為門檻，而非已證實洗錢。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.7; Sample Questions MSSB/CA_01/2021, Example (5)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.7段；參考試題 MSSB/CA_01/2021 例子(5)

en.q: To fulfil the statutory suspicious transaction reporting obligations, the appropriate AML/CFT Systems for an MSO licensee should include:
statements: appointment of an Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
shortlisting internal reports by the frontline staff before reporting to the MLRO
implementing clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the Joint Financial Investigation Unit, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off
keeping proper records of internal reports and Suspicious Transaction Reports
notes: Correct: ¶7.7(a) lists the appointment of an MLRO.
Incorrect: ¶7.7 lists an MLRO, clear policies and procedures, and proper records; frontline staff shortlisting internal reports before they reach the MLRO is not among them.
Correct: ¶7.7(b) lists clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the JFIU, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off.
Correct: ¶7.7(c) lists keeping proper records of internal reports and STRs.

tc.q: 為履行法定的可疑交易舉報責任，金錢服務經營者持牌人適當的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度須包括：
statements: 委任一名洗錢報告主任
向洗錢報告主任報告前，先由前線人員篩選內部報告
就內部報告、向財富情報組作出報告、作出報告後如何減低風險及防止通風報訊執行清晰的政策和程序
備存內部報告及可疑交易報告的妥善紀錄
notes: 正確：第7.7(a)段列出委任一名洗錢報告主任。
不正確：第7.7段列出的是委任洗錢報告主任、執行清晰的政策和程序及備存妥善紀錄；由前線人員先篩選內部報告並不在其中。
正確：第7.7(b)段列出就內部報告、向財富情報組作出報告、作出報告後如何減低風險及防止通風報訊執行清晰的政策和程序。
正確：第7.7(c)段列出備存內部報告及可疑交易報告的妥善紀錄。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.3.5 and ¶8.3; Sample Questions MSSB/CA_01/2021, Example (6)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.5及8.3段；參考試題 MSSB/CA_01/2021 例子(6)

en.q: For the record-keeping requirement on CDD and transactions, which of the following data or information should be kept?
statements: The identity document of the beneficial owner of the customer
The results of any analysis undertaken
The residential address information of the customer
The account opening record of the customer
